jobs.title: Spacecraft Systems Engineer II, Avionics
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Spacecraft Systems Engineer II, Avionics oversees the design, integration, and testing of avionics systems for our Winnebago Spaceship. They ensure that all systems are ready for both launch and operational phases, requiring a deep understanding of avionics system design, manufacturing processes, and operational protocols. They closely collaborate with various engineering teams and navigate conflicting requirements to achieve seamless system integration. Their expertise will be crucial in ensuring the vehicle meets its mission objectives, from space manufacturing to hypersonic testing during reentry.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with cross functional teams to define project scopes and initial requirements, guiding designs from concept to prototype and full-scale production.

• Develop electrical architecture, system diagrams, and budgets to account for power, telemetry, channel count, size, and mass predictions used to communicate closing vehicle solutions to company level objectives.

• Analyze architecture for potential faults and risks, develop comprehensive mitigation plans, resolve uncertainties, and collaborate on Fault Detection Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) or operational workarounds when hardware solutions are unfeasible.

• Conduct comprehensive verification plans for avionics systems on flight and HITL hardware, ensuring readiness for launch and compliance with mission objectives for space and reentry operations.

• Participate in mission operations as an Avionics specialist or system operator, where they’ll determine system health, suggest corrective actions to reentry commit criteria for operational success.

• Oversee the integration of the Winnebago avionics systems, acting as the primary point of contact for integrated systems investigations.

• Design, build, and operate the Hardware In The Loop (HITL) testbeds, simulating the spacecraft on the ground to ensure all systems are mission ready.

• Develop avionics ground infrastructure, support the design and integration of test racks and R&D equipment used to power and communicate with the flight vehicles. Contribute to developing engineering best practices, focusing on increased test automation and efficiency.

• Draw from their experiences to help mentor and train new engineers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement within the team.

Basic Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.

• Experience: 3+ years of experience in system design, test planning, and validation.

• Programming Skills: Proficiency in programming and debugging with Python.

• Technical Expertise: Experience with power supplies, modular DAQ systems, RTD and 4-20mA devices, and general test equipment.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Proven experience taking vehicle electrical systems from concept to operational production.

• Prior experience setting up HITL testbeds, managing configuration control, and conducting system level tests.

• Familiarity with Unix environments and the ability to use command line utilities.

• Experience developing test cases and test equipment to meet vehicle operating conditions.

• Strong project or program management skills.

• Relevant prior roles: Avionics Hardware, FPGA Engineer, Electronics Test Engineer, Electrical Systems Engineer

Pay Range

• Salary range: Engineer II: $119,543 - $172,673/per year

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.title: Account Executive, Mid Market (West)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

• 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue

• All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah

An ideal candidate has:

• Proven track record of consistent quota achievement

• Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes

• Experience with high-volume cold calling

• Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process

• SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.




TEAM OVERVIEW

Demand Generation turns Deepgram's speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent products into enterprise pipeline across contact centers, healthcare, financial services, and more. This is a connecting role: you'll take every launch and program from brief to pipeline alongside Product Marketing, Events & Field Marketing, SDR leadership, Partner Marketing, Marketing Operations, Brand, Content, and Sales. You'll report to [Director, Demand Generation / VP, Demand Generation: confirm] and build the integrated campaign playbook the whole go-to-market team plans against, with room to grow into people leadership as the team expands.




KEY GOALS

 - Run every product launch with Product Marketing as one integrated campaign across paid digital, email, content, web, events, SDR outreach, and partners, mapped to personas and target accounts and scaled by launch tier.

 - Build the launch template and integrated campaign playbook so new launches, verticals, and regions plug in without a rebuild, making integrated campaigns a top source of pipeline.

 - Run always-on ABX programs for priority verticals and named accounts, keeping momentum between launches with vertical narratives, customer proof, and competitive plays.

 - Run pre-event, onsite, and post-event campaigns with Events & Field Marketing, including AWS re:Invent and Deepgram's flagship events, so booth meetings become pipeline.

 - Co-design sequences, talk tracks, and proof steps with SDR leadership for every campaign.

 - Run partner campaigns with Partner Marketing and partners like AWS, Twilio, and NVIDIA, including MDF-funded programs, with reporting that connects partner activity to pipeline.

 - Set KPIs before every launch, report weekly, and run a retro on each campaign; with Marketing Ops, show how campaigns move pipeline from first touch to closed deal, and make the call on what to scale and what to cut.

 - Own the cross-functional campaign calendar and intake process that Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, Content, Events, and Sales plan against.


MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & CAPABILITIES

 - Has taken a product launch to market as one integrated campaign across multiple channels, thinking in launch tiers, personas, and buyer journeys.

 - Runs account-based programs for enterprise buyers and can show the pipeline and revenue they produced.

 - Turns a positioning doc into one story across ad copy, email, landing page, and SDR opener, leading with the buyer's problem and proof rather than feature lists.

 - Builds campaign sequences hands-on with SDR teams in Outreach or a similar tool.

 - Knows Salesforce campaign structures well enough to trace campaigns, including partner and MDF programs, from first touch to closed deal, and builds the analysis that shows what's working.

 - Sets KPIs up front, runs honest retros, and cuts what isn't working.

 - Creates lightweight, agile processes like a shared calendar and intake that many teams actually use, and keeps alignment without formal authority.

 - Operates AI-native: builds human+AI workflows for briefs, copy variants, list building, and reporting.

 - Keeps rigor when the roadmap shifts and the plan changes often.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE-TO-HAVE, NOT REQUIRED)

 - Typically ~5–7 years in B2B marketing, including several years running integrated, ABM/ABX, or demand gen campaigns at a fast-growing technical company (dev tools, cloud, data infrastructure, or AI), or equivalent demonstrated experience.

 - Hands-on with HubSpot, Outreach, and Salesforce, plus Dreamdata or a similar attribution tool, and LinkedIn and Google Ads.

 - Ran hyperscaler or ISV co-marketing, including MDF programs.

 - Marketed to contact center, healthcare, financial services, or public-sector buyers.

 - Close working experience with product marketing on launches, value stories, and messaging.


OUR VALUES

 - Be You — bring your whole self and a different perspective; diverse viewpoints make our products better.

 - Be Curious — challenge the status quo, keep learning, and ask 'how might we?' instead of accepting limits.

 - Grow Together — push each other to do great work, treat feedback as a gift, and leave the drama out.

 - Do the Right Thing — act with integrity and candor, assume best intent, choose ethics over expediency.

 - Think Smart. Act Fast. — weigh the high-leverage options, decide, and move; no analysis paralysis.

 - Put the Customer First — listen with empathy, understand their goals, and let their success drive ours.



We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting great candidates — so please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Leader
jobs.description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

Who we’re looking for

As Arc's Manager, Talent Acquisition, you will own how Arc hires as we scale from flagship production into commercial and defense programs. That means building and leading the recruiting team, running a hiring engine that moves fast without cutting corners, and partnering with leaders across engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams to land the people who will electrify the water.

We're looking for someone fired up by the mission and ready to build. You'll thrive here if you move fast, take ownership, and care about the details.

This is a full-time, on-site role at our Los Angeles headquarters.

What You'll Do

• Leading, coaching, and growing a team of recruiters and coordinators, setting clear goals and raising the bar on candidate experience

• Owning Arc's hiring plan end to end, partnering with senior leadership on headcount timelines and prioritization, making smart tradeoffs when plans change

• Personally recruiting for our most critical and senior roles across engineering, manufacturing, operations, and commercial, finding the people who'll help us electrify an entire industry

• Building scalable recruiting processes, from intake and structured interviews to offer approvals and close

• Partnering with hiring managers as a trusted advisor on role design, market realities, compensation, and selection decisions

• Running Greenhouse and our recruiting tech stack, keeping the data clean, and using AI to help a small team do more, better, and more creatively

• Sharing pipeline health, time to fill, offer acceptance, and source quality openly, so leaders have the context to make smart decisions

• Getting creative about finding hard-to-fill technical and skilled trades talent, from passive candidates to people in automotive, aerospace, energy, and traditional marine who are ready for something new

• Telling Arc's story through job descriptions, outreach, events, university and veteran partnerships, and referral programs, making people want to be part of what we're building

• Building a hiring process where people from all backgrounds see themselves at Arc and feel like they'd belong here

• Ensuring hiring practices meet employment law and export control (ITAR) requirements as Arc expands into defense work

• Managing agency relationships and the recruiting budget with a bias toward building in-house capability

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with at least 2 years leading recruiters or a talent acquisition function

• Experience hiring across technical and non-technical roles, including engineering and manufacturing or skilled trades

• Background in a high-growth environment such as a startup, hardware, automotive, aerospace, or energy company

• Proficiency with an ATS (Greenhouse preferred) and using recruiting data to forecast, prioritize, and report

• Ability to influence senior leaders, push back with data, and keep hiring managers accountable

• Ability to build processes from scratch and still personally close top candidates

• Track record of scaling AI across a recruiting team to improve throughput, quality, and creativity, responsibly

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience recruiting in marine, EV, defense, or other regulated hardware industries

• Proficiency with ITAR or export-control screening and hiring for cleared or defense-adjacent roles

• Background scaling a recruiting team through a hypergrowth stage (for example, 100 to 500+ employees)

• Experience building university, apprenticeship, or veteran hiring programs

• Comfortable pushing a fast but sustainable pace

• Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base salary for this role is M3: $190,000; M4: $220,000 annually.

Highly competitive equity grants are included with full time offers. As well as semi-annual bonuses tied to your impact, not just your tenure.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Healthcare benefits — 99% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision

• Parental leave — 14 weeks fully paid for birthing and non-birthing parents

• Generous time off — Highly competitive PTO with an opportunity to earn more time with tenure

• Income protection — Life and disability insurance for all employees

• Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access

• Water fund — $500 for you to spend each year to get out on the water, however you choose

• Professional development — $500 annual reimbursement for professional development and a monthly AI stipend

• Safety Support — Annual reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe

• Captain training — Training and access to take Arc boats out with friends and family

• Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite

• Relocation assistance — Available depending on role eligibility.

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

• Ownership over both your work and the company’s success

• Empathy for colleagues and for customers

• Humility in problem solving and collaboration

• Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly

• Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Accounting Operations
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Manager, Accounting Operations to lead accounts payable and billing and collections as one function. You'll own procure-to-pay and order-to-cash from end to end, with teams across the US, the Philippines and Colombia.

This is an accounting-led role. AP and AR sit at the start of our financial data. When an invoice gets paid without a PO, or a bill goes out at the wrong price, the problem lands in the general ledger weeks later. We want a leader who understands the accounting impact of every transaction and builds controls to get the data right at the source.

Dandy runs high-volume physical operations: two US manufacturing labs, dental practice and DSO customers in several countries, a large vendor base and multiple legal entities. You'll bring accounting rigor and scale to the teams behind every dollar in and out.

 - A working collections process for aged receivables and a lower DSO.

 - AP and AR reconciliations complete early in the close, with no audit adjustments.

 - Documented SOPs and controls for every core AP and AR process.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Events & Field Marketing
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.




TEAM OVERVIEW

Events and field marketing are Deepgram's largest demand generation investment, and this role owns North America. Reporting to the Director of Demand Gen, you'll run 20+ trade shows and conferences each year, partner co-hosted programs, and field programs with Sales, splitting your time between flagship brand moments and programs that move target accounts. You'll help set event strategy with marketing leadership and work closely with regional sales leaders, Product Marketing, alliances, Demand Generation, SDRs, and Marketing Operations. The role starts as a senior individual contributor, with room to grow a team.




KEY GOALS

 - Run the North America trade show and sponsorship portfolio end to end, from turnkey kiosks to flagship presences at AWS re:Invent and Dreamforce, including budget, MDF and partner co-op funding, contracts, and vendors.

 - Help set event strategy, the annual plan, and the calendar for third-party and hosted events with marketing leadership, backed by data on budget, investment tiering, and portfolio mix.

 - Equip Sales, alliances, and Demand Generation before and after marquee events so they invite the right accounts and turn attendance into pipeline, expansion, and retention.

 - Keep every event on product messaging and the voice of the customer, timed to product launches and sales priorities.

 - Design and run field programs with regional sales leaders, such as executive dinners, roadshows, customer events, and account-based plays against named target accounts.

 - Co-host events with hyperscaler, CCaaS, and voice AI partners like AWS, Twilio, Five9, and NVIDIA, so Deepgram shows up where their customers already are.

 - Concept and deliver brand activations at competitor-heavy shows, from stadium takeovers to interactive demos and hosted moments.

 - Close the loop on every program with same-day lead logging, a fast-follow SLA with Sales, clean SDR routing, and a standard post-event scorecard tied to pipeline and cost per opportunity.

 - Grow Deepgram Speak as a first-party event series and support community programming in our SF and NYC offices.


MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & CAPABILITIES

 - Has run flagship presences at large-scale shows (re:Invent, Dreamforce, or similar) end to end: contracting, booth, logistics, staffing, speakers, and lead capture.

 - Owns both trade shows and field programs hands-on, and treats regional sales leaders as core partners.

 - Shapes an annual event plan, not only executes one: makes tiering and portfolio calls with data and can explain what to cut and why.

 - Ties event and field activity to sourced and influenced pipeline in Salesforce, working with Marketing Ops on campaign setup, attribution, and lead routing.

 - Analyzes funnel metrics and event ROI, and presents clear recommendations to executive and sales leadership.

 - Manages program budgets, negotiates vendor contracts, and holds agencies to quality and timelines.

 - Takes an original creative concept from sketch to a fully produced experience.

 - Operates AI-native: builds AI and automation workflows that cut manual work in planning, logistics, comms, and reporting, and turns them into playbooks others adopt.

 - Flags risks and opportunities early and keeps many stakeholders aligned through clear communication.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE-TO-HAVE, NOT REQUIRED)

 - Typically ~7–10 years in B2B events and/or field marketing, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

 - Managed a 7-figure annual program budget.

 - Co-marketed events with hyperscalers (AWS especially) or channel partners, including MDF management.

 - Hands-on with modern event tech: registration platforms, lead retrieval, meeting booking tools, mobile event apps, and CRM/MAP integrations.

 - Background at AI, developer tools, API, or infrastructure companies, or familiarity with CX/contact center, healthcare, or fintech buyer communities.


OUR VALUES

 - Be You — bring your whole self and a different perspective; diverse viewpoints make our products better.

 - Be Curious — challenge the status quo, keep learning, and ask 'how might we?' instead of accepting limits.

 - Grow Together — push each other to do great work, treat feedback as a gift, and leave the drama out.

 - Do the Right Thing — act with integrity and candor, assume best intent, choose ethics over expediency.

 - Think Smart. Act Fast. — weigh the high-leverage options, decide, and move; no analysis paralysis.

 - Put the Customer First — listen with empathy, understand their goals, and let their success drive ours.



We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting great candidates — so please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Battery Failure Analysis Engineer
jobs.description:
About the job

Delart is home to a team of world-class engineers and project leaders dedicated to developing the next generation of advanced networking technologies, consumer devices, and innovative technology solutions. Trusted by some of the world’s leading technology companies, we deliver highly scalable, mission-critical solutions that power both consumer and business applications globally. Since our founding in 2017, we have been at the forefront of designing cutting-edge networking, telecommunications, and consumer products, while driving end-to-end project execution and creating transformative technology applications.

Overview

Join our team as a Battery Failure Analysis Engineer, with hands-on responsibility for operating and maintaining a CT scan system used to analyze battery cells, modules, and packs. This role is central to uncovering and interpreting internal defects through advanced imaging, directly supporting root-cause investigations across various battery form factors. You will serve as a technical bridge between cell manufacturing, battery design, and failure analysis, generating actionable insights for design, quality, and validation efforts.

Responsibilities

• Independently operate CT scan equipment for battery cells, modules, and packs, including sample preparation, fixturing, scan parameter selection, and scheduling in a lab environment.

• Interpret 2D and 3D CT images to identify defects such as electrode misalignment, jellyroll deformation, welding issues, foreign material inclusions, electrolyte dry-out, swelling, and mechanical damage.

• Compile clear and detailed failure analysis reports, including annotated images, measurements, and actionable conclusions for cross-functional teams in design, quality, and validation.

• Conduct battery teardowns and complementary failure analysis in dry room or glovebox settings when needed, ensuring adherence to safety protocols.

• Maintain CT system calibration, perform routine troubleshooting, and coordinate with equipment vendors for service or repairs.

• Enforce strict compliance with radiation, laser, and battery safety standards during CT scan operation and handling of potentially hazardous or damaged lithium-ion cells.

• Support battery validation activities by correlating CT imaging results with electrical, mechanical, and abuse testing data.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in battery failure analysis, with a deep background in cell design and structure.

• Comprehensive understanding of cell manufacturing processes, including electrode coating, calendaring, winding/stacking, electrolyte filling, and formation cycling.

• Demonstrated experience operating and interpreting results from CT/X-ray inspection systems for battery analysis.

• Advanced training and adherence to safety protocols for both CT system operation and lithium-ion cell handling.

Preferred Qualifications

• 10+ years total experience in battery failure analysis and cell engineering roles, spanning multiple cell chemistries and formats (cylindrical, pouch, prismatic).

• Proficiency in conducting detailed cell teardowns and failure investigations across a range of battery types, including hard-can designs.

• Familiarity with additional analytical techniques, such as SEM/EDS, cross-sectioning, and optical microscopy for root-cause investigations.

• Experience with battery validation, including electrical, thermal, and mechanical abuse testing methodologies.

• Ability to operate independently in a laboratory environment and effectively communicate technical findings to diverse engineering and development teams.

CA Base Pay

$125,000—$170,000 USD

Benefits

Delart provides competitive benefits and compensation across all regions where we operate. In the United States, our benefits package includes premium PPO and HMO medical insurance, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, a company-matched 401(k) plan, and a generous paid time off policy.

Join us in shaping the future of technology. Apply today!

Delart is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace for all employees. We strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Scientist – HIV-SOMAL
jobs.description:
(ID: 2026-3884)

Axle is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Benefits We Offer:

• 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• 401K match up to 5%

• Educational Benefits for Career Growth

• Employee Referral Bonus

• Flexible Spending Accounts: Healthcare (FSA) Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK) Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP) Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Position Overview

The Bioinformatics Scientist will address the bioinformatics, scientific computing, and data analysis needs of investigators within the NIAID Division of Intramural Research (DIR) and their collaborators, as part of the Integrated Data Sciences Section (IDSS) within the Research Technologies Branch (RTB), with particular emphasis on HIV research. The incumbent will provide analysis support across genomic and clinical research data — including viral sequence, host–pathogen, and immunologic datasets generated by HIV studies — develop and maintain production pipelines, and contribute to a scalable resource supporting NIAID scientists. A substantial portion of the work will directly support HIV investigators and their laboratory and clinical research teams. The successful candidate will be highly motivated, adaptable, structured, and detail-oriented.

Key Responsibilities

• Scientific consultation. Address the bioinformatics, scientific computing, and data analysis needs of users within the NIAID Division of Intramural Research and their collaborators, providing expertise in the statistical design of biological experiments involving high-throughput genome-scale technologies, data mining and knowledge discovery techniques, automated workflow development, and experimental design consultation.

• Bioinformatics support. Provide support spanning somatic and germline variant calling and analysis, single-cell and bulk gene expression analysis, de novo assembly of genomes and transcriptomes, comparative genomics of model and non-model organisms, proteomics, ChIP-seq, and ATAC-seq, including development of high-throughput pipelines for these data modalities.

• Programming support. Provide programming and troubleshooting support to the Research Technologies Branch and collaborating Institutes in the dissemination of research data.

• Data analysis. Perform computational data analysis on genomic and clinical research data, and provide statistical support and analysis on research data.

• Collaboration. Work with staff on scientific programming and experimental design.

• Publication. Contribute to and co-author scientific publications in leading peer-reviewed journals.

• Resource development. Contribute to the development of a scalable and flexible resource providing next-generation sequencing bioinformatics, structural and computational biology, and machine learning data support to NIAID scientists and investigators.

The Bioinformatics Scientist is expected to bring strong skills in the following areas:

• Next-generation sequencing analysis (whole-exome, whole-genome, RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, using both long- and short-read technologies)

• Statistical modeling

• Scripting

• Biological interpretation

Required Qualifications

• Clearance. Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

• Education. Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a related field; master’s degree or doctorate preferred.

• Experience. Four or more years of experience in bioinformatics, including two or more years developing and maintaining production bioinformatics pipelines.

• Programming languages. Expert-level proficiency in two of the following: Python, R, C/C++, sh/bash.

• Containerization. Experience building images using one of the following: Docker, Podman, Singularity/Apptainer.

• Pipeline frameworks. Expert-level proficiency in one pipeline framework: Snakemake, Nextflow, or CWL/WDL.

• Documentation. Demonstrated expertise building technical and user documentation for tools, pipelines, and applications.

• Infrastructure. Experience building pipelines on-premises using available high-performance computing infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting HIV research, including the analysis of HIV sequence data — for example viral genome assembly, phylogenetic and quasi-species analysis, drug-resistance profiling, or characterization of the latent reservoir.

• Familiarity with HIV and infectious disease data resources and host–pathogen study designs, including integration of viral sequence data with host genomic, transcriptomic, or immunologic datasets.

• Experience building pipelines or applications in the cloud using AWS, GCP, or Azure.

• Experience building applications using one of the following frameworks: Django, Flask, RShiny, Electron, Flutter, or React.

• Experience working in a laboratory setting.

• Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale or complex construction and capital improvement projects.

• Lead ground-up data center projects from preconstruction and site development through core and shell construction, critical infrastructure installation, testing, and turnover.

• Oversee the integration of mission-critical building systems, including medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, utility interconnections, substations and transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, and backup power infrastructure.

• Coordinate the construction and integration of data hall infrastructure, power distribution to IT equipment, cooling systems, controls, fire protection, and associated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems.

• Direct the selection, contracting, and performance management of architects, engineers, and general contractors.

• Negotiate complex contracts, change orders, and dispute resolutions.

• Mentor and provide guidance to Project Managers, Associate Project Managers, and Project Coordinators.

• Present project status, budget, and risk updates to senior leadership and clients.

• Ensure compliance with entitlements, permitting, and all applicable codes and regulations.

• Oversee project closeout, commissioning, and transition to property management.

• Manage integrated systems testing, commissioning, and operational readiness of critical power and cooling systems, coordinating with owners, operators, engineers, utilities, and specialty contractors.

• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or related field required; advanced degree a plus.

• 8+ years of progressive experience in commercial construction project management, including large or complex projects. Direct experience delivering ground-up data center construction projects is required; experience limited to core and shell construction is insufficient.

• Demonstrated experience overseeing the installation and commissioning of data center electrical and critical infrastructure, including power distribution, redundancy, UPS, generators, switchgear, and associated cooling systems.

• Working knowledge of data center operational requirements, infrastructure coordination, system redundancy, and phased commissioning/turnover processes.

• Demonstrated success managing multi-million dollar budgets and cross-functional project teams.

• Strong knowledge of construction law, contracts, and risk management.

This role involves standard office work with the ability to use a computer for extended periods. Frequent travel to properties, job sites, and client and consultant meetings is required.

This position is 100% in-office. The role requires working in office during standard business hours. Remote work or telecommuting is not an option for this position.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Testing (U.S. Air Force)
jobs.description:
About Skylight

Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.

We’re at the forefront of a civic movement to reinvent how all levels of government serve families, patients, and many others in today’s digital world.

If you want to play a part in driving this critical movement forward, we’d love for you to join our growing team of public interest technologists.

The work we do matters.

About the job

At Skylight, software engineers design, implement, and maintain software systems to improve government services for users. This software is built to meet the needs of regular users of government services as well as Skylight’s partners in government.

Skylight is partnering with a U.S. Air Force program office that runs a portfolio of civil engineering systems. These systems serve users across civil engineering, security forces, and services, including readiness managers, range personnel, and fire and emergency services. Releases are slow today. Regression testing is manual, security review happens after development finishes, and code freeze to production can take a month or more. We’ll move the program to an outcome-driven model with test automation and security built into the pipeline, starting with migrating the first application onto a DoD software factory. Leadership wants this office to become the model other Air Force offices adopt.

In this role, you’ll own test strategy across the portfolio and lead the move from manual to automated regression, so the team can ship with confidence and say clearly when a release is ready.

What to know going in

Your first 30 days are about working with the Skylight team and government personnel, learning how the program office gets changes to users today, and understanding where testing and security slow things down. This is new work that replaces a traditional support model, so part of the job is coaching your government partners to keep these practices running after we leave. Expect to work alongside government engineers and other contractors, with tools and processes changing as the work gets underway.

This role is contingent on Skylight being awarded the underlying contract. If we’re not awarded the contract, we’ll let you know promptly and discuss whether there are other opportunities that fit.

What you’ll do

• Design the test strategy for a portfolio of web applications, and decide pragmatically what to automate first

• Build automated regression suites and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline

• Move the team from manual to automated regression testing, shrinking the time from code freeze to production

• Lead a shared pool of four test engineers starting in February, and help them grow

• Communicate release confidence clearly to non-technical stakeholders

• Pair with and coach government testers and engineers so automated testing sticks after we leave

What we’re looking for

Basic qualifications

• Ability to write clean, working, and reusable code

• Familiar with how to build secure, compliant software and defend against common vulnerabilities

• Understand the different pieces of software systems and how to fit them together, while keeping performance, reliability, and availability in mind

• Understand the importance of always putting users at the center of your work, including thinking through the impact and implications of any code that you write

• Experience designing test strategy and building automated regression suites for web applications

• Experience leading testers or a test effort

• Experience working in a government or regulated environment with formal security authorization (ATO)

• Experience working on cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering, ops) in iterative delivery

• A track record of staying aligned and accountable on remote teams

• A mindset and work approach that aligns with our core values

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with Selenium or behavior-driven test tools like Cucumber, and test case management in Zephyr Scale

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD, ideally GitLab CI

• Experience testing COTS-based systems such as Esri or IBM TRIRIGA

• Experience using AI-assisted tools for test generation, paired with disciplined review

• Experience delivering technology in government, regulated industries, or other public-benefit settings

Don’t meet every qualification but think you can do the job? We’d still love to hear from you. If you’re excited about the role, apply. We consider candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences.

Other requirements

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.



With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.



Role Overview

We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our satellite development team. In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate electrical systems that power and control spacecraft propulsion systems, working closely with engineers from other subsystems to integrate your designs from concept through flight.



This is a hands-on, collaborative role where you’ll lead electrical hardware design, lab testing, and debugging across low-to-high voltage subsystems. This includes embedded microcontroller hardware, power tree design, precision sensor acquisition, valve drivers, and dedicated DC/DC converters. You will work alongside firmware and power electronics engineers and collaborate closely with propulsion and avionics teams to ensure hardware reliability in harsh space environments.



What You’ll Do

 - Hardware Design: Design and develop electrical subsystems for propulsion electronics, including embedded microcontroller hardware, sensor interfaces, valve drivers, and power conversion.

 - PCB Development: Lead schematic capture and multi-layer PCB layout design from breadboard prototypes to flight hardware.

 - Power & Driver Stages: Design, tune, and validate DC/DC converters and driver stages for inductive and resistive loads.

 - Analog Acquisition: Implement precision analog front-ends for critical telemetry, including current sensing (high-side/low-side), pressure transducers, and temperature monitoring.

 - Firmware Collaboration: Collaborate closely with embedded firmware engineers to define hardware/firmware interfaces, peripheral pin mappings, register maps, and communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).

 - Reviews & Quality: Conduct hardware design and layout reviews. Support component sourcing while ensuring compliance with standards and derating guidelines.

 - Testing & Automation: Develop and execute electrical test plans from breadboard to flight hardware, writing Python scripts for test automation and data logging.

 - Lab Debugging: Troubleshoot and debug electrical systems in a lab environment using test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, electronic dynamic loads, power meters).

 - Documentation: Develop electrical interface documentation (ICDs) and test procedures for spacecraft subsystems.

 - Integration Support: Support assembly, integration, and test (AIT) activities, including environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC).



Required Qualifications

 - Education: B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

 - Experience: 2+ years taking mixed-signal designs from schematics to manufacturing and lab bring-up.

 - EDA & Modeling: Familiarity with electrical design and simulation tools (e.g., Altium, KiCad, SPICE).

 - Core Technical: Fundamental understanding of mixed-signal electronics, power tree design, power conversion, signal integrity, and hardware reliability in harsh space environments.

 - Embedded HW: Hands-on experience designing embedded microcontroller hardware and peripheral interfaces (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).

 - Power Electronics: Experience designing driver circuits for inductive loads (valves, valve drivers, solenoids) and closed-loop DC/DC converters. High-voltage power electronics experience is a plus.

 - Analog Design: Strong background in precision sensor acquisition and analog signal conditioning (op-amps, filtering, ADC/DAC interfacing).

 - Lab Validation: Hands-on experience with electrical testing, debugging (oscilloscopes, dynamic loads, power meters), and Python test scripting.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Exposure to satellite systems, avionics, or electrical power systems.

 - Experience with space environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC per MIL-STD-461) and component derating standards (e.g., NASA EEE-INST-002).

 - Experience developing hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulators

 - Familiarity with reading embedded C/C++ to collaborate seamlessly with firmware engineers during low-level driver bring-up and boundary-scan debugging.



For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). 



For U.K. Roles: To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).



For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR. 



We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.

About You

Reliable builder: You design for failure and prove that recovery works.

Hands-on engineer: You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.

Strong owner: You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.

What you will be doing

• Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications.

• Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries.

• Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials.

• Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls.

• Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery.

• Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes.

• Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production.

• Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect.

What you will bring to the role

• Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language.

• Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases.

• Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.

• Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems.

Scope by level

Senior: Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.

Staff: Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.

Principal: Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services.

Our stack

Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.

OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open.

Detail-oriented, reliable, creative team player to lead in process design for new and existing facilities.  Analyze, calculate, and design new or revamped process equipment in refinery, chemical, and other industrial applications.
 
Job Duties/Responsibilities:
•Lead field and technical evaluations of existing process units
•Provide technical direction for refinery and chemical process units and licensed technologies
•Direct and perform calculations, develop PFDs and P&IDs, provide design documentation for downstream engineering disciplines, develop equipment specifications, compile scope of work packages for construction
•Lead Client and Contractor interface, attend meetings, and provide written reports
•Provide technical support for field execution, including outage/turnaround projects
•Assist in constructability planning, proposal, and estimate development
 
Minimum Qualifications:
•Education: Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering
•Experience:Min Yr = 10+ 
•Licensure: P.E. Preferred
•Technical Skills: Knowledge of P&ID development, heat and material balances, hydraulic and equipment sizing calculations, relief device sizing, API standards, and ASME codes required
Strong technical knowledge of refinery and chemical plant unit operations and/or licensed technologies
•Management: Experience mentoring and leading teams required
•Other Skills: Strong organizational, written and verbal communication skills
 
Professional Development Opportunities:
•Advance technical knowledge of refinery and chemical process unit operations and licensed technologies
• Advanced knowledge of applicable codes and standards, involvement in AIChE or similar local/national chapters and code committees (API, ASME etc) 
•Growth in leading technical teams as subject matter expert or lead engineer
•Advance skills in multi-discipline technical and managerial environment
 
Individual field assignments typically each have their own unique requirements.  Prior to deployment on any field assignment, you must be able to meet all client-specific site requirements.  Should you be unable or unwilling to meet assignment-specific requirements, your continued employment would then be subject to the availability of other assignments whose requirements can be met.  These unique requirements may include:
 
•You must possess physical mobility (on the ground and at heights).
•You may be required to pick up, lift, carry, and move up to 50 lbs.
•You may be required to work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off platforms/scaffolding/ladders using the appropriate and required fall protection.  
•You must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold, and wind) while wearing the appropriate PPE. This may include but not be limited to a hard hat, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves, and leather, steel-toed work boots.  
•You may be required to position yourself to work in confined spaces
•You may be required to adhere to a client’s random drug testing program prior to entering their site.
•You may be required to meet a client’s facial hair safety policy prior to entering their site.
 
Pay Range: $140,000 - $185,000 annually
 
The above pay range represents a general guideline; however, Brindley considers several factors when determining base salary that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, certifications, specific work location, and current market conditions. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonus and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans in addition to base pay to reward individual contributions and allow employees to share in company results. 
 
In addition, BE provides a comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees, including health, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with employer matching, company-paid holidays, paid parental leave, compensatory time off, and paid time off (PTO). Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
 
Brindley Engineering is an Equal Opportunity Employer and committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
 
BE participates in E-Verify. For additional information regarding E-Verify, please go to www.e-verify.gov.
