jobs.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Supervisor(a) de Operações - Pre-Contract Ops Support
jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

Atuamos no modelo remote-first, oferecendo total flexibilidade para você trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Para quem gosta de encontros presenciais, disponibilizamos nosso escritório em São Paulo e coworkings parceiros. Além disso, contamos com o programa Work From Anywhere (WFA), que permite trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar do mundo por até 90 dias no ano.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

A posição de Supervisor(a) de Operações em Pre-Contract Ops Support atua como um hub central de acompanhamento e governança (perfil focado em PMO) para as frentes de desenvolvimento de soluções de IA, desenho de processos, treinamento e qualidade dentro de operações pré-contrato. A pessoa será responsável por orquestrar entregas, prazos e prioridades entre analistas técnicos e diversos stakeholders da companhia.

Suas Responsabilidades

• Gerenciamento de Projetos e Entregas: Acompanhar o cronograma diário das entregas e produtos do time em ciclos (sprints) tipicamente de 4 semanas, garantindo previsibilidade e qualidade.

• Gestão do Board e Priorização: Monitorar o Jira diariamente, atribuindo chamados aos analistas responsáveis e direcionando fluxos de trabalho.

• Rituais de Acompanhamento: Conduzir reuniões semanais (weekly check-ins) com a equipe para avaliar o progresso das entregas, mapear riscos e tratar gargalos operacionais.

• Mapeamento e Alinhamento com Stakeholders: Entender as demandas das áreas solicitantes, mapear requisitos/acessos necessários e realizar a apresentação final das entregas para stakeholders.

• Controle de Qualidade: Aplicar ferramentas de qualidade (5W2H, Ishikawa, Causa Raiz, GUT) para calibrar outputs com os criadores e assegurar que as soluções entregues atendam às expectativas da operação.

O que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos / atuação em estilo PMO.

• Domínio prático de Kanban, ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira) e metodologias/ferramentas de gestão da qualidade (5W2H, Ishikawa, causa raiz, matriz GUT).

• Conhecimento avançado no ecossistema Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Docs e Slides).

• Vivência ou familiaridade com projetos de Inteligência Artificial (Gemini ou Claude) em operações.

• Excelente habilidade de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e negociação sutil de prazos e escopo com stakeholders.

Como é nosso processo seletivo?

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

• Triagem

• Entrevista com People

• Entrevista com o gestor da vaga

• Live Case

• Etapa de entrevista com Stakeholder

• Offer.

Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.

Benefícios

Oferecemos um pacote completo focado na sua saúde, bem-estar, família e desenvolvimento:

• Remuneração: Salário competitivo, Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR - para funções elegíveis) e Remuneração Variável (para funções elegíveis).

• Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub (Gympass) e QuintoCare (apoio psicológico, jurídico, social e financeiro gratuito).

• Qualidade de Vida: Vale Refeição e Alimentação, Day Off de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais.

• Flexibilidade: Auxílio Home Office e programa Work From Anywhere (WFA).

• Família e Cuidado: Auxílio Creche, Auxílio Parentalidade Atípica, Licença Parental Estendida e Kit Leiturinha.

• Educação e carreira: Parcerias com instituições de ensino;

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público-alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.

Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Manager, Technical (ACF)
jobs.description:
About Skylight

Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.

We’re at the forefront of a civic movement to reinvent how all levels of government serve families, patients, and many others in today's digital world.

If you want to play a part in driving this critical movement forward, we’d love for you to join our growing team of public interest technologists.

The work we do matters.

About the job

At Skylight, product managers are responsible for strategy, planning, execution, stakeholder management, and team health. Product managers partner with researchers, designers, engineers, client stakeholders, and others to inform their product decisions. At a high level, it’s the product manager’s job to figure out what to build next and why.

A technical product manager specializes in products with significant technical depth — platforms, APIs, data systems, or modernization efforts — where product decisions depend on fluency with the underlying architecture and engineering tradeoffs.

The Administration for Children and Families (ACF) is expanding surge support and capacity for its new Data Capacity and Digital Services organization within the Office of Administration, through the option year of our Task Order 1 contract. The team works with enterprise-serving organizations like ACF Tech and the Office of Grants Management to help programs deliver on ACF’s mission, including priorities focused on reducing grantee burden; reducing waste, fraud, and abuse; and modernizing legacy systems.

You’ll lead product work that spans rapid-turnaround surge requests and signature modernization efforts, working directly with ACF staff to decide what’s worth building and why. Much of this work sits on top of platforms like Palantir Foundry, Databricks, and enterprise AI tools, so you’ll need technical fluency to weigh architecture and data tradeoffs alongside your engineers.

What to know going in

This work calls for a consultant’s skill set: you’ll interface directly with senior leaders, and much of the work isn’t scoped in advance. This isn’t a team where you simply prioritize existing work in a backlog. You’ll need a working understanding of service design and fluency to engage with AI-forward delivery teams, including data scientists, Foundry engineers designers and others. Alongside delivery, we do a lot of technical consulting and capacity building, so people who take initiative and are comfortable with uncertainty and ambiguity tend to do best here.

What you’ll do

• Lead a cross-functional team of researchers, designers, engineers, and subject matter experts to build and ship high-impact products and services

• Shape loosely defined, unscoped problems into a clear product strategy, including vision, objectives, measures of success, roadmap, and backlog

• Translate policy and program requirements from ACF leadership into technical solutions the team can deliver, and keep plans current as priorities shift

• Write and prioritize user stories, build release plans, and facilitate team ceremonies such as planning, stakeholder syncs, and retrospectives

• Work in close partnership with government teams to help them build digital skills and product knowledge throughout the course of the project

• Creatively navigate bureaucratic challenges, paving the way for more intuitive processes in the future

What we’re looking for

Basic qualifications

• Can develop a product strategy grounded in the problem to be solved, prioritizing outcomes over features, with a roadmap and clear success criteria

• Apply lean and agile principles (e.g., minimum viable product) to validate assumptions early, break scope into small chunks of value, maintain a prioritized backlog of validated user stories, and facilitate ceremonies on cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering, ops)

• Experience applying service design methods, such as journey mapping, service blueprinting, and contextual inquiry, to uncover pain points, manual workarounds, and opportunities to automate or streamline

• Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled products or workflows, including judging where AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, intelligent document processing) adds value versus where simpler automation or process change is the better answer

• Understanding of how data moves through an organization, with the ability to spot fragmented or duplicated data and work with engineers to design more connected, reliable systems

• Technical fluency to reason through system architecture, APIs, data modeling, security, and engineering tradeoffs with engineers, and to make product calls that depend on them

• Ability to manage clients and stakeholders in a way that builds trust, alignment, and healthy environments for individuals and teams

• A track record of defining and measuring impact, such as time saved, reduced processing times, fewer errors, or increased adoption

• A mindset and work approach that aligns with our core values

Nice-to-haves

• Hands-on experience with one or more of Credal, Palantir Foundry, Databricks, or Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)

• Experience delivering through AI-enablement with responsible AI practices, such as evaluating model outputs, designing human-in-the-loop review, and familiarity with frameworks like the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or federal AI guidance

• Familiarity with federal security and compliance processes, such as FedRAMP and Authority to Operate (ATO), and how they shape what tools can be adopted

• An engineering or data background, or experience taking a product from zero to one in a startup or other setting where you had to navigate uncertainty

• Experience translating policy into technical solutions and implementing it through software

• Experience modernizing legacy systems, including migrating data and workflows off spreadsheets, paper, or aging case management tools

• Experience delivering AI-forward technology in government, highly regulated industries, or other public-benefit settings

• A track record of staying aligned and accountable on remote teams

Don’t meet every qualification but think you can do the job? We’d still love to hear from you. If you’re excited about the role, apply. We consider candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences.

Other requirements

• Some of our available roles are on federal contracts that require a degree or additional years of experience as a substitute.

• All work must be conducted within the U.S., excluding U.S. territories.

• You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without sponsorship.

• An existing clearance isn’t required to apply, but as a government contractor, anyone hired into this role must be able to obtain a Tier 2 public trust background investigation.

• You must complete a company background check successfully.

Logistics

Position type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Location

This is a fully remote position.

Travel

This role may require travel one to two times a year based on client or contract needs.

Care package

Salary

We want to give you the most competitive salary possible. After all, you deserve it! To that end, we use the results of our interview process to determine what salary is most appropriate given your current level of seniority. For a Product Manager at Skylight, the current salary ranges are as follows:

• Associate Product Manager: $90,000–$125,000

• Product Manager I: $120,000–$140,000

• Product Manager II: $135,000–$160,000

• Senior Product Manager: $150,000–$185,000

• Staff Product Manager: $170,000–$203,000

• Principal Product Manager: $180,000–$230,000

Benefits

Your well-being is important to us, so we focus on supporting you in a variety of ways:

• Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance

• Life and AD&D insurance

• Dependent care FSA, healthcare FSA, health savings account

• Dollar-for-dollar 401(k) match up to 10% of your salary with no vesting period

• Flexible paid-time-off policy (generally around 25 days per year), plus 11 paid federal holidays

• Up to 12 weeks paid-time-off for all eligible new birth, adoption, or foster parents

• Performance rewards, including annual salary increase, annual performance bonus, spot bonuses, and stock options

• Business development / sales bonuses

• Referral bonuses

• Annual $2000 allowance for professional development

• Annual $750 allowance for tech-related purchases

• Annual swag budget of $100 to display your Skylight pride with some merchandise (hoodies, hats, and more)

• Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

• An environment that empowers you to unleash your superpowers for public good

Interview tips

Our process includes a preliminary screen, a skills interview, a behavioral interview, and a reverse interview where you meet your potential team — usually four conversations across two to three weeks. Here are some tips to help you prepare for a successful interview:

• Visit our join page to learn more about how our interview process works.

• Check out our Career Pathways framework to learn more about the different roles within Skylight and the skills needed to do them.

• Browse our case studies to learn more about our work.

If you’d like to request reasonable accommodations during the application or interviewing process, please contact our recruiting team at recruiting@skylight.digital.

We participate in E-Verify and upon hire, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you’re authorized to work in the U.S.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Communications Manager, Claude Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a Communications Lead to own external communications for the Claude Platform, our API. The Claude Platform is how many of our customers put Claude to work, and this role shapes how that work is understood beyond Anthropic: from flagship product launches to the steady cadence of capability releases and developer-facing news.

You'll sit on the Product Communications team and work day to day with the Platform product and engineering teams, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations.

You should understand how developers and enterprises actually build with APIs and be comfortable engaging with developer tools and hold a clear point of view on what makes a product land.

Key responsibilities

• Own communications for the Claude Platform end to end: capability releases, product updates, and the steady cadence of developer-facing news

• Build and maintain strong relationships with the journalists, newsletter writers, and creators covering AI platforms, enterprise software, and the API economy

• Prepare Platform leaders to be effective spokespeople for press, podcasts, panels, and the smaller moments in between

• Partner with Product and Engineering to align external narratives with how these products are sold and supported, and surface customer feedback back to the teams who can act on it

• Work across press, social, owned, and community channels, with the judgment to know which one carries a given moment and when to coordinate more than one at once

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in communications, PR, or product marketing, including meaningful time on platform, API, developer, or enterprise products

• An understanding of both developer culture and enterprise buying, and the judgment to read timing and tone when the conversation around AI gets noisy

• Strong instincts for which product moments deserve the spotlight and which don't, and genuine curiosity about what makes a launch land

• A demonstrated ability to operate with high agency and low ego, with a bias to action

Preferred qualifications

• 8-10 years of experience in communications, PR, or product marketing

• Communications experience at a developer platform, API-first, or enterprise software company

• Existing relationships with reporters and analysts covering AI platforms, enterprise tech, or the developer ecosystem

• Experience managing communications for AI or ML products

• Are very online: you follow the right channels, know what's moving through Hacker News and developer social chatter, and catch things early

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$265,000—$295,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Healthcare operations designed around people, systems, and impact.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Success
jobs.description:
ABOUT OPENROUTER

OpenRouter is the unified interface for AI inference, giving developers and organizations access to hundreds of models through a single API. Our platform helps teams choose, route, evaluate, and scale model usage across providers, making it easier to build production AI applications with the right model for every use case.

As inference becomes a core operating layer for modern software companies, OpenRouter helps customers move faster, reduce complexity, and get more value from the rapidly evolving model ecosystem.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Director of Customer Success to build and scale the next generation of Customer Success at OpenRouter.

This is a builder role, not a traditional Customer Success management role.

Our ambition is to build an AI-native Customer Success organization that combines exceptional customer relationships, deep technical expertise, and intelligent systems to drive adoption, retention, and growth at scale.

You'll own our Customer Success strategy and execution across AI-native startups, enterprises, and strategic customers. You'll lead a team of Customer Success Managers, partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineering, Support and Sales, and build the systems that help our customers realize value from OpenRouter.

The ideal candidate has led Customer Success at a hyperscaling AI-native company, model lab, or developer infrastructure platform. You understand consumption-based businesses, can build trusted relationships with technical and executive stakeholders, and know how to turn customer usage into measurable business outcomes.

We're looking for someone who can operate at both ends of the spectrum: personally engage with our largest strategic customers while building AI-powered systems and scalable programs that support thousands of growing developers and startups.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build an AI-Native Customer Success Organization: Define and execute a Customer Success strategy that scales through intelligent systems, automation, and high-impact customer engagement rather than proportional headcount growth.

 - Drive Adoption and Customer Value: Own the customer journey from onboarding through production adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion across our customer segments.

 - Own Retention and Growth: Drive Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), customer health, and inference consumption growth. Partner with Sales on strategic renewals and expansion opportunities.

 - Build Scalable Customer Engagement: Develop AI-powered workflows, customer intelligence, and lifecycle programs that proactively identify risks, uncover growth opportunities, and deliver personalized engagement at scale.

 - Lead Strategic Customer Relationships: Build trusted relationships with developers, technical leaders, founders, and executives at some of the world's most innovative AI companies and enterprises.

 - Build a High-Performance Team: Lead and develop exceptional Customer Success Managers who combine technical fluency, commercial acumen, and strong customer ownership.

 - Drive Operational Excellence: Establish customer health frameworks, success plans, adoption milestones, executive business reviews, and measurable customer outcomes.

 - Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate customer activation, resolve adoption barriers, and identify opportunities for growth.

 - Turn Customer Insights Into Action: Use product telemetry, inference usage, customer feedback, and business signals to drive proactive engagement and influence product strategy.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - AI-Native Leadership: Experience leading and scaling Customer Success at a hyperscaling AI-native company, model lab, or developer-first infrastructure platform.

 - Proven Customer Success Experience: 8+ years in Customer Success, account management, or related post-sales functions, including 4+ years leading teams through significant growth.

 - Builder DNA: You've personally built scalable Customer Success programs, workflows, automations, or AI-powered systems that meaningfully improve customer outcomes and team effectiveness.

 - Developer-First Mindset: You understand APIs, SDKs, LLMs, inference infrastructure, and the challenges of taking AI applications from experimentation into production.

 - Commercial Ownership: You have a strong track record of driving retention, expansion, NRR, GRR, and consumption growth in usage-based or subscription businesses.

 - Strategic Customer Leadership: You're comfortable engaging with developers, engineering leaders, founders, and C-level executives, translating technical adoption into measurable business value.

 - Track Record of Scale: You've built repeatable customer engagement models that support significant growth in customers and revenue without proportional increases in headcount.

 - Data-Driven Approach: You use product usage, customer health, adoption signals, and revenue data to prioritize engagement and drive outcomes.

 - High Ownership: You move quickly, thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable balancing hands-on customer work with building long-term organizational capabilities.

The Logistics Coordinator in the Customs Brokerage department is responsible for identifying and understanding customer transportation needs while ensuring the timely, accurate, and compliant movement of freight and information. jobs.title: Head of Sales Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT ASSEMBLED

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments.

More than 400 companies, including DoorDash, Salesforce, Stripe, and Sephora, trust Assembled https://www.assembled.com/customers. We've raised $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, Stripe, and Basis Set Ventures and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London.




THE ROLE

This is the founding sales engineering leadership role at Assembled. You'll own the technical side of how we win deals, and from day one that means getting your hands dirty in the ones that matter most. You'll also build the sales engineering function from the ground up and shape the team your way, starting with one sales engineer and the green light to hire more. You've done this before, ideally more than once, and you know what a high-performing SE function looks like at scale. You'll partner with Account Executives to run technical evaluations, prove out Assembled against real customer data and workflows, and turn complex support operations problems into clear, compelling demonstrations of value delivered. A big share of that work centers on our AI agents for chat, voice and email. You'll show prospects how those agents resolve real customer issues inside their existing support stack, and how they work alongside the human teams Assembled already helps them run.



The best SE leaders don't want to step out of the deals, they want to be in them. You'll stay hands-on and carry a reduced quota because we want someone who still loves deal execution and the learnings that come from it. Alongside that, you'll stand up the demo environments, the discovery frameworks, the proof-of-concept playbooks and the technical content that help the whole GTM team move faster. You'll be the technical voice our prospects trust and the bridge between what customers need and what product builds next.



This is a high-priority, cross-functional role with exposure to executive leadership and a large level of responsibility that will help accelerate your career. We're in-person 5 days a week from our bright, airy offices in the Mission (San Francisco) and Chelsea Market (New York).

 




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead and grow the sales engineering team. Hire, coach and develop sales engineers, and define the metrics the function is measured by, such as technical win rate, POC conversion and time-to-value.

 - Partner with Account Executives to drive technical evaluations from discovery through proof of concept to close, and run our largest and most strategic deals yourself, especially early on, to get your product knowledge and command of the platform to world-class.

 - Build the function's foundations: demo environments, discovery frameworks, POC playbooks and reusable technical content that scale the whole team.

 - Own the technical win end to end. Lead discovery to understand each customer's business context and goals, propose the right technical solution across our AI agents and workforce products, run tailored demos, and prove value delivered against real data and workflows.

 - Own RFP and security assessment responses, and build the processes and content that make them repeatable as the team grows.

 - Act as the bridge between prospects and product. Bring hard customer evidence back so it shapes the roadmap, and partner with product marketing on technical content and competitive positioning.

 - Partner with sales leadership on the pipeline as a whole and on individual deals. Spot the patterns in where we win and where deals stall, and shape the technical strategy for the opportunities that matter most.




ABOUT YOU

 - You're an analytical operator who likes hard problems: You'd rather solve a prospect's problem than talk about it. You bring significant technical and pre-sales experience, and messy data or complex integrations get you going. Assembled is a wide and deep product, so you'll need real analytical range and strong critical thinking to reason across all of it.

 - You've closed large enterprise deals (required): You've led the technical side of complex enterprise sales cycles and have won deals of $500K or more in upfront value. This is a hard requirement for the role. You're as effective with a C-level exec as you are with an engineer or a support agent.

 - You've built the function before: You've stood up or scaled a sales engineering team from scratch, ideally more than once. You've seen what works and what doesn't, and you know how to get there.

 - You lead by doing: You've managed or mentored sales engineers, and you still love carrying a number and being in the deal yourself. You set the bar through your own work and raise the team around you.

 - You move fast and don't give up: You work with urgency, juggle competing deals and drive toward value delivered. You push through roadblocks in unstructured environments and are comfortable operating independently.

 - You think strategically while working in the weeds: You pull key trends from prospect conversations and the broader market, then connect the dots on what we should do on go-to-market and product.

 - You're a coach with a growth mindset: You coach and give direct feedback to sales engineers and account executives alike, and you welcome the same feedback in return. You're collaborative, humble and quick to help.

 - Preferred: 5+ years in sales engineering, solutions consulting or a comparable technical pre-sales role. Hands-on experience selling or deploying AI agents across chat, voice or email is a strong plus, as is a background in Workforce Management or Support Operations.



If this is you, you're a fit. Apply.



This role comes with competitive compensation (base + commission), equity in a high-growth startup, and the opportunity to significantly influence a rapidly expanding market. If you're ready for impactful work with freedom to innovate and execute, we'd love to connect.

 



We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement listed in a job description. If the role excites you and you believe you can make an impact at Assembled, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong and has the opportunity to do their best work. We look forward to hearing from you!



For United States Applicants:
Assembled participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

For United Kingdom Applicants:
Assembled is required to verify your right to work in the UK and will conduct a Right to Work check prior to employment in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Line Cook II, Mimi Kakushi
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The Line Cook II supports the Chef de Partie in the daily operation of an assigned kitchen station. This role is responsible for maintaining food production standards, quality control, and consistency in the preparation of meats, fish, fowl, sauces, stocks, seasonings, and other menu items. The position ensures all food is prepared safely, efficiently, and in accordance with established recipes, standards, and health regulations.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in the setup, organization, and smooth operation of the assigned kitchen station.
• Prepare all food items according to standard recipes, specifications, and guest orders to ensure consistency and quality.
• Visually inspect, select, and utilize only high-quality ingredients suitable for cooking and service.
• Support the Chef de Partie in maintaining portion control, presentation standards, and flavor consistency.
• Monitor proper storage, labeling, rotation (FIFO), and freshness of all food products to maintain the highest quality standards.
• Ensure all refrigeration, storage, and work areas are kept clean, organized, and compliant with health department regulations.
• Prepare daily food and supply requisitions as required for production.
• Assist with stock control, waste minimization, and efficient use of ingredients.
• Operate kitchen equipment safely and correctly, reporting any maintenance or safety issues.
• Follow all food safety, sanitation, and hygiene standards at all times.
• Read and follow recipes accurately, applying basic mathematical skills for measurements, portions, and scaling.
• Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure timely and efficient service.
• Provide guidance and support to junior kitchen staff when required.

Supportive Functions

In addition to essential duties, the Line Cook II  may be required to perform the following tasks as determined by operational needs:

• Carry out general cleaning duties using approved cleaning products.
• Maintain dry, clean, and safe floors to prevent slip or fall accidents.
• Assist with moving supplies, equipment, and deliveries as required.

Clean up spills and respond promptly to unexpected kitchen situations

SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

The ideal candidate must demonstrate the following:

Strong working knowledge of broiler, sauté, fry, roast, moist-heat, and other standard cooking methods.

Solid understanding of food safety, sanitation, and hygiene standards.

Ability to operate standard kitchen equipment including stoves, ovens, broilers, steamers, kettles, and similar tools.

Basic mathematical skills for recipes, measurements, requisitions, and portion control.

Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English to follow recipes, complete requisitions, and communicate effectively with the team.

Physical ability to lift, carry, or move items weighing up to 100 lbs on a continuous schedule.

Ability to stand for extended periods and work efficiently in confined spaces.

Ability to perform duties in environments with varying and extreme temperature ranges.

Strong attention to detail and pride in food quality and presentation.

Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

Good organizational and time-management skills.

Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and grow within the kitchen brigade.

Flexibility to work varying shifts, including weekends and holidays.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Photonic IC Design Engineer, Design Automation & Modeling
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

K2's ambitions extend beyond the satellite bus. By designing and operating our own spacecraft and regularly manifesting hardware to orbit, K2 is uniquely positioned to develop, test, and deploy ambitious, “limit-of-physics” optical and photonic payloads across MEO, GEO, cislunar, and deep space on unprecedented timelines. The satellite bus is the platform – the payloads are the mission.

As a Photonic IC Design Engineer focused on design automation and modeling, you will own the team's photonic design flow: the software that takes a requirement to a fabrication-ready, DRC-clean design whose measured performance matches simulation. Inverse design and AI-guided design are core parts of that flow, alongside parametric layout generation, fabrication-aware models, and automated verification. You will build the tools, the component library, and the models the whole team designs with (and that our tunable circuits are calibrated and controlled with in operation), and work closely with the test and automation team so every design is built for test and every measurement flows back into the models. You will also own real device blocks on the team's product tapeouts and take them from design through lab measurement, so the flow is proven on parts that ship. As a founding member of the photonics team, you will help set the tools and design practices the team grows on.

Responsibilities

• Own the team's photonic design automation flow: parametric layout generation, simulation orchestration, design-space exploration, and automated DRC/LVS and sign-off across multiple integrated photonics foundry platforms (e.g., silicon, silicon nitride, III-V).

• Build and maintain fabrication-aware inverse design (topology optimization in JAX or PyTorch, with lithography models and robustness to process variation) as a core engine of the flow.

• Bring agentic and AI-guided tools into the design loop for design-space exploration, layout generation, optimization, and data analysis.

• Own device and circuit blocks on product PICs from specification through tapeout and characterization, on the team's tapeout schedule (e.g., polarization handling, low-loss routing, mode converters, vertical couplers for 3D integration, and wideband devices).

• Partner with the photonics test and automation team on characterization: build design-for-test into the flow (test structures, probe- and fiber-array-compatible layouts), define measurement plans and metrics, and connect the flow to the shared test data pipeline.

• Characterize your devices in the lab and on the test team's automated stations (insertion loss, extinction, bandwidth, high-speed electro-optic response), treat simulation-to-measurement error as your key metric, and turn the data into model calibrations, design rules, and flow updates.

• Maintain pcells and compact models for the team's component library, with regression tests so flow and PDK changes don't break existing designs.

• Extend those models into calibration and control for tunable PICs (thermal tuning, resonator locking, modulator bias): derive the control and calibration algorithms from the same models used in design, and use test-station calibration data to update both.

• Develop behavioral and physical models of photonic circuits, links, lasers, and gain media, and support system co-design with K2's electronics and ASIC teams.

• Make the flow usable by the whole team through documentation, reviews, and mentoring.

Qualifications

• PhD or MS in electrical engineering, optics, physics, computer science, or a related field, or a Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience.

• Built inverse design or other computational design tools that produced fabricated, measured devices on commercial integrated photonics foundry platforms.

• Strong software engineering: Python, autodiff frameworks, version control, and maintainable shared code.

• Electromagnetic simulation (FDTD, FEM, or RCWA) and hands-on lab characterization correlated to simulation.

Nice to Have

• Machine learning or agentic AI applied to engineering design.

• Control systems, calibration, or system identification for tunable photonic circuits.

• Photonic layout and PDK tooling (e.g., gdsfactory, KLayout, Cadence).

• Laser or VCSEL design and modeling.

• 3D heterogeneous integration or co-packaged optics.

• Contributions to open-source electromagnetic or design tools (e.g., Meep).

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $200,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Staff Software Security Engineer - Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role will be hybrid in LInkedIn’s Mountain View office location.

About the team

LinkedIn's members entrust us with their information every day and we take their security seriously. Our core value of putting our members first powers all the decisions we make, including how we manage and protect the data of our members and customers. Information Security at LinkedIn is dedicated to protecting and securing business-critical member data and company assets. Our core mission is to empower LinkedIn to create a secure and thriving platform for every member of the global workforce. The Enterprise & Identity Security team strives to proactively safeguard our corporate identity and infrastructure against external and internal threats and bad actors. You will strive to proactively safeguard our corporate infrastructure and digital assets by identifying, assessing, and mitigating security risks across cloud/SaaS environments, identity systems, endpoints, and essential business workflows. You will operate at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, identity management, software development, and mission-critical security workflows.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms and services, enabling secure and scalable access across the organization.
• Engineer and deliver new identity capabilities that improve security, user experience, automation, and operational efficiency.
• Drive modernization initiatives by re-architecting legacy identity systems into resilient, cloud-ready, and highly scalable platforms.
• Design solutions that address performance, reliability, scalability, and availability challenges across identity infrastructure.
• Define and execute the long-term technical strategy and roadmap for identity platforms, aligning with business growth and security objectives.
• Partner closely with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to integrate identity services into enterprise applications and platforms.
• Establish engineering best practices, architectural standards, and governance models for identity systems and services.
• Lead complex technical initiatives from concept through implementation, influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving execution at scale.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve identity architecture and platform capabilities.
• Mentor and guide engineers, fostering technical excellence and a culture of innovation within the organization.
• Build platforms and services that support Zero Trust principles, strong authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management.
• Ensure identity systems are designed to meet compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements while maintaining a seamless user experience.
• Assess new and existing applications and system deployments for vulnerabilities and design flaws, and prioritize remediation efforts based on risk.
• Devise and bolster defenses through secure-by-default frameworks, architectures, and processes.
• Maintain and build improvements to systems supporting supply chain assurance.
• Evaluate new products and technologies, including potential acquisitions.
• Respond to external vulnerability researcher inquiries and vulnerability reports.
• Educate and advocate for security improvement throughout the LinkedIn ecosystem through mentorship and coaching.

Basic Qualifications:

• BA/BS Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or related technical discipline, or related practical experience.
• 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Active Directory, workforce identity lifecycle management, role based access, authentication, authorization, and Single Sign-On (SSO)
• 5+ years experience and in-depth knowledge of application security, authentication and security protocols, cryptography, supply chain security and mobile security.
• 5+ years experience in various security assessment methodologies such as threat modeling, design reviews, penetration testing and vulnerability assessment.
• Experience with programming languages such as Java, GoLang or Python

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms (such as Microsoft Entra ID), including developing new capabilities, re-architecting legacy systems, and driving large-scale identity transformations.
• Proven ability to solve scalability, reliability, and performance challenges while creating future-ready identity architectures that support business growth and evolving security requirements.
• Demonstrated success designing long-term identity platform strategies that support rapid organizational growth and future business needs.
• Experience with security research, bug bounty and CTF competitions
• Experience with codeql, semgrep and GitHub integration workflows
• Ability to work across teams and communicate concisely and clearly to stakeholders

Suggested Skills

• Technical Leadership
• Architectural Mastery
• Workforce Identity and Access Management
• Enterprise Security
• Advanced Security Practices

You will Benefit from our Culture

We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families. That is why we offer generous health and wellness programs and time away for employees of all levels. LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Support
jobs.description:
ABOUT OPENROUTER

OpenRouter is the unified interface for AI inference, giving developers and organizations access to hundreds of models through a single API. Our platform helps teams choose, route, evaluate, and scale model usage across providers, making it easier to build production AI applications with the right model for every use case.

As inference becomes a core operating layer for modern software companies, OpenRouter helps customers move faster, reduce complexity, and get more value from the rapidly evolving model ecosystem.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Director of Customer Support to build and scale the next generation of technical support at OpenRouter.

This is a builder role, not a pure support management role.

Our goal isn't to scale support by continuously adding headcount. It's to build an AI-native support organization where intelligent systems, AI agents, and exceptional technical talent deliver a world-class experience to developers and enterprises at scale.

You'll lead our global support function, our technical support teams, and continuously build and improve the systems that power the customer experience. You'll be hands-on with AI, automation, and developer tooling while ensuring our customers receive fast, accurate, and deeply technical support.

The ideal candidate has led Customer Support at a hyperscaling AI-native company or model lab, understands what developers expect from mission-critical AI infrastructure, and has a track record of building systems that scale faster than the teams operating them.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build an AI-Native Support Organization: Own the strategy and execution for a support function designed around AI, automation, and technical excellence rather than traditional headcount growth.

 - Engineer for Scale: Build, orchestrate, and continuously improve AI agents, workflows, and internal tools that increase support capacity, quality, and efficiency.

 - Own the Developer Experience: Deliver exceptional technical support for developers, AI-native startups, and enterprise customers building production applications on OpenRouter.

 - Lead Technical Support Operations: Own support performance, incident response, escalations, global coverage, and enterprise SLAs across our customer base.

 - Drive Operational Excellence: Define and improve key metrics including response times, resolution times, customer satisfaction, automation effectiveness, and cost to serve.

 - Build a High-Leverage Team: Lead and develop a small, exceptional team of Support Engineers who are equally comfortable debugging technical problems and improving the systems that solve them.

 - Create Scalable Solutions: Turn recurring customer issues into better automation, self-service capabilities, documentation, and product improvements.

 - Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Forward Deployed Engineering to resolve complex issues and translate customer feedback into lasting improvements.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - AI-Native Leadership: You have managed and scaled Customer Support or Technical Support Engineering at a hyperscaling AI-native company, model lab, or AI infrastructure platform serving developers.

 - Proven Support Experience: 8+ years in technical support or support engineering, including 4+ years leading teams through significant growth.

 - Builder DNA: You don't just manage people and processes. You've personally built, implemented, or operated AI agents, automations, and technical systems that fundamentally improve how support works.

 - Developer-First Mindset: You understand APIs, SDKs, LLMs, inference infrastructure, latency, reliability, and the challenges developers face running AI applications in production.

 - Track Record of Scale: You've demonstrated the ability to support significant growth in customers, usage, or ticket volume without proportional increases in headcount.

 - Technical Fluency: You're comfortable working with Engineering, investigating complex technical issues, using APIs, and getting hands-on with Python, TypeScript, or similar tools.

 - Operational Rigor: You've owned support SLAs, incident management, escalations, and customer experience metrics in a high-growth environment, along with experience building global, 24/7 technical support coverage.

 - High Ownership: You move quickly, thrive in ambiguity, and measure success through customer outcomes and the leverage your organization creates.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a leading LLM model lab, AI inference provider, or developer-first AI infrastructure company.

 - Experience building and maintaining production AI agents or agentic workflows for customer-facing operations.

 - Experience supporting high-volume API platforms with demanding enterprise reliability requirements.

 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, agent frameworks, and modern support platforms.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first 30 days, you'll understand our customers, support operations, technical challenges, and existing AI-powered systems. You'll identify opportunities to improve support quality and scalability.

In your first 60 days, you'll begin shipping meaningful improvements to our support systems, automation, and escalation workflows while establishing clear performance metrics.

In your first 90 days, you'll have a clear operating model for scaling technical support, measurable improvements in efficiency and customer experience, and a roadmap for continuing to increase support capacity without proportional headcount growth.




YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You'd rather build a system that solves a thousand problems than hire a team to solve them one at a time.

 - You're a leader who still loves to build, debug, experiment, and ship.

 - You see AI agents as part of your team, not simply tools your team uses.

 - You understand the expectations of developers building mission-critical AI applications.

 - You believe exceptional customer support is measured by outcomes, not team size.

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Recruiting Coordinator to join our Talent Acquisition team. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. In this role, you’ll be instrumental in delivering a seamless candidate experience while supporting recruiters and hiring managers throughout the interview process. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about helping teams grow.

This hybrid role is based out of our San Jose, CA office, requiring on-site attendance 3 to 4 times per week, with occasional travel to our Mountain View, CA office.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate and schedule interviews across time zones, including virtual and on-site meetings

• Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, ensuring timely and clear communication throughout the interview process

• Maintain our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse), including accurate candidate records, job descriptions, interview plans and postings

• Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to drive an efficient, organized hiring process

• Manage interview logistics such as booking rooms, setting up video links, and handling travel arrangements when applicable

• Greet and support candidates during on-site interviews, ensuring a welcoming and professional experience

• Support broader recruiting efforts including headcount tracking, reporting, and sourcing

• Help coordinate recruiting events and internal sourcing jams

• Identify opportunities for process improvements that enhance candidate experience and team operations

Qualifications

• 1+ year of experience in a recruiting coordinator, recruiting operations, or similar role in a fast-paced technical environment.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

jobs.title: Photonic IC Design Engineer, Chip-to-System Integration
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

K2's ambitions extend beyond the satellite bus. By designing and operating our own spacecraft and regularly manifesting hardware to orbit, K2 is uniquely positioned to develop, test, and deploy ambitious, “limit-of-physics” optical and photonic payloads across MEO, GEO, cislunar, and deep space on unprecedented timelines. The satellite bus is the platform – the payloads are the mission.

As a Photonic IC Design Engineer focused on chip-to-system integration, you will design photonic integrated circuits (PICs) and the packages that connect them to the outside world: small, light, low-cost, and rugged enough to fly at constellation scale. You will own the boundary between chip and system on both sides: optically, how light gets on and off the chip and how fibers are attached and held; electrically, the high-speed modulators, RF interfaces, and bias and tuning control that connect the PIC to its drive electronics. You will also make sure the whole assembly survives launch and years in orbit. Your coupling-loss, modulator, and bandwidth numbers feed directly into system link budgets, so you will work closely with K2's systems, photonics test and automation, RF, ASIC, and manufacturing teams, and with external foundry and packaging partners. As a founding member of the photonics team, you will help set how K2 designs, packages, and qualifies photonic hardware.

Responsibilities

• Design, simulate, and lay out PIC devices and circuits (edge and grating couplers, spot-size converters, photodetectors, and passive components) from specification to tapeout on commercial integrated photonics foundry platforms.

• Design high-speed modulators (e.g., traveling-wave Mach-Zehnder and ring modulators), including electrodes, terminations, and RF launches, and co-design them with RF and ASIC engineers against driver and TIA specifications.

• Implement bias and tuning control in hardware: place heaters and monitor photodiodes, define the drive and readout interface with K2's electronics engineers, and bring up closed-loop modulator bias and resonator locking, verified over temperature and radiation.

• Set the optical I/O requirements (coupling loss, alignment tolerance, polarization, and I/O placement on the die) and work them into the floorplan with chip designers and into the link budget with systems engineers.

• Design the mechanical side of the package in 3D CAD: PIC carriers and submounts, fiber-array V-groove and lid geometry, strain relief, and alignment and assembly fixtures, with tolerance stack-ups tied back to the coupling-loss budget.

• Drive radiation, thermal-vacuum, and vibration qualification of photonic devices and packages: write the test plans, lead the campaigns alongside K2's test and reliability engineers and outside test facilities, and turn the results into design rules.

• Partner with the photonics test and automation team on characterization: define test plans and pass/fail metrics, design test structures and probe- and fiber-array-compatible layouts, help bring up and validate automated measurements, and use the shared data pipeline to close the loop between simulation, measurement, and design.

• Carry the high-speed electrical path through the package (wirebond or flip-chip transitions and RF interconnects to the drive electronics) and present designs at preliminary and critical design reviews.

Qualifications

• PhD or MS in electrical engineering, optics, physics, or a related field, or a Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience.

• PIC designs taken through tapeout on one or more commercial integrated photonics platforms (e.g., silicon photonics, silicon nitride, indium phosphide, thin-film lithium niobate), with the fabricated devices characterized in the lab.

• Hands-on work at the chip boundary: optical I/O design with fiber attach or packaging, or high-speed modulator and RF design measured with a VNA (S-parameters, electro-optic bandwidth).

• Photonic device simulation (Meep, Tidy3D, Lumerical FDTD, FEM, or EME), layout tools (e.g., KLayout, gdsfactory, Cadence), and Python for automation and data analysis.

Nice to Have

• 3D mechanical CAD (e.g., SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion) for package parts or fixtures, including drawings that a machine shop can build from.

• Radiation, thermal-vacuum, or vibration testing of photonic or electronic devices.

• Inverse design or topology optimization of couplers and other optical I/O devices.

• RF package or board design to tens of GHz (e.g., HFSS, Sonnet).

• Heterogeneous or 3D integration and co-packaged optics.

• Hardware built for space or other harsh environments.

• Modulator bias control, resonator locking, or other closed-loop control of photonic devices.

• Background in RF or microwave engineering.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $200,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

This is a high-impact, hybrid role for someone who delivers outstanding service to candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers alike, and who brings judgment to scheduling. • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication, with the ability to interact confidently with all levels, including senior executives.

• A self-starter who is a natural problem-solver and troubleshooter, looks for ways to support the team, and wants to make an impact whether asked or acting on their own ideas.

• Stays calm under pressure and juggles competing priorities.

Hybrid (minimum of 3 days per week onsite)

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst Consultant - Device Management & Endpoint Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT KALLES GROUP:

Everyone deserves to be secure. Our mission at Kalles Group is to help secure the future for companies of all shapes and sizes.

While our expertise spans multiple disciplines, our method remains consistent: building trust and relationship with people -- whether you are a client, a consultant, or--in this case--a candidate.

No matter what role you come from--whether you're an executive or just starting your career-you can expect our highest level of attention and respect. We want to find the right fit for each role, but we also want you to find the right fit for your career.

We believe the best way to show you what our team is like is to treat you like you're already a part of it. We hope you'll consider joining our team of experienced professionals who are building their careers at Kalles Group—and having fun while doing it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

As a Business Systems Analyst with Kalles Group, you’ll be on assignment with one of our clients, supporting their Device Management and Endpoint Security team on both day-to-day operations and modernization work. You’ll mix hands-on data and systems analysis with project coordination. That means learning how endpoint tools and services are used today, then helping the team standardize, automate and modernize them. You’ll contribute across several workstreams: standardizing remote access and browsers, automating patching, moving users from personal devices to managed devices, and automating processes with UiPath. Day to day, you’ll gather and analyze data, document current and future-state processes, track progress, and keep stakeholders aligned as priorities shift. This is a generalist role for someone curious, collaborative and quick to learn, and deep technical expertise isn’t required. It’s a hybrid role in Seattle, with 2–3 days a week in the office.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Analyze remote access portal usage (users, services, apps, servers, networks) and help define a path to standardized remote access.

• Support browser standardization – inventory usage, assess user/app dependencies, plan retirement of non-standard browsers.

• Support patch automation – document current patching, identify manual steps, define automation requirements.

• Support BYOD → managed device transition – impact and user-population analysis, readiness tracking, communications.

• Partner with the UiPath automation team to identify, document and prioritize automation candidates.

• Project coordinator for operational work – plans, tasks, risks, dependencies, status updates and meetings.

• Deep-dive data analysis – gather, clean and interpret inventory, ITSM and reporting data to support decisions.

• Document current/future-state processes, business requirements and user stories.

• Create end-user and Helpdesk content (e.g., SharePoint KB articles) to drive adoption.

• Support stakeholder engagement, change management and cross-functional communication.

• Track and report key metrics and progress across workstreams.

ABOUT YOU:

Your values:

• Integrity: You believe in doing the right thing, even when it's uncomfortable, seemingly inefficient, or costly. Purposefulness: You have a desire to serve others with your skillset and an openness to continuous learning and growth. Ownership: You stick to your commitments, follow up with action, and seek clarity in communication & expectations.

YOUR EXPERIENCE:

Required Qualifications

• 2–4 years as a BSA, BA, Project Coordinator, or similar in an IT/technology environment.

• Strong analytical skills; able to spot trends and draw conclusions from data.

• Curiosity and ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and how people use them.

• Process, requirements and workflow documentation (process maps, Visio, user stories).

• Coordinating tasks, timelines and stakeholders across multiple workstreams.

• Excellent written/verbal communication; translates between technical and non-technical audiences.

• High energy, collaborative, comfortable with shifting priorities.

• Familiar with Jira, ServiceNow or Zendesk, SharePoint, Microsoft 365.

Preferred Qualifications

• UiPath or comparable RPA / process automation exposure.

• Browser standardization, remote access standardization, patch automation, or BYOD/managed-device programs.

• Awareness of endpoint management and security concepts (Intune, Defender, Secure Score).

• Power BI or similar reporting/visualization tools.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• The annual salary range for this role is $90,000-$105,000.

• We offer Medical, Dental, Vision plans, 401K with matching, and PTO for salaried employees.

• Work/life balance – we know there’s more to life than work! We encourage our team to pursue other passions, get outside, and spend time with family. We work with clients and consultants to set expectations for a manageable workload.

LOCATION:

This role is hybrid with onsite requirements at our client's location in Seattle, WA.  Therefore, we are currently only considering candidates that are already living in the Seattle area.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please fill out the form below (including uploading your most recent resume) and we'll be in touch! We know imposter syndrome can be a barrier to many great applicants. We hope you'll still consider applying. That's why we've made the application process as short and simple as possible.

Even if you're not a fit for the role, you can expect to hear back from us! We want you to have the best experience as a candidate, so please feel free to share feedback at any stage of the process to talent@kallesgroup.com.
