jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About Buildkite

Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both - giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

About the Role

Our largest customers run CI/CD at frontier scale. AI is driving their build and test workloads up sharply, and more of these large, established companies want a partner to come in and build alongside them so they can grow and scale even faster.

As one of Buildkite's first Forward Deployed Engineers, you'll take on scoped engagements with strategic customers from design through delivery. Customers pay for an outcome: you work out what they actually need, agree on a clear deliverable, build it as production code, and land it in the platform. It's hands-on engineering with real customer access.

You'll spend time on site with the platform teams behind some of the most demanding CI workloads in the world, in the room with their engineers and executives, and you'll stay accountable until what you built works and is handed off. You'll also shape how it runs (how we scope, value, and hand off work) by actually implementing the first engagements, not by writing the playbook first.

You'll sit in our Revenue org alongside Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers, close to customers and Sales, and work hand in hand with Product and our Engineering team in Australia. The role is based on the US West Coast, with regular travel to customer sites (around 25%).

What You'll Do

• Work through the customer's reality and scope engagements before the deal closes: partnering with Solution Architects and TAMs to dig into what stands between a customer and Buildkite, identifying true gaps. Spot patterns across customers and bring them back to Product so recurring workarounds become roadmap items.

• Turn true gaps into defined engagements: a clear deliverable, an estimate, and exit criteria that the customer and Buildkite both sign off on, then keep the work inside that scope as new asks come up.

• Build core platform features, held to the same bar (and using the same frontier tools) as our product engineers. Then hand off cleanly to Product and Engineering so what you build becomes a supported part of Buildkite, benefitting all customers.

• Help Solutions Architects and Account Executives recognize FDE opportunities in their deals and explain what FDE is (and isn't) in plain terms, especially as we build the role together through iteration on engagements.

This Is You If...

• You've shipped production software end to end in the last few years: code you owned and were accountable for, not just contributed to.

• You'd pass the same technical bar as our product engineers.

• You can translate a business need into a technical spec and back again, and you stay composed when a customer's executive is frustrated.

• You're at ease with large, established enterprises: structured evaluations, security reviews, and leaders who want to understand the why before they commit.

• You can scope: take a vague ask, craft it into something defined and shippable, be clear about scope, and balance that line when new asks show up mid-engagement.

• You'd rather solve the customer's problem than either selling them more or building something shiny.

• You have product judgment: you can tell a one-off from something every customer needs.

• You want to build and stay close to customers, and you don't want to give up either.

• You're excited to help build a new function, and you know that means running the first engagements yourself and letting what you learn shape the playbook.

This Probably Isn't You If...

• You want to focus on code with little customer time, or on customers with little code. This role is both.

• You prefer a well-defined roadmap to working out what the problem is and taking initiative.

• You're looking for hourly consulting, training, or migration work. Those matter, but they're a different role.

• You'd rather not travel. Time on site with customers is a core part of this job.

Bonus Points If...

• You've led or supported a migration from another CI/CD system.

• You've been an early engineer at a developer tools, infrastructure, or B2B SaaS company, or worked in a forward deployed role.

• You've worked inside, or alongside, the engineering org of a growth-oriented SaaS company or large enterprise.

• You already use Buildkite.

Benefits

• 20 days paid annual leave plus 10 days sick & carer's leave — actively encouraged, we want you to be at your best and time off is a part of that.

• An ongoing remote-work allowance to help you do your best work — we want you to have everything you need, from great wifi to wellness options that are right for you.

• Retirement and health coverage (based on your region) — build towards your future, your way.

• 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers (6 weeks for secondary) — becoming a parent is life changing and we're committed to supporting you and your family through it.

• Confidential EAP & mental health support — sometimes life gets hard. You should be able to access the resources and support you need.

• Support for learning and growth — with time and budget for conferences, courses, and coaching so you have the opportunity to grow, improve your craft, and build mastery.

• Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world for up to 6 weeks a year — great work doesn't have to happen from one desk.

Exact benefits may vary slightly by country. We'll walk through the specifics for your location.

Compensation

This role sits on our engineering compensation bands: base salary plus equity. There's no commission: you're measured on outcomes delivered, not on what the customer spends. The base salary range is $223,000 - $247,000 USD. Compensation is determined based on geographic location, relevant experience, and qualifications.

🌈 Equal Opportunity Employer

At Buildkite, we value diversity and celebrate all types of skills, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment and providing reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process.

If you need any accommodations or support during the application or interview process, please reach out to us at accommodations@buildkite.com.

jobs.title: Social Strategist, X and Insights
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are investing in our owned social channels to grow share of voice and tell a clearer, more connected company story across LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube. We need someone to take direct ownership of X and run it day to day, while also maintaining consistent social performance data analysis across all of our owned channels.

This is a hands-on social strategy role for someone who knows how to build an interesting, credible and active presence on X. You will also work with the Social Manager to turn channel and audience data into clear recommendations about what Harvey should create, publish, test, stop and scale. The goal is a steady feedback loop between how our audience behaves, what our content strategy is and how our creative gets made.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


OWN X STRATEGY AND EXECUTION

 - Own Harvey's X strategy, programming and daily execution.

 - Develop a distinctive voice and a clear role for Harvey on the platform.

 - Create posts built for X, not LinkedIn content with the formatting changed.

 - Find proactive, reactive and real-time opportunities for Harvey to join relevant conversations.

 - Support product launches, research, events, partnerships, customer stories and company announcements on X.

 - Build recurring formats and programming that give people a reason to come back.

 - Write and edit copy that is clear, sharp and right for the platform.

 - Monitor replies, mentions and relevant conversations.

 - Work with the Social Content and Community Manager on engagement and response coverage.

 - Support founder, executive and employee amplification where it makes sense.

 - Use sound judgment in moments that carry brand, reputational or customer sensitivity.

 - Track changes to X and adjust our approach as the platform evolves.


MANAGING CROSS-CHANNEL INSIGHTS AND OPTIMIZATION

 - Work with Social Manager and Social Content and Community Manager to pull weekly and monthly performance analysis across X, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

 - Collaborate with the social team to go beyond surface metrics and explain what actually drove performance.

 - Identify patterns across format, topic, audience, timing, creative approach and distribution.

 - Help turn findings into specific programming and creative recommendations.

 - Work with third party analytics tools to track follower growth, reach, engagement, clicks, sentiment and other channel-specific signals.

 - Analyze performance during major launches, events and campaigns utilizing third party analytics and channel analytics.

 - Work with Content Operations on data accuracy, UTMs, reporting processes and dashboards.

 - Bring audience and performance insight into quarterly strategy and planning.


PUT SOCIAL LISTENING AND COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE TO WORK

 - Review owned and third party findings on legal AI conversations, share of voice and competitor activity.

 - Separate meaningful signals from routine noise.

 - Connect listening and competitive insights with channel performance data to build a fuller picture of what is working.

 - Translate audience questions, competitor moves and emerging conversations into programming and creative recommendations.

 - Write concise readouts for Social, Marketing and company leadership.

 - Flag opportunities and risks early enough for the team to act on them.


SUPPORT THE BROADER SOCIAL TEAM

 - Partner closely with the Social Manager on channel strategy, campaign planning and editorial priorities.

 - Help translate company priorities into programming for each platform.

 - Bring performance insight into the creative briefing process.

 - Support social coverage during major events and launches.

 - Collaborate with Content, Communications, Product Marketing, Customer Engagement and Harvey Creative Studio.

 - Help build repeatable processes without adding unnecessary approval layers.

 - Do the work yourself while also improving how the team makes decisions.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience in social strategy, social media, audience development, digital publishing or a related field.

 - Deep knowledge of X and a track record of growing or reshaping a meaningful brand presence there.

 - Strong editorial judgment and the ability to write sharp copy that fits the platform.

 - Experience running an active social channel in a fast-moving environment.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with social performance data.

 - The ability to explain why content performed the way it did, not just report the numbers.

 - Experience using social listening, competitive analysis and share-of-voice data to inform strategy.

 - A habit of turning data into specific creative and programming recommendations.

 - Experience designing social tests and evaluating the results honestly.

 - Familiarity with social publishing, analytics and listening platforms.

 - Good instincts for real-time content, reputational risk and sensitive moments.

 - Experience presenting insights to senior marketing or company leaders.

 - Excellent communication skills and a collaborative way of working.

 - Comfort making good calls with incomplete information and shifting priorities.

 - Genuine interest in legal technology, AI and how professional work is changing.

You do not need to be a data scientist. We care about analytical fluency, curiosity and the ability to tell a clear story with data, combined with strong social instincts.



Helpful but not required: Experience in B2B technology, media, professional services, legal or another complex industry.




COMPENSATION

$112,000 - $154,000 USD

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Implementation Operations
jobs.description:
Who is Spring Fertility?

We are a passionate, dedicated team of leading physicians and scientists who have trained at some of the world’s top research hospitals and fertility centers. Together, we are building the fastest-growing fertility group in the country, grounded in clinical excellence and innovation. We deliver deeply patient-centric, individualized, and compassionate care, recognizing that every journey is unique. Our mission is to partner with patients to help them achieve their goals, whatever those may be. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to build a family if they choose, and our team is committed to guiding and supporting patients every step of the way.

Why should you join our team?

We are a mission-driven organization seeking motivated, high-performing professionals who are eager to innovate and make an impact. As we build a first-class fertility practice, we balance excellence with a culture that values collaboration, positivity, and enjoyment in the work we do. We are growing rapidly and are deeply committed to the professional and personal development of our team. Guided by optimism, compassion, and teamwork, we are united by a shared dedication to putting patients first.

Role Summary

Spring Fertility is seeking a Director of Strategic Implementation Operations to translate company growth priorities into focused plans, patient-centered operating models, measurable initiatives, and scalable execution across markets. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and partnering closely with Clinical, Marketing, and Technology executive leaders. This role connects marketing strategy, business operations, clinical operations/patient interface, patient experience, finance, technology, and local market teams.

This is a high-impact role for a structured, analytical operator who can move from strategy to execution: diagnosing business and patient journey opportunities, building business cases, designing processes, recommending where technology can improve the patient experience and reduce manual work, and ensuring initiatives are prioritized, implemented, tested, and measured against business impact.

Essential Functions

Improving the Patient Journey to Fuel Growth

• Translate enterprise growth priorities into operational strategies and measurable initiatives across markets.

• Seeks to continuously improve the end-to-end patient journey from first inquiry through treatment onboarding, identifying friction points, handoffs, communication gaps, and opportunities to make the experience clearer, warmer, and easier for patients.

• Lead analyses to identify growth opportunities, diagnose funnel or market performance issues, and recommend actions across patient acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and resource allocation.

• Develop executive-ready business cases and decision memos that synthesize patient needs, operational realities, financial implications, risks, and required capabilities.

• Create planning cadences, prioritization frameworks, and governance mechanisms that improve focus, accountability, execution, and cross-functional alignment.

• All other duties as assigned.

Analytics, KPI Ownership & Executive Reporting

• Own key marketing, patient funnel, operational, and systems performance metrics, including new patient demand, inquiry response, appointment conversion, campaign performance, clinic capacity alignment, system adoption, and workflow efficiency.

• Develop dashboards, reporting, and executive summaries that connect marketing activity, patient journey performance, operational constraints, resource allocation, and growth.

• Partner with Finance to evaluate business ROI, market economics, resource utilization, budget allocation, and growth tradeoffs.

• Jointly track patient satisfaction, time-to-service, and administrative-burden reduction with operational and technology owners; do not own technical KPIs such as platform availability, AI accuracy, model drift, or integration performance.

Process Design and Business Requirements

• Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders, clinical and finance operation leaders, and technology partners to define, document, and prioritize business requirements, functional specifications, workflows, and success measures.

• Maintain ownership of the operating process after launch and recommend/implement adjustments based on business performance and frontline feedback.

• Own current-state and future-state processes, including patient-facing and internal workflows, role clarity, decision rights, handoffs, escalation paths, and data flows across functions and systems.

Business Readiness, Testing, and Change Management

• Own stakeholder alignment, operational readiness, business communications, role clarity, frontline engagement, and operating-procedure changes for approved initiatives.

• Co-lead user-acceptance testing with operational users and provide business sign-off against defined acceptance criteria; Technology owns system and integration testing.

• Partner with AI Transformation and Technology on rollout sequencing, training, adoption, and feedback loops; Technology owns technical training, release readiness, go-live, and post-launch stabilization.

• Assess operating-model, process, capacity, and adoption risks and coordinate mitigation with accountable functional owners.

Education, Licenses, Certifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or related field.

• 2–5+ years of experience in strategy, business operations, growth operations, management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, healthcare operations, or a similarly analytical role.

• Ability to structure ambiguous problems, analyze data, build recommendations, and align senior stakeholders.

• Experience translating strategy into operating plans, cross-functional processes, KPIs, and scalable execution models.

• Strong analytical and financial acumen, with comfort using funnel, volume, operational, and financial data to inform tradeoffs and decisions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready presentations, business cases, dashboards, and decision memos.

• Strong systems and process fluency, with experience using dashboards, CRM or patient funnel reporting, project management tools, and workflow processes to drive visibility, accountability, and execution.

• Experience managing, coaching, or providing functional leadership to direct reports or cross-functional execution partners.

• Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple clinics or markets simultaneously and navigate ambiguity.

• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the credibility to work effectively with clinical and provider audiences.

• Background in management consulting, investment banking, private equity portfolio operations, corporate strategy, business operations, or strategic finance preferred

• Experience in healthcare, fertility, women’s health, consumer healthcare, multi-site services, or other operationally complex businesses preferred

• Experience supporting multi-location, multi-market, or practice-based businesses where strategy must be translated into localized execution preferred

Employment Type

This is a full-time, exempt role that will be hybrid/remote based in one of our regions (CA, NY or OR) with ~20% expected travel

Compensation

The starting salary range for this role is $150,000-$190,000 annually. Salary is based on several factors including job related knowledge and skill set, depth of experience, certifications and/or degrees.

Benefits

Investing in You Today and Tomorrow

Supporting your well-being

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision plans

• Paid time off to recharge and enjoy personal time

• Access to BetterHelp therapy sessions for mental and emotional wellness

• Commuter benefits and discounted rates on home, auto, and pet insurance

Investing in your future

• 401(k) with up to a 4% company match

• Comprehensive fertility and parental leave benefits

• Career development opportunities in a fast-growing organization

• Employer-paid life and disability insurance

*Temporary and contract roles may not be eligible for all benefits listed above

Don’t have it all? We still welcome you to apply!

At Spring Fertility, we believe that everyone who wants a family deserves to have one, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, or religion. Just as we acknowledge and value the diversity of goals, life experiences, and unique paths to parenthood among our patients, we also actively celebrate diversity within our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment for all. We recognize that diversity among our team allows us to not only more effectively serve our patients, but also to advance innovation and opportunity within our field. We encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to apply to our employment opportunities.

We are scientists. We are humanists. We are passionate about fertility.

Spring Fertility will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please give us a call.

We’re building an agent that works on behalf of our members across their entire career. It learns who they are and what they want, finds opportunities they would have overlooked, surfaces the people who can help them get there, and takes the next step with them.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Career Agents team in our talent marketplace. You’ll work side by side with AI and ML engineers, designers, and researchers, and you’ll ship iterations weekly.

Basic Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience building agents or LLM-powered products and shipping them to real users

jobs.title: Senior Photonics Engineer, Free-Space Optics
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

K2's ambitions extend beyond the satellite bus. By designing and operating our own spacecraft and regularly manifesting hardware to orbit, K2 is uniquely positioned to develop, test, and deploy ambitious, “limit-of-physics” optical and photonic payloads across MEO, GEO, cislunar, and deep space on unprecedented timelines. The satellite bus is the platform – the payloads are the mission.

As a Senior Photonics Engineer focused on free-space optics, your role is to define how K2 measures and models the atmosphere, and how our optical hardware is designed to work through it. You will work at the intersection of free-space optical communications, adaptive optics, and integrated photonics, and own the full loop from experiment to model, across a ladder of experiments: tabletop emulators that reproduce atmospheric turbulence in the lab, benches that put our optical hardware (free-space receivers, wavefront correction, and photonic chips) inside that emulated channel, outdoor links across real turbulence on rooftops and test ranges, and occasional campaigns at mountaintop optical ground stations and observatories. You will own K2's atmospheric channel modeling and decide how measured data flows into requirements for PIC, test, and payload teams. You will work closely with PIC designers, test engineers, and K2's optical payload team, and as K2's payloads grow, you will also consult on remote-sensing and other payloads that look through the atmosphere.

Responsibilities

• Design and build tabletop experiments that emulate optical propagation through turbulent media, using spatial light modulators, phase plates, and phase-screen generation; validate them against target statistics (Cn², r0, scintillation, beam wander, wavefront error, fade statistics).

• Put receivers in the loop (free-space optics, fiber and photonic-chip front ends, and their control electronics) and measure coupling efficiency, fading, bit error rate, and control-loop bandwidth.

• Characterize wavefront sensing and correction hardware (Shack-Hartmann sensors, deformable mirrors, SLMs) alongside photonic-integrated alternatives.

• Take experiments out of the lab: outdoor horizontal-path links on rooftops and test ranges, then night campaigns at mountaintop optical ground stations and observatories, including site coordination, laser-safety approvals, equipment transport, night operations, and data reduction.

• Own K2's optical propagation and channel models long-term: build them in Python, calibrate them continuously against lab and field data, quantify their uncertainty, and turn the results into requirements.

• Define the experiment roadmap: decide which measurements most reduce model uncertainty, and set the lab-to-field test plan.

• Automate experiments on the team's shared test framework so lab and field data share one pipeline.

• Mentor engineers and technicians supporting the experiments.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in optics, physics, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.

• 5+ years of hands-on free-space optics experience in free-space optical communications, adaptive optics, or atmospheric propagation (a relevant PhD counts toward this).

• Led free-space optical experiments end to end: designing and aligning benches, taking data, and correlating it with models.

• Working knowledge of optical turbulence and propagation theory (Cn², Fried parameter, Rytov variance), with Python for modeling and analysis.

Nice to Have

• MS or PhD in optics, physics, or a related field.

• Adaptive optics experience in astronomy, beam control, or free-space optical communications.

• Experience with photonic integrated circuits, photonic lanterns, or fiber coupling through turbulence.

• Pointing, acquisition, and tracking (fast steering mirrors, beacon tracking) or optical link performance analysis (BER, SNR, scintillation and fading).

• Spatial light modulators, deformable or fast steering mirrors, or phase-plate turbulence emulators.

• Field campaigns at an observatory or outdoor optical test range, including night operations.

• Remote sensing, lidar, or atmospheric characterization instruments.

• Wave-optics simulation tools (e.g., AOTools, WaveProp) and Zemax.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $220,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Total Rewards Analyst
jobs.description:
The team + the role

Pendo's Total Rewards team runs the benefits, leave, and compensation programs that employees depend on for health coverage, financial security, and time away from work. Accurate enrollments, clean vendor data, and clear communication determine whether those programs work efficiently.

Total Rewards at Pendo runs on accuracy, speed, and a practice of improving every process we touch.

The Total Rewards Analyst administers benefits and leave programs day to day, keeps enrollment and eligibility data accurate across vendors and payroll, and reports on program health. The role partners with Payroll, Finance, the wider People Team, and external benefits vendors. At the P3 level, the role works independently within a defined scope, adapts established approaches to varied problems, and turns audit findings into process improvements. When the role is done well, employees get correct answers quickly, vendors receive clean files, and payroll deductions match elections the first time.

What this looks like day-to-day

• Benefits operations: Works the queue of life event changes and benefits inquiries, confirms each change lands correctly in vendor and payroll systems, and prepares open enrollment materials ahead of the annual window.

• Leave administration: Runs leave intake through return, keeps status tracking current, and sends timely updates to Payroll and the sales organization.

• Data quality: Audits benefits and compensation data on a recurring cadence, resolves eligibility file errors with providers, and documents the fix so the same error does not return.

• Compliance and reporting: Fulfills required benefits reporting and filing requirements such as audits, 5500 filings, Non-discrimination testing, etc.

• Support employee & manager inquiries: Triage escalated tickets through Kinfolk (AI based HR ticketing & workflow system), and enhance knowledge base and workflows.

• Vendor and invoice management: Reviews benefits invoices, supports invoice processing.

• Knowledge and documentation: Keeps leave and benefits guides, process documents, and employee resources accurate in Confluence and Google Drive.

• AI-assisted execution: Applies AI to drafting, anomaly detection, reporting, and documentation upkeep.

Who you are

Must-haves

• You have 5 or more years of experience in benefits administration, leave administration, HR operations, or total rewards, or equivalent experience, and you can point to outcomes you owned.

• You have owned processes from intake to accurate completion, working independently with review at key milestones.

• You have working knowledge of benefits programs (health, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, 401(k), COBRA) and of leave and accommodation processes, including the compliance basics behind them.

• You bring strong attention to detail with data, including auditing eligibility files, reconciling invoices, and spotting anomalies.

• You make sound calls with incomplete information and know when to escalate with a recommendation.

• You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation with employees, vendors, Payroll, and leaders, and you handle confidential medical and personal information with discretion.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience leading an annual open enrollment cycle.

• Experience with Workday as a benefits enrollment platform.

• Experience building process documentation and employee-facing guides.

EEOC

We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility

All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

Compensation

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supporting children with learning differences? Parallel is seeking a dedicated and collaborative Special Education Teacher to support our 5th through 8th-grade students. In this full-time role, you will deliver direct instruction tailored to individual student needs while managing a caseload of students with mild to moderate disabilities. Beyond academic instruction, we are looking for an educator who excels at building meaningful relationships with students, partnering closely with general education teachers, and actively contributing to a strong, supportive school culture.

What You'll Do

• Deliver Expertise: Provide legally compliant, specially designed instruction (SDI) and deliver compensatory education services (when indicated) to students with active Individualized Education Programs (IEPs).

• Instructional Design & Implementation: Develop and execute data-driven, individualized lesson plans to target critical skill areas:

• Reading and literacy development

• Foundational math skills and intervention

• Executive functioning and organizational strategies

• Functional and adaptive life skills

• IEP Management & Compliance: Own the creation, management, and ongoing progress monitoring of student IEPs, including case management responsibilities.

• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Collaborate with the student's IEP team to coordinate service schedules and tailor instructional approaches to unique student needs.

• Assessment & Evaluation: Administer screenings, conduct progress monitoring, and complete formal outcomes assessments to drive instructional decision-making.

What You'll Need

Core Qualifications (Required Qualifications)

• Active Special Education teaching license/certification in the state of Colorado.

• School-based experience providing specially designed instruction and working effectively with diverse student populations.

• Exceptional collaborative communication skills for engaging with IEP teams, including teachers, parents, and students.

• Proficiency in conducting virtual services using meeting platforms and a strong command of instructional technology.

Remote Setup & Availability

• Dedicated, private workspace with a secure, high-speed internet connection, reliable computer, and webcam.

• Availability during traditional school hours (8:00am - 4:00pm) and days (Monday-Friday).

• Commitment to a minimum availability of 37.5 hours/week.

Why Join Parallel?

At Parallel, We Simplify Your Work So You Can Focus On What Matters Most—delivering Quality Care. We Provide Comprehensive Support, Including

• Thoughtful Student & District Matching: Alignment with your experience, licensure, and expertise to match you with appropriate districts, schools, and student needs.

• Efficient Tools and Support: Access to templates, tools, and streamlined systems designed to reduce administrative paperwork and maintain organization.

• Billing & Operational Support: Systems that manage billing and documentation workflows, allowing you to prioritize student support and collaboration.

• Clinical Resources: Utilization of standardized assessments, progress monitoring tools, and therapy resources to ensure high-quality service delivery.

• Innovation & Feedback: Opportunities for your input to directly shape the future of our programs.

• Clinical Community: Connection with peers through dedicated office hours, provider meetings, and free continuing education opportunities offered throughout the school year.

• A Powerful Mission: The chance to significantly improve the lives of students nationwide.

Compensation

Parallel is the first tech-forward provider of care for learning and thinking differences across the United States. We believe learning differences are parallel ways of thinking that should be celebrated. Our mission is to provide students with the resources and encouragement to succeed in the classroom and beyond by helping them build confidence in their unique strengths and create strategies to work around their challenges.

Our core services include:

• Psychological Assessment

• Counseling

• Speech-Language Services

• Special Education

• And more

Learn more at parallellearning.com.

At Parallel, we believe in celebrating differences. This belief extends from schools into our workplace and through the ways we work together toward our mission. We are committed to fostering a diverse, accessible environment that represents many different cultures, backgrounds, viewpoints, and abilities by championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.

jobs.title: Director Analytics (Media)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Crossmedia is the global media independent. We’re committed to doing media and business the right way, guided by the principles of TRUST, REASON and the Pursuit of HAPPINESS. Crossmedia US was founded in NY in 2000 and is one of the largest minority-owned full-service media planning & buying agencies in the nation. We are 500+ Crossmedians worldwide with big ambitions to continue to grow with soul.

We focus on what media agencies should do: create innovative connections between brands and people regardless of channel or budget. And we do it in an honest way. We are and always have been a values-based organization. We earn our clients TRUST by ensuring media transparency in our business model and objectivity in decision-making. We apply REASON & logic to finding solutions to our clients' greatest business challenges. The Pursuit of HAPPINESS matters to us. Big time. We invest in each colleagues’ professional & personal wellbeing and growth. It’s why we have countless initiatives, clubs & cultural events dedicated to our people and why we have been the top ranked media agency named to Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for the past seven years in a row.

We have offices in the NY, Philadelphia, London and Germany.  Our client roster includes U.S. Bank, Invesco, Newell Brands, NASCAR, American Cancer Society, Ricola, Herschend Family Entertainment, Zalando, Edible Arrangements, Citizens Bank, and more.

YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a passionate, collaborative, and resourceful Director to join Redbox, Crossmedia’s analytics and business intelligence team.  You will help lead the development and implementation of analytics solutions to evaluate and optimize marketing performance. Your expertise will guide clients in understanding the effectiveness of their media investments across various channels, driving strategic decisions and maximizing ROI.

As a senior member of the team, you will partner closely with the Group Director to review project briefs, provide analytics leadership on client strategic challenges, and drive the development and execution of cross-channel measurement strategies.  You will roll up your sleeves to analyze MMM and MTA outputs, design analytics frameworks, create data visualizations, optimize media investment, and translate complex data into actionable insights.  The ideal candidate is passionate about advancing the role of analytics in strategic marketing, and excited to build best-in-class measurement solutions across a portfolio of high-profile client.

THIS IS A NY BASED ROLE AND WE WORK IN A HYBRID SETTING

Client Leadership & Strategic Partnership

• Act as a key Redbox lead across assigned accounts, providing guidance, leadership, and direction on all measurement initiatives.

• Build strong, independent relationships with client leads across media, analytics, and brand teams.

• Partner closely with internal Media Planning and Strategy teams to fully understand client business needs, KPIs, and strategic priorities, ensuring alignment on goals and collaboration plans.

• Serve as a senior strategic advisor to clients, helping them connect measurement outputs to broader business decisions.

• Advocate for measurement as a critical driver of business value, not just a reporting function.

Measurement and Data Strategy

• Translate complex modeling outputs into clear, compelling business recommendations for clients and internal teams.

• Build, refine, and integrate Incrementality Testing best practices into broader measurement frameworks (e.g., involving MMM, MTA, brand lift).

• Own partnerships with modeling vendors and/or lead internal model development efforts.

Team Leadership & Development

• Manage and mentor a team of analysts and managers, fostering growth in technical, strategic, and storytelling skills.

• Train the team on best-in-class measurement, dashboarding, insights generation, and client presentations — leading by example.

• Serve as a visible, accessible leader that the team looks up to for clear direction, decision-making, and collaborative input.

• Encourage a culture of continuous learning across new tools, visualization platforms, audience building, MMM, MTA, and testing

• Bring forward new ideas for improving processes, building the team, enhancing output, and evolving the way we work.

• Lead the development of reporting and dashboarding platforms, helping the team navigate setup based on client needs — and be ready to dive in hands-on when needed

REQUIREMENTS

• 6+ years’ experience in media analytics and business intelligence, with a focus on measurement strategy

• Experience crafting tailored measurement + optimization frameworks and test + learn agendas across multiple verticals or lines of business

• Experience with marketing mix modeling (design, interpretation, strategic application) with experience across other forms of media measurement (MTA, brand lift, incrementality testing)

• Strong understanding of media channels (traditional, digital, retail, and commerce media) and how they drive business results.

• Experience with floodlight-based connections and measurement ideal

• Experience with statistical modeling platforms/tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) a plus, but storytelling and strategy skills are equally critical.

• Ability to synthesize complex technical outputs into clear, client-ready insights.

• Highly effective project/team manager: Has solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking agility

• Reliable & responsible: can steward the analytics team day to day and help manage workflow. Manage across multiple projects, tools, clients, deadlines.

• Excellent collaborator & communicator. Used to presenting in front of larger audiences.

• Strong listening skills: believes good thinking can come from anyone and any place; is a team player willing to compromise their point of view in support of others

THIS IS A NY BASED ROLE AND WE WORK IN A HYBRID SETTING.

CROSSMEDIA BENEFITS

Our principles of Trust, Reason, and the Pursuit of Happiness are brought to life through benefits that recognize and support the diversity and physical, emotional, and professional well-being of our people, including:

• Flexibility to work in hybrid manner with in-office and work from home options (depending on role).

• Open/Flexible PTO/Annual leave with US & UK specific policies

• Sponsored healthcare options and agency-wide physical & mental health support

• 401k with company match (USA), and generous Pension (UK)

• Paid sabbatical at significant milestone anniversaries

• Generous paid parental leave policy

• Life milestone recognition & support

• The Pursuit of Happiness Fund devoted to helping Crossmedians find their happy (be it travel, enrichment class, fitness membership or professional development)

• Cell phone/tech reimbursement

• Student Loan payment plan (US)

• Tuition reimbursement

• Learning & Development and training programs

• And burgers – lots and lots of burgers

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Diversity is in our DNA. As a minority-owned company, our commitment to an inclusive environment has long been embedded into agency practices and at every level. Almost one third of senior leadership identifies as a person of color and over half of our executive leadership are women. We have active mentoring & internship programs that create opportunities for underrepresented groups. Internal agency programming is anchored by XMEquity365, a permanent, year-round initiative fostering acknowledgement and support of marginalized communities within five pillars – Excellence, Voices, Education, Giving & Representation.

Crossmedia is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and creating a diverse and inclusive company culture and that does not discriminate against candidates and employees because of their disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Essential and other job functions are subject to modification. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to which will be required in this position. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.” Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions in compliance with the American with Disabilities Act of 1990 (US based)

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

Job Description

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Litigation & Operations Legal Specialist to join our team based out of our corporate offices in Frisco, TX.

The successful candidate will support the Company’s legal department across a broad range of litigation, regulatory, and legal operations matters, including litigation intake, litigation management, law enforcement subpoenas, inquiries from the field, regulatory inquiries, consumer group inquiries, small claims matters, legislative tracking, bankruptcy matters, and assisting outside counsel and internal legal staff with advancing cases.

This role has become available due to an expansion of the team. The selected candidate will work closely with two existing Litigation & Operations Legal Specialists, as well as other members of the Legal Department, who will be actively involved in training, mentoring, and supporting the selected individual. This is a strong opportunity for someone to learn directly from experienced team members, build deep institutional knowledge, and contribute to an established, and actively growing, legal operations function.

Key Responsibilities

Litigation Support

• Intake, monitor, and track new litigation cases.
• Manage the active litigation docket, including small claims and eviction matters
• Process service of process and assign litigation matters to in-house and outside counsel as appropriate
• Assist in compiling responses to discovery requests, subpoenas, government inquiries, and regulatory investigations
• Support internal investigations, including timeline development and data analysis
• Coordinate with IT and business units to collect electronically stored information (ESI) for discovery and regulatory matters
• Serve as internal liaison between outside counsel, business units, and the legal team for fact collection, document production, and discovery coordination

Legal Compliance

• Provide legal compliance guidance to field operations and commercial real estate teams on various matters, including delinquent accounts, property management issues, and operations policies
• Assist with tracking legislative and regulatory developments impacting Company operations.
• Support responses to regulatory inquiries, customer escalations, and internal compliance questions.

Legal Operations

• Support the intake, assignment, and tracking of legal matters across internal systems.
• Maintain and update matter management systems, including opening matters, tracking status, managing budgets, and reporting on outcomes
• Respond to inquiries from the field relating to Legal matters and escalate internally as needed.

Assist with process improvements, reporting, and coordination across Legal, Field Operations, IT, and other business teams.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree and ABA-approved paralegal certificate or equivalent legal training required, with at least 5 years of relevant experience
• Thorough working knowledge of, and advanced aptitude in using, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Microsoft Word, and corporate legal databases such as CounselLink, CSC, ServiceNow (or similar ticketing/matter management systems), Westlaw, PACER, Docuware, and Yardi with the ability to learn new applications and programs
• Excellent communication skills
• Must be detail-oriented and highly organized
• Must be a self-starter and possess strong multi-tasking skills
• Must be able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Enthusiasm for being part of a growing, collaborative legal team

Workplace

Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst, Connected Warfare
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Our Business Operations team works across business lines and functional organizations to solve high-priority, ambiguous challenges and build the analytical and operational muscles needed to support rapid growth.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Business Operations Analyst, you will sit at the intersection of operations, strategy, and data, turning messy, complex operational challenges into structured data to inform high stakes business decisions.

Your primary focus will be producing high-quality, repeatable data analysis and synthesis to enable informed, data-backed decision-making across leadership and cross-functional teams. You will get hands-on with our data architecture—leveraging modern enterprise data platforms and analytical tools to establish reliable sources of truth, build intuitive dashboards, and translate quantitative findings into strategic narratives for executive audiences.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build Repeatable Analytics Workflows: Design, execute, and automate high-quality, repeatable data models and analytical pipelines to track critical operational, business, and financial metrics.

• Drive Business Decision-Making: Partner closely with leadership and functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, evaluate operational trade-offs, and guide strategic decisions through data synthesis.

• Data Visualization & Dashboarding: Develop clear, self-service dashboards and visualization frameworks that equip functional teams with the tools and metrics to monitor and improve their processes.

• Executive Storytelling: Translate complex analyses into clean, executive-ready presentations, reports, and narratives, with results presented directly to senior leadership teams.

• System & Tool Deep-Dives: Work deeply within our data tools and business infrastructure (including Salesforce, Oracle, Palantir Foundry, Databricks, and other core enterprise systems) to execute scrappy analyses on short timelines and build robust data pipelines over the long term.

• Drive Operational Excellence: Proactively identify friction and process bottlenecks across the organization, using quantitative analysis to drive sustainable operational solutions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2–5 years of professional experience in Business Operations, Business Analytics, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, Banking, or a similar analytical operating role.

• Demonstrated expertise in Business Analytics and Data Visualization: Proven track record of structuring ambiguous operational problems, manipulating large datasets, and presenting data visually to influence decisions.

• Enterprise Data Tooling: Hands-on experience querying and working within modern data and analytics platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Oracle, Palantir Foundry, Databricks, SQL, or equivalent enterprise data environments).

• High Fluency in Excel & PowerPoint: Advanced capability in Excel (complex modeling, pivot tables, data manipulation) and PowerPoint (building polished, executive-ready narrative decks).

• High Ownership & Bias for Action: You are self-driven, hyper-organized, and detail-oriented; you step into gaps proactively and follow through from insight to execution.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill sophisticated quantitative insights clearly to senior leadership and diverse cross-functional teams.

• Security & Compliance: Must be a U.S. Person and eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance due to access to export-controlled information.

• Willing to travel as necessary (up to 25%)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience operating within defense technology, aerospace, manufacturing, government contracting, or fast-scaling tech environments.

• Prior experience building data pipelines, transforms, or front-end applications within Palantir Foundry or Databricks.

• Familiarity with Salesforce and Oracle, or other relevant ERP, MRP, or CRM systems.

US Salary Range

$117,000—$145,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

By enabling earlier detection of disease recurrence, NavDx helps clinicians optimize patient management and improve outcomes. In this role, you will engage a broad range of stakeholders—including medical oncologists, radiation oncologists, head and neck surgeons, and colorectal surgeons—within multidisciplinary care teams to expand clinical awareness and utilization of NavDx.

SK Hynix Memory Solutions is a leading worldwide provider of NVMe storage solutions for enterprise and hyperscale applications. You will own test execution, initial failure analysis, and drive issues to resolution with development and functional teams to ensure the highest product quality for customers.

Responsibilities

• Develop test plans for devices/systems under test based on the NVMe/OCP/PCIe specifications, PRDs, and customer requirements.

• Experience working with enterprise servers in Linux, ESXi, and Windows Server OS environments is a PLUS/desirable.

Education Requirement

REGARDING COMPENSATION

SK hynix memory solutions America Inc. offers you the opportunity to apply your skills to exciting projects while working with innovative teams. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe is built on vertical integration, and our advantage depends on how well our business units work together. This role sits at the center of that. You’ll strategize and build the Crusoe Operating System: the software, processes, and AI that connect our business units and make vertical integration a real operating advantage.

You’ll work side by side with the CTO and senior leaders to keep teams aligned, initiatives moving, and priorities clear as the company grows quickly. You’ll support the CTO and a staff of about six, work closely with Cloud Engineering and Product, and have direct access to the people making the biggest decisions.

This is a high-agency role. You spot what needs attention before anyone asks, and you step in without waiting for direction. The problems are real and high-impact: coordination gaps between teams, initiatives that stall without an owner, and processes that worked at one size and break at the next. You’ll build the structure and clarity that let a fast-scaling company run as one organization.

This is not a calendar-and-slide-deck chief of staff role, and it isn’t a program manager scoped to a single initiative. You’ll need enough technical depth to engage credibly with engineering leaders and enough organizational instinct to work in the seams between teams.

If you like getting your hands dirty, do your best work in fast-moving environments, and want a tangible impact on how a high-growth company at the junction of the world’s most important industries operates, we’d like to meet you.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Build the Crusoe Operating System. Strategize and build the combination of software, processes, and AI that ties our business units together.

 - Lead internal AI and IT strategy. Weave modern technology into every business process at Crusoe.

 - Support the CTO and the CTO’s staff. Partner with the CTO and a staff of about six to keep priorities clear and work moving.

 - Be the connective tissue across leadership. Build real relationships with senior leaders, directors, and tech leads. Know what’s actually going on in their orgs, and help them see the things they’re too close to notice.

 - Keep the health of the org strong. Chase down open items and keep processes streamlined.

 - Build and own the KPI infrastructure. Give leadership real visibility through dashboards, operational metrics, and initiative trackers. Data should tell the story before anyone has to ask.

 - Drive quarterly planning. Quarterly planning is run by engineering managers and project TPMs. You own the process, the timeline, and the quality of the output, so every team walks out with clear goals and commitments.

 - Keep the org close. Identify redundant processes and gaps, and suggest ways to close and collapse them.

 - Push back with technical credibility. Go deep on the topics that matter, don’t accept surface-level answers, and hold people to the commitments they made last week.

 - Be the face of the CTO’s office in cross-functional forums. Represent priorities and constraints clearly so individual teams aren’t pulled in ten directions by people who aren’t in the room.

 - Stay tight with Cloud Engineering and Product. Keep them from drifting apart between planning cycles and scrambling to realign every quarter.

 - Own the cross-cutting programs that don’t have a natural single owner. Production readiness, tooling decisions, org-wide comms, and similar work. If nobody owns it, you do.

 - Drive IPO readiness and compliance.

 - Coordinate headcount planning and org design. Handle the operational logistics of scaling across multiple sites and countries.

 - Use AI tooling and agentic systems aggressively. Aggregate information across a large, globally distributed org, and build systems and workflows that scale.

 - Drive follow-through on commitments across the org. You’re the person who remembers what was promised and isn’t afraid to ask about it.

 - Tighten the connective tissue between our operational tools. Operational data should flow cleanly into reporting and decisions without manual stitching.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Engineering or computer science background strongly preferred, with 8+ years in software engineering, technical program management, or a technical product role. You’ve been close enough to production systems to understand what an SLO breach actually means.

 - The ability to operate independently with little direction.

 - People skills to talk to every executive as a peer, and to represent engineering credibly to product, executive leadership, and external stakeholders.

 - A solutions-oriented approach, with strong documentation and organization.

 - Experience in a high-growth infrastructure or cloud environment where things break and processes are still being built. Ambiguity doesn’t paralyze you; it’s where you do your best work.

 - Experience helping scale an organization through a significant growth phase. You know which processes to formalize and which to leave lightweight.

 - Strong opinions about operational excellence, and the willingness to push back on leaders when follow-through slips. Diplomacy matters, but so does directness.

 - The ability to work across teams without formal authority. People trust you because you come prepared, follow up, and make their lives easier.

 - The ability to take messy, inconsistent data from multiple sources and turn it into a clear picture of organizational health.

 - A scrappy mindset. When the automation doesn’t exist yet, you build it or do it manually until it does.

 - Low ego, high drive. You care about the outcome more than the credit.



Bonus Points

 - Neo-cloud experience, or time inside AWS, GCP, Azure, CoreWeave, Lambda, or a similar cloud provider

 - Experience standing up or running an operations, chief of staff, or reliability function from scratch

 - Experience driving quarterly or annual planning for organizations of 200+ people

 - Experience building reporting automation, such as pulling data from APIs and generating dashboards

 - Background in AI/ML infrastructure



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $200,000 - $240,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.



Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

You’ll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. You’ll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Core responsibilities:

 - Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

 - Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

 - Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

 - Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

 - Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

 - Deliver tailored demos.  Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

 - Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

 - Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

 - Travel 30–50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. 

 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

 - Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

 - Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

 - Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

 - Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

 - Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

 - Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

 - Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

 - Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

 - Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

jobs.description:

Thunkable is the leading no-code and AI platform that empowers anyone to design, develop, and deploy powerful, native mobile applications without writing a single line of code. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the front end of the sales pipeline. They turn target accounts and inbound interest into qualified, sales-ready meetings for Account Executives. The role blends outbound prospecting, inbound lead follow-up, and early-stage discovery, and success is measured almost entirely by pipeline created.
In one line:Find the right people, start the right conversations, qualify fit honestly, and hand AEs opportunities worth their time.

Prospect, educate, qualify, and develop Target Accounts and inbound leads to create sales-ready meetings and opportunities. Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to stimulate opportunity

Become a trusted resource and develop productive relationships with prospects

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline targets

Maintain professional internal and external relationships that meet our core values

Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing, and presentation skills
The highest level of integrity

jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health.
