ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented Manager, Production Planning to lead the planning team responsible for our non-sterile compounded production. This position manages and develops the site's production planners and owns the forward-looking production plan. The plan converts demand forecasts and inventory policy into a rolling view of the next several weeks through the next year or more, tests that plan against labor, equipment, and material capacity, and identifies where the business cannot meet it. The Manager then drives the response to each gap, whether through training, labor, or capital investment, and hands the plan to Production Scheduling for on-site execution. The ideal candidate is a proactive people leader with a strong understanding of integrated planning systems, supply chain dynamics, and cross-functional collaboration across the operations planning team.

 


YOU WILL:

 - Lead, manage, and develop the team of production planners, setting priorities, coaching, reviewing output, and ensuring consistent planning practices and coverage.

 - Own the development and maintenance of mid- and long-term production plans for non-sterile compounded products in alignment with demand forecasts and inventory policies.

 - Define the planning horizons, plan-of-record cadence, and frozen window, and publish the plan to Production Scheduling on a fixed schedule.

 - Manage finished goods inventory for compounded products within company guidance while maintaining click-to-deliver metrics for customers.

 - Develop what-if scenarios that identify where and when the plan exceeds available capacity, and which constraints are most sensitive to demand, product mix, batch size, and shift patterns.

 - Articulate and document all risks resulting from production capacity constraints, including volume at risk, timing, and effect on delivery and inventory. If the plan cannot be met, make or recommend revisions when plans cannot be met, and document the reason for each revision.

 - Recommend and size actions to close each gap, including training and cross-training for skill coverage, hiring and labor planning, overtime and shift design, equipment and facility investment, and outsourcing. Partner with Compounding Operations, HR, and Quality to carry out approved actions and track whether each one delivers the capacity it was sized to deliver.

 - Monitor plan attainment, forecast accuracy, and capacity utilization at the weekly and monthly level, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions.

 - Use actual cycle times, yields, and throughput reported by Production Scheduling to update planning standards and capacity model assumptions.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally across the operations planning team, partnering with demand planning to communicate forecast discrepancies and agree on the plan of record, with production scheduling to confirm the plan can be executed and take in the constraints it escalates, and with procurement and raw materials planning to confirm material availability.

 - Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and KPIs that communicate plan status, constraints, risks, and performance to plan to leadership.

 


YOU HAVE:

 - 8+ years experience in at least 1 of the following: Production planning, capacity planning, or resource planning, with demonstrated experience leading or developing others.

 - Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or related field required; APICS/CPIM certification a plus.

 - Experience building capacity models and presenting investment, staffing, or outsourcing recommendations to senior leaders.

 - Proficient in inventory management concepts with an understanding of the financial and operational implications of planning decisions.

 - Experience in pharmaceutical or pharmacy production/manufacturing environments is a plus.

 - Excel proficiency including experience with data manipulations – Lookups, PivotTables, External Data Connections.

 - Basic SQL and/or Python experience is a plus.

 - Deep knowledge of supply chain and manufacturing planning processes.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making.

 - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead a team in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:
Join our growing Advanced Microscopy team in Phoenix, AZ and help shape the success of our state-of the-art laboratory. We are seeking a Materials Analyst to join our specialized Dual Beam (SEM-FIB) group, supporting advanced materials and semiconductor analysis for clients across a wide range of industries.

This hands-on role focuses on TEM lamella preparation using Dual Beam FIB tools and offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge instrumentation. As a key member of the team, you will contribute to high-impact client projects by producing quality, site-specific TEM samples that enable advanced failure analysis and materials characterization.

The successful candidate is a strong technical contributor who enjoys working directly with advanced tools, thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced laboratory environment, and takes pride in delivering quality and timely results for clients.

What You’ll Do

A typical day in this role includes:

• Performing SEM imaging to support sample navigation, preparation, and quality verification.
• Managing multiple client samples, ensuring adherence to internal quality standards and turnaround commitments.
• Working closely with your team to optimize workflows, improve efficiency, and maintain consistent output.

• Hands‑on experience operating Dual Beam FIB‑SEM systems, OR strong academic / early‑industry exposure with demonstrated capability to independently execute sample preparation workflows.
• Working knowledge of electron microscopy principles (SEM/TEM).

• Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to manage priorities in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven lab environment.

• Prior experience supporting high‑throughput or production laboratory environments.
• Clear, timely technical communication with internal teams and external clients.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As the Sr. Director, RevOps AMER, you are the most senior Revenue Operations leader for the Americas business, and a critical executive stakeholder. You will bring a proven track record of designing regional operating models that scale and predictable quarterly outcomes. You are an expert at building deep, influential relationships at the executive level and possess the analytical rigor to turn complex data into competitive advantage.

• AI Adoption: Drive adoption of AI tools within the Sales Organization. Identify, prioritize and support practical AI use cases in forecast preparation, pipeline analysis and management, rep productivity, and territory design.

• Experience: 12+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations; prior direct management experience a plus.

• Proven Scale: Significant experience as the Head of AMER Operations (or equivalent, such as a regional or segment RevOps leader) in a high-growth, SaaS organization.

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist (Onsite/Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Senior Applied Scientist, Advanced Technology Group

About the Company

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

This role will drive the design, development, and deployment of new subsurface imaging hardware, on muon projects with high energy physics detectors and seismic measurements with seismometers. This role is ideal for an engineer or scientist who thrives at the intersection of science, engineering, and data and is excited about bringing new technology to life.

In this role, you will own mechanical and electrical systems of new imaging instruments through the full technical lifecycle: from concept and prototyping through validation, manufacturing, and deployment in the field. You will work closely with our data scientists, engineers, and geoscientists to design instrumentation that produces rich, high-quality datasets, feeding the machine learning models that drive KoBold’s mineral exploration around the world.  You will be a key member of a hardware development team and contributor to various novel hardware projects.

You will also help to build the hardware development discipline and organization at KoBold, contributing to a culture and process that will make our engineering efforts innovative, scalable and repeatable. You will report to the Head of Subsurface Imaging and join a world-class team of data scientists, engineers and geoscientists developing novel technologies to accelerate the discovery of critical minerals for batteries and electrification.

Responsibilities

• Own the technical development of mechanical and electrical systems of novel sensing and imaging instruments from concept and prototype to deployment in remote field sites. Coordinate with and orchestrate internal and external resources across hardware and software engineering to deliver.

• Contribute to system architecture definition, navigating technical tradeoffs through rigorous research and analysis and balancing cost, complexity, and timeline.

• Collaborate with KoBold's data systems and exploration teams to integrate the new data stream into KoBold's proprietary data system and ensure usability for exploration projects.

• Build a deep understanding of mineral exploration science and operations to ensure the system and data generated meet user needs and field requirements.

• Build partnerships, source, and contract with service providers and vendors to develop hardware solutions that solve KoBold exploration needs.

• Create effective product plans and mechanical and electrical designs - from concept through prototyping and production.

• Contribute engineering expertise, analysis, and design to various hardware projects across KoBold.

• Help develop KoBold’s hardware development tools and processes.

Qualifications

A great candidate will have:

• A successful track record of developing and deploying complex state-of-the-art scientific instruments: about five years after a PhD, or correspondingly more after a BS or MS.

• Experience deploying and supporting complex equipment to remote sites including commissioning, validation, training and monitoring.

• The ability to simultaneously and gracefully wear many hats including technical lead, project manager, product manager, and hands on in-the-weeds engineer.

• Excellent communication skills for a highly interdisciplinary workplace.

Technical skills, including extensive experience with:

• Executing end-to-end technical product development from concept through testing and deployment.

• Physical measurement and data analysis systems.

• Applying scientific knowledge to identify and prototype emerging technologies.

• Automation, systems integration and data acquisition.

• Mechanical or electrical design for scientific instruments, and processing of measured signals.

• Vendor selection and management.

• Third-party contractor selection and management.

Work practices and motivation:

• Ability and desire to take ownership and responsibility of large projects.

• Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights and innovations.

• Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who aren’t hardware experts.

• Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on a range of responsibilities.

• Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks effectively.

• Solutions oriented, positive, and collaborative.

• Valid passport and willingness to travel to observe our work at Mingomba or at an exploration site around the world.

It is also helpful but not required to have experience with:

• Product management for scientific hardware.

• Particle detectors, optics, and electronics

• Seismic, acoustic, or other geophysical instrumentation.

• Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.

• A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.

• Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

This position is Full-time Exempt

The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $130,000 - $190,000

Location: San Francisco Bay Area.  Must be able to work out of the Berkeley, CA office on any given day of the week.

Travel: Must be able to travel domestically and internationally, 20-30% time.  Travel may include visits to remote field sites.  Work trips may extend to 3+ weeks.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

As a Staff Product Manager at Roo, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving company-wide impact by leading high-priority initiatives that map directly to our most critical business goals. You’ll partner with cross-functional teams—including engineering, design, data, marketing, operations, and more—to define strategy, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes. You’ll set the vision, define the north-star metric, establish clear success criteria, and ensure we’re executing with focus and speed.

Your north-star metric will be directly tied to the “Roo Equation,” our guiding business model, ensuring your impact is visible and meaningful. Operating with significant autonomy, you’ll take a growth-minded, iterative approach—identifying leverage points, shipping improvements quickly, and building scalable systems for our customers and internal users.

This role reports to the VP of Product. While the position is remote, occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events is expected.

Your Responsibilities

• Own the path from sign-up to first shift which includes identity and license verification, the approval decision, first-run experience, and the flow from browsing to requesting to working. Decide what gets automated and what stays human.

• Build the product for high-volume relief vets: recurring bookings, multi-shift blocks, durable hospital relationships, and the calendar and earnings tooling that makes Roo their default rather than one of several apps.

• Turn promotions and incentives from operator-run levers into product such as targeting, automation and guardrails that decide where a dollar goes.

• Partner with the BU's growth marketer as a pair, not a handoff: shared conversion targets, joint experiments, and a standing argument about where the bottleneck actually is.

• Fix the instrumentation before the roadmap. Work with the BU analyst on cohort definitions, attribution and holdouts so we ship what we can prove.

• Co-own the BU strategy with the GM to help decide what we do and don't do, carry the product half, and say out loud when a committed lever isn't working.

• Keep one marketplace. Your decisions land on hospital screens too; partner with the PMs in the other BUs so users get one product, not our org chart.

• Communicate strategy, progress and learnings clearly to leadership and across BUs.

Qualifications

• Marketplace experience or commerce depth. 5+ years working on supply, demand, or core marketplace teams. Ideally in high-growth environments. Strong commerce or consumer-platform backgrounds with equivalent funnel depth are welcome.

• Funnel depth. You've owned real surfaces across the funnel (e.g. search, recommendations, acquisition, onboarding, activation, retention) and you know where the leverage sits in each.

• Commercial fluency. You're comfortable in the unit economics of a business (take rate, price, contribution margin, payback, etc) and can hold your own in a conversation about margin, not just engagement.

• Proven impact. A strong track record of delivering measurable results for both users and the business across multiple teams or initiatives.

• Exceptional communication. You craft strategic narratives in writing and communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

• Systems thinking. You balance big-picture thinking with operational precision, designing experiments, scalable systems, and impactful features.

• AI fluency. You know how to leverage AI to accelerate you and your teams while always taking ownership over the output.

• Influential leadership. You inspire alignment across teams and functions, driving progress even without formal authority. People seek your input and want to partner with you.

• User-centered mindset. You deeply understand customer needs and behavior, advocate for best-in-class UX, and prototype to bring ideas to life.

• Startup-ready. You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, know how to create clarity from chaos, and are energized by building from zero-to-one.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

jobs.description:
Mercury's Design Systems team helps product teams build interfaces that feel consistent, accessible, and carefully considered. We're hiring a Frontend Engineer to help evolve the shared components and patterns behind those experiences, making it easier for teams across Mercury to turn good ideas into well-crafted software.

You'll work closely with designers and engineers to understand product needs, explore solutions, and carry improvements into the hands of the teams using them. This role is open to early-career and intermediate engineers. You'll build depth in frontend engineering and design systems through meaningful project ownership, with guidance from experienced teammates suited to your experience.

Design systems will be your initial focus within the team's broader Design Foundations work. As opportunities and interests align, you can also contribute to code-based prototyping and tools that help designers and AI agents work with Mercury's components. Strong AI fluency is part of how we build from the start.

As part of this role, you will:

• Build shared components and patterns that make Mercury's interfaces better. You'll work in React and TypeScript, turning recurring product needs into flexible solutions that teams can use across different experiences.

• Partner with designers and product engineers to connect design intent with working software. Help evolve components and tokens across Figma and code, using feedback from real product work to improve the system.

• Improve the quality of the experiences built with our components. Consider how they look and behave for different users, bringing accessibility, thoughtful interactions, and reliable behavior into implementation and testing.

• Make the design system easier to use. Help teams adopt shared patterns and improve the examples, documentation, and workflows that let people build confidently with them.

• Use AI tools to explore approaches and move ideas into working code. Apply your judgment to what agents produce, test the results in context, and contribute useful approaches back to the team.

What you'll bring:

We're interested in what you've built and how you think. Your experience may come from professional work, internships, coursework, open source, or personal projects.

• A foundation in React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience building interfaces and the ability to explain the decisions behind your code.

• Care for visual craft and how people use software, including an interest in accessible interfaces and the details that make interactions feel right.

• Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools. You can provide useful context, evaluate and improve generated code, and verify that it works as intended.

• Ownership and a willingness to learn: you follow work through, communicate when you need help, and use feedback to improve your approach.

• Curiosity about reusable systems and the tradeoffs involved in serving different product needs with shared components.

• An interest in solving problems alongside designers and engineers, contributing ideas, and understanding the needs behind a request.

• Experience with design systems, prototyping, or developer tooling is a plus. You don't need to have held a design systems role to bring useful skills and ideas to this team.

We’re seeking a Contract Specialist to support large, complex heavy civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (bus and rail), aviation (international airports), and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. Your main focus will be supporting the procurement of engineering and design services for a major transportation program, working alongside senior contract administrators from solicitation and qualifications-based selection through negotiation, contract administration, and closeout.

This is a long-term, full-time, hybrid position (mostly remote with in person meeting as needed at client sites) located in Atlanta, GA.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Support the qualifications-based selection of engineering and design consultants, from advertisement through award.

• Prepare solicitation documents that meet applicable procurement rules.

• Organize the evaluation meetings where consultant statements of qualifications are scored, and support the panel through the process.

• Support task order fee negotiations by checking proposed staff hours against the defined scope so the agreed price holds up as reasonable for the work.

• Perform day-to-day administration of executed agreements, including reviewing contract documents and monitoring compliance.

• Work with project managers and consultant representatives to answer questions and help resolve issues on contract compliance and contract terms.

• Prepare progress reports on active contracts for project managers and management.

• Perform the compliance checks needed to close out a contract.

• Work within established procedures under the direction of senior contract administrators, and support them on more complex procurements.

• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

• Excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.

• Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.

• Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, finance, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 2+ years of procurement or contract administration experience.

• Experience supporting solicitations or administering contracts within an established procurement process.

• Familiarity with public procurement rules and standard contract terms.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

• Experience working with project managers and technical staff to develop the scopes of services that go into solicitations and contracts.

• Experience researching contract questions and preparing recommendations for management.

jobs.title: Senior Inside Sales Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid role including in office and remote working days. Must be resident or relocatable to Austin TX area.

Hours are between 8am-5pm.

The Sr Inside Sales Business Development Manager is a revenue generating position with responsibility for quarterly sales quota attainment for the Facial Aesthetics portfolio of products (BOTOX® Cosmetic, JUVÉDERM® Collection of Fillers, SkinMedica®, KYBELLA®) and for managing and enhancing portfolio growth through business development activities using primarily phone communication.

The Sr IBDM represents the Allergan Aesthetics product portfolio to targeted aesthetic customers within a designated geographical area. Responsible for product and program education, product adoption, and portfolio growth through business development activities.

The Sr IBDM provides technical product and procedure training, as well as competitive product differentiation.  Assigned sales goals are obtained through strategic analysis of account data, strong knowledge of accounts aesthetic goals, understanding of market dynamics, application of consultative selling and implementation of the U.S. Sales/Marketing plan.  The company offers flexible career paths with a strong emphasis on opportunity for internal mobility.

Allergan Sr IBDMs must:

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

• Consistently achieves sales quota across portfolio. Proficient in sales execution component of marketing plans. Independently creates call and business development plans across the product portfolio. Demonstrates adaptability and creativity with multiple initiatives.

• Manages attainment of assigned sales quota and customer satisfaction through consistent communication with the Regional Manager and Inside Sales Area Manager, managing own sample allocation, placing orders, providing marketing materials, and assisting accounts with marketing strategies. Also leads execution on all campaigns/promotions, new product launches, training of accounts on Allergan programs and other sales related initiatives.

• Educating and supporting the customer with marketing strategies including but not limited to website and social media development, internal office branding, patient segmentation, and external marketing strategies.

Also includes execution on all campaigns/promotions, new product launches and other sales related initiatives.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.

Requirements:

Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience in educating or influencing targeted customers.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required.

• Skill in managing time effectively.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.location: Remote Canada; US - Boston, MA ; US - Houston, TX
jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Role: Principal Software Engineer
Reports to: Manager, Product Development
Location: Houston, TX - Boston, MA Hybrid

About the role

As a Principal Software Engineer on Conga’s B2B Platform Engineering, Core Services team, you’ll own the security, identity, and access management capabilities that every Conga B2B product is built on. You’ll lead a team of 5 to 8 engineers, set technical direction for authentication and authorization across the platform, and serve as a key technical partner to the Advantage Platform organization. Together with Advantage, you’ll establish secure, reusable integration patterns between the two platforms.

This is a senior, hands-on role for an engineer who wants influence beyond a single product team. You’ll work in a highly connected environment, on a small team that supports a large customer base. That means ramping quickly, building trust across groups, and shaping shared security services used throughout Conga’s platform ecosystem.

What you’ll do

Own platform identity and security

• Act as the primary technical lead for platform-level security and identity services, including authentication and authorization systems.

• Lead design and development of mission-critical core services that support cross-product identity, access control, tenant context, and security standards.

• Translate high-level architectural direction into detailed technical designs and production-ready implementations.

• Ensure platform services meet strict security, availability, performance, and reliability requirements.

Build the B2B and Advantage integration

• Partner with the Advantage Platform team to define and implement secure integration patterns between B2B and Advantage.

• Define API contracts, authentication flows, authorization models, and tenant-context propagation across distributed systems.

• Coordinate cross-platform design, implementation, testing, release readiness, and operational support for shared authentication capabilities.

Lead and raise the bar

• Lead and mentor a team of 5 to 8 engineers, and provide technical guidance to engineering groups beyond your own.

• Provide technical leadership through code reviews, design reviews, threat modeling, and operational readiness.

• Raise the bar on secure coding practices and platform engineering discipline.

• Lead development in an Agile, CI/CD environment with a strong emphasis on automation, testability, and observability.

Partner across Conga

• Work with Architecture and Product Security to implement and evolve security patterns, standards, and controls across the platform.

• Collaborate across B2B Platform, Advantage Platform, Architecture, Product Engineering, AI, and Product Security to deliver secure, reusable integrations.

• Translate strategic AI pillar objectives into secure, scalable platform capabilities that can be reused across products and AI experiences.

• Document decisions, dependencies, ownership, and operational responsibilities clearly across team boundaries.

Support customers and production

• Lead incident investigation and resolution for security-sensitive services, including root cause analysis and long-term remediation.

• Engage directly with customers on support issues and escalations, and work through conflicting priorities with internal and external stakeholders.

Are you the person we’re looking for?

• 8+ years of backend software engineering, with a track record delivering enterprise SaaS services that operate at scale and are security-critical.

• 3+ years designing, building, or operating shared identity and platform-security services used by multiple products, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, token-based authentication, role and permission models, and policy-driven access control.

• 3+ years as a technical leader or senior contributor on shared platform or infrastructure services.

• Deep experience building backend systems in a modern language such as Java, C#, Python, TypeScript, Scala, or Rust.

• Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs used by multiple consumers.

• Solid experience with SQL and data stores supporting platform services.

• Strong understanding of software design patterns, distributed systems, and platform tradeoffs.

• Experience leading complex initiatives end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.

• Experience leading technical initiatives that span multiple platforms, engineering organizations, and ownership boundaries.

• Experience leading and mentoring engineers, and influencing teams you don’t directly manage through collaboration and technical credibility.

• Experience translating strategic product or AI objectives into secure platform designs and executable delivery plans.

• Comfort in customer-facing work, including support, escalations, and resolving competing stakeholder perspectives.

• Strong communication skills and executive presence. You can work effectively with Architecture, Security, Product, engineering leaders, customers, and junior engineers.

Here’s what will give you an edge…

• Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus containerized and orchestrated environments (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Experience with Azure SQL

• Microservices experience and familiarity with cloud-native security patterns and service-to-service communication

• Exposure to DevOps and SRE practices for platform services, including monitoring, alerting, and automation

Why this role matters

You’ll be the technical leader for the identity and access capabilities that protect Conga’s entire B2B portfolio. Your work will secure the integration between the B2B and Advantage platforms, and it will define reusable authentication and authorization patterns for both product and AI experiences. You’ll also bring consistency to identity, tenant context, permissions, and service-to-service access across Conga.

The role comes with broad impact across multiple product teams, close alignment with Architecture and long-term platform strategy, and a clear growth path in technical leadership. You’ll help shape Conga’s security posture, engineering standards, and platform foundations.

jobs.title: Sommelier - Delilah
jobs.description:
The Sommelier at Delilah is responsible for delivering an exceptional luxury dining experience through expert wine and beverage service while supporting the restaurant's commitment to Forbes Five-Star hospitality standards. This role serves as a beverage ambassador, guiding guests through an extensive wine, champagne, cocktail, and spirits program while collaborating closely with service and management teams to create memorable dining experiences.

The Sommelier is responsible for beverage recommendations, sales, inventory management, wine list maintenance, staff education, and ensuring flawless execution of wine and beverage service standards. This position plays a critical role in enhancing guest satisfaction, driving beverage revenue, and maintaining the excellence of Delilah's renowned dining experience.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience & Beverage Service

• Deliver exceptional, personalized service consistent with Forbes Five-Star standards.
• Greet guests in a warm, welcoming, and engaging manner.
• Develop meaningful guest relationships to encourage repeat visitation and loyalty.
• Provide expert wine, champagne, spirit, cocktail, and beer recommendations tailored to guests' preferences and dining selections.
• Execute proper wine presentation, decanting, and service procedures.
• Conduct tableside beverage service with confidence, professionalism, and attention to detail.
• Anticipate guest needs and respond promptly with a sense of urgency.
• Communicate effectively with guests, service team members, culinary staff, and management.
• Ensure guests receive an elevated experience throughout all dining and lounge environments.
• Bid farewell to guests in a gracious manner and encourage future visits.

Wine Program & Inventory Management

• Maintain comprehensive knowledge of all wines, spirits, beers, cocktails, and non-alcoholic beverage offerings.
• Assist with maintaining and updating wine lists to ensure accuracy and consistency.
• Monitor wine inventory levels and assist with ordering recommendations.
• Receive, inspect, and properly store wine and beverage shipments.
• Perform regular beverage inventories and assist with reconciliation processes.
• Update inventory locations, bin numbers, and product information accurately within designated systems.
• Monitor wine storage conditions to ensure product quality and integrity.
• Reduce waste through proper handling, storage, and service practices.
• Coordinate product exchanges and resolve inventory discrepancies as needed.
• Stock and organize wine storage areas before, during, and after service.
• Assist with wine pairing preparation, special event beverage organization, and by-the-glass program execution.

Training & Leadership

• Serve as a beverage resource and mentor for service team members.
• Educate and train employees on wine knowledge, beverage offerings, and service techniques.
• Conduct regular wine tastings, beverage classes, and product knowledge sessions.
• Promote beverage sales opportunities through ongoing team coaching.
• Reinforce service standards and ensure consistent execution throughout the dining room.
• Actively participate in pre-shift meetings and departmental training programs.
• Partner with management to enhance beverage programs and guest experiences.

Operational Excellence

• Follow established service sequences and operating procedures.
• Complete opening, closing, and side work duties accurately and efficiently.
• Maintain designated service areas, wine stations, and storage spaces in a clean and organized manner.
• Ensure compliance with all health, safety, alcohol service, and company policies.
• Maintain working knowledge of hotel amenities, entertainment offerings, and local attractions.
• Support floor operations as needed, including assisting with seating arrangements and service coordination.
• Attend required departmental meetings and training sessions.
• Maintain a polished, professional appearance in accordance with Wynn standards.
• Perform all other job-related duties as assigned.

Experience

• Minimum of two years of experience in a luxury, fine-dining restaurant environment.
• Previous sommelier experience preferred.
• Experience with high-volume luxury dining operations strongly preferred.
• Proven ability to provide elevated guest service and beverage sales.

Education & Certifications

• High school diploma or equivalent required.
• Court of Master Sommeliers Level 1 Certification required.
• Advanced beverage knowledge including wine, champagne, spirits, cocktails, digestifs, food and wine pairing, and proper beverage service techniques.
• Ability to obtain and maintain all licenses and work cards required by local and state regulations.

Skills & Abilities

• Strong understanding of wine regions, varietals, vintages, producers, and food pairings.
• Excellent guest engagement, sales, and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to communicate professionally and effectively in English, both written and verbal.
• Proficiency with POS systems and inventory management software.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - Austin TX (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.


Why This Role Matters
Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools.
This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster.
You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast.
What You'll Do
GTM Analysis & Decision Support
Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers.
Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff.
Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach.
Data Modeling & Quality
Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system.
Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking.
Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics
Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software.
Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it.
Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests.
Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself.
How You'll Work
Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager.
Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked.
What We're Looking For
Experience
5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it.
Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data.
Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work.
Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data.
Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome).
BI & AI Fluency
Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches.
Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale.
We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty.
Mindset
Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning.
Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle.
Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often.

jobs.title: Sr. Partner Onboarding & Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Role

You'll build and scale our partner enablement engine, turning newly signed partners into technically and operationally capable allies ready to transact and serve their customers. Rather than treating partner ramp as a single training event, you'll own the end-to-end readiness journey—aligning cross-functional resources across Business Development, Solutions Architecture, Implementation, and Support to build long-term partner self-sufficiency.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

• Own the post-signature partner onboarding and readiness journey, coordinating cross-functionally with BD Account Directors, Implementation, Solutions Architecture, Support, and Account Managers while maintaining clear ownership boundaries across teams.

• Build structured readiness tracks—including technical setup, customer onboarding workflows, sales process execution, and operational enablement—tailored to distinct partner types like resellers, MSPs, and service providers.

• Guide partners through operational transaction steps, including setting up customer organizations and sub-organizations, ingesting data, submitting orders, and registering opportunities.

• Serve as a practical, trusted advisor to partner teams, verifying their operational capability and establishing clear escalation paths through Everlaw's documented support systems.

• Track onboarding milestones, partner capability demonstrations, and friction points, maintaining clear documentation and handoff evidence to ensure seamless long-term account transitions.

• Identify recurring operational or technical friction for partners, surfacing structured feedback and evidence to internal product and process owners to improve the broader partner experience.

About You

• You have at least 8+ years of experience in partner onboarding, technical customer success, implementation coordination, or partner success in B2B technology.

• You've guided external organizations through complex software platforms, building their internal capability to use, support, and sell technical products.

• You bring clear, practical communication skills, with a track record of explaining technical workflows to users with varying levels of technical depth.

• You excel at cross-functional coordination across internal teams—such as Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product—while maintaining clear boundaries and accountability.

• You have a diagnostic approach to problem-solving, with the ability to determine whether a partner blocker is technical, operational, commercial, or training-related, and route it effectively.

• You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

• Experience in legal technology, litigation support, investigations, or regulated B2B software environments.

• Experience onboarding service providers, system integrators, MSPs, or reseller partners.

• Experience designing partner readiness frameworks, milestone tracking, and transition criteria in platforms like Salesforce or partner portals.

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team — Business Development

The Business Development team builds and grows the network of partners who extend Everlaw's reach into the market. By identifying, recruiting, and supporting partners across the ecosystem, the team creates relationships that open new paths to customers and reinforce Everlaw's position in the industry. This work turns strong partnerships into a durable channel for growth, helping more organizations discover Everlaw through partners they already trust.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is between $183,000 and $231,000. This role is also eligible for additional incentive pay/commission. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate’s experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

Health & well-being

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses

• Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness

• Paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

• Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth

• 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

• 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave

• Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year

• Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues

• Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics

• Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup

• Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw

When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

• #LI-BL1

​​About Everlaw

At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: Customer Experience Associate I (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Since 2018, Wisetack has been building transparent and intuitive consumer lending products that help service-based businesses thrive (think HVAC companies, veterinarians, or auto repair shops).

Our leadership team comes from top fintech companies such as Lending Club, Affirm, and Varo Money. And we’re backed by leading VCs, including Insight Partners, Greylock, Quadrille, and Bain Capital Ventures (investors in Airbnb, LinkedIn, Instagram, Dropbox, and more).

Having raised $84M, we’re a well-funded startup and have invested in people and technology while growing our partnerships — responsibly.

We’re also proud to have received recognition from the fintech world. Awards we’ve won include:

• Ranked #21 on 2024 Inc. 5000 based on revenue growth

• Ranked #15 on 2024 Deloitte Fast 500 based on revenue growth

• 2024 Best Embedded Finance Solution for Banking Tech Awards

• 2023 Best Consumer Lending Program by Tearsheet

But what you’ll find us gleaming about the most is the recognition from our own customers, particularly our sky-high NPS rating of 79. (For reference, the average score is 44 for financial services and 36 for SaaS companies.)

As a result of our efforts in building this healthy company culture, we’ve been nominated to several Great Places to Work lists, such as Best Small Workplaces, Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance.

Like any startup, we’re in it for the long haul, and we’re looking for people willing to join our journey of building something special together.

This process starts with our company values, which guide us in everything we do — and have played a critical role in our success. We valiantly abide by them, and would expect you to do the same:

• Put customers first (that’s our M.O.)

• Act fast (leverage our startup environment).

• Lead the way (show and tell).

• Take ownership (everyone is hands-on here).

• Be a good human (no egos, build financial products that do right by people).

Learn more about our values here.

The Role

At Wisetack, customer experience is a competitive advantage. As a Customer Experience Associate I, Borrower Support, you will help borrowers navigate their financing experience with clarity, empathy, and accuracy. This role requires sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to protect consumer trust in high-stakes lending conversations.

As an AI-forward company, we’re excited about candidates who are curious, adaptable, and eager to use AI tools to work more effectively, improve customer outcomes, and help shape the future of support at Wisetack.

Responsibilities

• Deliver exceptional borrower support: Support borrowers by phone and across other channels, helping them navigate applications, approvals, payments, repayment, refunds, and account questions with clarity, empathy, and accuracy. Set clear expectations for next steps, follow-up, and escalations.

• Navigate consumer lending with care: Follow lending requirements, company policies, and established processes while identifying risks, complaints, or issues that need review. Partner cross-functionally to resolve issues responsibly and balance customer advocacy with responsible lending practices.

• Own customer outcomes: Own borrower issues from first contact through resolution, following up and coordinating across teams to deliver timely answers. Document interactions accurately and keep borrowers clear on status, ownership, and next steps.

• Turn customer contacts into insights: Identify recurring pain points, process gaps, product friction, and operational opportunities. Share insights with Product, Engineering, Risk, Operations, Merchant Success, and other partners to improve documentation, workflows, macros, and scalable fixes.

• Embrace AI and continuous improvement: Use AI tools to improve speed, quality, customer outcomes, and efficiency while protecting empathy, accuracy, privacy, and trust. Share best practices, explore better ways of working, and stay flexible as business needs evolve, including support for merchants.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree preferred.

• 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, financial services, operations, or another customer-facing role.

• Experience leveraging AI tools to improve customer support workflows or operational efficiency.

• Comfortable spending the majority of your workday supporting customers over the phone in a high-volume environment.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Demonstrated ownership and follow-through from initial customer contact through final resolution.

• Experience working with consumer lending products or other environments where accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail are critical.

• Experience using Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar customer support platforms.

• Willingness to work weekends.

Bonus points

• Experience supporting borrowers or consumers in lending, banking, payments, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.

• Familiarity with consumer lending regulations or compliance-driven customer support.

Conclusion

The hourly rate for the position is $25.00, plus equity, non-exempt PTO policy, sick pay, 6 paid holidays, and 401k.

Spend a little time on our About Us page and check out our Press page and our blog for more. If you think this might be a fit, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: H&M Visual Keyholder - Parkdale Mall
jobs.description:

As a Visual Keyholder, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, & consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will be responsible for executing the visual, commercial, and styling curation according to visual & commercial guidelines for the store. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Contribute to the total OMNI customer experience in your store by ensuring visual and commercial curation according to guidelines (In-direct)
• Representing yourself and the H&M Brand positively during customer interactions (Direct)
• Organize and plan your workload according to store activation plan and adapt based on business needs in collaboration with your Store Management team and Area Visual Manager
• Launch and maintain the latest global campaigns and sale activities on time according to H&M Brand Standards
• Ensure good garment care, stock levels, and give input on allocation to Store Management and Area teams
• Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
• Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
• Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, products, brands, competitors, and relevant influencers etc.
• Plan time for fashion & trend awareness to understand trend theory and mood boards for styling techniques and product presentation to anticipate our customer’s needs and enhance our shopping experience in store

Team & Development

• Share, inspire and educate your store teams, keep them updated with seasonal changes, fashion trends, relevant visual & commercial information, in-store communication, including price perception
• Coach and develop the Store team’s visual and commercial skills to secure high quality of product & commercial presentation according to guidelines
• Support & develop daily routines and best practices for your Store team to always ensure a consistent level of visual & commercial standard while maintaining customer service engagement
• Develop and coach talents and provide onboarding training to new colleagues
• Organize, provide, and carry out the visual & commercial upskilling for you and your colleagues
• Complete Visual Competencies & Commercial 4 All trainings based on Regional & Sales Market learning and development goals
• Support Sales Market and Area teams with expansion (store projects) needs

Visual & Commercial Execution

• Execute the visual & commercial curation & styling for the store based on commercial calendar, allocation, store activation plan and fashion trends according to mood boards and direction from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Carry out sample picking best practice routines including stockroom garment quantities, accessories, and shoes to ensure you create clear trends and stories according to inspiration from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Secure window & styling execution according to visual & commercial guidelines to create inspirational and commercial customer experience
• Provide good customer flow by maintaining commercial layout, fixtures, to secure the best trend story placement
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in windows and throughout the store following guidelines according to Global strategy and Sales Market requirements
• In collaboration with Facilities Management ensure all lighting is working correctly, aimed to highlight our products and display forms in windows and throughout the store
• Maintain and care for all display forms and interior material (fixtures & fittings) with sustainability in mind
• In collaboration with Area Visual Manager ensure your store navigation is maintained and kept up to date according to latest guidelines and store layout
• Ensure your store has enough quantities of sale and other activity including POS material according to local routines
• Keep sales floor and back of house clean, organized, and safe according to local security guidelines

Leadership & Operational Responsibilities

• Holds additional operational responsibilities, such as opening and closing the store, managing the cash register, and ensuring the store’s security protocols are followed
• Acts as a leader on duty when managers are not present, taking responsibility for the sales floor, resolving customer issues, and directing team members
• May delegate and oversee tasks for the store team during their shift
• Makes decisions related to store operations, including customer service escalations, staff breaks, and enforcing store policies
• Acts as a bridge between the team and management during non-visual tasks
• Balances visual merchandising with operational duties and customer service
• Prioritizes tasks based on immediate store needs, such as sales targets or operational issues

Who You Are

• For you to be a successful Visual Keyholder, you must be curious and creative; always looking for inspiration, proactive, solution focused, flexible, with effective communication skills to achieve results cross functionally
• We look for individuals with fashion interests and leadership skills who can apply their visual and commercial experience working in a dynamic environment to the role
• Experience with being solution focused to improve product presentation and commercial execution in store
• Good knowledge of visual, commercial, and operational best practises, routines, and tools
• Know how to manage, follow-up and act on selling equation and weekly sales reports
• A leader who can motivate and guide a team, ensuring store standards are upheld and colleagues are supported in their roles
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced retail environment
• Comfortable taking on keyholder responsibilities, including opening and closing the store, handling cash, and ensuring safety and security protocols are followed
• Skilled at providing exceptional customer service and resolving customer concerns with a solutions-oriented approach
• A collaborative team player who communicates effectively and fosters a positive, inclusive work environment
• Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to balance operational responsibilities and visual merchandising tasks while meeting deadlines

jobs.title: Product Manager, Ambulatory Autonomous Coding
jobs.description:
About Us:

Here at Ambience, we never set out to be just another scribe. We’re building the AI intelligence platform that restores humanity to healthcare and drives meaningful ROI for health systems across the country.

Our technology helps providers focus on delivering great care by removing the administrative burden that pulls them away from patients and away from their most impactful work. Ambience delivers real-time coding-aware documentation and clinical workflow support across ambulatory, emergency and inpatient settings at the top health systems in North America.

Our teams operate relentlessly with extreme ownership to build the best solutions for our health system partners. We value candor, positivity and deep thought — and we expect a lot from each other because we know the problems we’re solving truly matter.

Ambience was ranked #1 for Improving the Clinician Experience in the KLAS Research Emerging Solutions Top 20 Report, recognized by Fast Company as one of the Next Big Things in Tech, named one of the best AI companies in healthcare by Inc., and selected as a LinkedIn Top Startup in 2024 and 2025. We’re backed by Oak HC/FT, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), OpenAI Startup Fund, and Kleiner Perkins — and we’re just getting started.


THE ROLE

As our Product Manager, Ambulatory Autonomous Coding, you'll own Ambience's ambulatory professional coding product, starting with primary care. Your mission is to help clinicians capture the services they provided with accurate, well-supported coding at the point of care, while reducing the manual work required from coding teams.

You'll own the product end to end: understanding how clinicians and coding teams work today, deciding which problems to solve first, setting the roadmap, shipping with Engineering and Clinical AI, and measuring results with customers. The initial focus is CPT coding, including E/M levels, add-on codes, modifiers, and procedures. Over time, the goal is to move from coding recommendations to autonomous coding for encounters where accuracy, compliance, and customer workflows support it.

Done well, this role helps clinicians capture the full value of the care they deliver and makes accurate, compliant coding something that happens at the point of care, not after the fact.

This is a Senior PM role - you'll work closely with engineering, design, Clinical AI/ML, and GTM teams.

We're a hybrid company headquartered in San Francisco. This role requires being in the SF office 3x/week.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Product Strategy & Workflow

 - Define and execute the ambulatory coding roadmap, starting with primary care and expanding to additional code families and specialties based on customer needs and measurable value.

 - Spend time with clinicians, coders, and revenue-cycle teams to understand how encounters are documented, coded, reviewed, and billed, and use that understanding to decide what we build.

 - Own the clinician and coding-team experience, from recommendations during the visit through review, exception handling, and writeback into Epic's existing charge workflows.

 - Work closely with our ambulatory teams so coding uses the right clinical context without creating more work for clinicians.

Coding Quality & Automation

 - Partner with Engineering, Clinical AI, and coding experts to improve accuracy and coverage across the code sets we support.

 - Establish clear evaluations for coding accuracy, completeness of the encounter, supporting documentation, and reliability of Epic writeback. Understand where errors happen and prioritize the ones that matter most.

 - Define when a coding recommendation is ready for human review versus when an encounter can be processed with less manual intervention, validating the approach with customer coding and compliance teams before expanding autonomy.

 - Build a repeatable approach for adding new code families and specialties rather than treating each one as a separate product.

Customer Outcomes

 - Drive adoption with clinicians and coding teams. Identify where the product creates friction or fails to fit existing workflows, and fix it.

 - Measure code coverage, complete-encounter accuracy, manual review and exception rates, and the share of encounters that can be coded without routine human changes.

 - Work with Data, Value Attainment, and customer Finance and RCM teams to measure the value created through accurate revenue capture, less coding work, and reduced rework, distinguishing modeled value from results customers have realized.

 - Partner with GTM and Product Marketing to communicate what the product does, where it works well, and what value customers should expect.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves

 - 3+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of a product area from discovery through delivery and adoption. We care more about the quality of your experience and your rate of growth than years alone.

 - Track record of rapidly learning a complex domain and earning the trust of people who know it well.

 - Strong technical fluency - comfort with AI/ML products, data, APIs, and complex integrations.

 - Experience building products for workflows with multiple users or stakeholders, where reliability and getting the details right matter.

 - Strong written communication, product judgment, and the ability to make progress in ambiguity.

 - Based in SF, available to be in the office 3x/week.

Nice-to-Haves

 - Healthcare, revenue-cycle, or professional coding experience, especially CPT, E/M, modifiers, and Epic Professional Billing (a plus, not a requirement - we hire on scorecard competencies, not domain pedigree).

 - Experience with AI-assisted workflows, model evaluations, or products that automate work previously done by people.

 - Prior 0-to-1 product experience.

 - Experience with enterprise customers and regulated products.

Life at Ambience 

Working at Ambience means opting into a high-ownership, high-trust environment built for people who want to grow fast, operate decisively and focus on work that matters. This could be the right place for you if you want to

 - Work on mission-critical AI technology that directly improves clinicians’ day-to-day lives and health system financial health across some of the most complex, high-stakes workflows in the world.

 - Join a “dream team” culture where we hire exceptional people, expect exceptional outcomes and invest deeply in feedback and continuous growth. We operate as a championship team, and that means being ok with hard, uncomfortable, ambiguous problems that lead to real greatness.

 - Operate with real ownership and accountability in an environment where there are no bystanders: If something is broken, we fix it! You will have meaningful autonomy and be expected to drive work to completion.

To help you do your best work, we pair these expectations with benefits intentionally designed to help you feel supported and safe at Ambience and beyond. Some of our key benefits include

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) with a company match of up to 3% of base salary

 - A remote-friendly culture (with a San Francisco HQ) and full equipment provisioning to ensure you can work effectively from wherever you’re based.

 - Parental leave to support your family needs

 - Annual company-wide off-sites, team off-sites and regular team lunches and all-hands gatherings, with travel, lodging and meals covered

 - Flexible time off with no annual cap, company-wide holidays and an annual holiday shutdown from December 24–January 1 designed to support real rest and long-term sustainability.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Ambience is committed to supporting every candidate’s ability to fully participate in our hiring process. If you need any accommodations during your application or interviews, please reach out to our Recruiting team at accommodations@ambiencehealthcare.com recruiting@ambiencehealth.com. We’ll handle your request confidentially and work with you to ensure an accessible and equitable experience for all candidates.

jobs.title: Veterinary Sales Associate - Southern Oregon
jobs.description:
Are you an entrepreneurial sales professional with a passion for pet health? Trupanion, the leading pet health insurance provider, is seeking a Territory Partner Associate (TPA) to manage and grow our territory along the I-5 corridor from Salem, Oregon, to the southern border of the state. This dynamic role offers uncapped earning potential, a competitive salary-plus-commission structure, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of pets and their families.

Location Requirement: Candidates must reside within the territory (Salem, Oregon, to the southern border).

What You'll Do

As a TPA, you’ll develop and grow your exclusive territory through proactive account management, relationship-building, and sales execution:

Sales Territory Development

• Drive revenue growth by identifying new opportunities within veterinary practices, shelters, rescues, and State Farm offices.
• Achieve aggressive sales goals with a focus on maximizing performance and profitability.

Account Management

• Build and maintain relationships with veterinary teams and other accounts to promote Trupanion's services.
• Conduct in-clinic presentations and provide ongoing support to veterinary professionals.

Sales Execution

• Influence decision-makers to prioritize pet insurance discussions using consultative sales approaches.
• Implement and sustain Trupanion programs by appointing and supporting Client Education Coordinators in accounts.

Account Visits

• Maintain a monthly schedule of 120-200 account visits to ensure consistent engagement and support.

Portal Adoption

• Ensure veterinary hospitals implement Trupanion’s Portal for seamless client experiences and direct pay.

Administrative Duties

• Attend weekly team meetings and maintain accurate activity records using CRM tools like Microsoft Dynamics.
• Utilize data analysis tools such as Tableau to refine strategies and report on performance.

Event Participation

• Represent Trupanion at local events, conferences, and expos to generate leads and enhance brand visibility.

What You'll Need Sales Experience

• Proven success in sales with strong consultative selling skills and a focus on measurable goals.
• Experience in territory management or account-based sales is highly preferred.

Personal Traits for Success

• Independent motivation: Self-driven and disciplined to create your own opportunities.
• Work independently: Comfortable operating autonomously in the field.
• Income-driven: Motivated by the potential to create and grow your own income.
• Disciplined and influential: Strong ability to build trust and influence decision-makers.
• Creative and fun: Bring an engaging and innovative approach to sales.

Other Requirements

• Valid driver’s license.
• Ability to obtain a State Property and Casualty Insurance License.
• Comfortable with being on the road five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation: Competitive salary-plus-commission structure with uncapped earning potential, driven by your success in growing the territory. This is not an order-taking role – your success and rewards are tied to your ability to create and develop opportunities.

Benefits:

• PTO and vacation.
• 401(k) match.
• Company-provided vehicle.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Trupanion:

We’re more than insurance – we’re a tech company too! Learn more about how you can use Trupanion to pay your vet directly here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vdWZ4KHiPTQ

For more information about Trupanion, visit https://trupanion.com/about
