jobs.title: Regional Director Central
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The CareDx Regional Director (RD) is responsible for driving growth, building strong client relationships, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional results in their assign geography. Focusing primarily on transplant center account customers, the RD will lead, manage and partner with a diverse team of regionally aligned roles, including Transplant Account Managers (TAMs), Clinical Liaisons (CL) and Medical Science Liaisons (MSL) from the Medical Affairs team. Successful RDs are agile, proven problem solvers with strategic account management expertise and strong communication skills, possessing the ability to provide clear direction and hold the regional team accountable to execution and results. The RD role reports directly to the Sr Area Director.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Strategic Account Management: Develop a deep understanding of account’s needs, objectives, and challenges in order to provide tailored solutions that meet their requirements. Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts to upsell and cross-sell relevant CareDx products, solutions or services.

Strategic Planning and Executing Account Plans: Develop and execute strategic plans to drive business growth and achieve sales targets. Create and implement long-term, account-specific strategies and tactics to drive adoption, gain market share, expand the CareDx footprint and achieve commercial goals.

Building Strong Customer Relationships: Identify key customer stakeholders and influencers, establishing strong relationships and partnerships, continually soliciting feedback on additional needs, products, and features. Resolve customer issues promptly and efficiently, managing expectations and ensuring customer satisfaction.

Managing the Sales Pipeline: Forecast and manage the sales pipeline and growth strategies to track progress towards objectives at both the account and regional levels. Prepare regular performance reports for executive leadership, providing insights into strategy effectiveness, ROI, and key other performance indicators

Lead, Manage, and Coach: Lead, manage, and coach a field team consisting of TAMs and DSS to achieve business objectives and deliver exceptional customer service.

Team Development: Foster a positive and collaborative team environment, providing ongoing training and development opportunities to enhance team performance.

Performance Management: Monitor and evaluate team performance, providing regular feedback and implementing improvement plans as necessary.

Collaborating with Internal Teams: Partner with Commercial, Marketing, Customer Experience, Medical Affairs, Market Access and Operations teams to develop creative solutions that address customer needs.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree required, advance degree (e.g., MBA) preferred

• Minimum of 10 years sales or strategic account management experience in the healthcare industry

• Minimum 5 years sales management experience in the healthcare industry

• Experience selling into hospitals, hospital/health systems, and/or enterprise-level accounts, navigating across multiple levels of stakeholders and departments

• Experience with complex, multi-touch, long sales processes/cycles (6-9months) and closing deals

• Track record of developing effective commercial strategies that maximize business outcomes

• Demonstrated, proven track record developing high performing teams and building collaborative relationships within the organization and with external customers

• Strong written and oral communication & organizational skills

• Must be willing to travel 50- 75% or greater, including frequent day trips and overnight travel

• Proficient with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Salesforce.com and analytical tools

Role Competencies:

• Healthcare Market Understanding: Anticipates the potential business implications of an evolving healthcare marketplace and identifies new opportunities for growth

• Business & Territory Planning: Aligns market and customer needs and insights with CareDx products, solutions and services to develop strategic action plans

• Analytics and Insight Generation: Leverages many sources of complex business and customer data to generate insights, identify market trends and opportunities, and inform decision making.

• Account Management: Develops a deep understanding of customer needs and aligns them with CareDx products, solutions and services to attain mutually beneficial outcomes

• Consultative Selling Agility: Applies selling skills to understand and meet customer needs and ensure sales execution is compliant and strategically aligned with business objectives to maximize sales results

• Leading Through Influence: Builds alignment and mobilizes cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority to advance strategic priorities, overcome barriers, and achieve shared business and customer outcomes.

Additional Details:

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

Our competitive Total Rewards package for US Employees includes:

• Competitive base salary and incentive compensation

• Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program

• 401(k) savings plan match

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Pre-tax commuter benefits

• And more!

• Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers

In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow.

With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it’s an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together.

Certain jurisdictions require notice of how we use and protect your personal information. For more information, please read our Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Product Manager, Recommendations
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).



Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At the core of Suno’s user experience is inspiring people to create their next favorite song. Personalization makes this possible, by helping people discover music they love and ideas that spark their own creativity. We are seeking a Product Manager to lead recommendations across Suno. You will define the strategy and roadmap and partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to build our recommendations system from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to shape personalization for music creation: defining how a product learns someone’s taste and uses that understanding to expand their creative possibilities. This role is ideal for a technical Product Manager with deep experience in and a passion for recommendations. You are hands-on with data, comfortable working through technical details, and excited to build experiences that make Suno more valuable with every visit.



Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/song/d7e92b5b-4936-4c7f-ac0a-6d814672526c




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead personalization across Suno — Own the recommendations strategy and roadmap across all product surfaces and problems. Partner with UX product teams to make their features more personalized.

 - Shape recommendations strategy for creation — Partner with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to design approaches and experiments that inspire users to create. Lead product thinking in that partnership, grounding technical decisions in user needs and behavior.

 - Go deep with data — Build a detailed understanding of our users and product surfaces. Own experiments that move success metrics.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of improving consumer experiences through personalization

 - An effective thought partner to technical teams, fluent in recommendation systems and their evaluation

 - Hands-on with data analysis, with experience defining success metrics and designing rigorous experiments

 - Sound product judgment that connects user needs, algorithm development, and business impact

 - Excited to build from scratch and bring clarity to ambiguous problems

 - A clear communicator who aligns teams around a shared vision

 - Passionate about personalization and curious about how people’s tastes shape what they listen to and create




ADDITIONAL NOTES

 - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 - This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy.

 - Must be willing to travel once per quarter for larger team meetings.




PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

jobs.title: Sr. Associate Business Development Director I
jobs.description:
ICON Prime is seeking an entrepreneurial, high-impact Associate Business Development Director to expand our defense business across the military services, from military construction (MILCON) to defense technology (MilTech). You will operate with significant autonomy to generate, shape, and close complex government opportunities. The ideal candidate has a defense background, a proven track record of winning competitive government contracts and converting relationships into awards, and knows how to navigate the Pentagon and defense innovation pathways to align ICON's capabilities with the government's highest-priority requirements. You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Regulatory teams so that BD commitments are technically grounded and contractually executable and customer needs shape our product roadmap. This role is based in Washington, DC, reports to the Senior Director, Prime Business Development & Government Affairs, and requires up to 30% travel.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute a business development strategy to expand ICON Prime's presence across DoD, including the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, and National Guard.

• Build and maintain a high-quality federal pipeline. Engage program offices, requirements owners, and contracting officers early to shape opportunities before they are released.

• Cultivate deep relationships with key stakeholders at USACE, NAVFAC, AFCEC, DIU, AFWERX, and service-specific construction and installation commands.

• Lead capture for targeted opportunities end to end, from business validation and qualification through gate reviews, proposal development, final proposal revisions, and contract negotiation, including teaming strategy and pricing guidance.

• Pursue design-build, OTA, and IDIQ opportunities, including barracks, hardened facilities, and base infrastructure, as well as expeditionary construction and SCIF deployment.

• Develop and deliver briefings, white papers, and capability narratives for general officers and senior civilian officials, and represent ICON at industry events, industry days, and installation visits.

• Conduct market intelligence and competitive analysis, and assess competitors and emerging trends to guide capture strategy and product roadmap decisions.

• Partner with Engineering, Operations, and Regulatory teams to ensure solutions align with Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) and service requirements, and bring customer feedback into product development and the product roadmap.

• Maintain pipeline and customer data in HubSpot, contribute to pipeline and gate reviews with Prime leadership, and support and manage business development and proposal professionals as the team grows.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of business development, capture management, or program management experience within DoD or military construction, with a track record of closing competitive federal contracts.

• Experience working with federal government agencies, DoW organizations, or military construction projects with understanding of government contracting and acquisition processes.

• Deep fluency in federal procurement, including FAR/DFARS, OTAs, IDIQs, DIU and AFWERX pathways, SBIR/STTR, the MILCON process, and defense appropriations cycles.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to present complex technical information to government stakeholders, military officials, and internal teams, and create compelling proposals, presentations, and technical marketing content.

• Exceptional relationship-building and networking abilities with demonstrated success establishing trust and credibility with government agencies and federal stakeholders in professional and regulatory environments.

• Proven ability to engage senior DoD stakeholders at the Pentagon, service command, or major command level.

• Working knowledge of Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) and military design standards.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to self-direct and execute at startup speed with limited institutional support.

• Ability to travel up to 30% for customer meetings, conferences, and industry events.

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Prior military or federal civilian service, particularly with USACE, NAVFAC, AFCEC, Marine Corps Installations Command, or a DoD R&D command, including Navy Civil Engineer Corps or Seabees, Air Force civil engineering, or Marine Corps engineering and facilities.

• Active or current eligibility for a Secret or TS/SCI security clearance (TS/SCI preferred).

• Familiarity with MILCON project delivery, OTA construction agreements, or other non-traditional defense acquisition pathways.

• Background in design-build or fast-track delivery, or in 3D printing, additive manufacturing, robotics in construction, or other innovative construction methods.

• Graduate degree in construction management, engineering, or a related discipline, or a background in management consulting or strategic advisory focused on defense.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Asscoaite
jobs.description:
Company Description

Farther is a rapidly growing RIA that combines expert advisors with cutting-edge technology - delivering a comprehensive, tailored wealth management experience.

Farther’s founders are leaders and innovators from the private wealth industry who possess a unique blend of traditional wealth management, fintech, and technology production expertise. We’re backed by top-tier venture capital firms, fintech investors, and industry leaders.

Joining Farther means joining a collaborative team of entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping their clients and our teammates achieve more. If you’re the type who breaks through walls to get things done the right way, we want to build the future of wealth management with you.

The Role

Finance runs on good data, and we need a Business Intelligence Associate to help keep ours clean, current, and useful. You'll work directly with our Revenue Operations Manager and alongside the Finance team to run our monthly reporting, dig into the numbers behind it, and get a little sharper every cycle. Expect real coaching, hands-on projects, and a clear path toward data analyst or data science work in finance and AI. If you're excited about finance and want to learn fast, this is a great place to build.

Your Impact

• Run our monthly financial and operational reports using established frameworks, and keep them accurate and on time

• Pull data from databases, spreadsheets, and APIs with SQL and Python to spot trends and answer questions

• Check data quality so everyone can trust what they see

• Use AI tools to speed up analysis and automate repeat work

• Support ad hoc requests from Finance, Revenue Operations, and partner teams like HubSpot, and explain what you find in plain English

The Ideal Match

• A real interest in finance or wealth management, and a clear reason you want to build a career in it

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Analytics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, plus at least one relevant internship

• Intermediate Python and SQL, and comfort reading code and working with AI to write and debug it

• Sharp attention to detail and strong integrity with numbers

• Coachable, motivated, and quick to learn: you take feedback and turn it into better work

Bonus Points

• Early-career experience in finance, fintech, consulting, or analytics

• Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform

• Background in wealth management or financial services

Why Join Us

• Hands-on coaching from a manager who invests in your growth

• Your scope grows as fast as you do — we'd rather stretch you than box you in

• A flat team where anyone can talk to anyone and good ideas win regardless of title

• Competitive pay that tracks your impact

• Full health, dental, and vision from day one, plus 401(k) matching and Roth IRA options

• Unlimited PTO

• Recognized as one of Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces two years running

Ready to build the next era of wealth management? Let's talk!

jobs.title: Finance Data Product Analyst — FP&A
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Finance Data Product Analyst will serve as the dedicated FP&A analytics support resource, owning the requirements-to-handoff lifecycle across core FP&A domains. This role fills a current gap where FP&A requirements gathering, stakeholder coordination, and AI-to-engineering handoff are absorbed across leads without dedicated capacity. The analyst will ensure faster turnaround, stronger domain ownership across GLTD, Revenue, CapEx, and HC portfolios, and less rework in downstream deliverables.

Roles and Responsibilities

Serve as the dedicated FP&A analyst for requirements intake — gather, clarify, document, and prioritize business requirements from Finance stakeholders across GLTD, Revenue, CapEx, and HC portfolios.

Translate business requirements into structured technical specifications and data model requirements for handoff to the onsite senior analyst and engineering team.

Own the requirements-to-engineering handoff process — ensure specifications are complete, unambiguous, and validated before passing to development, reducing rework cycles.

Perform data validation, reconciliation, and UAT support — verify that delivered models and reports match business intent and source data.

Debug and trace data through existing EDW models to answer stakeholder questions, identify discrepancies, and document root causes for engineering resolution.

Coordinate between onsite and offshore teams — manage requirements backlogs, track delivery status, flag gaps or conflicts, and ensure timely handoff at each stage.

Maintain documentation: business requirements documents, data dictionaries, test cases, and process guides.

Support AI-augmented analytics adoption by articulating business needs that could benefit from AI/ML capabilities and translating them into actionable requirements.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

4 years of experience in BI analysis, data product analysis, or finance analytics support roles.

Strong understanding of FP&A concepts — general ledger, revenue recognition, CapEx planning, headcount reporting, cost center hierarchies.

SQL proficiency for data investigation — ability to query, trace, and validate data across EDW layers (not expected to build pipelines).

Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and business-to-technical translation.

Familiarity with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms from an analyst/consumer perspective.

Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools for report validation and basic analysis.

Strong written and verbal communication — ability to write clear specs and coordinate across time zones with onsite teams.

Detail-oriented with a structured approach to tracking deliverables and handoff checklists.

Preferred Qualifications

SAP Finance or ERP data familiarity (GL, AP, AR, cost center structures).

Exposure to AI/ML concepts — enough to recognize where AI-assisted analytics could add value to FP&A workflows.

Experience working in offshore delivery models with structured SDLC or agile processes.

Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.

Required Education and Training

Bachelor's degree in finance, computer science, mathematics, information systems, or business.

• Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.

• Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.

• Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).

• Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployment Engineer, Strategic Customer Engagements U.S.
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help develop transformative solutions for our most strategic accounts, starting with our Global Defense and Security customers. In this role, you will work directly with key partners, acting as a senior technical contributor and hands-on builder within a collaborative engineering team. Your mission will be to tackle complex, mission-critical customer challenges by building high-impact software solutions.

You will have a high degree of autonomy to design and build what is needed, turning ambiguous requirements into functional and reliable software. Your work will directly contribute to delivering on critical customer commitments and will help inform future product development. This role is ideal for an individual contributor who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex technical problems from design to delivery.

• Spearhead the full development lifecycle from discovery and decomposition to designing, building, and deploying bespoke solutions for customer challenges.

• Develop robust, full-stack software, including front-end, back-end, data integration, cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), and CI/CD pipelines.

• Collaborate directly with customers to understand operational challenges and translate them into technical requirements.

• Analyze customer solutions to identify reusable patterns that inform broader platform development.

• Leverage the latest AI tooling and an AI-first mindset to drive rapid iteration, deliver value quickly, and adapt to evolving requirements with a bias for action.

• Mentor team members, conducts code reviews, and helps foster a collaborative engineering culture.

• Execute critical commitments on time to directly support key customer relationships and business goals.

• Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, and testing methodologies.

• Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to diverse internal and external stakeholders.

• Experience with fast, iterative development cycles and an ability to adapt to shifting requirements.

jobs.title: Cardiothoracic Transplant Account Manager - Texas
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Transplant Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for driving adoption and volume growth of the CareDx transplant diagnostics portfolio and ecosystem (www.caredx.com/products-and-services/transplant-services). Focusing primarily on heart and lung programs in the transplant center, the TAM will coordinate and collaborate with the Solutions Account Manager (SAM), Clinical Liaisons, and Medical Science Liaisons (MSL) to develop and execute account level growth strategies. Successful TAMs are collaborative, agile problem solvers with strategic account management and sales experience, possessing strong communication skills and clinical aptitude, taking a patient centric approach to delivering results. The TAM role reports directly to the Regional Director (RD).

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Strategic Account Management: Develop a deep understanding of account’s needs, objectives, and challenges in order to provide tailored solutions that meet their requirements. Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts to upsell and cross-sell relevant CareDx products, solutions or services.

Strategic Planning and Executing Account Plans: Develop and execute strategic plans to drive business growth and achieve sales targets. Create and implement long-term, account-specific strategies and tactics to drive adoption, gain market share, expand the CareDx footprint and achieve commercial goals.

Product Knowledge and Clinical & Technical Proficiency: Possess an understanding of therapeutic area, scientific concepts, testing platforms, mechanisms and processes; as well as supportive key clinical studies.

Building Strong Customer Relationships: Identify key customer stakeholders and influencers, establishing strong relationships and partnerships, continually soliciting feedback on additional needs, products, and features. Resolve customer issues promptly and efficiently, managing expectations and ensuring customer satisfaction.

Managing the Sales Pipeline: Forecast and manage the sales pipeline and growth strategies to track progress towards objectives at both the account and regional levels. Prepare regular performance reports for regional leadership, providing insights into strategy effectiveness, ROI, and key other performance indicators

Leading through influence while collaborating with Internal Teams: Partner with Commercial, Marketing, Customer Experience, Medical Affairs, Market Access and Operations teams to develop creative solutions that address customer needs.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree required, advance degree (e.g., MBA) preferred

• Minimum of 10 years sales or strategic account management experience in the healthcare industry

• Experience selling into hospitals, hospital/health systems, and/or enterprise-level accounts, navigating across multiple levels of stakeholders and departments.

• Track record of developing effective account strategies that maximize business outcomes in a highly matrixed organization

• Strong written and oral communication & organizational skills

• Must be willing to travel up to 75%, including frequent day trips, overnight travel, and some weekend conferences

• Willing to be in the field and customer facing a minimum of 4 days per week

• Proficient with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Salesforce.com and analytical tools like PowerBI

• Clinical or sales experiences in Transplant, Cardiology, Respiratory, Pulmonology, Molecular Diagnostics and Lab

• Deep clinical knowledge of transplantation is strongly preferred

Role Competencies:

• Healthcare Market Understanding: Anticipates the potential business implications of an evolving healthcare marketplace and identifies new opportunities for growth

• Business & Territory Planning: Aligns market and customer needs and insights with CareDx products, solutions and services to develop strategic action plans

• Analytics and Insight Generation: Leverages many sources of complex business and customer data to generate insights, identify market trends and opportunities, and inform decision making.

• Account Management: Develops a deep understanding of customer needs and aligns them with CareDx products, solutions and services to attain mutually beneficial outcomes

• Consultative Selling Agility: Applies selling skills to understand and meet customer needs and ensure sales execution is compliant and strategically aligned with business objectives to maximize sales results

Additional Details:

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

Our competitive Total Rewards package for US Employees includes:

• Competitive base salary and incentive compensation

• Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program

• 401(k) savings plan match

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Pre-tax commuter benefits

• And more!

• Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers

In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow.

With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it’s an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together.

jobs.description:

Farther’s founders are leaders and innovators from the private wealth industry who possess a unique blend of traditional wealth management, fintech, and technology production expertise. We’re backed by top-tier venture capital firms, fintech investors, and industry leaders.

Joining Farther means joining a collaborative team of entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping their clients and our teammates achieve more. If you’re the type who breaks through walls to get things done the right way, we want to build the future of wealth management with you.

The Role

The billing team is responsible for developing and executing the billing process for all of the services we provide to our advisory clients. jobs.title: [2026-2027] School Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The School Operations Manager (SOM) is responsible for managing and executing smooth daily operations of the school Specifically, the SOM ensures core daily systems are effectively executed, student enrollment targets are met and maintained, facilities and technology systems are in good working order, daily student health and safety protocols are adhered to, and daily events logistics are executed as planned. The SOM reports directly to the Director of Operations (DOO) and manages the School Operations Administrator (SOA).

Duties and Responsibilities:

General responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Daily Operations Management: Oversee key daily systems such as student arrival, attendance, transitions, lunch/recess, and dismissal. Ensure all processes run smoothly and efficiently. Ensure the main office is staffed, supplies are replenished, and equipment is in good working order. Manage technology, facilities, and other operational systems, resolving issues promptly. Lead planning and execution of student recruitment and enrollment processes.
• Communication & Interaction: Foster strong relationships with staff, students, and families. Communicate effectively with all stakeholders and respond within 24-48 hours. Support the school’s mission through active participation in student enrichment activities and field lessons when needed
• Office Management: Manage the School Operations Administrator (SOA), ensuring they meet deadlines, standards, and goals. Hold regular one-on-ones with the SOA to monitor progress and provide guidance.
• Student Health & Safety: Monitor student health and ensure communication with the school nurse. Serve as an active member of the BRT and assist in emergency or high-urgency situations.
• Collaboration with DOO: Assist the DOO with special projects, systems supporting instructional vision, and escalated concerns. Report progress and barriers to DOO for continuous improvement. Conduct daily walkthroughs with the DOO to maintain operational integrity. Ensure events and field trips are well-executed.

• Strong interpersonal skills that contribute to a collegial working environment and a healthy measure of the character traits we value: zest, grit, hope, social intelligence, gratitude, and a sense of humor.
• Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience.
• Thrives in fast-paced, high-achieving, team-oriented, and mission-driven environments.
• Highly organized, resourceful, and able to manage multiple tasks with precision.
• Quick learner, critical thinker, and open to feedback.
• Proactively manages multiple critical deadlines, ensuring timely completion of tasks and responsibilities.
• Demonstrates resilience, flexibility, and innovation when necessary.
• Takes ownership of impact on self and others, adjusts accordingly, and embraces growth opportunities.
• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office and school operations systems; computer literate.
• Outstanding written and oral communication skills; effectively communicates with diverse backgrounds.
• Excellent at prioritization, with high attention to detail.
• Proactive, and able to manage high responsibility levels.
• Demonstrated passion for and commitment to the KIPP mission with school based experience strongly preferred

Compensation and Benefits:

KIPP NYC offers a salary ranging from $80,340 - $88,745. Salary ranges at KIPP NYC are standardized based on role level and role function. Individual salaries are determined through a lens of equity, accounting for years of experience relevant to the role and scope of responsibilities, and are benchmarked against others within the same salary band.

KIPP NYC offers a generous benefits package, including, but not limited to, the following:

• Robust benefits include medical, dental, and vision.
• Generous time off, including 5 school vacation weeks, sick and personal days, and an extended summer break.
• Up to 12 weeks of 100% parental leave.
• Bright Horizon Back-up Child and Elder Care.
• Employer-paid Life Insurance and Short-term/Long-term disability.

This description is intended to describe the type of work being performed by a person assigned to this position.  It is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities required by the employee.

This role is based in NYC and will require travel to our schools. If you relocate outside of a commutable distance or out of the state of NY, your employment will be subject to review, which may include separation from KIPP NYC. You must notify HR if you move or have plans to relocate.

jobs.title: Director, GLP-1 & Cardiometabolic Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada Health is looking for an experienced product marketing leader to help us win in GLP-1 and cardiometabolic health. This role supports our new program development marketing, including GLP-1 solutions, with an emphasis on differentiated positioning, commercial execution, and bringing new offerings to market. This is a hands-on player-coach role with one direct report. Your primary focus will be leading strategy and personally delivering high-impact work, complemented by focused coaching and development of a product marketer.

You will be a strategic partner to commercial, product, and clinical leadership, translating buyer needs, competitive dynamics, and field insights into a clear, compelling reason to choose Omada. You will own product messaging, go-to-market strategy, and support sales enablement, helping our teams connect the right offering and value story to each buyer’s priorities. Your highest priorities will be buyer and offer clarity through developing positioning and value stories by segment and asset development with a fast market-to-field feedback loop that increases selling effectiveness.

At the center of this role is a continuous feedback loop between the field and our value story. You will work closely with sales, consultant relations, and other channel and customer-facing teams to understand what resonates and why we win or lose. You will turn those insights into stronger messaging, more effective sales tools, and recommendations that inform product and commercial strategy, then bring those improvements back to the field and assess what works.

About you:

• Relevant experience: 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, including 5+ years in healthcare and life sciences. Experience in virtual care, digital health, health plans, PBMs, or pharma is preferred.

• Commercial judgment: A track record of shaping product marketing strategies that help sales teams compete and win in complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes. You understand how employers, health plans, PBMs, and benefits consultants evaluate clinical and economic value.

• Product marketing craft: Demonstrated strength in buyer research, competitive intelligence, positioning, messaging, go-to-market planning, product launches, and sales enablement.

• Strategic and hands-on execution: You can set a clear direction and personally build the presentation, business case narrative, competitive response, or launch messaging needed to move the work forward. You've done this on a lean team, delivering field-ready work in weeks, not quarters.

• Field partnership: Experience working directly with sales and customer-facing teams to turn deal-level feedback into actionable insights, stronger value stories, and repeatable approaches to selling.

• Compelling storytelling: The ability to translate complex clinical, product, and economic information into clear, credible content tailored to different buyers and stakeholders.

• Cross-functional leadership: The ability to influence decisions, facilitate productive feedback, and align teams across commercial, product, clinical, and marketing without relying on formal authority.

• People development: Experience directly managing and developing marketing talent, with a willingness to balance coaching one direct report with substantial individual contribution.

• Measurement: Experience defining KPIs and using qualitative and quantitative feedback to assess buyer understanding, field readiness, competitive conversion, and adoption, rather than simply counting materials produced.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Your impact:

You will help turn Omada’s GLP-1 and cardiometabolic strategy into a differentiated commercial story that drives selling effectiveness. Success means buyers understand our value, the field is equipped to win the right opportunities, and eligible members receive a clear, consistent explanation of the care available to them.

Market sensing that drives action:

• Run a regular win/loss forum that incorporates competitive feedback.

• Facilitate a fast feedback loop across Sales, Consultant Relations, channel teams, Product Marketing, and Strategy. Translate signals into clear recommendations about what has changed and what we should do differently, not simply market updates.

• Partner with Product and Clinical to translate programs and analysis into messaging implications.

• Close the loop by bringing updated messaging and tools back to the field, pilot in select deals, and using the results to guide further improvements.

Buyer segmentation and differentiated positioning:

• Set annual product marketing priorities for how Omada wins in GLP-1 and cardiometabolic health: who we target, which problems we solve, and why buyers should choose us over alternatives.

• Work through a broader B2B and Brand Marketing organization to drive awareness of your program segments and strategy

• Develop distinct value stories for employers covering GLP-1s and those not covering them, and for buyers prioritizing cost management versus population health. Support segment adaptation for consultant and payers.

• Maintain one coherent Omada portfolio narrative, with differentiated reasons to buy across audiences, offerings, and channels.

• Partner with Clinical and Thought Leadership to translate evidence into relevant proof points and identify evidence gaps that matter to purchasing decisions.

Offer clarity and the buyer business case:

• Turn capabilities into understandable, purchasable offers that clearly explain what is included, who qualifies, how access works, who pays, and what value is supported by evidence.

• Co-develop packaging and pricing recommendations, comparison and business-case tools, and guarantee messaging with Product, Finance, Strategy, and commercial partners.

• Ensure clinical and economic claims are clear and credible, explicitly distinguishing observed results from modeled savings and explaining relevant assumptions and limitations.

Sales and channel effectiveness:

• Personally build and refine the narrative, pitch decks, discovery guides, competitive responses, proof points, and support business-case tools that help the field sell effectively.

• Partner with sales leaders on priority opportunities, tailoring the value story and addressing clinical, operational, and economic objections. Turn successful approaches into repeatable tools and practices.

• Equip consultants, PBMs, and other channel partners with a compelling reason and a practical way to sell Omada, including channel-specific messaging, use cases, and materials that fit their selling process.

• Partner with Customer Effectiveness on practical training, and test messaging and tools in real buyer conversations rather than treating delivery of an asset as the finish line.

Launch readiness and continuous adaptation:

• Support commercial readiness for new GLP-1 and cardiometabolic offerings, not just announcement day, aligning the offer, messaging, evidence, training, channel materials, and member communications.

• Lead product marketing’s launch planning and post-launch optimization, with clear cross-functional responsibilities and feedback from early selling and member experiences.

• Keep messaging and tools current as capabilities, evidence, and market conditions change.

Lead as a player-coach:

• Manage and develop one product marketer, setting clear priorities, providing regular feedback, and supporting growth.

• Maintain direct ownership of strategic initiatives and core deliverables, modeling strong product marketing craft and close partnership with the field.

Benefits:

• Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus

• Equity grants

• Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)

• Remote first work from home culture

• Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones

• Generous parental leave

• Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)

• 401k retirement savings plan

• Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)

• Mental Health Support Solutions

• ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

• Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.

• Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.

• Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.

• Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.

• Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.

• Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Project Manager/Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Timmons Group is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering Project Manager or Senior Project Manager to join our Energy team supporting utility-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the electrical engineering and design of PV and BESS projects from conceptual design through issued-for-construction (IFC) documents and construction support. This position will lead teams of electrical engineers and designers, manage project staffing and resources, and ensure electrical design projects are delivered in accordance with established scope, budget, schedule, and quality requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Manage the electrical engineering and design of utility-scale PV and BESS projects from conceptual and preliminary design through IFC design and construction support.
• Lead and coordinate teams of electrical engineers and designers responsible for project execution.
• Plan project staffing, assign work, manage workloads, and coordinate internal resources to meet project schedules and deliverables.
• Develop and manage electrical engineering scopes, budgets, schedules, work plans, and deliverable schedules.
• Serve as the primary technical and project management point of contact for clients for electrical design projects.
• Provide technical leadership and oversight for electrical design activities, calculations, drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables.
• Oversee development of PV electrical systems, including DC collection, inverter systems, AC collection, medium-voltage collection systems, grounding, communications, and associated electrical balance-of-system design.
• Oversee development of BESS electrical systems, including battery systems, power conversion systems (PCS), transformers, switchgear, medium-voltage collection, auxiliary power, grounding, communications, and associated electrical balance-of-system design.
• Oversee underground and overhead medium-voltage collection design, including routing, conductor and cable selection, equipment locations, pole layouts, and overhead-to-underground transitions.
• Coordinate electrical interfaces with project substations, gen-tie facilities, utility interconnections, SCADA/communications systems, and other project infrastructure.
• Coordinate electrical requirements with civil, structural, geotechnical, substation, and other engineering disciplines.
• Coordinate equipment requirements and vendor information for PV inverters, BESS PCS and battery systems, transformers, switchgear, and other major electrical equipment.
• Review and approve electrical calculations, drawings, specifications, equipment schedules, studies, and other engineering deliverables.
• Lead design reviews and ensure electrical designs are complete, coordinated, constructable, and compliant with applicable project requirements and standards.
• Manage project performance against established budgets and schedules and proactively address staffing, scope, schedule, and technical issues.
• Identify changes in project scope and support development of additional service requests and contract amendments.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to electrical engineers and designers.
• Assist with development and implementation of electrical design standards, procedures, templates, and quality-control processes.
• Support preparation of proposals, scopes of work, fee estimates, and project schedules for electrical engineering services.
• Build and maintain strong client relationships and support business development within the solar PV and BESS markets.

Skills/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from an accredited engineering program.
• Minimum of 7 years of electrical engineering experience, with progressively increasing responsibility in electrical design, technical leadership, and/or project management.
• Demonstrated experience with electrical engineering for utility-scale solar PV, BESS, power generation, substations, or other medium- and high-voltage power systems.
• Demonstrated ability to manage electrical engineering projects, including scope, budget, schedule, staffing, and technical deliverables.
• Experience leading and coordinating teams of electrical engineers and designers.
• Working knowledge of medium-voltage electrical systems, electrical equipment, grounding, cable and conductor systems, and power distribution.
• Ability to review and provide technical direction on electrical calculations, one-line diagrams, equipment layouts, collection systems, grounding systems, wiring diagrams, and construction documents.
• Strong understanding of electrical engineering principles and applicable industry codes and standards.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to effectively communicate with clients, engineers, designers, equipment vendors, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and engineering teams concurrently.
• Ability to exercise independent technical judgment and make sound project-level decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.
• Direct electrical engineering and project management experience with utility-scale solar PV and/or BESS projects.
• Experience managing electrical design projects from conceptual engineering through IFC design and construction support.
• Experience with 34.5 kV or similar medium-voltage collector systems.
• Experience with underground and overhead medium-voltage systems.
• Familiarity with PV inverters, BESS PCS equipment, battery systems, medium-voltage transformers, switchgear, substations, and utility interconnection equipment.
• Experience with electrical system studies, including short-circuit, load flow, grounding, cable ampacity, and equipment evaluation.
• Experience coordinating electrical designs with substation, utility interconnection, SCADA, civil, and structural engineering disciplines.
• Experience managing multiple simultaneous projects and allocating engineering and design resources across a portfolio of work.
• Experience developing electrical engineering scopes, proposals, fee estimates, and project schedules.
• Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop electrical engineers and designers.

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, patient, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace. Candidates must share a commitment to our company’s Vision, Mission and Shared Values.

Timmons Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Timmons Group is a full-service engineering and technology firm recognized nationally as a “Best Firm to Work For” by CE News. With 22 offices throughout the Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, and South Central United States, we provide civil engineering, environmental, economic development, GIS/geospatial technology, landscape architecture, and surveying services to a diverse client base. As one of Engineering News Record’s (ENR) Top 500 Design Firms for over 30 years, we are dedicated to being an employer of choice and providing our people with the best resources, technology, and culture to help them thrive in an engaging career development setting. jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By bringing everyone together, you’ll be able to create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, helping you, your team, and H&M succeed. Ensuring an excellent operational & visual experience for your store, customers & colleagues. You’ll be aware of your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. Analyze and follow up on sales, and create plans to optimize results and profits.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and acting on them
• Establish & analyze sales and budget goals, creating plans to optimize results
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Manage your department in a cost-efficient way
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
• Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions

Team & Development

• Responsible for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, upskilling & developing your team in-store
• Complete performance evaluations and succession planning to support business & team needs
• Retain and share your knowledge and skills with your team
• Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Responsible for the teams planning & scheduling
• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
• Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding & introduction processes, trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
• Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
• Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
• Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
• Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
• Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

• To be a successful and effective Department Manager, you’ll be a strong leader who enjoys taking responsibility for others.
• You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
• You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $17.05 - $19.86 hourly**

EEOC Code: SLS

Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

Our company is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we actively seek colleagues who share our commitment.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.

If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer I, Off-Planet Systems
jobs.description:
Job Description

ICON is looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to assist in our Strategic R&D efforts.  As the Mechanical Engineer for Off-Planet Robotics, you will be responsible for the development of conceptual and detailed designs of spacecraft and planetary systems, conducting trade studies and ideation exercises, participating in our design review and systems engineering processes, and ultimately fly the hardware you have designed.  This role is based locally in ICON’s Austin, TX laboratories, and will report to the Senior Director of Off-Planet Systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Contribute in the development of a robotic platform for construction applications, focusing on motion platforms and dynamic fluid systems.

• Design and create prototypes using in-house and external fabrication

• Specify robotic servo-driven actuators using industry standards for aerospace applications, including mobile (rover-based) robotics, and large format, long reach robotic actuators.

• Run FEA and CFD analysis to provide safe and reliable engineered solutions for use in space.

• Provide hands-on, troubleshooting, and build support as well designing, implementing, and integrating solutions in a fast-paced environment with a quick AGILE development cycle.

• Create design solutions utilizing engineering methods with good documentation processes

• Collaborate with cross-functional, multidisciplinary teams to procure, fabricate, test, and ultimately fly the hardware you have designed.

• Perform a wide range of tasks on a daily basis (e.g. Transition from office work to field work at a moment’s notice)

• Establish individual and team goals consistent with overall company OKRs

• Mentor engineers in their career development

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• B.S. degree or higher in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.

• 8+ years of recent experience designing aerospace or equivalent type mechanical system elements within aircraft, spacecraft, or launch vehicles.

• Strong mechanical design and integration skills using 3D modeling tools.

• Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• M.S. or PhD in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.

• Strong thermal analysis skills.

• Past design experience in extreme thermal environments.

• Familiarity with serial robotic arm operations and design constraints.

• Experience in aerospace actuation design.

• Experience in formal systems engineering: requirements development, implementation, verification, system integration, qualification and release.

• Experience in spacecraft systems design.

• Experience in Solidworks.

• Experience in structural FEA and CFD using ANSYS, or similar tools.

PHYSICAL/ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, noise, and outdoor conditions.

• Physical effort may be required for the handling of supplies or materials (up to 50 lbs unassisted).

ICON is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an innovative, inclusive, diverse and discrimination-free work environment. Employment with ICON is based on merit, competence, and qualifications. It is our policy to administer all personnel actions, including recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. Consistent with the obligations of these laws, ICON will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Furthermore, as a federal government contractor, the Company maintains an affirmative action program which furthers its commitment and complies with recordkeeping and reporting requirements under certain federal civil rights laws and regulations, including Executive Order 11246, Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (as amended) and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 (as amended).

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit candidates through this application. ICON does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency submissions for candidates and will not pay fees to any third-party agency without a prior agreement with ICON.

As part of our compliance with these obligations, the Company invites you to voluntarily self-identify as set forth below. Provision of such information is entirely voluntary and a decision to provide or not provide such information will not have any effect on your employment or subject you to any adverse treatment. Any and all information provided will be considered confidential, will be kept separate from your application and/or personnel file, and will only be used in accordance with applicable laws, orders and regulations, including those that require the information to be summarized and reported to the federal government for civil rights enforcement purposes.
