jobs.title: Corporate Controller
jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

We're hiring a builder-minded Director, Corporate Controller to lead the global accounting function and take it to public-company standard. You will set the strategy for the controllership organization, own the close and accounting policy, build the controls environment, and lead the accounting workstreams behind our IPO readiness. The decisions you make will shape Armada's financial foundation for years to come.

This is not a maintenance role. You will architect the processes and systems a much larger, multi-entity, manufacturing-and-deployment business will run on, while staying close enough to the work to personally resolve the hardest technical questions.

• Reports to: VP, Finance

• Location: This role is remote-based in the United States

• Team: Directs accounting and tax through a team of managers and senior individual contributors; partners with FP&A, Treasury, Legal, and the Executive Team

What You'll Do

Close and reporting

• Own the global month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close; drive it to a predictable 7-10 business days

• Deliver accurate, timely US GAAP financial statements, including multi-entity consolidation and foreign currency translation across international subsidiaries

• Own the accounting content of board, investor, and lender reporting packages, and ensure ongoing debt covenant compliance

Technical accounting and policy

• Establish and document the company's accounting policies and technical positions, and defend them with auditors and senior leadership

• Lead revenue recognition (ASC 606) on complex, milestone-heavy hardware, deployment, software, and services contracts, including multiple performance obligations and variable consideration

• Advise sales, legal, and deal teams on the revenue and accounting implications of complex customer and government contract terms before signature

• Own accounting for leases (ASC 842), stock-based compensation (ASC 718), debt and financing transactions, contract costs (ASC 340-40), and foreign operations (ASC 830)

Audit, controls, and IPO readiness

• Own the external audit relationship and lead the annual audit, negotiating significant accounting and scope matters with the audit partner

• Define the SOX readiness roadmap and direct the design and implementation of internal controls to achieve a SOX-ready control environment within 12 months

• Own the accounting workstreams for IPO readiness, partnering with legal, FP&A, and external advisors on timeline and deliverables, and drive process improvements across finance

Government and international

• Own accounting and compliance for US government contracts (Other Transaction agreements today, FAR/DFARS work ahead), including invoicing and cost compliance

• Partner with tax and treasury to set strategy for intercompany, transfer pricing, statutory audits, and local filings across international entities

Strategy, leadership, and systems

• Set the accounting systems roadmap; own and scale the ERP (NetSuite) and surrounding stack: procure-to-pay, billing, payroll, inventory/MRP, and consolidation tools

• Develop new methods to automate, standardize, and document close and reporting processes as the business scales

• Build, lead, and develop a growing accounting and tax organization, including hiring and developing managers; set the bar for rigor and pace, and define performance standards and career paths for the team

• Help establish the finance organization's strategic plans and objectives, and translate them into a multi-year controllership roadmap covering people, process, systems, and controls

• Cascade functional strategy into clear goals, priorities, and evaluation criteria for the accounting and tax team

• Own the accounting department budget, including headcount, audit and advisory fees, and systems spend

• Serve as a trusted advisor to the VP Finance and executive team on the accounting implications of strategic decisions, transactions, and financings

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field; active CPA license

• 12+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 5+ years leading an accounting function as a Controller or Director at a high-growth company

• A track record of building and leading multi-layer accounting teams, including hiring and developing managers

• Big 4 or national-firm public accounting experience

• Deep US GAAP judgment, especially ASC 606 on complex hardware-plus-services arrangements; you can write a memo and defend it

• A track record leading external audits and building SOX-ready controls before they were required

• Multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation experience across international subsidiaries

• Comfort with ambiguity and pace: you prefer building the playbook to following one

• Executive presence: you explain complex accounting matters clearly to executives, the board, auditors, and investors, and can reconcile competing stakeholder views

• Experience owning a departmental budget and multi-year functional roadmap

Backgrounds We Value

• IPO or S-1 experience, or Controller time at a newly public company

• Government contracting accounting (FAR, DFARS, DCAA, CAS) and systems

• Experience in data centers, edge computing, robotics, aerospace/defense, or industrial hardware

• International operations in the Middle East, Latin America, Europe, or Asia-Pacific

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications.  In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

Benefits

• Competitive base salary and equity

• Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost)

• Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA)

• Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k)

• Unlimited paid time off (PTO)

• 14 paid company holidays per year

#LI-SM1

#LI-Remote

Compensation

$225,000—$300,000 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

• A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge

• A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company

• A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda

• Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Tech Lead - React & Python
jobs.description:
Tech Lead  (Perm, USA, Remote + Travel)

This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in the United States and authorized to work without sponsorship. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

This position also requires traveling to client sites within the U.S., with travel expenses covered by the company.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.
Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

• Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.

• Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.

• Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.

• Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.

• Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.

• Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.

• Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

• Significant experience in software engineering and 2+ years of experience leading projects and mentoring as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, we are looking for professional experience with Python and React.

• Experience with AI application development and Agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g., LangGraph, Agentspace, etc.)

• Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.

• Strong CI/CD experience, including hands-on work with Terraform, Helm, and other cloud-native IaC technologies.

• Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.

• Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.

• Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.

• Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.

• Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)

• Empathy and people skills

Benefits & Perks:

• Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.

• Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!

• Flexible Time Off Package - We offer a flexible annual leave policy plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.

• Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in USD) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.

• Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.

• Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.

• 401k - We offer a 401k plan and match up to 4%, with no minimum entry requirements and immediate vesting of employers’ contributions.

Our Interview Process

• Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom) An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

• Panel Interview (60 mins via Zoom) A conversation with two of our Technical Directors focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

• Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins via Zoom) A structured assessment led by a senior Technical Lead or Head of Engineering, designed to evaluate key aspects of a Technical Lead role. This session includes a selection of tasks to cover: Architecture Design - We want to see how you approach a high-level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process. Technical Implementation - How do you turn a design into reality, taking into account business needs? Code Standards and Feedback - We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.

Our salary range is $170,000 - 200,000 + bonus & benefits. Further details will be discussed in the initial interview, and final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and other job-related factors discussed during the interview process.

jobs.title: Field Reimbursement Manager - Parkinson’s
jobs.description:
This role is field-based, and candidates should live within a reasonable distance from the primary city.

Candidates may live in the following areas:

• Minneapolis, MN
• Omaha, NE

The Parkinson’s Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) acts as an alternative in-office resource that is available to address HCP questions about patient access.  The FRM calls directly on HCP offices in their assigned, specific geography to answer questions about patient access & reimbursement in support of Duopa, Vyalev and Juvmo.  The FRM provides expertise on coverage and common access and reimbursement challenges affecting Duopa, Vyalev and Juvmo. The FRM responsibilities include educating on the access and reimbursement support tools available from AbbVie, advising HCPs on prescription status and program eligibility, and educating HCP offices on payer processes and procedures.

Specific Responsibilities:

• Educate HCPs on patient support programs, including access and reimbursement support tools and services

• Educate on product-specific acquisition and access options such as specialty pharmacy networks and specialty distribution

• Educate on resources available to address access issues

• Provide local expertise regarding national/regional payor policies to educate providers on payer issues, coding changes, and appropriate claims submission processes

• Liaise with AbbVie’s Access and Reimbursement support center to update HCPs on Rx status and program eligibility

• Report back payer trends related for approved products to Patient Services and MHC account management teams

• Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate providers within territory

• Remain current on key managed care, reimbursement, and policy activities

• At least 3 years of experience in Neuroscience with experience in Managed Health Care, Payer Account Management, and/or Access and Reimbursement
• Thorough understanding of the technical payer policy processes, systems and requirements for coverage, coding and payment for specialty medicines
• Demonstrated understanding of the rules, regulations and risks associated with provision of reimbursement support services
• Strong understanding and ability to communicate technical elements of coding and billing requirements at the National and Regional level across all settings of care
• Comprehensive understanding of Parts A, B, C and D or Medicare and associated reimbursement dynamics
• Strong understanding of drug acquisition and dispensing in the Neuroscience space (Specialty Pharmacies, Specialty Distributors and white-bagging, etc.).Strong understanding of access and reimbursement support service centers and how to effectively interact in a compliant fashion
• Excellent territory and account management skills
• Bachelor’s degree/ Valid driver’s license
• An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
• These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. to AbbVie has resources to answer questions you may have regarding your responsibilities.

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

jobs.title: Risk & Compliance Specialist (Southfield, MI)
jobs.description:
We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.

About the Role:

As a Risk & Compliance Specialist, you’ll review cases, gather evidence, take enforcement action, and keep compliance records accurate. You’ll also communicate with Proof’s users and support other teams across the company.

You’ll follow documented procedures to handle standard cases on your own, document your work thoroughly, and escalate unusual or high-stakes situations. Success in this role means resolving risks quickly, producing accurate, well-documented cases, and applying compliance rules consistently, even at high volume.

What You'll Do:

Investigations & Risk

• Review incoming cases, decide which need attention first, and take action based on the type of case and the evidence.

• Gather and document evidence; call, text, or email as needed to gather context and discuss irregularities or recurring patterns.

• Follow documented procedures to handle standard cases independently, and escalate unusual, unclear, or high-stakes situations.

• Keep a closer eye on accounts under review: follow up on open cases and record new findings on a regular cadence.

• Execute compliance actions and assess coverage impact; alert cross-functional stakeholders as needed.

• Handle escalation calls disputing investigation outcomes; communicate resolution actions clearly and professionally.

Signal Detection & Monitoring

• Monitor and action daily alerts and signals indicating anomalies.

• Surface pattern observations within cases and server behavior; escalate larger or recurring trends.

Compliance

• Process identity document submissions for new applicants and document renewals; ensure documentation is complete and meets eligibility requirements.

• Support weekly compliance document maintenance: action expired documents and send compliance outreach communications.

• Support ad hoc internal requests and compliance-related projects.

Server Communications & Enablement

• Handle inbound account update communications and outbound compliance outreach with contractors.

• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of external-facing Help Center articles, ensuring content accurately reflects current processes and requirements.

Data, Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Track personal performance metrics.

• Collaborate cross-functionally within the Marketplace Supply organization; participate in Product meetings and submit feature requests as needed.

• Contribute to team process improvement efforts; surface observations and suggestions that support consistency and scalability.

• Assist with account setup, compliance document collection, and activation processing.

• Provide ad hoc support and contribute to marketplace projects as needed.

What You'll Bring:

• 2-3 years of experience in risk and compliance, trust and safety, operations, or contractor management, preferably within a two-sided marketplace or technology platform.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct structured case reviews, including triage, evidence gathering, clear documentation, and sound enforcement judgment, while following established frameworks and playbooks.

• Familiarity with compliance documentation, credentialing, and eligibility workflows; ability to apply rules consistently across varied cases.

• Comfortable with data and business intelligence tools (SQL proficiency is a plus); experience tracking and owning personal performance metrics.

• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of cases across multiple case types simultaneously while maintaining thoroughness and quality.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting clear, professional user-facing communications and handling server escalation calls; experience with independent contractor communications preferred.

• A collaborative, proactive mindset with a genuine interest in platform integrity, compliance, and operational excellence.

Compensation

• Salary range $53,000 - $55,000 based on experience and location

Benefits

• Full time, onsite, salary position

• Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available

• Phone and Internet monthly stipend

• Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays)

• 2 work-from-home days per month

• Necessary equipment provided

E-Verify

This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.

jobs.title: Compliance Lead
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Build the insurance behind the physical world.

The world is building data centers, energy projects, hospitals, schools, and critical infrastructure. Every one of those projects needs insurance to move forward. Yet the process of getting that insurance still depends on scattered documents, manual work, and weeks of back-and-forth.

 

Shepherd is rebuilding commercial insurance with software, data, AI, and deep underwriting expertise. We started in construction and energy, where understanding the specifics of a project matters and better decisions have consequences far beyond a screen.

 

We develop insurance products, decide which risks to insure and how to price them, and partner with established insurers to back the coverage. We own the platform our team uses to turn complex submissions into coverage for the builders and operators shaping the world around us.

 

Real problems. Real ownership.

Our engineers, designers, underwriters, and actuaries build together. The problems span turning messy documents into reliable data, making pricing more precise, and designing AI agents that can take on increasingly complex underwriting work.

 

The ambition is a platform where experts spend more time on judgment and relationships, supported by software that handles the work around them. Join us to build systems whose decisions help real projects get built.

 

630+ customers / $500B+ insured project value

 
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/cfdfd0b4-accb-41e6-8804-1216b89e5f82/0348cf6f-15dd-401e-8c20-de06e7a553fc/full-team.jpg]
 


OUR INVESTORS

Capital to build. Partners to grow with.

$67M total funding / $42M Series B in March 2026

 

Shepherd is backed by Intact Private Capital, Costanoa Ventures, Spark Capital, Susa Ventures, and Y Combinator. In March 2026, we announced a $42M Series B led by Intact Private Capital, bringing our total funding to $67M.

 

Intact is also a capacity partner. Alongside its investment, Intact works with Shepherd to bring insurance products to market. That relationship connects our platform and underwriting expertise with the resources of a global insurer.

 

A bigger opportunity ahead

We are investing in new insurance products, our underwriting team, and the path toward autonomous underwriting. For the people joining Shepherd, that means the chance to shape both the technology and the business it makes possible.

 

Our backing brings together investors who build technology companies and partners who understand insurance. We are building a company that earns the confidence of both.

 
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/cfdfd0b4-accb-41e6-8804-1216b89e5f82/1441bf79-1d14-43aa-be40-ef718b7fdac3/nyc-wide.jpg]
 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Shepherd is hiring a Compliance Lead to own and manage the company's rate and form filing process nationwide. This person will be the driving force behind every filing that brings a Shepherd product into the market, including building the filing package, working with carrier partners to submit the filing package, and responding to state objections.

You'll own Shepherd's entire filing footprint at a moment of real growth: a second carrier partner for Shepherd's core business units, and continued growth of Shepherd's verticals beyond construction and renewable energy in both Casualty and Inland Marine/Builders Risk product lines. You'll also work with Shepherd's technical underwriting leads to draft new forms, collaborate on developing tools with Shepherd's engineering team, and partner with Shepherd's customer experience team to ensure that policies are appropriately issued.

This role reports to Shepherd's Director of Compliance.

In this role, you will:

 - Own and manage Shepherd's rate and form filing process across all 50 states across our casualty, inland marine/builders risk, and workers' compensation programs.

 - Prepare, assemble, and submit complete filing packages in collaboration with Shepherd's paper partners and actuaries, including drafting and compiling supporting exhibits such as rate pages, rule pages, form schedules, actuarial memoranda support, and explanatory memos.

 - Serve as Shepherd's primary point of contact during the filing lifecycle, responding to objections and information requests, and tracking approvals to closure.

 - Own the implementation of approved forms in Shepherd's underwriting platform, including uploading new and revised forms, configuring their rules and fill-in fields, testing that they attach and populate correctly on issued policies, and working with customer experience and engineering to resolve issues.

 - Maintain Shepherd's library of filed forms, rates, and rules, and ensure consistency between filed content and issued policies.

 - Draft new forms and endorsements, and revise existing ones, working with Shepherd's technical leads and underwriting leadership to support new products and program expansion.

 - Serve as the escalation point for underwriting and customer experience on forms and policy issuance questions, including issues raised by Shepherd's Compliance Specialist, and resolve them directly.


ABOUT YOU

You would be a dream candidate if you have…

 - 7+ years of experience in insurance regulatory/compliance work with a hands-on focus on rate and form filings in casualty, workers' compensation, or inland marine/builders risk programs.

 - A track record drafting insurance policy forms and endorsements, ideally in commercial casualty.

 - Hands-on SERFF filing work, including building filing exhibits and supporting documentation.

 - A history of working directly with state insurance regulators, including responding to objections and managing filings through to approval.

 - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with comfort owning concurrent filings across 50 states.

 - Working knowledge of state insurance regulatory frameworks.

 - A desire to help people across Shepherd, from those new to insurance to those with decades of experience, understand forms and regulatory issues.

This is an onsite position in our San Francisco, New York City, Dallas Fort Worth, Chicago, or Los Angeles offices.

 

#LI-Onsite


HOW WE WORK

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

 - Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. The work here is aimed at a system that runs on its own, and the roadmap gets sequenced backward from that rather than forward from what's easy.

 - Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. Come set a standard the rest of the team inherits.

 - Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best product calls here come from engineers who've sat with underwriters and underwriters who understand where the model breaks, and much of this job is listening closely enough on both sides to make that happen.

 - Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the roadmap, the data, or the meeting invite. You pull the failing runs, book the time with the underwriters, and decide what matters.

 


BENEFITS 

🏥 Premium Healthcare
100% contribution to health, dental, and vision

🥕 Fertility benefits and family building support

🏖️ Flexible PTO
Flexibility to take the time off, recharge, and perform

🥗 Daily lunches, dinners, and snacks
We work together, and enjoy meals together too

🖥️ SF, NYC, Dallas-Fort Worth, Chicago and LA Offices

📚 Professional Development
Access to premium coaching, including leadership development

🏦 Competitive 401(k) Plan

🐶 Dog-friendly office
Plenty of dogs to play with and make friends with in the SF office

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.




YOUR ROLE

We are a team of about 60, headquartered in San Francisco, with teammates around the world. The office is where a globally distributed team becomes one team: where researchers and engineers work side by side, where customers and partners visit, and where onsites and offsites bring everyone together. Making that space work well, every day, is not a background task — it shapes how the company feels to work at.

As Office Manager, you will run our SF office day to day and help plan the in-person moments that bring the team together: onsites, offsites, team dinners, and events in San Francisco, New York, and Berlin. You will be office manager, host, planner, and fixer in one. The first big project is our office move, which you will help drive end to end.

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role reporting to our Executive Business Partner, fully onsite five days a week. If you like variety, take pride in a space that runs well, and spot what's broken before anyone asks, you'll fit right in.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Office Operations

 - Help drive the office move end to end — vendors, logistics, and onsite needs — as the first priority

 - Run SF HQ day to day: space, kitchen and snacks, furniture, supplies, mail, and packages

 - Do daily walkthroughs to keep the office clean, safe, stocked, and compliant with health and safety requirements

 - Serve as the point of contact for building management, maintenance, and facilities vendors, including cleaning and AV

 - Manage access control and visitor registration, including badges and guest credentials

 - Be the onsite point person for equipment, printers, monitors, and conference room tech, in partnership with IT

 - Maintain desk assignments, meeting room bookings, and phone booths

 - Support purchasing and vendor invoices with the Executive Business Partner

Onsites, Offsites & Events

 - Help plan and run company onsites and offsites: venues, housing, travel, catering, group activities, and daily onsite operations

 - Support logistics for executive leadership offsites, conferences, and customer visits

 - Plan happy hours, dinners, celebrations, and events in SF and other cities, including New York and Berlin

 - Manage event vendors alongside the Executive Business Partner

Travel & Executive Support

 - Book and coordinate team travel for offsites, events, and in-office visits

 - Support international travelers with logistics such as ESTA and visa invitation letters

 - Back up the Executive Business Partner during PTO and peak periods: calendars, travel, expenses, and ad-hoc needs

Workplace Experience

 - Host guests and shape the in-person experience for visitors, candidates, and customers

 - Run employee experience programs, track team birthdays, and help build culture through team events

 - Help manage the Shopify store and merch




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years in office management, workplace operations, hospitality, or event coordination, ideally at a fast-growing startup

 - Hands-on experience planning multi-day offsites or events for 30+ people

 - Fluency with Google Workspace, Slack, and Notion; comfortable with laptops, docks, and conference room tech

 - Ridiculously organized, with strong follow-through and attention to detail

 - Warm, unflappable, and great with people at every level

 - Comfortable with shifting priorities and making the call when no one else is around to make it

 - Sound judgment with confidential information

 - AI-native in how you work: you use LLMs and automation to take repetitive work off your plate

 - Based in SF and able to be fully onsite five days a week; able to lift up to 25 lbs

Bonus:

 - International travel and group housing logistics

 - Experience with access control or visitor management systems

 - Experience managing an office move or build-out

 - Experience with Shopify




WHY THIS ROLE

You will own how Prime Intellect works in person — the office, the events, the moments that turn a distributed team into one — at a company where the people walking through the door are among the best researchers and engineers in the world. You will work directly with leadership on a small team with no layers between you and the work, and have real room to grow into workplace operations, events, or people operations as the company scales.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - $95,000–$120,000 base salary + equity

 - Fully onsite role at our San Francisco HQ (501 Folsom St, SoMa), with occasional travel for offsites and events

 - Benefits included

 - Professional development budget

 - Team off-sites and conferences

jobs.title: Associate Director, Portfolio Management
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Portfolio and Pipeline Strategy helps Revolution Medicines make clear choices as assets, indications, and investment options grow. The Associate Director of Portfolio Management is a late-stage, molecule-facing role that partners closely with Project Teams and Lifecycle Teams to build strong decision packages for pivotal development, registration, launch, and lifecycle decisions.

For material decisions, the role adds an enterprise portfolio perspective. It frames the broader questions around a molecule or indication, identifies dependencies and alternatives, and translates clinical, commercial, financial, and strategic insight into comparable portfolio inputs. The role works closely with Disease Area Strategy, asset, Commercial, Development, and Finance teams, as well as other relevant functions and governance partners, to support clear, well-informed decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with assigned Project Teams and Lifecycle Teams to frame strategic questions and develop decision packages for pivotal development, registration, launch, indication, and lifecycle choices.

• Partner with teams to develop the fact base for asset decisions—including target product profiles, evidence plans, probability of success, value scenarios, and development options—and translate these inputs into clear portfolio context and implications.

• Integrate inputs from Development, Commercialization, Finance, Data and Analytics, Disease Area Strategy, and other relevant functions into clear decision briefs and recommendations.

• Support teams in developing option sets, decision criteria, and Go/No-Go thresholds.

• Apply asset, disease, and portfolio insight to late-stage and lifecycle choices, including pivotal-trial design, indication strategy, sequencing, and investment.

• For material decisions, collaborate with teams to assess strategic fit, feasibility, capacity and timing dependencies, competing investments, and what an option enables or displaces.

• Contribute molecule and indication insights to portfolio reviews, scenarios, path-to-ambition analyses, and prioritization recommendations.

• Identify when a decision requires broader enterprise perspective and coordinate with portfolio leadership to develop the appropriate analysis.

• Build trusted working relationships with program and functional leaders through rigorous analysis, constructive challenge, and practical support.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• 8 or more years of experience in biotechnology or pharmaceuticals, with experience in drug development, program leadership, portfolio planning, commercialization, strategy, or a closely related field.

• Strong understanding of late-stage development, registration, commercialization, and lifecycle planning, including the decisions that shape pivotal trials, indication strategy, sequencing, and investment choices.

• Demonstrated ability to frame complex strategic questions, develop options, assess trade-offs and portfolio implications, and communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• Experience working across Development, Regulatory, Commercialization, Finance, Data and Analytics, Disease Area Strategy, and other relevant functions to develop a common decision package.

• Strong analytical skills and comfort working with clinical, market, financial, probability-of-success, and portfolio inputs.

• Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and operate effectively in a highly cross-functional, evolving environment.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in oncology drug development and commercialization.

• Experience supporting major investment decisions, indication prioritization, portfolio scenarios, or external opportunity assessment.

• Advanced degree preferred, such as an M.S., MBA, Ph.D., M.D., or comparable degree in life sciences, medicine, business, or a related field.

jobs.title: Partner Engagement and Communications Manager
jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US)
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Director, Partnerships
Compensation: $85,000 - $110,000 annually

CodePath’s Philanthropy Partnerships team raises the philanthropic capital behind the courses, career support, and career outcomes of our students. The Partner Engagement and Communications Manager turns CodePath’s impact into action. You’ll equip the team with compelling stories, visual communications, donor experiences, and campaigns that help funders understand the difference their partnership makes and inspire them to deepen their investment. The role owns a portfolio spanning fundraising collateral and asset management, cultivation and stewardship events, and seasonal fundraising, including end-of-year giving.

This is a highly autonomous building role that combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution. You’ll lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from concept through execution, and build the systems, templates, and AI-enabled workflows that make recurring fundraising communications faster and more consistent. Success requires moving quickly in a fast-paced, evolving organization, translating data and stories into compelling visual communications, and continuously improving how the team plans and executes events and campaigns.

Key Activities

External engagement and events (~60%)

• Own strategy and execution for key cultivation and stewardship events, designing experiences that deepen donor engagement and advance priority fundraising opportunities, including positioning, contact lists, attendance tracking, and logistics

• Lead event content and program development, including speaker points, donor experience, and run of show, working with Philanthropy Partnerships and cross-functional teams to ensure engagement outcomes

• Own donor thought leadership projects such as joint PR, announcements, op-eds, panels, and special events; collaborate with our PR firm, internal marketing team, and the Office of the CEO to execute

• Serve as the on-the-ground lead at key events, representing the Philanthropy Partnerships team in person and overseeing day-of execution (presentation decks, leave-behinds, signage, run of show)

• Partner with other departments, including the Office of the CEO, to lead and streamline preparation for key events (messaging alignment, attendance tracking)

• Capture stories, photography, video, and other event content to repurpose across future cultivation, stewardship, and fundraising communications

• Research and recommend conferences and external engagement opportunities based on their potential to expand CodePath’s network, strengthen relationships, and generate new fundraising opportunities

Fundraising communications and asset development (~30%)

• Build, maintain, and frequently update a shared library of polished, reusable visual and narrative assets, including one-pagers, pitch decks, program description templates, proof-point graphics, and boilerplate visuals

• Identify, develop, and package student stories and impact narratives into fundraising assets that strengthen donor understanding of CodePath’s impact

• Keep the asset library current as programs, outcomes data, and impact metrics evolve, in collaboration with the Grant Writer

• Develop scalable design templates, brand systems, and AI-enabled asset-creation workflows that increase the team’s capacity to produce high-quality communications

• Ensure all assets are on-brand and consistent with CodePath’s visual identity

• Maintain an editorial calendar and refresh cycle so fundraisers have timely, relevant assets for priority opportunities

• Project-manage CodePath’s annual report, including partnering with designers, managing funder outreach and clearance, sourcing student stories, and writing targeted sections. This work runs well above 30% in Q1 2027 and tapers as the report is finalized

End-of-year and online giving (~10%)

• Lead end-of-year giving and other seasonal campaigns end to end, including audience strategy, messaging, digital integration, and project management

• Own campaign performance across landing pages, email, digital assets, and fundraising platforms, using engagement and giving data to optimize

• Monitor website and online donations, and identify opportunities to move digital donors toward deeper engagement and larger gifts

• Develop targeted outreach and campaign messaging that motivates giving and strengthens donors’ connection to CodePath’s mission

• Analyze campaign and donor data to improve future campaigns and convert one-time or smaller online donors into more engaged supporters

Key Success Metrics

At 30 days

• Understands CodePath’s core narrative, program model, impact, and active funder portfolio, and how communications and events support donor engagement

• Has assessed the existing asset library and identified key gaps and priorities

• Knows the upcoming cultivation, stewardship, and fundraising calendar and the major initiatives needing communications or event support

• Is familiar with the annual report process, including scope, timeline, stakeholders, and responsibilities

At 60 days

• Owns a shared editorial and asset-refresh calendar so fundraisers have timely materials for priority opportunities

• Is contributing high-quality assets against live fundraising needs

• Independently owns at least one cultivation or stewardship event from planning through execution, with clear engagement objectives

• Has established reusable templates and workflows for high-volume asset types

• Has built effective working relationships with the Office of the CEO, Marketing, and frontline fundraisers

• Independently manages annual report workstreams against the production timeline

At 90 days

• The shared asset library is current and in active use across the Philanthropy Partnerships team

• Has led at least one cultivation or stewardship event through execution and follow-up, with evidence it met its engagement objectives

• Has launched, or is executing, a seasonal giving campaign with a clear audience strategy, messaging, and coordinated digital experience

• Has implemented at least two repeatable or AI-enabled asset workflows that reduce manual effort or increase team capacity

• Consistently delivers communications and asset requests on agreed timelines

• Uses engagement, event, and campaign data to inform improvements to future work

Qualifications

Required

• Demonstrated commitment to CodePath’s mission, vision, and core values

• 6–10 years of experience in external communications and/or event planning, preferably with institutional and corporate funders or foundations

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to build repeatable workflows or assets that improve efficiency and quality

• Strong visual design skills (layout, typography, color, composition), with fluency in a design tool such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or Figma

• Ability to translate data and narrative into clear, compelling visual storytelling

• Sharp eye for brand consistency, polish, and detail across materials and formats

• Comfortable both setting strategic direction (event positioning, campaign approach) and turning others’ source content into polished execution

• Strong project management skills across concurrent requests and deadlines

• Able to lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from concept through execution with a high degree of autonomy

• Collaborates effectively with writers, fundraisers, and program teams

• Adaptable to fast turnarounds and shifting priorities

• Continuous-improvement mindset: documents and streamlines recurring work to free time for higher-value strategic and creative tasks

Preferred

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Design, or Communications

• Fluency in HubSpot (reporting, customization, outreach, analysis)

• Experience with Asana or other project management platforms

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Manager-level position at an annual salary of $85,000 to $110,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

• Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

• Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

• Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

• Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

• ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

• Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$85,000—$110,000 USD

jobs.title: H&M Department Manager - Golden Triangle Mall
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By bringing everyone together, you’ll be able to create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, helping you, your team, and H&M succeed. Ensuring an excellent operational & visual experience for your store, customers & colleagues. You’ll be aware of your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. Analyze and follow up on sales, and create plans to optimize results and profits.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and acting on them
• Establish & analyze sales and budget goals, creating plans to optimize results
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Manage your department in a cost-efficient way
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
• Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions

Team & Development

• Responsible for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, upskilling & developing your team in-store
• Complete performance evaluations and succession planning to support business & team needs
• Retain and share your knowledge and skills with your team
• Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Responsible for the teams planning & scheduling
• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
• Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding & introduction processes, trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
• Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
• Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
• Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
• Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
• Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

• To be a successful and effective Department Manager, you’ll be a strong leader who enjoys taking responsibility for others.
• You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
• You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $23.56 - $27.09 hourly**

EEOC Code: SLS

Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

Our company is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we actively seek colleagues who share our commitment.

You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.

If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

Coupang is seeking a Staff AI Security Governance Engineer to join our AI GRC (AI Governance, Risk Management, & Compliance) team. This role is designed for a technical governance strategist who bridges the gap between complex AI regulatory requirements and technical security architecture.

In this role, you will define and architect Coupang’s enterprise AI risk framework, translate regulatory mandates into policy-as-code specifications, and establish the technical guardrails for AI development. You will partner with AI/ML engineers, security architects, Legal, and Privacy teams to set standards, while collaborating with our dedicated Control Assurance team to ensure seamless execution and continuous monitoring.

Architect policy-as-code rule sets and security baseline specifications for deployment across AI pipelines.

• Cross-Functional Engineering Alignment: Partner closely with AI platform teams, infrastructure engineers, and security architects to embed governance and security requirements directly into AI architectures, CI/CD workflows, and runtime environments.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the backend and AWS platform that keep these workers running around the clock. The team owns services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability. You will write Python services and infrastructure code that let workers make approved changes and preserve evidence.

About You

Reliable builder: You design for failure and prove that recovery works.

Hands-on engineer: You write production services and improve the tools engineers use every day.

Strong owner: You follow changes through deployment, monitoring and production support.

What you will be doing

• Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications.

• Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge. Handle approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries.

• Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval. Enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials.

• Build model API access for OpenAI, Anthropic and supported AWS paths, including credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls.

• Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces, tokens, findings and verified outcomes. Evaluate ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery.

• Create reliable usage records and reconciliation. Prevent retries, duplicate findings and incomplete work from being counted as new outcomes.

• Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls across development, staging and production.

• Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery. Test failures and verify that sensitive changes actually took effect.

What you will bring to the role

• Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language.

• Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases.

• Strong SQL and data modeling skills. Experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response.

• Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems.

Scope by level

Senior: Own a backend or platform component, including deployment, tests and production operation.

Staff: Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.

Principal: Set shared backend and platform contracts, resolve system tradeoffs and implement foundational services.

Our stack

Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.

OpenAI and Anthropic model integrations are planned. We are also adding an agent harness and dedicated analytics. ClickHouse is a hiring focus for analytics, and BigQuery or equivalent experience is relevant. The harness and analytics choices remain open.

And extra credit for

• ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering.

• Multi-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development.

• Deploying agent frameworks, including Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, Strands Agents, Deep Agents or LangGraph. Prior identity experience is optional.

jobs.title: Risk & Compliance Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description:
We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.

About the Role:

As a Risk & Compliance Specialist, you’ll review cases, gather evidence, take enforcement action, and keep compliance records accurate. You’ll also communicate with Proof’s users and support other teams across the company.

You’ll follow documented procedures to handle standard cases on your own, document your work thoroughly, and escalate unusual or high-stakes situations. Success in this role means resolving risks quickly, producing accurate, well-documented cases, and applying compliance rules consistently, even at high volume.

What You'll Do:

Investigations & Risk

• Review incoming cases, decide which need attention first, and take action based on the type of case and the evidence.

• Gather and document evidence; call, text, or email as needed to gather context and discuss irregularities or recurring patterns.

• Follow documented procedures to handle standard cases independently, and escalate unusual, unclear, or high-stakes situations.

• Keep a closer eye on accounts under review: follow up on open cases and record new findings on a regular cadence.

• Execute compliance actions and assess coverage impact; alert cross-functional stakeholders as needed.

• Handle escalation calls disputing investigation outcomes; communicate resolution actions clearly and professionally.

Signal Detection & Monitoring

• Monitor and action daily alerts and signals indicating anomalies.

• Surface pattern observations within cases and server behavior; escalate larger or recurring trends.

Compliance

• Process identity document submissions for new applicants and document renewals; ensure documentation is complete and meets eligibility requirements.

• Support weekly compliance document maintenance: action expired documents and send compliance outreach communications.

• Support ad hoc internal requests and compliance-related projects.

Server Communications & Enablement

• Handle inbound account update communications and outbound compliance outreach with contractors.

• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of external-facing Help Center articles, ensuring content accurately reflects current processes and requirements.

Data, Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Track personal performance metrics.

• Collaborate cross-functionally within the Marketplace Supply organization; participate in Product meetings and submit feature requests as needed.

• Contribute to team process improvement efforts; surface observations and suggestions that support consistency and scalability.

• Assist with account setup, compliance document collection, and activation processing.

• Provide ad hoc support and contribute to marketplace projects as needed.

What You'll Bring:

• 2-3 years of experience in risk and compliance, trust and safety, operations, or contractor management, preferably within a two-sided marketplace or technology platform.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct structured case reviews, including triage, evidence gathering, clear documentation, and sound enforcement judgment, while following established frameworks and playbooks.

• Familiarity with compliance documentation, credentialing, and eligibility workflows; ability to apply rules consistently across varied cases.

• Comfortable with data and business intelligence tools (SQL proficiency is a plus); experience tracking and owning personal performance metrics.

• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of cases across multiple case types simultaneously while maintaining thoroughness and quality.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting clear, professional user-facing communications and handling server escalation calls; experience with independent contractor communications preferred.

• A collaborative, proactive mindset with a genuine interest in platform integrity, compliance, and operational excellence.

Compensation

• Salary range $53,000 - $55,000 based on experience and location

Benefits

• Full time, remote, salary position

• Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available

• Phone and Internet monthly stipend

• Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays)

• Necessary equipment provided

Team & Development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

Who You Are
