jobs.title: Recruiter - Sales Development
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s sales team is growing, and you’ll be the recruiter who helps build it. You’ll own full-cycle recruiting for entry-level sales roles, partnering directly with ADR directors and managers to bring in the people who will take our products to the customers who need them.

This is a high-volume role with a tough talent pool, so most of your pipeline will come from your own outbound sourcing. You’ll move fast, screen at a steady pace, and send forward only the candidates who clear a high bar. You’ll see the results of your work in the hires you make, and you’ll work with leaders who value your input on who gets hired.

If you love the hunt, build strong relationships, and want a role where your impact shows up in the team’s growth, you’ll thrive here.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Own full-cycle recruiting for entry-level sales roles, from kickoff through offer acceptance

• Build and run proactive outbound pipelines, using LinkedIn Recruiter as your primary sourcing channel

• Partner with ADR directors and managers to align on candidate profiles, interview process, and market realities

• Use funnel data (conversion rates, pass-through, time-to-fill) to spot problems early and adjust your strategy

• Keep a high volume of candidates moving with urgency while delivering an excellent candidate experience

• Calibrate continuously with interview teams to improve decision quality and reduce misalignment

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including hands-on sales recruiting

• Deep experience sourcing, engaging, and converting passive talent

• Proven success in a high-volume environment with multiple concurrent requisitions

• Strong track record of building trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders, and setting expectations clearly

• Comfort using metrics and funnel data to drive recruiting decisions

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong organization and follow-through

• Ability to move quickly and hold a high bar for quality in a fast-changing environment

An ideal candidate also has:

• Agency recruiting experience

• Curiosity about AI and how it can improve sourcing and screening, at work or in your own time

• Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar applicant tracking systems

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$86,275—$116,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Intern- Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch accelerates the development of next-generation aerospace and defense technologies through reusable hypersonic flight testing. Our autonomous, air-launched Talon-A vehicles provide access to operationally realistic flight environments at speeds exceeding Mach 5, delivering critical data that helps customers validate system performance and advance technologies toward deployment. Our team brings together expertise in engineering, manufacturing, and flight operations to solve complex challenges and advance capabilities essential to national security.

Application window closes 11/7/26

Stratolaunch is seeking a detail-orientated and driven Supply Chain Intern to support our operations team. This role offers hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment, with exposure to procurement, aircraft parts logistics, inventory control, and vendor coordination critical to maintaining operational readiness.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Procurement

• Assist with creating and processing purchase requisitions and purchase orders for production materials, components, tooling, and indirect supplies.

• Support buyers in obtaining supplier quotes, confirming lead times, and tracking order status.

• Help maintain accurate purchasing records, pricing information, and supplier documentation within the ERP system.

• Review open purchase orders and help identify potential material shortages, late deliveries, and other supply risks.

• Assist with expediting critical materials to support production schedules and customer commitments.

Shipping and Receiving

• Support receiving activities by verifying incoming materials against purchase orders, packing slips, certifications, and inspection requirements.

• Assist with labeling, documenting, and routing received materials to inspection, stock, production, or quarantine areas.

• Help prepare domestic and international shipments, including packaging, shipping documentation, carrier coordination, and tracking.

• Maintain accurate shipping and receiving records in accordance with company procedures and aerospace quality requirements.

• Assist with investigating shipping discrepancies, damaged goods, incorrect quantities, and missing documentation.

Supplier Management

• Support supplier communication regarding order acknowledgments, delivery schedules, quality documentation, and corrective actions.

• Assist in maintaining supplier performance data, including on-time delivery, quality performance, lead times, and responsiveness.

• Help organize supplier records, certifications, approvals, and compliance documentation.

• Participate in supplier review meetings and assist with follow-up actions as assigned.

• Support efforts to identify alternate suppliers and mitigate supply-chain risks.

Inventory Control

• Assist with cycle counts, physical inventory activities, and reconciliation of inventory variances.

• Help maintain accurate inventory records, location data, and material traceability in the ERP system.

• Monitor inventory levels and support replenishment planning for critical materials and consumables.

• Assist with identifying excess, obsolete, damaged, or slow-moving inventory.

• Support material movement and warehouse organization to improve inventory accuracy and operational efficiency.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Currently pursuing a degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Management, Operations Management, Logistics, or related field.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Strong interest in supply chain operations within aerospace, manufacturing, defense, or other regulated industries.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis tools.

• Familiarity with ERP systems such as Costpoint, SAP, Oracle, or similar is preferred.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

• Ability to work collaboratively with procurement, warehouse, quality, production, engineering, and supplier teams.

• Basic understanding of inventory management, purchasing, logistics, or manufacturing processes is preferred.

• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office Tools: Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

• Eagerness to learn and take initiative.

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

• This position is located in Mojave, CA

• This position may involve work in both an office setting and a warehouse or manufacturing environment. The intern may be required to safely handle, move, and organize materials in accordance with company procedures and applicable safety requirements.

• $20.00 Hourly

• 9/80 Schedule

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

• Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)

• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave

• 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

• Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles.  The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? You’re within a half day’s drive or less of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and San Francisco where you can find a variety of live entertainment, museums, tours, and historical sight-seeing. Theme parks are in abundance, with Six Flags Magic Mountain, Disneyland, and Knotts Berry Farm ready to meet the needs of rollercoaster thrill seekers.

Food and drink fanatics are in a haven of delectable choices. Wine aficionados will also find easy access to some of the state’s best vino in Paso Robles, Santa Ynez, and even more locally in Tehachapi and Agua Dulce. Beer fanatics will find some of the best West Coast IPAs at Bravery and Lucky Luke’s in Lancaster. Any food option you crave is covered, and we always recommend the authentic and fresh Mexican food that you won’t find anywhere else in the United States.

We encourage people from all walks of life to apply, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Our management team does not tolerate discrimination or harassment at any point during our employees’ and applicants’ time with us, especially with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, and general treatment during employment.  For purposes of transparency, U.S. Citizenship may be required for some positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

jobs.title: Pricing Analyst (Remote)
jobs.description:
Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate.

Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco.

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover

We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart

We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Trace3 is building a centralized Pricing Operations function focused on improving deal-level margin performance, enabling smarter pricing decisions, and creating a better seller experience.

This is a hands-on, consultative role. The Pricing Analyst will review deals, analyze pricing and profitability data, and provide recommendations that help sellers build competitive and profitable customer solutions. The role will identify opportunities for margin improvement, evaluate pricing trends, support complex sales opportunities, and help translate business insights into actionable recommendations.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills with business judgment, attention to detail, and a service-oriented mindset. The Pricing Analyst should be viewed by sellers as a trusted advisor who helps improve deal outcomes, increase profitability, and accelerate deal execution.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Pricing Guidance, Deal Support, and Profitability Analysis

• Provide pricing analysis, commercial recommendations, and deal guidance to improve competitiveness and profitability.

• Review business data, historical transactions, pricing exceptions, and deal outcomes to identify margin opportunities and performance trends.

• Support complex or non-standard opportunities by evaluating options and partnering with stakeholders to inform decisions.

• Translate analysis into actionable recommendations, leadership reporting, and business reviews.

• Promote adoption of pricing tools, processes, and best practices across the sales organization.

• Document outcomes and key learnings to improve pricing consistency and effectiveness.

Continuous Improvement and Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with Sales, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Partner Management, and other stakeholders to support pricing initiatives and commercial decision-making.

• Identify opportunities to improve pricing processes, tools, reporting, and seller experience.

• Maintain documentation, standards, and best practices related to pricing operations activities.

• Support testing, validation, and implementation of enhancements to pricing processes and tools.

• Contribute to the ongoing development of a scalable Pricing Operations function.

QUALIFICATIONS & INTERESTS:

• 3-5 years of experience in pricing, deal desk, sales operations, commercial finance, revenue operations, financial analysis, or a related analytical discipline.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze pricing, profitability, discounting, cost structures, margin performance, or commercial transactions.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

• Understanding of gross profit, margins, pricing strategy, discounting practices, rebates, incentives, and overall deal economics.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, modeling, and reporting.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced sales environment.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across multiple business functions.

• Strong problem-solving skills and sound business judgment.

• Consultative mindset with a focus on seller enablement and customer outcomes.

• Ability to thrive in a growing organization where processes and capabilities continue to evolve.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Data Analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience within a technology reseller, value-added reseller (VAR), systems integrator, technology distributor, software company, or related technology sales environment.

• Familiarity with hardware, software, cloud, managed services, and professional services transactions.

• Experience supporting deal review, pricing strategy, quote desk, commercial operations, or sales support organizations.

• Familiarity with CRM platforms, ERP systems, CPQ solutions, pricing tools, or business intelligence platforms.

• Experience evaluating vendor quotes, special pricing agreements, rebates, incentives, promotions, and deal registrations.

• Exposure to pricing models, transaction analysis, profitability analysis, or commercial decision-support tools.

jobs.title: Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

As a Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer, you will own the final mile between embedded code development and physical deployment across our global fleet of connected devices. In this hybrid role, you sit at the intersection of build infrastructure, automated validation, and release governance. You won’t just run test suites or push buttons on a deployment train—you will architect the continuous integration pipelines, design Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) automation fixtures, define gatekeeping qualification criteria, and orchestrate safe, staged over-the-air (OTA) updates.

You will work closely with firmware engineers, hardware validation teams, and cloud backend developers to ensure that every build that lands on a customer’s wall, ceiling, or door controller is stable, secure, and reliable.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You'll Do

• Own the Release Lifecycle: Define, maintain, and optimize the end-to-end release pipeline for embedded Linux and RTOS builds across our devices.

• Build Automated Validation Systems: Design, build, and scale automated Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test harnesses to catch regressions before firmware ever reaches external hardware.

• Set Quality & Gatekeeping Standards: Establish clear go/no-go qualification gates, track test flakiness, and lead triage for release-blocking bugs alongside core firmware developers.

• Orchestrate Safe Deployments: Drive staged fleet rollouts, canary deployments, and automated telemetry monitoring to catch field anomalies early and execute fast rollbacks when needed.

• Drive Developer Productivity: Build tools and CI/CD automation that speed up firmware compile, packaging, and local test cycles.

• Self-motivated problem solver: At Verkada, you will tackle large, complex edge-case bugs spanning silicon, firmware, networking, and cloud services with no clear answers.

• Teach and learn: You will take technical ownership of major validation systems while collaborating with and mentoring peers across software, firmware, and hardware engineering.

What You Bring

• BS or graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 3+ years of experience in software/firmware build infrastructure, embedded test automation, or release engineering.

• Strong programming proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, scripting, and test framework development.

• Working knowledge of C/C++ in embedded Linux or RTOS environments.

• Hands-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, TeamCity) for embedded systems.

• Experience with automated test execution on physical hardware targets (HIL testbeds, serial/UART logging, JTAG/SWD, network power switches).

• Understanding of modern version control workflows (Git branching models, tagging, release trains) and build systems (Yocto/BitBake, CMake, Make, Bazel).

• Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week at our San Mateo HQ.

• Must be willing to travel at least one week a year to our engineering office in Krakow, Poland.

Nice to Have

• Working knowledge of Go.

• Experience with secure boot workflows, cryptographic firmware signing, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation.

• Familiarity with over-the-air (OTA) update frameworks and dual-partition (A/B) fallback mechanisms.

• Experience monitoring fleet health telemetry (DataDog, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK).

• Knowledge of standard embedded communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet) and Wi-Fi/cellular networking.

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

• Expanded mental health support

• Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

• Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

• Professional development stipend

• Wellness/fitness benefits

• Healthy lunches provided daily

• Commuter benefits

Additional Information

• We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

Estimated Annual Pay Range

$125,000—$260,000 USD

jobs.title: Security Systems & Technology Lead
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



The Role

Hadrian's Physical Security team protects the people, factories and export-controlled work behind Hadrian's growth. We are opening new factories and facilities at a rapid pace, and every one of them needs security systems designed, built and commissioned to a single standard, so each new site is a standard package and not a new project.

You will own the technology behind Hadrian's physical security program: access control, video surveillance and the systems around them, from security input on construction drawings through installation, commissioning and day-to-day administration. You'll set the standards, run several site builds and platform migrations at the same time, and hold integrators to the work. You'll partner closely with IT, Facilities, Information Security and the Facility Security Officer, and report to the Director of Physical Security. This is an individual contributor role based on site in Torrance, CA, San Francisco, CA or Mesa, AZ, with travel up to 30% to Hadrian sites.

What You’ll Do

 - Deliver security systems for every new facility on time, from security design input on construction drawings through install and commissioning, working with architects, general contractors and integrators.

 - Write and own the security systems standards by site type, including door hardware and commissioning requirements, and confirm every system works before a site opens.

 - Lead the migration of multiple sites to a single enterprise access control platform, and select and roll out a new video management system across every site.

 - Manage security integrators and systems vendors across several builds at once, holding them to scope, schedule and standard.

 - Administer and integrate access control, video, visitor management and mass notification systems so they are easy to monitor and ready to support investigations.

 - Partner with IT, Information Security, Facilities and the Facility Security Officer on networked devices, door schedules and controlled-area requirements.

What We’re Looking For

 - 7+ years designing, deploying or managing enterprise physical security systems, including access control and video management platforms, whether in house or at a security integrator.

 - Hands-on experience deploying and administering Lenel across an enterprise, multi-site environment.

 - Experience on construction projects, including reading drawings and working with architects, general contractors and integrators.

 - A record of holding integrators and contractors accountable, including rejecting work that does not meet spec.

 - Experience writing system standards, specifications and commissioning procedures that others build to.

 - Working knowledge of networking and comfort partnering with IT and Information Security teams.

What Will Set You Apart

 - Experience leading an access control platform migration across multiple sites.

 - Experience with PSIM platforms or perimeter detection systems.

 - Aerospace, defense or manufacturing site experience, including designing export-controlled areas.

 - PSP certification.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer I (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

SAYARI

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEERING | JOB DESCRIPTION

Forward Deployed Engineer I

About Sayari

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

The Role

Sayari’s customers run risk screening, graph analytics and investigation workflows, and data integrations (APIs and feeds) on the Commercial World Model. Those deployments have to work on day one and keep working. As a Forward Deployed Engineer I, you own that outcome. You scope the problem with the customer, prove it technically, ship it, and keep the account healthy after go-live. The same engineer scopes the work and delivers it.

This is not a ticket queue. You receive direction, not a script. You work across a portfolio of accounts rather than embedding in one, so the role rewards engineers who move fast, document as they go, and leave every deployment in a state another engineer can pick up. Opportunity to contribute to Sayari’s agentic platform.

What You’ll Do

• Scope and prove: run technical scoping and evaluation with customer teams, and confirm Sayari fits the workflow before delivery starts.

• Implement: deploy risk screening, graph analytics and investigation workflows, and data integrations (APIs and feeds). Write production Python and SQL to do it.

• Deliver data: execute bulk data cuts and formatted data products (Parquet, CSV), set up and support API endpoints, and onboard customer pipelines: environment setup, data validation, integration testing.

• Keep deployments healthy: monitor usage and pipeline status, build dashboards that give customers and internal teams clear visibility, and resolve issues before they become churn risk.

• Build the playbook: follow and improve delivery playbooks and SOPs. Document your work clearly enough that another engineer can pick it up without a handoff call.

• Feed the product: bring recurring customer needs and field findings back to core engineering.

What We’re Looking For

Required

• 3 to 5 years in a client-facing technical role (forward deployed engineering, sales engineering, technical delivery, or technical consulting).

• Production Python, including the data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas).

• Deep SQL: writing and optimizing complex queries.

• Hands-on experience integrating, testing, and supporting REST APIs.

• Large-scale data processing with Spark, BigQuery, or Snowflake, and pipeline orchestration with Airflow or similar.

• Working knowledge of AWS or GCP.

• AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude, or similar) as a daily part of how you work.

• Strong written and verbal communication. You explain technical work clearly to engineers, analysts, and senior stakeholders.

• Problem solving in ambiguity, and fast uptake of new technologies and tools.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field.

Desired

• Building with LLM APIs for analytical or automation tasks.

• Containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud deployment patterns.

• BI and dashboarding tools (Looker, Tableau, Metabase).

• Graph data technologies and their query languages.

• Exposure to ML, NLP, or entity resolution.

• Experience in high-stakes domains: AML and financial crime, supply chain risk, or national security.

How You Work

You are self-directed. You do not need someone to define every step. You spot gaps, ask the right questions, flag tradeoffs, and execute. You hold a high bar on output quality because the work you hand off represents Sayari to the customer. You take full accountability for what you deliver.

Logistics

• Travel and in-office time: 25-30% combined.

• Limitless growth and learning opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Solar PV & Battery Energy Storage Systems
jobs.description:
Timmons Group is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Energy team supporting utility-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects.

The successful candidate will serve as a senior technical resource responsible for the electrical engineering and design of utility-scale PV and BESS facilities from conceptual and preliminary design through issued-for-construction (IFC) documents and construction support. This position will focus on electrical system design, engineering calculations, equipment application, technical review, and multidisciplinary design coordination.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with medium-voltage power systems and be capable of independently developing and reviewing complex electrical designs while providing technical guidance to other engineers and designers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Perform and lead the electrical engineering and design of utility-scale PV and BESS projects from conceptual design through IFC and construction support.
• Develop and review electrical one-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, equipment layouts, grounding plans, cable schedules, details, specifications, and construction documents.
• Design PV electrical systems including:DC collection systemsModule stringing and DC conductor sizingInverter systemsInverter loading and DC/AC configurationLow-voltage AC systemsMedium-voltage collection systemsGrounding and bondingAuxiliary power systemsElectrical balance-of-system equipment
• Design BESS electrical systems including:Battery and power conversion system (PCS) interfacesPCS and inverter configurationsMedium-voltage transformersSwitchgear and switchboardsMedium-voltage collection systemsStation and auxiliary powerGrounding and bondingElectrical balance-of-system equipment
• Develop underground and overhead medium-voltage collection systems, including system configuration, routing, conductor and cable sizing, equipment locations, pole layouts, risers, and overhead-to-underground transitions.
• Perform and review electrical engineering calculations, including:Cable and conductor sizingCable ampacity and thermal analysisVoltage dropLoad flowShort-circuit calculationsGrounding calculations and studiesEquipment ratings and applicationTransformer sizingAuxiliary load calculationsAC and DC system losses
• Develop electrical equipment requirements and technical specifications for inverters, PCS equipment, transformers, switchgear, reclosers, breakers, disconnects, cables, conductors, and other major electrical equipment.
• Review manufacturer drawings, equipment data sheets, technical submittals, and vendor documentation for compliance with project requirements.
• Evaluate equipment configurations and electrical design alternatives and provide recommendations based on system performance, constructability, reliability, and cost.
• Coordinate electrical interfaces with project substations, gen-tie systems, utility interconnections, protection and controls, SCADA/communications systems, and other project infrastructure.
• Coordinate electrical designs with civil, structural, geotechnical, substation, transmission, and other engineering disciplines.
• Apply applicable electrical codes, standards, utility requirements, and project-specific technical requirements to the design.
• Perform senior-level technical reviews of electrical calculations, drawings, specifications, equipment schedules, studies, and other engineering deliverables.
• Participate in design reviews and ensure electrical designs are complete, coordinated, constructable, and technically sound.
• Identify and resolve complex electrical design issues during engineering and construction.
• Respond to RFIs, review electrical submittals, and provide technical support during project construction and commissioning.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to electrical engineers and designers.
• Assist with the development and continuous improvement of electrical design standards, calculation templates, design tools, details, specifications, and QA/QC procedures.

Skills/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from an accredited engineering program.
• Minimum of 7 years of electrical engineering experience, with progressively increasing technical responsibility.
• Demonstrated electrical engineering experience with utility-scale solar PV, BESS, power generation, substations, industrial power systems, or other medium- and high-voltage power systems.
• Strong working knowledge of medium-voltage power distribution and collection systems.
• Experience developing and reviewing electrical calculations, one-line diagrams, equipment layouts, collection systems, grounding systems, cable schedules, wiring diagrams, specifications, and construction documents.
• Working knowledge of electrical equipment including transformers, switchgear, breakers, reclosers, disconnect switches, inverters, PCS equipment, cables, conductors, and grounding systems.
• Strong understanding of electrical engineering principles and applicable industry codes and standards.
• Ability to independently develop technical solutions and exercise sound engineering judgment.
• Ability to review the work of engineers and designers and provide clear technical direction.
• Strong technical communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with other engineering disciplines, equipment vendors, contractors, and clients.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.
• Direct electrical engineering experience with utility-scale solar PV and/or BESS projects.
• Experience designing projects from conceptual engineering through IFC design and construction support.
• Experience with 34.5 kV or similar medium-voltage collector systems.
• Experience with both underground and overhead medium-voltage collection systems.
• Detailed knowledge of PV inverters, BESS PCS equipment, battery systems, medium-voltage transformers, switchgear, reclosers, and associated electrical balance-of-system equipment.
• Experience performing or reviewing:Load flow studiesShort-circuit studiesCable ampacity studiesGrounding studiesVoltage-drop calculationsEquipment-duty evaluations
• Experience with industry-standard electrical analysis tools such as ETAP, CYMCAP, or equivalent power-system modeling software.
• Experience applying the National Electrical Code (NEC), National Electrical Safety Code (NESC), IEEE standards, and applicable utility requirements to renewable-energy projects.
• Experience coordinating electrical designs with substation, utility interconnection, protection and controls, SCADA, civil, structural, and transmission engineering disciplines.
• Experience providing technical mentorship and reviewing the work of junior electrical engineers and designers.

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, patient, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace. Candidates must share a commitment to our company’s Vision, Mission and Shared Values.

Timmons Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.

jobs.description:
About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health, offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter. Learn more at calm.com.

What We Do

We build Calm’s product, guide Calm’s analysis, secure Calm’s data, and operate the platforms that underpin it all. We’re product-minded, team-oriented, and grounded in the mission of meeting everyone where they’re at on their mental health journey. We work in fast-moving, small pods, and as an SDET you’ll make sure what we ship is reliable, well-tested, and ready for the millions of people who rely on Calm.

Millions of people rely on Calm every day, and you’ll help make sure every release earns their trust. As an SDET, you’ll build the automation and pipeline checks that catch issues early, lead our QA efforts, and partner with engineering, product, and design to ship the Calm app and our internal tools with confidence.

Specifically, you will:

• Set the testing strategy and quality bar for the Calm app and our internal content and admin tools

• Architect and build automated test frameworks and suites (UI, API, mobile, and integration) that run reliably in our CI/CD pipelines

• Review requirements, specs, and pull requests early so issues are caught in-sprint rather than at the end

• Work with all of our consumer product teams on release planning and certification, and monitor release health after launch

• Partner with product and design (roughly 30% of your time) to define acceptance criteria and keep release timelines on track

• Manage and direct our offshore QA team, shifting their work toward automation and higher-value testing over time

• Triage and document defects with clear, actionable detail, and drive them to resolution

• Contribute to feature development in Android, iOS, backend, or web as the role grows

• Hands-on experience building test automation frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines

• Experience testing mobile apps (iOS and/or Android)

• Experience leading QA efforts and owning release readiness, ideally with distributed or offshore teams

• Comfortable using AI-assisted tools in your testing and development workflow

Nice to Haves

• Experience with a consumer subscription or mobile app at scale

• Hands-on development experience in a mobile, backend, or web codebase

jobs.title: Director of Content
jobs.description:
Fairmarkit is the #1 autonomous sourcing platform revolutionizing the way all organizations buy & sell. Fairmarkit equips procurement teams with automation, AI, and GenAI so they can source more competitively at scale. Our solutions for tail spend and strategic sourcing help innovative procurement teams reduce cycle times, drive out costs, meet ESG/Diversity targets, and provide a better stakeholder experience to internal partners and suppliers. Fairmarkit has been recognized with awards by organizations such as Gartner and IDC, and is backed by strategic investors like Notable Capital, Insight Partners, 1984.VC, and Newfund.

About the Role

Fairmarkit is looking for a Director of Content Marketing to help shape how we show up in the market and build a content engine that makes us impossible to ignore.

At the heart of this role is great storytelling. We’re looking for an exceptional writer and editor who knows how to find a strong idea, sharpen it, and turn it into something people actually want to read, share, and talk about. But creating great content is only part of the job.

You’ll think just as much about how an idea travels. Across LinkedIn, search, AI answer engines, customer stories, executive voices, video, research, and whatever channel emerges next. You’ll help establish Fairmarkit and our leaders as trusted voices in procurement while finding new ways to reach the people we care about.

You’ll also help us rethink how content gets made. AI is changing the way people discover information and the way marketing teams work. We want someone who’s excited to experiment with that shift, build smarter workflows, and figure out where AI creates leverage and where human judgment still matters most.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll write. You’ll edit. You’ll experiment. You’ll build. And you’ll work closely with Brand & Design, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, our executives, customers, and outside partners to bring great ideas to life.

What You’ll Own

Content & Thought Leadership

• Own Fairmarkit’s content strategy across all mediums (video + written), editorial direction, and the way our brand narrative comes to life in the market.

• Write and edit exceptional content, while helping executives and subject matter experts turn their expertise into ideas and stories people care about.

• Put customers, original research, data, executive perspectives, and strong points of view at the center of our content strategy.

• Create repeatable content programs that build an audience, not just fill an editorial calendar.

• Partner closely with Brand & Design to bring ideas to life across written, visual, video, and other formats.

Social & Executive Presence

• Own our organic social strategy, with LinkedIn playing a major role in how we engage the procurement community.

• Help Fairmarkit’s executives and employees become authentic, active voices in the market, extending our reach well beyond the company account.

• Build the playbooks, training, tools, and habits that make it easier for people across Fairmarkit to participate.

• Know what makes social content work. You’ll write, test, engage, learn, and continually refine our approach based on what resonates with the audience.

SEO, AEO & Distribution

• Own how Fairmarkit gets discovered across traditional search and the growing world of AI-powered discovery.

• Develop our approach to SEO and AEO/GEO across Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Reddit, YouTube, and whatever comes next.

• Stay curious about how buyer behavior is changing and what that means for the way we create, structure, and distribute content.

• Be hands-on enough to do the work yourself and experienced enough to effectively lead agencies and specialized partners when we need to scale.

AI-Powered Content Operations

• Find practical ways to use AI across research, creation, editing, repurposing, distribution, optimization, and measurement.

• Build workflows yourself where it makes sense, and know how to define the problem and requirements when more technical support is needed.

• Experiment constantly, keeping what genuinely makes the work better and ignoring what doesn’t.

• Use AI to give the team more leverage without sacrificing originality, quality, or the human judgment behind great content.

We’re not looking for someone who’s simply good at prompting ChatGPT. We’re looking for someone who’s curious about how AI can fundamentally change the way a modern content team works.

Measurement & Impact

Great content should ultimately create business impact. You’ll help us understand that journey from the earliest signals all the way through pipeline and revenue.

You’ll define what we should measure, establish the right leading indicators, and help us understand whether we’re gaining attention and authority with the audiences that matter.

That could include share of voice, procurement audience engagement, executive reach, organic and AI visibility, branded search, qualified traffic, target-account engagement, content influence, and pipeline.

Most importantly, you’ll use what we learn to make the work better.

What We’re Looking For

• 7+ years across content marketing, editorial, social, organic growth, or related disciplines, ideally within high-growth B2B SaaS.

• You’re an exceptional writer and editor. You know what good content sounds like and have a portfolio that proves it.

• You’re a builder. You’re comfortable starting with a blank page, figuring things out, and creating programs and systems that didn’t exist before.

• You understand B2B social and LinkedIn deeply, ideally with experience helping executives or employees build their own presence.

• You know SEO and are actively thinking about how AEO/GEO changes the organic discovery landscape.

• You’ve done more with AI than generate copy. You’ve built or implemented workflows that made marketing meaningfully better, faster, or more effective, and you can tell us exactly what you built and why.

• You’re comfortable with data and can connect creative work to audience growth, engagement, pipeline, and business outcomes.

• You know how to work with executives and across teams without needing a big organization underneath you to get things done.

• Experience with enterprise audiences, procurement, finance, supply chain, or AI is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

A year from now, Fairmarkit should have a stronger, more recognizable voice in the procurement market and a content engine built around ideas people actually care about.

Our customers, data, and executives should be generating stories and perspectives that travel. Our leaders should have stronger voices on social. We should be easier to discover through both traditional search and AI. And behind the scenes, AI-enabled workflows should help us produce and distribute better work with significantly more leverage.

We’ll also have a much clearer understanding of what’s working, why it’s working, and how those early signals eventually translate into pipeline and revenue.

Ultimately, success is pretty simple: we want Fairmarkit to become a company the procurement market reads, follows, references, searches for, and talks about.

Compensation / Location

For this role you need to reside in one of the following states: California (CA), Colorado (CO), Florida (FL), Georgia (GA), Illinois (IL), Indiana (IN), Maryland (MD), Massachusetts (MA), Montana (MT), New Hampshire (NH), New Jersey (NJ), New York (NY), North Carolina (NC), Ohio (OH), Pennsylvania (PA), Rhode Island (RI), Texas (TX), Tennessee (TN), or Washington (WA).

The annual compensation for this role is $162,000–$225,000 (including a bonus), depending on experience and location, plus equity and benefits. This range is provided in accordance with applicable U.S. pay transparency laws. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location. #LI-remote #LI-YM1

Headquartered in Boston, and backed by a $35.6M Series C co-led by OMERS, Highland, Notable Capital, Insight Partners, and ServiceNow. We are looking for exceptional candidates who want to help grow our company into a global enterprise and make their mark on the B2B tech industry. Come soar to new heights with us!

Fairmarkit is an equal opportunity employer, and selects individuals best matched for the job based upon job-related qualifications regardless of race, religion, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, age, ancestry, national origin, gender identity, genetic information, disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status or any other status or characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
Coordinator, Strategic Initiatives

Who we are

Campus Compact is a national coalition of colleges and universities committed to the public purposes of higher education. As the largest national higher education association dedicated solely to higher education civic and community engagement, Campus Compact enables higher education institutions to develop students’ citizenship skills and forge effective community partnerships. Our resources support senior administrators, faculty, staff, and students as they pursue community-based teaching, scholarship, and action in the service of positive change.

Today, we stand at a defining moment: we are ready to scale our impact when the stakes for our work have never been higher. We know that higher education has a critical role to play in fostering democratic principles and culture by addressing polarization, strengthening civic participation, and ensuring students are prepared to navigate and shape our democracy. Thanks to the investment of philanthropic partners, Campus Compact is preparing for a period of significant growth and expansion, particularly in the areas of innovation, scaling, and coalition building.

About the role

The Coordinator, Strategic Initiatives (Coordinator) supports the design, coordination, and implementation of cross-cutting projects that advance Campus Compact’s mission and strategic priorities. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Initiatives, the Coordinator plays a critical executional role—providing project coordination (scheduling, stakeholder alignment meetings, budget support), communication, and logistical support across a dynamic portfolio of initiatives.

This role is well-suited for an early-career professional who is highly organized, eager to learn, and motivated by Campus Compact’s commitment to civic and community engagement, equity, and institutional impact. The Coordinator contributes to multiple initiatives simultaneously and works closely with colleagues across the organization and with external partners and stakeholders.

This is a one-year, grant-funded position, with possible renewal depending on funding.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Us:

Here at Ambience, we never set out to be just another scribe. We’re building the AI intelligence platform that restores humanity to healthcare and drives meaningful ROI for health systems across the country.

Our technology helps providers focus on delivering great care by removing the administrative burden that pulls them away from patients and away from their most impactful work. Ambience delivers real-time coding-aware documentation and clinical workflow support across ambulatory, emergency and inpatient settings at the top health systems in North America.

Our teams operate relentlessly with extreme ownership to build the best solutions for our health system partners. We value candor, positivity and deep thought — and we expect a lot from each other because we know the problems we’re solving truly matter.

Ambience was ranked #1 for Improving the Clinician Experience in the KLAS Research Emerging Solutions Top 20 Report, recognized by Fast Company as one of the Next Big Things in Tech, named one of the best AI companies in healthcare by Inc., and selected as a LinkedIn Top Startup in 2024 and 2025. We’re backed by Oak HC/FT, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), OpenAI Startup Fund, and Kleiner Perkins — and we’re just getting started.

The Role:

The mission of an Account Manager (Care Transformation) is to build strong, long-term partnerships that drive meaningful positive change for providers, patients, and administrators across the healthcare landscape. You'll own your accounts from enterprise signature forward — retain, expand, renew — including the commercial outcomes that come with them. Working closely with leaders across health systems, you'll deepen adoption of Ambience from initial enterprise rollout into new care settings and new products. Your goal is to ensure Ambience delivers measurable clinical and financial outcomes as we grow our partnerships. As a trusted advisor, you'll align executive priorities with frontline needs to ensure Ambience enables better care at scale.



What You'll Do:

 - Own the commercial trajectory of every assigned account. You'll protect and grow revenue through renewals and expansions, build renewal readiness well ahead of contract expiration, qualify expansion opportunities as they emerge, and run the commercial boundary with Sales cleanly.

 - Take the handoff and run. You'll accept ownership of accounts at enterprise signature — stakeholder map, relationship history, deal context — and drive adoption, utilization, and executive engagement across the deployed footprint from day one.

 - Build high-trust partnerships with clinical, operational, financial, and IT leaders across your accounts. You'll be the face of Ambience to our health system customers, earning the confidence of stakeholders from the C-suite to the front line and turning alignment into momentum.

 - Open new ground inside your accounts. You'll generate demand for new products and care settings — building clinical champions, running new-SKU pilots, and producing the proof points that convert into expansion.

 - Shape and deliver clear ROI narratives that speak to what health systems care about. You'll align stakeholders on value methodology early, own QBRs and executive readouts, and build the economic evidence behind every expansion and renewal.

 - Set the account strategy and keep an honest view of account health. For each account you'll put the strategy on paper — customer context, partnership assessment, path forward, quarterly goals — and maintain a scorecard that rates partnership strength on evidence, not sentiment.

 - Make us better, together. You'll capture repeatable playbooks and account frameworks to help the entire Care Transformation team level up.



Who You Are:

 - 8+ years of experience in strategic account management, healthcare transformation, health tech implementation, or healthcare management consulting. You've worked closely with provider organizations and know how to navigate complex health systems.

 - You have owned commercial outcomes directly — renewals, expansions, pricing and packaging decisions, and contract negotiation. You've been in the negotiation, not next to it.

 - Proven track record of managing and expanding enterprise partnerships — you've led post-sale motions, grown deployed footprints into enterprise-wide relationships, and built champions across clinical, operational, and executive teams.

 - Exceptional communicator with the ability to switch fluently between clinical, operational, and financial language. You know how to meet stakeholders where they are and communicate with clarity and credibility across functions.

 - Comfortable operating independently in high-ambiguity environments. You bring structure where none exists, anticipate roadblocks, and take ownership without waiting for instructions.

 - Deeply mission aligned — you care about fixing what's broken in healthcare and are motivated by working with a team that shares that urgency.

This role requires up to 30% travel. Travel will include onsite support during key customer events, stakeholder meetings, and QBRs across the U.S. All travel expenses are covered in accordance with Ambience's travel policy.

Life at Ambience 

Working at Ambience means opting into a high-ownership, high-trust environment built for people who want to grow fast, operate decisively and focus on work that matters. This could be the right place for you if you want to

 - Work on mission-critical AI technology that directly improves clinicians’ day-to-day lives and health system financial health across some of the most complex, high-stakes workflows in the world.

 - Join a “dream team” culture where we hire exceptional people, expect exceptional outcomes and invest deeply in feedback and continuous growth. We operate as a championship team, and that means being ok with hard, uncomfortable, ambiguous problems that lead to real greatness.

 - Operate with real ownership and accountability in an environment where there are no bystanders: If something is broken, we fix it! You will have meaningful autonomy and be expected to drive work to completion.

To help you do your best work, we pair these expectations with benefits intentionally designed to help you feel supported and safe at Ambience and beyond. Some of our key benefits include

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) with a company match of up to 3% of base salary

 - A remote-friendly culture (with a San Francisco HQ) and full equipment provisioning to ensure you can work effectively from wherever you’re based.

 - Parental leave to support your family needs

 - Annual company-wide off-sites, team off-sites and regular team lunches and all-hands gatherings, with travel, lodging and meals covered

 - Flexible time off with no annual cap, company-wide holidays and an annual holiday shutdown from December 24–January 1 designed to support real rest and long-term sustainability.



Ambience Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Ambience is committed to supporting every candidate’s ability to fully participate in our hiring process. If you need any accommodations during your application or interviews, please reach out to our Recruiting team at accommodations@ambiencehealthcare.com recruiting@ambiencehealth.com. We’ll handle your request confidentially and work with you to ensure an accessible and equitable experience for all candidates.


Ambience Healthcare has become aware of scams targeting jobseekers with fake jobs and even interviewing people. Our emails will always come from @ambiencehealthcare.com. We would never our ask candidates to download apps or make any form of payment(s). If you are contacted through WhatsApp, Telegram, similar but fake email domains, or asked to make a payment, these contacts are not legitimate. Report the issue immediately to LinkedIn and the FBI https://www.fbi.gov/how-we-can-help-you/scams-and-safety.
