jobs.title: Manager – AI & Data Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Manager – AI & Data Platform Engineering within the Enterprise Data & AI Platform Engineering department, based on a Hybrid (3 days in office) basis in Santa Clara, CA, and reporting directly to the Senior Manager – Data Strategy, to lead the evolution of our enterprise data platform into an AI-ready data and knowledge platform. Sitting at the intersection of Data Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Knowledge Engineering, and Generative AI, you will combine a deep foundation in modern data engineering and cloud platforms with practical experience building RAG systems, knowledge graphs, AI/LLM data pipelines, and production-grade AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning architecture, engineering execution, people leadership, and platform strategy.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

• Lead a team of data and AI engineers across the US and India, owning performance, career development and day-to-day execution across both full-time staff and contractors

• Own the Data Platform (Snowflake, dbt, Matillion) and the in-house pipelines that build the enterprise's knowledge and AI foundations, turning structured and unstructured data into trusted, AI-ready assets such as knowledge graphs and vector stores, accountable for quality, reliability and delivery

• Turn platform strategy and architecture direction into roadmaps, quarterly plans and delivered outcomes, partnering with architects and engineering leadership and shifting focus across data, knowledge and AI work as priorities change

• Run the platform as a product for internal customers such as domain delivery teams, BI, context and semantic teams and AI engineering, defining service levels, onboarding paths and paved roads that make self-service and AI-native development fast and safe

• Build agentic operations that automate the team's operational work, such as pipeline monitoring, failure triage, data quality checks and remediation, and establish a reusable framework and standards that other teams can adopt for their own operations

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You are comfortable diving deep into architectural discussions, removing roadblocks for team members, and evaluating effort estimates effectively, all while empowering your senior and principal engineers to lead system design.

• You possess a comprehensive understanding of the complete engineering lifecycle from enterprise data ingestion and transformation to knowledge retrieval, context engineering, and production agent deployment.

• You are equally adept at driving architectural strategy and engaging in technical implementation details, making pragmatic decisions to eliminate technical debt.

• You are an inspiring people leader committed to hiring, mentoring, and advancing engineering team members while cultivating a culture of ownership and engineering excellence.

• Versatile across data platforms, knowledge engineering and agentic operations, you’re equally at home in any of the three. You lead a globally distributed team with an owner’s mindset and a bias for action, and you thrive in a fast-moving AI landscape.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

• Practical understanding of Generative AI architectures, particularly RAG and enterprise knowledge systems, with experience designing pipelines for structured and unstructured data

• 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data platform engineering, or data architecture

• 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams with demonstrated technical and people leadership

• Strong hands-on expertise in Python and SQL, with a solid foundation in modern data engineering and distributed systems

• Experience designing and operating production-grade data platforms on AWS (or another major cloud platform) using modern tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery, along with dbt

• Strong grounding in data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, and observability, with a proven ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable engineering solutions

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Production experience building RAG or GraphRAG platforms, Knowledge Graphs, and graph databases (ArangoDB, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), vector databases, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, and re-ranking

• Hands-on experience building infrastructure for AI agents and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex, alongside LLM evaluation, AI observability, and LLMOps

• Deep cloud-native platform engineering expertise across Kubernetes, Terraform, and Ray/Ray Data, with a track record of building internal developer platforms and reusable data and AI platform services

Job Title: NCCER Advanced Rigger
Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department:  Loenbro West
Location: Kemmerer, WY
Reports to: Superintendent / Project Manager
Employment Type: Full Time
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary
Loenbro is seeking an experienced Lead Rigger to support a project in Kemmerer, WY. The Lead Rigger provides daily on-site supervision as the designated person in charge for lifting/rigging activities while working as a productive member of the crew.

The successful candidate will have a solid background in rigging, erecting, modifying structural steel in an industrial construction setting. Your leadership skills and your experience have earned you the ability to direct the work of others and make quick decisions. You must be well-organized and favor safety above everything else.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Coordinates and supervises daily activities of crew while working as a productive member of that crew.

• Visually inspect and test rigging materials to ensure safety and reliability.

• Select appropriate gear such as cables, pulleys, vices, winches, etc. according to load weights and sizes, work area, and job specifications.

• Ensure all lifts comply with client requirements and project-specific lift plans.

• Maintain satisfactory standards of employee conduct, integrity, and competence.

• leading or participating in daily JHAs / toolbox talks and exercising stop-work authority.

• Be aware of obstacles, surrounding structures, barriers or objects and the location of other people.

• Signal or verbally communicate with workers and others engaged in hoisting, suspending, and moving loads to ensure the safety of workers and materials.

• Dismantle, inspect, clean, organize and store rigging equipment after use.

• Supervise and train workers.

• Guarantee all safety precautions and quality standards are followed.

• Support five-day ten hour work schedule.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• NCCER Advanced Rigger certification (or certification equivalent to NCCCO Advanced Rigger with proof of practical and written test) mandatory.

• 3+ years’ experience industrial or heavy-lift rigging experience.

• Able to manage team members and multiple projects.

• Knowledge of reading and interpreting sketches, blueprints, and detailed drawings

• Coordinate tasks according to priorities and plans.

• Ensure labor and resources are adequate.

• Must pass a background check and do a drug screening.

Preferred:

• Capable of performing physically demanding tasks during long shifts.

• Skilled in math which includes adding and subtracting fractions.

• Fall Protection Competent Person, MEWP, First Aid/CPR certifications.

• Previous Lead or Foreman experience on industrial projects.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Compliance with all client, and Loenbro ES&H requirements is mandatory.

Work Environment:

• Potential exposure to extreme cold and hot temperatures.

• Fit and move in confined spaces including tanks and vessels.

• Limited working surfaces.

• Exposure to areas with limited visibility.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay.

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities. If you are ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

…we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director, AI Learning Experience & Innovation
jobs.description:
What We Do

At Leading Educators (LE), we know that excellent teaching is the most important driver of student success. The moment a student steps foot in the classroom, their opportunity to learn depends on how prepared their teacher is to translate complex content knowledge, standards, and their knowledge of that student into lessons that help them learn deeply and apply their thinking to the real world.

That’s a big lift, and it often happens alone. As a national nonprofit, we partner with school systems to overcome persistent instructional challenges, foster intentional collaboration and adult learning by design, and ignite new possibilities through systemic solutions at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology.

We work shoulder-to-shoulder with educators at every level of the education system to strengthen their instructional and leadership practices, bring a vision for excellent instruction to life with consistency, and ensure every student reaches their full potential.

Through direct support, strategic advising, innovation pilots, and best-in-class research, we help educators work toward a future where every student is ready to thrive. Learn more about our work at leadingeducators.org.

Internal Candidate Application Deadline: October 30, 2026

External Candidate Application Deadline: October 30, 2026

Position

Leading Educators is seeking a Director, AI Learning Experience & Innovation to lead the design and delivery of AI Accelerators—cohort-based learning experiences that empower organizational leaders to identify real-world challenges, develop AI-enabled solutions, and refine those solutions through rigorous user feedback. In this role, you'll architect the full learning journey for each cohort, from designing engaging, practical learning opportunities to orchestrating a cross-functional team of coaches and technical mentors. You'll translate strategic priorities into thoughtfully executed learning experiences that respond to the unique needs of different partners and participants, operating with the credibility and composure of an experienced consultant managing high-stakes client relationships.

This is a role for a builder—someone with direct, hands-on experience creating with AI tools, grounded in adult learning design, who is energized by building something new rather than following an established playbook. You'll contribute to the continued evolution of the Accelerators model by adapting learning experiences to meet partner needs, drawing on participant feedback and implementation insights to inform improvements, develop useful resources, and make thoughtful design and delivery decisions. Because Accelerators regularly puts LE in front of senior leaders—superintendents, nonprofit CEOs, and other senior decision-makers—this role carries external-facing weight, requiring you to operate with the credibility and composure that comes from experience managing high-stakes client relationships.

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with participating teams, organizational leaders, and executive sponsors across education and social-impact organizations, building trusted relationships while adapting your engagement strategies to different stakeholder roles and organizational contexts. Reporting to the Senior Director of Innovation, New Learning Models, you'll own end-to-end session design, direct the delivery team, resolve ambiguity independently, and exercise sound judgment within established goals and priorities—collaborating with leadership when decisions may affect scope, resources, or partner commitment.

Do you have expertise in…

• Designing and facilitating cohort-based learning experiences or similarly structured group learning environments for adult professionals?

• Building with AI tools hands-on—not just understanding them, but actually creating something tangible with them and articulating that process to others?

• Managing the operational execution of programs or initiatives, including coordinating teams of contributors (coaches, facilitators, contractors) toward shared delivery outcomes?

• Translating ambiguous or still-forming strategy into concrete, well-sequenced learning experiences and delivery plans that adapt as new information emerges?

Do you enjoy…

• Working in environments where the outcome isn't yet defined and pivoting quickly when direction changes without losing momentum or quality?

• Building trusting relationships across diverse stakeholders—from senior leaders to peers to cross-functional collaborators—and reading what isn't being said in the room?

• Using participant feedback and evidence to test, refine, and improve programs, then documenting effective approaches for future implementation?

• Reflecting on your own ways of working and adapting your personal habits and style to fit new or unfamiliar situations?

If you've answered affirmatively to these questions and meet the following prerequisites, we urge you to seize this opportunity. This role calls for the following:

• 8+ years of professional experience in learning design, adult education, instructional design, or an equivalent field, with demonstrated ownership of both the design and delivery of a program

• Direct, hands-on experience building with AI tools—demonstrated evidence of having actually created something with them—and the ability to speak credibly to that process of building with others

• Experience designing and facilitating learning for cohorts of adults, such as cohort-based programs, learning communities, or similarly structured group learning environments

• Ability to translate an ambiguous or still-forming strategy into a concrete, well-sequenced learning experience and delivery plan, adjusting scope and pacing as new information emerges

• Demonstrated success managing the operational execution of a program or initiative, including coordinating a team of contributors toward a shared delivery outcome

• Established credibility working with senior leaders through a consultancy, design lab, ed-tech company, or similar organization serving education or social-impact leaders (direct K-12 school district experience is not required)

• Comfort with ambiguity and a track record of moving work forward without a complete plan; a willingness to create from scratch and "build to think"

• Demonstrated ability to pivot quickly when direction changes—including late in a project—without losing momentum or quality of delivery

• A reflective, self-aware approach to your own ways of working, with the ability to adapt personal habits and style to fit new or unfamiliar situations

Travel Requirements

• Ability to travel nationally for organizational retreats, programming, donor meetings, and professional development

• Must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States

• Outside of the above mentioned travel, this person will work from a home office that must be located anywhere within the U.S.

Questions? We’re here to help.

If you have questions about this role or about our hiring process at any point, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at talent@leadingeducators.org. This inbox is monitored regularly, and we aim to respond within two business days. To ensure your question receives a thoughtful and timely response, we kindly ask that you refrain from emailing individual staff members or members of our HR team directly. The best way to connect with us is always through talent@leadingeducators.org.

Why Work at Leading Educators?

Imagine being part of an organization where your ideas and perspectives are highly valued. At Leading Educators, we believe in fostering individual strengths, encouraging personal growth, and embracing innovative ideas. If you thrive in a remote working environment, with the added excitement of travel, we're the perfect fit for you. By joining us, you become part of a powerful community of peers nationwide. Regardless of your location, you possess the power to make a significant impact on both students and teachers who rely on us daily. Join Leading Educators and become an integral part of driving progress in education.

Learn About Our Mission & Values:

Mission: Leading Educators partners with school systems to sustain the teaching, leadership, and conditions for every student to succeed in school and in life.

Values:

• Build on strengths: We affirm and begin with the unique and collective talents, experiences, and wisdom of ourselves and others.

• Continuously learn: We develop ourselves and others. We apply new learning and deepened self-awareness to our relationships and practices.

• Prioritize people: We build trust and reflect on the impact of different perspectives and experiences.

• Champion success for all: We re-imagine structures, habits, and mindsets to ensure every learner has access to evidence-based learning opportunities.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

• We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools throughout our hiring process, from the moment a candidate applies through the offer stage, to support administrative tasks and the initial review of candidate materials. These tools help us organize, analyze, and surface relevant information efficiently, but they do not make hiring decisions.

• All candidate materials—including applications, resumes, assessments, and interview feedback—are reviewed and evaluated by people. All hiring decisions, including interview selection, advancement, and offers of employment, are made by humans.

• We use AI solely as a support tool to assist with early-stage reviews and process efficiency. We do not use AI in ways that discriminate based on protected characteristics, nor do we use ZIP codes or similar data to target or exclude protected groups. Our hiring practices are designed to be fair, consistent, and aligned with equal employment opportunity standards.

Benefits

• Compensation: If hired for this position, the base compensation range is $113,714 to $144,157 annually. New hires typically enter the range at a set comp ratio (e.g., 0.95 or 0.98), depending on the role. For this position, the salary entry point is $125,354. Candidates may move up the range based on additional years of relevant experience beyond the role’s minimum years of experience qualification. If you have more than 8 years of directly relevant experience, your starting salary may be adjusted higher within the range, up to a maximum starting salary of $133,413. This approach ensures that candidates with additional experience beyond the minimum are recognized in the initial salary offer.

• Benefits: 100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for individual employees. Additional premium costs are covered 60% by Leading Educators for partners and dependents on medical, dental, and vision plans. 4% matching 401k plan, Flexible Spending Accounts for medical, childcare and commuter expenses, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Benefits are valued at or above $9,000 for employees.

• Time Off: First three years of employment, full-time staff accrue 22 days a year. Five additional days are accrued after the third and sixth year of employment. Leading Educators also offer 16 additional paid days off for various holidays, including three floating holidays staff may use at their discretion.

Equal Opportunity Employment

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Software Architect Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

We are hiring two hands-on architects. One will lead agent execution, harnesses and evaluations. The other will lead backend services, integrations, data and platform reliability. You will write critical code, resolve cross-team decisions and work with engineers through production rollout.

About You

Hands-on builder: You still write production code and test important decisions through implementation.

Practical architect: You choose a small, clear design and make it easy to extend when the product grows.

Trusted partner: You earn confidence through useful code, clear feedback and customer understanding.

What you will be doing

• Define and implement shared contracts for tasks, events, permissions, approvals, evidence and usage.

• Set clear boundaries between model reasoning, agent harnesses, durable workflows and services that enforce authorization.

• Select a harness through representative identity tasks, failure tests and operational evidence. Keep model providers and harness components replaceable.

• Design integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, including data boundaries, latency, cost, version changes and measured release quality.

• Build reference services for tenant isolation, scoped tool execution, idempotency, long approval waits and verified results.

• Define the transactional and analytics data architecture. Keep PostgreSQL application state separate from the planned ClickHouse or BigQuery analytics layer.

• Connect Product, Applied AI and Platform engineers through clear ownership and practical APIs. Resolve dependencies that slow delivery.

• Write critical implementations, review recovery and security, and guide technical leads through production rollout and customer expansion.

What you will bring to the role

• A record of leading architecture and delivery across multiple engineering teams, with recent production code you personally implemented.

• Deep knowledge of distributed services, API design, data consistency, cloud security and production operations.

• Experience making systems simpler while improving reliability, security or delivery speed.

• The ability to explain design tradeoffs, guide senior engineers and remain accountable through implementation.

• Depth in at least one of the two role areas below, plus the ability to work across the full product.

Role focus

AI systems architect: Build and evaluate agent harnesses, context management, model integrations and quality controls. Relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a comparable custom runtime.

Platform architect: Lead backend, connector, security, data and workflow architecture. Bring deep production systems experience and practical knowledge of integrating model-driven workflows.

Our stack

Python FastAPI, React and TypeScript, AWS Amplify, Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge and API Gateway. Storage uses RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector and S3. Security and operations include KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail.

We are adding OpenAI and Anthropic model API integrations. An agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery are planned. You will help choose and implement them.

And extra credit for

• Enterprise identity, security products, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or complex customer integrations.

• ClickHouse, BigQuery, agent evaluations, post-training systems or open-source infrastructure.

• Building a new product within a larger enterprise and keeping technical decisions reversible.

jobs.title: Scientific Director, Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
About Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.

Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.  is the global leader in innovating, developing, and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Amtagvi® (lifileucel) is the first FDA-approved, one-time treatment for previously treated advanced melanoma, now approved in three global markets and available at more than 95 authorized treatment centers. The Iovance TIL platform spans registrational trials and next-generation programs in additional solid tumors, including gene-edited and IL-12 tethered TIL therapies, next-generation IL-2, and precision immuno-oncology approaches. As the first and only company to take TIL therapy from concept to a broadly accessible commercial treatment, Iovance operates as an end-to-end cell therapy company, anchored by fully owned, centralized U.S.-based manufacturing that is scaled to serve thousands of cancer patients worldwide each year. For more information, please visit www.iovance.com.

Amtagvi® and its accompanying design marks, Proleukin®, Iovance®, and IovanceCares™ are trademarks and registered trademarks of Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. or its subsidiaries. All other trademarks and registered trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

Information on Iovance’s broad, industry-leading patent portfolio is available on the Intellectual Property page on www.iovance.com.

Overview

The Senior Cellular Therapy Medical Director reports to the Executive Scientific Director, Medical Affairs, and represents Iovance Medical Affairs as needed, serving as a TIL cell therapy therapeutic area expert in educational, strategic, and tactical discussions and presentations with internal colleagues and external experts and investigators. This role requires strong clinical expertise and credibility, recent surgical and/or cell therapy experience, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare providers to apply practical insights to patient care, including perioperative workflows and tumor procurement. The Senior Cellular Therapy Medical Director also collaborates with internal cross-functional teams to ensure territory alignment and optimization, and to support medical strategies in line with overarching corporate objectives.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

• Support and educate providers to optimize tumor tissue starting material for lifileucel manufacturing

• Lead engagement and best-practice discussions with surgeons on tumor tissue procurement

• Support ATC medical onboarding to prepare for direct patient care, and serve as an ongoing resource for patient- and product-specific questions

• Serve as subject matter expert and clinical support for TIL cell therapy

• Provide clinical trial support by engaging surgeons across all Iovance trials and investigator-sponsored trials (ISTs)

• Represent Iovance Medical Affairs as a TIL cell therapy expert across internal and external venues, including US and Global cross-functional teams, clinical sub-teams, external consultants, and advisory boards and steering committees.

• Work cross-functionally to support Commercial Quality, Market Access, Clinical Development, and the broader Med Affairs team.

• Participate in various Medical Affairs cross-functional working groups.

• Represent Iovance at professional meetings, congresses, and local symposia.

• Provide high-quality clinical input and review of disease strategy plans, slides, manuscripts, educational materials, IIT protocols, steering committee and advisory board meeting objectives, Standard Response Letters, and Commercial brand plans.

• Partner with Scientific Communications to develop timely publication strategies and plan, gap analysis, and key messages.

• Interact with key stakeholders as a therapeutic area medical strategy expert: Internal Medical Affairs partners ATC Operations Commercial partners Clinical Science & Clinical Operations Research Alliances Manufacturing Quality Marketing Market Access Regulatory Affairs Project Management Training External Investigators, KOLs Non-physician HCPs Steering Committees Advisory Boards

Travel – 30%

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

• A Physician Assistant or Nurse Practitioner with firsthand clinical or surgical experience is required; melanoma, cellular therapy, and/or surgical oncology experience is strongly preferred.

• A degree from an accredited and recognized school is required.

• A minimum of 7-10 years of academic/industry experience is strongly preferred.

• Expertise in the conduct of clinical trials in hematology/oncology is strongly preferred.

• Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex scientific and surgical concepts to diverse audiences, including presentations to large groups, facilitation of interactive discussions, and 1:1 interaction with surgeons and other HCPs.

• Excellent analytical skills and solid experience in translating medical, clinical, and surgical information into Medical Affairs strategies that improve tumor procurement quality and manufacturing success.

• Proficiency in critical data review and interpretation, including the ability to evaluate surgical variables impacting product quality and outcomes.

• Demonstrated customer-focused orientation & credibility with customers.

• Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the capacity to align scientific initiatives with organizational goals and adapt to evolving industry landscapes.

• Expertise in leading the development of effective and influential scientific content aligned with the latest advancements in the therapeutic landscape, utilizing PowerPoint for impactful presentations.

• Knowledge/application of data sources, reports, and tools for the creation of solid plans, including insights into surgical workflows and tumor procurement metrics.

• Ability and willingness to travel as needed to meet the demands of the role.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made upon request to enable individuals to perform essential functions. Please contact Human Resources to request accommodation.

Physical Demands and Activities Required

• Ability to travel, usually within the US.

• Must be able to remain in a stationary position standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.

• Must be able to move about inside an office and exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects.

Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgement, troubleshooting, problem-solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines.

Work Environment: This job operates in a professional or remote office environment and requires operating standard office equipment and keyboards.

jobs.description:
Product Enablement Intern

Location: New York, NY / Hybrid Remote

We have an office in New York and this position can either be based in the office or hybrid remote, with the expectation of attending the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays with flexibility to class schedule and (subject to your existing legal right to work in the jurisdiction).

About HERE

Everything works right here™.

Traditional browsers weren’t built for work. In today’s enterprise environment—where security threats are constant and productivity is critical—legacy browsers fall short. That’s why we built HERE, the browser purpose-built for work.

Powered by Chromium, HERE Enterprise Browser combines enterprise-grade security, seamless productivity, and native AI integration in one secure, intelligent workspace. Designed for regulated industries, HERE offers deep policy controls, identity-based access, secure workspace isolation, and full interoperability across SaaS, legacy, and virtualized environments. Our platform enables teams to work faster, more securely, and more intelligently—without compromise.

HERE technology is trusted by 90% of global banks and also used within the U.S. Intelligence Community and other sectors. We’re backed by some of the world’s most respected financial institutions and venture firms, including Bain Capital Ventures, Bank of America, J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo and IQT, the not-for-profit strategic investor that accelerates the introduction of groundbreaking technologies to enhance the national security of America and its allies.

About the Role

As a Product Enablement Intern, you’ll sit at the intersection of product and team enablement, helping teams across HERE get more value out of the Enterprise Browser they use every day. You’ll spend time with different departments to understand how they actually work, then leverage AI in HERE Studio to build and configure tools that remove friction from their routines.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll ship real internal apps, organize them into Supertabs, and train the people who use them. Coding knowledge is optional, being able to work across many teams and understand what makes them tick isn’t!

Responsibilities

• Meet with teams across the organization to understand their daily workflows and identify where the Enterprise Browser can simplify or automate repetitive tasks

• Translate what you learn into functional internal apps built in HERE Studio

• Group related tools into Supertabs so each team has fast, centralized access to what they need most

• Run onboarding and training sessions so teams know how to use the tools once they’re live

• Gather feedback after launch and iterate on apps and Supertabs based on how teams actually use them

• Document workflows and build patterns so other teams can reuse what you’ve built

• Excellent communication skills and comfortable working cross functionally- engaging with people in different roles to understand their technical challenges and pain points

• Organized and self-directed; able to manage multiple team relationships and projects at once

• Interest in enterprise software, financial services, AI, or cybersecurity is a bonus

From virtual socials and in-person events, to informal meetings and employee resource groups, we make it easy to engage and connect. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst / Finance Manager, Central FP&A
jobs.description:
Summary Description

This is a hands-on role on Expeditors’ new Central FP&A team, which runs the finance calendar, monthly forecast, annual operating plan, consolidated management reporting, and Board and earnings support. Reporting to the Director, Central FP&A, this person will build and run the models, processes, and reporting behind those cycles, and help shape how a growing FP&A function works at Expeditors.

We will hire at the Senior Financial Analyst or Manager level depending on experience. At the Manager level, the role takes broader ownership of forecast and reporting cycles, leads workstreams across Finance, and reviews the work of others as the team grows. We’re looking for someone who has done strong FP&A work in a well-run finance organization, is curious about how our business makes money, and is practical, detail-oriented, and comfortable in an evolving environment.

What You Do

Run the Forecast and Planning Cycles

• Prepare and consolidate the monthly and quarterly forecast, managing timelines, templates, inputs, and version control.
• Gather and validate inputs from regional controllers, finance business partners, and corporate functions, resolving gaps and inconsistencies.
• Build and maintain the driver-based models behind the forecast, annual operating plan, and long-range plan.
• Prepare planning assumptions, templates, scenarios, and review materials for the annual operating plan and long-range plan.
• Partner with corporate function leaders to prepare their operating expense forecasts and budgets, including headcount and cost center inputs, bringing consistency to cost centers planned today without finance support.
• Maintain the finance calendar and track significant strategic initiatives so their financial impact is reflected in the plan and forecast.
• Analyze forecast accuracy and variances to actuals, and recommend improvements to methods and assumptions.

Deliver Management, Board, and Earnings Reporting

• Prepare monthly management reporting on results, drivers, risks, opportunities, and outlook.
• Draft clear commentary on what changed, why it changed, and what it means for the outlook.
• Prepare analyses and supporting materials for Board meetings and the earnings process, working with senior Finance leaders and Investor Relations.
• Ensure reporting is accurate, reconciled to reported results, well documented, and delivered on time.

Build Models and Analysis

• Analyze business performance, cost, headcount, and productivity to support leadership decisions.
• Build scenario and sensitivity analyses that make key assumptions transparent.
• Apply consistent modeling standards for structure, documentation, and quality review.

Improve Processes and Systems

• Document and improve repeatable forecasting, planning, and reporting processes, reducing manual effort and cycle time.
• Support the transition to Oracle EPM Cloud through requirements, testing, data validation, and process design.
• Simplify, standardize, and automate recurring work using Excel, Power BI, and emerging analytical and AI tools.

Partner Across Finance

• Work closely with regional controllers, Accounting, Treasury, Human Resources, and finance business partners to understand the numbers behind the forecast and reporting.
• Build working relationships across functions and geographies, approaching the business with curiosity.
• At the Manager level, lead workstreams within the forecast and reporting cycles, and review and coach the work of others.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
• Senior Financial Analyst: four or more years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a related discipline. Manager: seven or more years, including ownership of a forecast, planning, or reporting process.
• Hands-on experience with forecasting, budgeting, consolidation, and management reporting in a large or complex organization.
• Strong financial modeling skills and advanced proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint.
• Solid understanding of the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and how operating drivers flow through to results.
• Ability to turn complex data into clear, concise analysis and commentary for senior audiences.
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to accuracy and confidentiality.
• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and work effectively where processes and systems are still evolving.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a mature FP&A organization within a public company.
• Experience preparing Board or earnings materials.
• Experience with Oracle EPM (Hyperion), Power BI, or comparable planning and business intelligence tools, including supporting a system implementation.
• For the Manager level, experience leading workstreams or coaching other analysts.
• CPA, CFA, MBA, or progress toward one.
• Global business perspective; experience in logistics, transportation, or another network-based business is a plus.

• Holidays (10)
• Flexible Days (2)

The role focuses on constrained optimization, trajectory refinement, controller performance, and integration of learned model outputs with executable vehicle behavior.

VLA Model and Development

• Prototype, train, and fine-tune VLA models or supporting perception and world-model components.

• Investigate recent methods and implement a focused research project with mentor guidance.

Data and Experimentation

• Prepare driving datasets and evaluation splits; improve data quality and coverage.

• Run controlled experiments and ablations and maintain reproducible configurations and experiment records.

Evaluation and Integration

• Measure model accuracy, driving behavior, robustness, and inference cost.

• Analyze failures in offline and simulation evaluation; collaborate with planning and deployment engineers on model interfaces.

Documentation and Collaboration

• Document methods, results, and limitations; review code and present findings.

• Deliver a reproducible prototype and a final technical report.

​General Skills:

• Analytical thinking and structured problem solving; clear written and verbal communication; careful documentation; collaboration across research and engineering teams.

​Required Specialized Skills:​

• Foundations in numerical optimization, linear algebra, and dynamical systems.

• Hands-on experience with QP or classical control such as MPC, LQR, or PID; knowledge of constrained

• Ability to implement and debug algorithms in Python or C++ and contribute to deployment code.

• Ability to assess trajectory feasibility, tracking error, constraint violations, and runtime.

​Desired Skills:

• Experience formulating QPs with OSQP, qpOASES, or HPIPM

• Knowledge of MPC, trajectory optimization, vehicle dynamics, and lateral / longitudinal control.

• C++, profiling, sparse numerical methods, solver warm starts, or embedded deployment.

• Simulation, log replay, software-in-the-loop, or hardware-in-the-loop validation.

​Workplace Flexibility:

​Years of Relevant Experience:

• Coursework, research, or project experience in optimization, motion planning, or control. Prior industry experience is not required.

​Required Education:

​Desired Education:

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer I - Assembly & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

MANUFACTURING

Manufacturing Engineering powers Rocket Lab’s factories from concept to full-scale production. We turn early ideas into manufacturable designs, build and optimize the systems that make them real, and constantly push for faster, better, smarter ways to build. We engineer the factories that build the rockets, boosting quality, cutting cost, and accelerating build rate.

SENIOR MANUFACTURING ENGINEER I - ASSEMBLY & INTEGRATION

This role focuses on improving manufacturing processes by conducting feasibility studies, supporting product design for manufacturability, and leading factory setup and optimization. It involves troubleshooting production issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving process improvements, and supporting organizational efficiency through effective change management and business system enhancements.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Prepare feasibility studies and conduct manufacturing technology Research & Development projects

• Partner with our Design Engineering teams to incorporate Design for Manufacture into our products to ensure robustness and manufacturability at scale

• Engineer and deliver our factories – design, procure, install, validate assembly, test and verification processes

• Support Development builds to uncover early learnings and resolve issues to accelerate the production ramp up

• Take engineering ownership of production lines to remove blockers, improve yield and increase build efficiency

• Triage and diagnose failures, conduct deep technical investigations and determine the right path forward including risk mitigation actions and root cause resolution

• Collaborate with cross functional teams to resolve complex issues

• Drive process improvements across manufacturing, test and integration

• Contribute to change management, assessing risk and impact of design or process changes

• Support business system and process improvements to drive increased organizational effectiveness and efficiency

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or similar

• 5+ years of technical experience in a Manufacturing, Production, or Process Engineering environment

• Hands-on experience proactively identifying and solving systemic multifaceted problems in complex manufacturing systems

• Ability to effectively deliver on multiple complex multifaceted assignments simultaneously with autonomy

• Ability to effectively coach and mentor others to raise the bar across multiple teams

• Detailed technical knowledge in complex manufacturing processes

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Working experience with environmental acceptance/production acceptance testing, such as vibration, shock, thermal, and vacuum

• Understanding of instrumentation, interfaces, and sensors including power supplies, oscilloscopes, serial devices, switch topologies, accelerometers, thermocouples, RTDs, and 4-20mA sensors

• Experience with designing, implementing, and supporting a production line and/or build area

• Experience transitioning products from design to production as a part of cross-functional team in a fast-paced, iterative design environment

• Demonstrated experience with DFMEA, PFMEA methodologies, Fault Tree Analysis, Pareto analysis, root cause and corrective action

• Ability to effectively deliver on complex assignments with autonomy

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)

$135,000—$194,000 USD

Base Salary

$115,000—$158,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you'll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Brand & Sales Content
jobs.description:
About Wellfit
Wellfit is a healthcare fintech platform helping remove financial barriers between patients, providers, employers, and payors. Our solutions help dental and healthcare organizations offer more flexible payment, financing, and membership options while improving access to care and supporting practice growth.

As Wellfit continues to scale, we're investing in stronger brand awareness, more effective marketing execution, and demand-generation programs that create measurable opportunities for our sales organization.

We're seeking a creative, commercially minded, and AI-enabled Demand Generation & Marketing Content Manager who can develop compelling content, execute integrated campaigns, and build a repeatable engine for generating qualified customer interest.

About the Role:
This is a hands-on marketing leadership opportunity for someone who combines exceptional content and storytelling capabilities with demonstrated success generating demand and supporting sales pipeline.

You will own Wellfit's content marketing, organic social presence, integrated campaigns, website messaging, and marketing collateral while helping establish a more disciplined, measurable approach to demand generation.

You'll collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and leadership to understand our customers, communicate our value, and turn marketing activity into meaningful commercial opportunities.

This is an individual contributor position with significant ownership and strategic influence. Success requires someone who can independently develop strategy, prioritize initiatives, and execute high-quality work without depending heavily on agencies or additional team members.

What You'll Do:
Demand Generation & Pipeline Growth
Own and execute integrated B2B marketing campaigns designed to create awareness, generate qualified leads, and contribute to sales pipeline.
Develop targeted programs for dental practices, healthcare organizations, partners, employers, payors, and other relevant decision-makers.
Partner closely with Sales to understand ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, prospect challenges, and opportunities to improve lead quality.
Build multichannel campaigns leveraging email, social media, landing pages, educational content, and other appropriate digital channels.
Develop lead-nurturing campaigns that move prospects from initial awareness toward meaningful sales engagement.
Track and evaluate campaign effectiveness using engagement, lead conversion, lead quality, and pipeline contribution.
Continuously test new messaging, channels, content formats, and campaigns to improve marketing performance.
Content Strategy & Brand Storytelling
Develop and execute a cohesive content strategy aligned with Wellfit's products, audiences, and growth objectives.
Create compelling content across blogs, thought leadership, product education, customer stories, emails, landing pages, presentations, and campaigns.
Translate complex healthcare, lending, payments, fintech, and SaaS concepts into clear, engaging, audience-specific messaging.
Develop content that supports the complete buyer journey, from awareness and education through consideration and sales engagement.
Maintain a consistent and recognizable brand voice across marketing channels.
Bring original creative ideas forward that help differentiate Wellfit and strengthen its market presence.
Social Media & Digital Marketing
Own Wellfit's organic social media strategy and execution across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Build a consistent publishing cadence focused on awareness, thought leadership, product education, and audience engagement.
Create engaging copy, graphics, video concepts, educational content, and campaign-driven posts.
Evaluate social media performance beyond vanity metrics, identifying opportunities to generate website traffic, inquiries, and sales conversations.
Support executive thought leadership and customer-facing communication initiatives.
Website Content & Conversion
Own marketing content improvements across Wellfit's website, ensuring messaging remains current, accurate, compelling, and aligned with business priorities.
Develop and optimize campaign landing pages, product messaging, calls to action, and customer education content.
Apply SEO fundamentals, metadata improvements, and content optimization techniques to increase discoverability.
Ensure Wellfit's payment, financing, membership, ACH, Pinless Debit, and emerging product offerings are clearly represented.
Identify opportunities to improve visitor engagement and conversion into qualified inquiries.
Sales Enablement & Marketing Collateral
Partner with Sales and Product to develop materials that support prospective customer conversations.
Create and maintain product one-pagers, brochures, presentations, educational resources, campaign assets, and customer-facing collateral.
Develop messaging tailored to buyer personas, product benefits, customer pain points, and different stages of the sales cycle.
Ensure marketing assets are accurate, current, professionally branded, and readily accessible.
Identify gaps in existing sales materials and proactively develop solutions.
Events & Campaign Marketing
Develop marketing content and promotional campaigns supporting conferences, trade shows, and industry events.
Create event-specific messaging, collateral, presentations, social content, and email campaigns.
Execute pre-event and post-event marketing initiatives designed to maximize awareness, engagement, and sales follow-up opportunities.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners on event-related marketing needs.
This role supports event marketing but is not responsible for shipping, booth logistics, or end-to-end event operations.
AI-Enabled Marketing Execution
Leverage AI-enabled tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva, marketing automation platforms, and creative technologies to increase marketing speed and effectiveness.
Develop repeatable AI-supported workflows for research, writing, campaign creation, creative production, and content repurposing.
Experiment with AI-enabled personalization, prospect messaging, video creation, and campaign optimization.
Identify opportunities to bring marketing capabilities in-house while reducing unnecessary reliance on external agencies.
Combine AI-assisted execution with strong creative judgment, editorial quality, and brand consistency.
What We're Looking For
6+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally spanning content marketing, demand generation, digital campaigns, and growth marketing.
Demonstrated ownership of marketing campaigns that contributed to qualified lead generation, sales opportunities, or pipeline development.
Strong writing, editing, storytelling, and content development capabilities.
Experience building and executing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
Understanding of B2B buyer journeys, audience targeting, lead nurturing, and conversion optimization.
Ability to measure marketing effectiveness through meaningful commercial outcomes rather than content production or engagement alone.
Experience collaborating directly with Sales to align marketing initiatives with revenue objectives.
Strong creative instincts and the ability to develop differentiated messaging for complex products or services.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve marketing productivity and execution.
Ability to independently manage priorities, execute campaigns, and deliver results in a lean, fast-moving environment.
Strong communication, collaboration, organization, and project management skills.
Comfort receiving feedback, adapting quickly, and continuously improving work.
Nice to Have
Experience in healthcare, dental, fintech, payments, lending, SaaS, or B2B technology.
Experience developing demand-generation programs within a growing or scaling organization.
Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation, campaign reporting, and lead attribution.
Experience managing company LinkedIn accounts, executive thought leadership, and organic social campaigns.
Working knowledge of SEO, landing pages, website content management, and digital analytics.
Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Camtasia, or comparable design and video tools.
Experience developing product demos, video scripts, customer stories, or educational content.
Experience supporting trade show and event-related marketing campaigns.
A portfolio demonstrating strong creativity, content quality, and measurable campaign outcomes.

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means building a marketing function that consistently contributes to Wellfit's growth.
You'll help establish a stronger and more recognizable brand, create a reliable cadence of high-quality content, and develop campaigns that attract qualified prospective customers.
You'll work with Sales to understand which marketing efforts generate useful conversations, improve conversion opportunities, and contribute to pipeline.
You'll also help Wellfit move faster by leveraging modern technologies, creating scalable workflows, and reducing dependency on external marketing agencies.
Most importantly, your work will connect creative execution to measurable business outcomes.

Why Wellfit
Meaningful Impact: Directly influence how prospective customers discover, understand, and engage with Wellfit.
Ownership & Autonomy: Help build and shape a growing internal marketing capability.
Modern Technology: Leverage AI and emerging technologies to make marketing more creative, scalable, and effective.
Competitive Compensation: $120,000–$130,000 annual base salary.
Hybrid Flexibility: Three days per week onsite in Irving, Texas.
Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, bonus eligibility, and 401(k) matching.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Product, Operations, and company leadership.

jobs.title: Associate Video Editor
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Good Inside is redefining parenting - not as something that should “just come naturally,” but as a skill to learn and practice. Founded by Dr. Becky Kennedy and Dr. Erica Belsky, we combine sturdy leadership with innovative technology to give parents personalized guidance, AI-powered support, and a global community.

Our mission: help parents raise resilient, confident kids in a changing world. We’ve already reached millions, and we’re just getting started.  We’re refining our product and expanding our reach to empower even more families.

We’re looking for bold, high-ownership problem-solvers who want to build something new, tackle big challenges, and be at the forefront of change.

The Opportunity

Video is increasingly how parents find Good Inside. We’re seeking an Associate Video Editor to turn raw footage into videos parents watch to the end, across YouTube, podcasts, social, app content and partner work. This role will specifically work across Good Inside’s podcast portfolio.

This is a high-impact role on our growing in-house studio team. You’ll work closely with our production and content teams to turn every podcast shoot into finished videos, from rough cut to final, and cut them for every platform we publish on. Along the way, you’ll sharpen your story instincts alongside experienced editors and learn how performance data makes each video better than the last.

We’re looking for an editor with strong technical fundamentals and a growing story instinct, who loves every part of the craft, from pacing and structure to color, sound and captions, and wants to keep getting better. If you want your work to reach millions of parents, this role is for you.

This is a hybrid role and requires 3 days per week in our Midtown Manhattan office.

What You’ll Own

• Edit long-form and short-form video from rough cut to final keeping viewers watching to the end.

• Work closely with our Manager, Studio and Production and Executive Producer, Podcasts, taking direction on story, pacing and structure and building your editorial judgment with every episode.

• Handle audio mixing, color correction, captioning and motion graphics, building toward full ownership of finishing and craft.

• Cut platform-specific versions for YouTube, Instagram and TikTok from a single shoot.

• Turn around notes quickly and cleanly.

• Join the team’s performance reviews and learn how data shapes the next edit.

• Ingest, sync and manage dailies so footage stays organized and easy to find.

Your Skills & Experience

• 2–5 years of editing experience, ideally for a creator, media brand or digital-first channel.

• A reel that shows range across long-form and short-form content.

• Proficiency in industry-standard video and audio editing software (Adobe Premiere preferred).

• A growing story instinct: you’re developing a feel for what to keep, what to lose and where the energy drops, and you welcome feedback.

• Experience cutting interview content.

• Bonus: YouTube retention know-how (hooks, chapters, where viewers drop off) and thumbnail design.

What We Offer

• Compensation: Annual salary for this role will be $86,000–$96,000

• Company Equity

• Comprehensive benefits package

• 401k + Company match

• Time off to recharge

• Hybrid work environment

• A high-ownership, high-performance, high-collaboration culture

Equal Employment Opportunity

Good Inside is an equal opportunity employer and as such, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented people. As much as we believe in focusing on the parent behind the parenting and the child behind the behavior, we believe in focusing on the person behind the job. We’re dedicated to building a workplace where we give each other the strategies, support, and space we each need to thrive—believing in and bringing out the good inside of everyone..

If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Fire Protection Designer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Position Overview

Jensen Hughes is seeking highly experienced and motivated Fire Protection Designer to join our team to work onsite at a large semiconductor facility in North Phoenix..  This role will support a fast-paced project through consulting, design, review, and field oversight activities at a large, advanced manufacturing facility. The position requires technical depth, sound judgment, and the ability to interface effectively with clients.

This role is responsible for the design, evaluation, and consulting of fire protection systems across a variety of project types. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong knowledge of applicable codes and standards, and the ability to lead projects and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

Key Responsibilities

Design, Consulting, and Technical Oversight

• Lead and execute fire protection system design from concept through construction, including system layouts, device placement, riser diagrams, sequences of operation, and calculations (battery, voltage drop, etc.)

• Develop detailed, code-compliant fire protection drawings, including shop drawings, specifications, and technical reports using REVIT, AutoCAD, and/or similar design industry tools

• Review architectural and engineering drawings to ensure life safety and fire code compliance

Project Execution and Field Activities

• Act as the owner’s representative for fire protection systems during design, construction, and commissioning phases

• Conduct site assessments and field surveys to evaluate existing conditions and fire system installations

• Prepare and review design, shop drawing, and construction submittals for compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project requirements

• Support testing, commissioning, and acceptance activities, including preparation of test plans, witnessing tests, and documenting results

Client, Contractor, and Team Coordination

• Coordinate and collaborate with engineers, architects, contractors, authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), and internal project teams

• Interface directly with clients to communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project status

• Manage technical aspects of projects, including schedules, workload planning, and adherence to approved scopes of work

Quality, Compliance, and Leadership

• Stay current on applicable codes, standards, and emerging technologies (e.g., NFPA 72, NFPA 70, IBC)

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff, including support for NICET development and training

Minimum Requirements

• Progressive experience in fire protection system design, consulting, or inspection

• Proficiency with AutoCAD, REVIT, and/or other industry design software

Preferred Qualifications

• NICET certification, NICET Level II or higher is strongly desired

• Proficiency with ASPIRE™ software

• Strong working knowledge of NFPA codes, life safety standards, and local jurisdictional requirements

• Experience with mass notification systems and integrated life safety solutions

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technically sound design strategies

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting client and schedule commitments

Additional Considerations

• Candidates with significant industry experience in fire protection system design, inspection, or code consulting are desired

Relocation Assistance Provided

jobs.title: Site Security Manager
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE

Hadrian's Physical Security team protects the people, factories and export-controlled work behind Hadrian's growth. As we open new factories and bring on new teams, every site needs a security leader on the ground, and the program needs people who help build it across all of our sites.

You will own security at our Torrance campus and be hands on every day: managing the contract security team, walking the site, and acting as the first call for any security risk. This is more than a walk-the-floor role. You'll also own a program area across every Hadrian site, such as investigations, workplace violence prevention, vendor management or security training, and help build a physical security program that keeps pace with the business. You'll partner with site leadership, Facilities, EH&S, People and the Facility Security Officer, and report to the Director of Physical Security. This is an on-site role in Torrance, CA.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Manage the contract security vendor at the site: set post orders and patrol plans, check the work against them, and hold the vendor to the contract.

 - Walk the site regularly, find gaps in doors, openings and day-to-day security practice, rank them, and get them fixed.

 - Lead the response to security incidents and site events as the first security leader on scene, and document them clearly.

 - Keep site controls in place, including badge access, visitor management, key control, contractor escorts and controlled areas, in partnership with the Facility Security Officer.

 - Build working relationships with local law enforcement, fire and other emergency services, and partner with site leadership, Facilities, EH&S and People.

 - Own a program area across every Hadrian site, such as investigations, workplace violence prevention, vendor management, budget or security training.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in corporate, industrial or government security, including time leading a site or a contract security team.

 - Experience building or improving a security program, not only running a post or a site.

 - Hands-on experience with access control, video and visitor management systems.

 - Sound incident judgment and clear writing: incident reports, findings and post orders others can act on.

 - Comfort working on a production floor and responding after hours when needed.

 - Ability to hold vendors to a high standard while keeping a strong working relationship.


WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Background in intelligence, investigations, workplace violence prevention or security training.

 - Aerospace, defense or manufacturing experience.

 - Experience with export-controlled or other controlled environments.

 - Experience with California workplace violence prevention requirements (SB 553).

 - PSP or CPP certification.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.
