jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Retrieval & Targeting
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Team Description:

The Ads Retrieval ML team builds the machine learning systems that identify relevant advertising candidates for Reddit users. Retrieval sits at the heart of the ads delivery funnel: before downstream ranking and auction decisions, our models determine which campaigns and ads are eligible to compete. We work on large-scale retrieval across multiple objectives, placements, and geographies. Our work combines representation learning, candidate generation, nearest-neighbor search, behavioral and contextual signals, and rigorous offline and online experimentation.

Role Description:

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Retrieval and Targeting ML team. You will lead the design and evolution of retrieval models and modeling practices that improve relevance, advertiser outcomes, and user experience at Reddit scale. This is an applied ML role centered on retrieval modeling and end-to-end product impact. You will be expected to stay close to the technical details—from data and objective design through model development, evaluation, experimentation, and launch—while setting direction for other engineers.

Responsibilities:

• Define the technical direction and multi-year roadmap for ads retrieval modeling in partnership with engineering, product, data science, and ads stakeholders.

• Design, develop, and launch candidate-generation and retrieval models for campaigns and ads across Reddit’s advertising surfaces.

• Apply modern approaches such as two-tower architectures, representation learning, embeddings, sequence models, graph-based methods, and other deep learning techniques when they create meaningful product value.

• Improve the retrieval stack across key modeling decisions, including objectives, labels, sampling strategies, hard-negative mining, feature design, embedding generation, candidate filtering, and retrieval depth.

• Work with approximate nearest-neighbor and vector retrieval systems, reasoning about recall, relevance, freshness, diversity, coverage, latency, and cost trade-offs.

• Establish strong evaluation practices that connect retrieval metrics—such as recall, precision, candidate coverage, calibration, and downstream lift—to ads and user outcomes.

• Lead offline analysis and online experiments, interpret ambiguous results, and translate findings into the next modeling iteration.

• Partner with downstream ranking, ads platform, auction, measurement, and product teams to ensure retrieval models integrate effectively into the full ads funnel.

• Write design documents, review code and model changes, and raise the quality bar for modeling, testing, observability, and production ownership.

• Mentor ML engineers and help grow the team’s expertise in retrieval, recommendation, and representation learning.

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of industry experience, including substantial experience building and shipping applied ML products.

• Deep experience with information retrieval, candidate generation, recommender systems, ranking, or related relevance problems.

• Strong understanding of retrieval modeling concepts, including DNN, embeddings, two-tower or dual-encoder models, approximate nearest-neighbor search, and multi-stage retrieval.

• Deep experience training, evaluating, debugging, and deploying deep learning models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.

• Demonstrated ownership of ML projects from problem framing and data preparation through offline evaluation, online experimentation, production launch, and iteration.

• Strong command of experimental design and model evaluation, including how offline retrieval metrics relate to downstream business and user metrics.

• Experience working with large-scale behavioral, contextual, or content datasets and complex feature pipelines.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to write clear, reliable, maintainable production code.

• Technical leadership experience: setting direction, leading complex projects, influencing partner teams, and mentoring other engineers.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex modeling choices to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with ads retrieval, ads ranking, ad targeting, ad serving, recommendation, search relevance, or marketplace optimization

• Experience modeling user, content, campaign, or ad interactions with sequential, graph, or multimodal signals

• Experience connecting retrieval improvements to downstream ranking, auction, conversion, revenue, or user-experience outcomes

• Experience in ads marketplaces at peer companies

• Publications, patents, or industry contributions in applied ML or ranking systems

• Experience with sequential modeling (e.g., RNNs, Transformers)

Benefits:

• 100% remote opportunity (we have 4 office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago)

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

#LI-AJ1

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:

$230,000—$322,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Coding Quality Auditor
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Coding Quality Auditor
Department: Compliance Department
Reports To: Compliance Department Lead
Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt
Location: Remote with approximately 25% travel to clinic locations as needed (Pacific Northwest, Wisconsin, California)
Pay: $100-$140k.

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to designated Compliance Department Leader, the Senior Coding Quality Auditor works directly with the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team to ensure coding compliance and the accuracy of claim submissions. The Auditor serves as the team’s resource for coding research and coding accuracy, reviews coding quality, and explains the reasoning and sources behind each coding decision so coders can apply it going forward. The Auditor is also the coding subject matter expert for Indigenous Pact’s Tribal Care programs and for any service line or business line Indigenous Pact decides to pursue, researching and vetting coding requirements before services launch.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

Coding Research and Coding Requirements

• Research complex and new ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, and modifier questions using authoritative sources.

• Monitor code set updates and CMS and payer policy changes, and communicate clear guidance to coders.

• Research and vet coding, documentation, and reimbursement requirements for Indigenous Pact’s Tribal Care service offerings, specialty programs, state expansions, and tribal healthcare operations, as well as any other service line or business line Indigenous Pact decides to pursue, and provide implementation guidance to coding, billing, and operational teams.

• Collaborate with Revenue Cycle, Compliance, and Operational leadership to evaluate the coding impact of new payer arrangements, encounter reporting requirements, alternative payment models, and tribal healthcare reimbursement frameworks.

• Work through complex coding questions with coders, sharing the research and rationale behind each answer, and maintain a coding reference library.

Coding Quality Checks

• Conduct prospective and retrospective coding audits, track accuracy by coder, and identify error trends.

• Review audit findings with coders, explaining the guidance behind each correction, and support corrective action plans and re-audits as needed.

• Analyze coding-related denials for root causes and support external audit responses.

General Responsibilities

• Participate in Tribal Care implementation and expansion projects, and in the launch of any new service line or business line, by providing coding subject matter expertise, identifying coding-related risks, and helping develop coding workflows, education materials, and documentation standards.

• Foster a culture of compliance, integrity, and confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills and Abilities

• Expert knowledge of official outpatient coding guidelines, NCCI, E/M rules, and outpatient payment methodologies.

• Strong research and auditing skills, with the ability to document authoritative sources.

• Knowledge of tribal healthcare reimbursement, encounter reporting requirements, and alternative payment models preferred.

• Clear, tactful communication and experience training or leading coding staff.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Associate degree in Health Information Management or related field, or equivalent experience; bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Active coding credential required; CPMA preferred.

• Minimum of 5 years of coding experience, including 2 years of coding audits or quality reviews.

Working environment:

• Expected working hours of 8:00am to 5:00pm.

• 25% travel to Indigenous Pact work sites may be required.

Why Choose Indigenous Pact?

Building a strong culture and exhibiting our core values is important to us. When you join Indigenous Pact, you are joining a team that values:

• Empathy is at the heart of everything we do—we listen, we understand, and we put ourselves in the shoes of others, whether it's our teammates, our clients, or the communities we serve.

• Wisdom is about learning from experience, being thoughtful in our work and making decisions that are grounded in knowledge and insight. It's about taking the time to get things right.

• Bravery is having the courage to take bold risks, challenging the status quo, and knowing that growth happens when we push our limits.

• Transformation drives us to continuously grow—both as a company and as people. It’s about not being afraid to change and to keep pushing forward in the pursuit of excellence.

Visit our Careers page (https://www.indigenouspact.com/careers) where we encourage you to learn more about the characteristics that are important to us (and we hope you bring them as well) such as Healthcare-focused, growth mindset, self-motivated, collaborative, resilient and adaptable.

Beyond the job opportunity and incredible culture, we also offer:

• Indigenous Pact's PTO Policy includes vacation, wellness and 11+ company-paid holidays

• Competitive benefits including 401(k), Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

• Open, transparent lines of communication with leadership

• Committed to giving back to improving our communities and environmental impact

• A development-focused environment where you have autonomy to drive your career path

Indigenous Pact is an equal opportunity employer and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and barrier-free work environment for all employees and candidates. We are especially interested in candidates with lived experience in, or a demonstrated history of working closely with, Indian Country and Tribal communities. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If accommodation is required during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact any member of our HR team. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

• Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator, Ecommerce
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Terrabis is a leading privately held cannabis company with a bold growth strategy, focused on driving innovation and market expansion. Our approach integrates wholesale, retail, and customer experience to set industry standards and create value for both consumers and stakeholders.

JOB SUMMARY

The Marketing Coordinator, Ecommerce keeps Terrabis online menus accurate, complete, and consistent across multiple locations. Working primarily in Dutchie POS and Dutchie Ecommerce, with cross-training on Jane, this role handles day-to-day menu maintenance and supports website QA. The coordinator is also the intake point for store requests and customer complaints about the web experience, and manages support tickets with ecommerce and web providers from start to resolution under the oversight of the Marketing Manager. This role is a strong fit for a detail-oriented cannabis professional who is comfortable with consistent, repeatable work and eager to learn more about ecommerce.

Reports to: Marketing Manager, Ecommerce & Promotions

Schedule: Full-Time, Remote

Travel: Minimal, as needed (expensed)

Pay range: $55,000 - $65,000

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintain online menus in Dutchie POS and Dutchie Ecommerce across multiple locations, including product names, categories, brands, images, descriptions, and availability.

• Audit menus regularly against POS and inventory data to find and correct discrepancies, missing products, duplicates, and incorrect information before they reach customers.

• Handle product listing updates and requests, including accessories and new product setup.

• Follow and help maintain menu standards for naming, categorization, and images so listings stay consistent.

• Review and edit product and strain descriptions so menu copy follows state advertising and compliance rules, including restrictions on effects claims, health claims, and slang.

• Build and maintain checklists and process documentation for menu maintenance.

• Serve as the intake point for store requests and customer complaints related to the web experience, from site bugs to menu discrepancies.

• Triage and log each request, keep the requester updated on status, and confirm the issue is resolved.

• Escalate site bugs, complaints, and menu issues that go beyond routine maintenance to the Senior Marketing Coordinator or Marketing Manager.

• Route discount and promotion requests to the Promotions Coordinator.

• Identify patterns across requests and complaints and share them with the Marketing Manager.

• Open support tickets with ecommerce and web providers, including Dutchie, Jane, and web developers, and manage each ticket from start to resolution.

• Submit clear bug reports with steps to reproduce, screenshots, and expected results, then follow up and verify fixes once released.

• Maintain a ticket log with status, owner, and resolution for every open issue.

• Support scheduled QA of the website and ecommerce menus on desktop and mobile, led by the Senior Marketing Coordinator, documenting bugs, broken links, and layout or checkout issues.

• Verify fixes after updates and report results to the Senior Marketing Coordinator and Marketing Manager.

• Cross-train on Jane Ecommerce and provide backup for Jane menu maintenance and fixes.

• Support the setup and ongoing monitoring of site analytics, such as GA4 and Google Search Console, as directed.

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

• 1 to 3 years of cannabis industry experience, such as inventory management, menu or ecommerce support, or cannabis retail operations.

• Experience with data entry, platform support, or compliance.

• Dutchie POS experience strongly preferred.

• Experience maintaining a product catalog, menu, or inventory data is a plus.

• Comfortable learning new software quickly; Dutchie Ecommerce and Jane training provided.

• Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets for menu audits and product lists, including sorting, filtering, and comparing lists.

• Strong written communication and proofreading skills for editing product copy.

• Ability to clearly document website and menu issues, including steps to reproduce and screenshots.

• Familiarity with Asana or similar project tools is a plus; WordPress, Terpli, A/B testing, or site analytics experience is a plus but not required.

• Highly detail-oriented, with a methodical approach to audits and verification.

• Comfortable with consistent, high-volume tasks and able to stay accurate over time.

• Eager to learn and take on new tools and responsibilities as the role grows.

• Customer service mindset, with the patience and follow-through to handle store and customer complaints.

• Organized and able to prioritize multiple requests and escalate issues appropriately.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Must be 21 years of age or older.

• Must pass a background check per applicable state cannabis regulations.

• Must obtain and maintain state cannabis agent registration or badging if required for the role.

jobs.title: Implementation Project Lead
jobs.description:
The Client Success & Strategy team at Force Therapeutics is the engine that powers the implementation, support, success, renewal and growth of Force's growing portfolio of Hospitals, Health Systems and Orthopedic Specialty Practices throughout the US. The Client Success team works with each client in a highly customized fashion to ensure they reach their unique goals while living our mission to extend Force's reach and impact via hospitals and health system partnerships across the country. We are looking for an experienced Implementation Lead who can confidently own multiple client implementations at once and help raise the bar for the implementation team as a whole.

As the Implementation Project Lead, you will be responsible for leading organizations through implementation on the Force platform. You'll own a portfolio of concurrent implementations of varying complexity, from the initial implementation kick off through first patient live and a seamless hand off to the Client Success Manager. You'll also serve as a mentor to our Implementation Associate, sharing best practices and helping build a consistent, high-quality implementation experience for every client.

What you’ll do:

Client Implementation Ownership: You will lead a portfolio of simultaneous implementation projects ranging from standard to complex. The process starts with support during the final stages of the sales process to ensure we're gathering the appropriate client information to inform implementation timelines through first patient live on the Force platform. You'll partner cross-functionally with internal clinical, product, and technical teams as needed, including on projects with integration components.

Project Management & Prioritization: Build and maintain project plans for each implementation, manage timelines and dependencies, proactively flag risks, and keep every project on schedule based on agreed upon timeframes with client stakeholders. Leverage tools such as Monday, Confluence, and Claude to organize, prioritize, and automate workflows effectively across your portfolio so that no project loses momentum, and escalate risks early when they arise.

Client Engagement & Accountability: Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients throughout implementation. Lead client meetings with confidence, secure commitments from client stakeholders, and drive them to complete their deliverables on time. Keep clients well informed and moving forward, even in busy hospital and health system environments with competing priorities. Comfort working autonomously and holding a high level of accountability for project deliverables.

Training and Presentation: Act as the subject matter expert in implementation best practices for the Force platform. Lead engaging training sessions that are tailored for end users, including surgeons, clinicians, and administrative staff, and deliver recommendations and updates to client leadership.

Operational Consistency: Proactively identify and contribute to initiatives that drive repeatability, consistency, and scalability across the implementation function, such as playbooks, templates, and process improvements. Create and leverage automations whenever possible to guarantee consistency and accountability throughout the implementation process.

What you bring:

Experience in Digital Health or SaaS: You bring 3–5 years of experience implementing SaaS or other health tech platforms, ideally with hospitals, health systems, or specialty practices. Exposure to EMR integrations and interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR, etc.) is a plus.

Project Management Skills: You have a strong track record of managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously, with an emphasis on delivering on schedule with a high degree of client satisfaction. You are proficient with project management platforms such as Monday.com and have hands-on experience using AI tools to automate routine tasks, streamline workflows, and make implementation delivery more efficient and scalable.

Organization and Prioritization: You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at prioritizing competing demands across several clients and workstreams at once.

Confident Communicator and Presenter: You are comfortable with public speaking and leading training for groups of end users, both virtually and in person. You have a strong presence and can command attention and drive action from client stakeholders at all levels.

Our trailblazing platform, backed by insights from over 70 leading healthcare centers and millions of clinically-validated patient data points, not only intelligently extends clinicians' reach but also engages patients at every pivotal moment of their care journey, from surgery scheduling to recovery. jobs.description:
Position Overview

SEAKR is seeking an accomplished Space Electronics Systems Engineer to spearhead the design, development, testing, and qualification of mission‑critical electronic subsystems for our next‑generation products. You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, mechanical, power, and software teams to deliver highly reliable, radiation‑tolerant electronics that meet stringent requirements.

Core Responsibilities

• Subsystem Architecture & Design – Define and validate the architecture for avionics, payload electronics, power‑distribution units, and environmental control systems. Produce derived specifications, system‑level block diagrams and test plans.
• Component Selection & Qualification – Evaluate and select commercial or radiation‑hardened components (COTS, rad‑hard) against mission specifications.
• Hardware Development & Production – Oversee prototype build, assembly, and production‑grade manufacturing.
• Test & Validation – Design and execute system‑level test plans (electrical, functional, EMI/EMC, vibration, thermal). Analyze test data, generate reports, and drive verification efforts.
• Systems Integration & Interface Management – Define and maintain electronic interface control documents (ICDs, EID). Coordinate with hardware, power, software, and mechanical teams to resolve cross‑disciplinary interface issues.
• Documentation & Knowledge Management – Produce design specifications, test procedures, and operational manuals. Maintain a living knowledge base for future teams.
• Communication Skills – Ability to understand mission, translate customer asks into technological solutions, and represent SEAKR in unit sell off and delivery
• Team Leadership & Collaboration – Mentor junior engineers, conduct design reviews, and foster cross‑functional teamwork.

Required Qualifications

• Education – Bachelor’s (or Master’s) in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Experience – 10+ years of systems engineering experience in the space industry, or 4+ years in a senior/lead role.
• Technical Expertise – Deep knowledge of digital and analog electronics design (mixed‑signal, high‑speed). Proficiency with Requirements Management Environment (RME) tools. Experience with radiation testing (TID, SEE) and mitigation techniques. Skilled in firmware/software integration for embedded microcontrollers/FPGA.
• Testing & Validation – Proven track record designing and executing electrical, EMI/EMC, thermal vacuum, vibration, and functional test plans. Ability to interpret and apply test data to design improvement.
• Soft Skills – Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication abilities. Team leadership and mentorship.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with RF processing system architecture and design including testing.
• Experience with space‑qualified microprocessors or FPGA families.
• Knowledge of system power calculations throughout a design cycle for space.
• Prior work with space‑qualifying standards: NASA SP‑3008, ECSS‑E‑ST‑20C, MIL‑STD‑1553, SpaceWire, etc.

jobs.title: Senior Staff SDET, Customer Engineering
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 



Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The best SDETs in the industry are no longer measured by how many tests they write. They're measured by the systems they build that decide whether software is safe to ship — and, increasingly, by how well they wield AI to do it.



That's the role we're hiring for. We're looking for a Senior Staff SDET to own quality architecture and engineering strategy for our most critical systems, and to lead how we apply AI across our entire testing and release pipeline. You'll build the frameworks, platforms, and agent-driven workflows that the rest of engineering depends on, define what "safe to ship" means here, and stay deep in the code while doing it.



This is a genuinely hands-on senior technical leadership role with impact that spans many teams. If you want to build AI-native quality systems rather than bolt AI tools onto a legacy suite, this is that job.




WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

 - AI is the core of the work. You'll own how we use LLMs and agents for test generation, failure triage, self-healing, and release decisioning — and you'll set the guardrails that keep it trustworthy.

 - You'll test AI, not just test with it. We ship AI-powered product features, which means building evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, and probabilistic assertions for systems that don't return the same answer twice. This is frontier work with very little established playbook.

 - Real autonomy and real scope. You'll set the technical direction for quality engineering, not inherit someone else's strategy.




YOU WILL:

Own quality architecture and strategy

 - Own quality architecture for our most critical systems and initiatives, defining long-term quality strategy aligned with business and product goals.

 - Design shared quality platforms, automation frameworks, and test infrastructure that are adopted across multiple teams.

 - Establish quality patterns and guardrails that scale across teams, eliminating duplicated, brittle, or low-signal testing approaches through platform-level solutions.

 - Anticipate systemic quality and reliability risks and drive preventative architectural solutions before they impact customers.

 - Set the standard for what "great" looks like in quality engineering at scale.

Lead our AI-driven testing strategy

 - Define and drive our strategy for AI-assisted testing — autonomous test generation, intelligent test selection, agent-based failure triage, and self-healing automation — with a clear-eyed view of where each genuinely pays off and where it adds noise.

 - Build the guardrails that make AI-driven testing trustworthy: knowing when a self-healing agent is masking a real regression versus absorbing harmless implementation drift is the difference between leverage and liability.

 - Orchestrate AI agents as part of the CI/CD decision pipeline, turning raw test signal into release confidence rather than more dashboards.

 - Own quality for our AI-powered product features — designing eval suites, golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scorers, and statistical approaches for non-deterministic behavior, plus testing for hallucination, safety, and response stability.

 - Establish how we test AI-generated application code, validating behavioral correctness and not just syntactic plausibility.

 - Evaluate emerging AI testing tooling with real rigor, and be honest about what doesn't work.

Raise the bar operationally and across the team

 - Lead the operational maturity of our quality systems and signals — defining quality metrics, dashboards, and release confidence indicators, and leading post-incident analysis that informs architectural and process improvements.

 - Produce exemplary technical artifacts — quality architecture documents, automation frameworks, test platforms — that set the bar for the rest of the team, while staying hands-on in critical quality systems and automation code paths.

 - Serve as the accountable technical leader for strategic initiatives, proactively managing reliability, scalability, and technical debt across teams.

 - Mentor senior SDETs, quality engineers, and other senior technical leaders — especially on building AI fluency into their practice.

 - Establish hiring standards, coaching, and talent development.

 - Champion customer-centric quality decisions, ensuring technical trade-offs reflect real user needs and long-term product value.

 - Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to embed scalability and resilience into roadmap planning, not just technical design.




YOU HAVE:

 - 10+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, including experience architecting quality strategy and automation platforms across multiple teams.

 - Proven track record designing and scaling test automation frameworks across the full stack — frontend web, mobile, and backend/API (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, Postman, or similar).

 - Deep proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin) used to build and maintain shared automation frameworks and tooling. You write production-quality code, not just test scripts.

 - Hands-on experience applying AI to testing — LLM-assisted test generation, agent-based workflows, intelligent test selection, or self-healing automation — with informed opinions about where it delivers and where it disappoints.

 - Demonstrated ability to define quality architecture and standards that scale across many teams, including shared quality platforms and test infrastructure.

 - Strong grasp of modern development and delivery practices (agile/lean, DevOps, shift-left testing, TDD) and experience embedding quality gates into CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins).

 - Experience mentoring and developing senior quality engineers and senior technical leaders, with a track record of raising the technical bar across a group or organization.

 - History of leading post-incident and root-cause analysis that drives architectural and process change.

 - Excellent judgment on trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term system resilience and maintainability.

 - Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product leadership on quality strategy, risk, and investment.

 - Experience with performance and load testing at scale.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling (e.g., Braintrust, Arize, MLflow, LangSmith, or similar).

 - Experience with cloud-based testing platforms and tools (e.g., AWS Device Farm, Sauce Labs, BrowserStack).

 - Familiarity with e-commerce or healthcare platforms and quality-at-scale practices in regulated environments.

 - Experience with internationalization and localization testing.

 - A track record of building quality engineering communities of practice — tech talks, katas, lunch-and-learns.

 - Published writing, talks, or open-source work on modern testing practice or AI in quality engineering.

 - Experience building evaluation or testing infrastructure for LLM-based or ML-driven product features (e.g., eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge scoring, regression testing for non-deterministic systems).
   
   


OUR BENEFITS (THERE ARE MORE BUT HERE ARE SOME HIGHLIGHTS):

 - Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

 - Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

 - Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

 - Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

 - 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

 - Offsite team retreats



We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.



Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.



It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.



Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Corporate Trainer & Facilitator - Chattanooga, TN
jobs.description:
SUMMARY:

The Corporate Trainer & Facilitator delivers highly interactive, engaging instructor-led training across the organization, both in person and virtually, with an emphasis on leadership and soft-skill development. The primary focus of this role is facilitating our signature programs, including Walden Way orientation, LEAP leadership series, and lunch-and-learns, along with CPR/AED/First Aid, role-based, and software training. The Corporate Trainer & Facilitator coordinates every aspect of these events from planning through completion in the LMS, leads train-the-trainer sessions for field Training Managers, and serves as the primary point of contact for the company-wide CPR certification program.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Facilitate instructor-led training developed in-house or curated from vendors, both in person and virtually, including: Walden Way, our interactive orientation program LEAP, our leadership development series Lunch-and-learns on various topics for leaders and individual contributors CPR/AED/First Aid certification and Instructor certification courses Role-based training (when instructor-led) Software demonstrations and training

• Use a highly interactive facilitation style, applying adult learning principles and techniques such as group discussion, questioning, role-play, activities, and games, to drive participation and knowledge retention

• Draw on personal leadership experience and relevant, concise stories to connect concepts to real workplace situations and help participants apply what they learn

• Create a psychologically safe learning environment that encourages open discussion, self-reflection, and practice, and skillfully manage group dynamics and sensitive conversations

• Adapt delivery to fit the audience, group size, and format, and partner with presenters to keep presentations and handouts current before each session

• Plan and coordinate all aspects of training events from start to finish, including but not limited to: Scheduling sessions, students and guest presenters, and reserving training rooms Confirming attendance with managers and supervisors and resolving scheduling conflicts Communicating with attendees, supervisors, and presenters through emails, agendas, calendar invitations, and reminders Advertising and promoting upcoming training opportunities across the organization Planning lunches, catering and refreshments, and ordering supplies and gifts within approved budgets Preparing attendee materials such as agendas, folders, handouts, name tents, and name tags Setting up and testing training rooms, audio-visual equipment, and virtual meeting platforms Coordinating schedules for out-of-town attendees, including individual meetings with department heads and travel timing

• Manage training enrollments and record completions in the LMS accurately and on time

• Collect and consolidate participant survey feedback, lead post-event debriefs, and recommend improvements to programs and events

• Lead train-the-trainer sessions on all instructor-led training programs developed in-house for field Training Managers in all divisions, and provide coaching and feedback to support consistent delivery

• Serve as the primary point of contact for the company-wide CPR certification program: Train and certify new CPR/AED/First Aid instructors and support them as they begin teaching Troubleshoot instructor and program issues Coordinate with our CPR Training Center to keep instructor certifications, renewals, monitoring, and guideline updates current Maintain CPR training materials, forms, equipment, and supply inventory for instructors across all locations

• Collaborate with L&D team members, department heads, and subject matter experts to prepare for sessions and continuously improve the learner experience

• Maintain awareness of current trends in facilitation, virtual training tools, and CPR/First Aid guidelines

• Ensure branding integrity is upheld

• Exemplifies the desired culture and philosophies of the organization

• Other duties and assignments as required

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• None

COMPETENCY:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies (minimum of 5):

• Analytical – Collects and researches data; Uses intuition and experience to complement data; Designs workflows and procedures; Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Uses intuition and experience to complement data.

• Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem-solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

• Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others.

• Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

• Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.

• Oral Communication - Speaks very clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; demonstrates group presentation skills; participates in various meetings.

• Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

• Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; is fully committed to the Quality Management System (QMS).

• Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost-saving measures. Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.

• Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events; adapts to new product introduction, emergent business needs, and business evolution.

• Organizational Support – Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; supports organization’s goals and values; Benefits organization through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

• Minimum High School Diploma or GED.

• Five-plus years of experience facilitating instructor-led training to adult learners in both in-person and virtual settings, with a strong focus on leadership development or soft skills.

• Three-plus years of experience leading people in a supervisory or management role.

• Experience coordinating training programs or events and leading train-the-trainer sessions is preferred.

• Experience in the security industry or with a field-based workforce is a plus.

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Engaging, confident presenter with a proven ability to facilitate in-person and virtual sessions for groups of all sizes, from individual contributors to senior leadership

• Highly interactive facilitation style grounded in adult learning principles that draws insight from participants through questions, discussion, and activities rather than lecture

• Skilled storyteller who draws on real-world leadership experience, keeping stories relevant, concise, and tied to the learning objective

• Solid understanding of the behavioral and psychological principles behind leadership and soft-skill development, such as emotional intelligence, motivation, behavior change, and communication styles

• Ability to read the room, manage group dynamics, and handle sensitive or emotionally charged discussions with professionalism and confidentiality

• Strong event planning and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail

• Proven ability to manage competing priorities and multiple events with fluid or tight deadlines

• Excellent business communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation skills)

• Comfortable running virtual sessions (breakout rooms, polling, chat) and troubleshooting basic technology issues in the moment

• Ability to coach other trainers and give constructive, actionable feedback

• Proven ability to build and manage relationships with stakeholders across the organization

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across divisions, functions, and levels

• Certification in behavioral or personality assessments (e.g., DiSC, CliftonStrengths, MBTI) is a plus

• Current CPR/AED/First Aid Instructor or Instructor Trainer certification is a plus

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

• Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations using the English language.

• Ability to write reports, internal business correspondence, curriculum, and procedure manuals.

• Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to create and interpret bar graphs.

REASONING ABILITY:

• Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.

• Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, or scheduled form.

COMPUTER SKILLS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual should possess intermediate to advanced skills in:

• Learning Management Systems (enrollments, tracking, and recording completions)

• Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)

• Virtual meeting platforms (Zoom and Microsoft Teams), including breakout rooms, polling, and screen sharing

• Audience engagement and survey tools (e.g., Kahoot, Jeopardy-style games, Microsoft or Google Forms)

• Adobe Acrobat (including creating fillable forms)

• Presentation and audio-visual equipment (projectors, displays, microphones and speakers)

• Ability to quickly learn new software programs well enough to demonstrate and train others on them

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, AND REGISTRATIONS:

• CPR/AED/First Aid Certification

• Current/valid state driver’s license

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS:

• Ability to pass a drug screen and criminal background check.

• Ability to travel to branch and client locations as needed to deliver in-person training, including occasional overnight travel.

• Flexibility to occasionally work extended hours to support multi-day training events.

• If not already certified, must be willing to obtain CPR/AED/First Aid Instructor and Instructor Trainer certification after hire.

• Travel may be up to 25%

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms; climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, the ability to adjust focus, and the ability to see and distinguish basic colors.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

OTHER TASKS:

This job description reflects Walden Security management’s assignment of the essential functions of the job; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Pay Rate

$57,000—$60,000 USD

We offer every employee — from executive managers to administrative support to security professionals — unique and generous benefits, as well as opportunities for career growth.

So if you’re ready to embark on a meaningful career with one of the nation’s most dynamic and fastest growing security companies, apply with Walden Security today.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Triage (SF)
jobs.description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!

About the role:

AssemblyAI is growing quickly, and we're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer for our Triage team. You'll own a book of customer accounts up to $50K a year. You'll solve their technical problems directly and build and run the agents that handle our first line of customer contact. Most of your work happens in Slack, with customers and with our Engineering and Research teams.

This role is hybrid. You'll need to live within commuting distance of our SF office.

What You’ll Do:

• Own your accounts. Be the technical owner for customers spending up to $50K a year. Diagnose integration issues, unblock them fast, and spot accounts that are ready to grow. Route commercial and pricing conversations to our Portfolio team.

• Build and manage agents. We run internal agents for customer support and operations, including our customer-facing chat agent, which you'll help bring back online. You'll iterate on these agents, build new ones, and own their quality.

• Turn escalations into fixes. When our chat agent can't resolve something, it escalates to you. Solve the customer's problem, then fix the agent so it handles that case next time.

• Close the loop with Engineering and Research. File bugs and feature requests with enough evidence to act on, and turn what customers tell you into product changes.

• Improve our docs and SDKs. Fix what's confusing customers at the source.

What You’ll Need:

• 2+ years in a technical, customer-facing role (solutions engineering, technical support, developer relations, or software development). We'll consider 1 year for someone with a strong solutions background.

• Proficiency in at least one programming language. Python preferred; other languages considered.

• Daily use of coding agents like Claude Code or Codex, with real projects shipped using them. You manage context across long tasks and check agent output before it reaches a customer.

• Experience with REST APIs, and the ability to read and debug customer code

• Strong written communication. Most of this job happens in Slack.

• Ability to hear a customer use case and map it to what our API can do

Nice to Have:

• You've built an agent or automation that other people rely on

• SQL

• Experience with speech, audio, or voice AI products

Where this role leads:

Triage is where you learn our product, our customers, and how we build with agents. Engineers who do well here move into larger books on our Portfolio and Strategic teams. Your manager will work with you on what that path looks like and the timeline.

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Salary range: $115,000 - $135,000

Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants, 100% employer-paid benefits, and working alongside the team in our San Francisco office. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US-based full time team members.

AI to Interview:

If you’re selected for an interview, please review this resource to better understand how AssemblyAI approaches the use of AI in our interview process.

jobs.title: Sr Advisory Solution Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Solution Consultant to partner with Sales and help enterprise customers address complex security, identity, access, asset visibility, exposure management, and risk challenges.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical and business advisor, leading discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, and customer validation activities. You will work directly with security, identity, infrastructure, IT, risk, and executive stakeholders to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate has strong cybersecurity knowledge, practical enterprise networking experience, strong communication skills, and a proven ability to support complex enterprise sales cycles.

Responsibilities

• Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, solution design, and customer validation.
• Deliver compelling virtual and in-person technical demonstrations.
• Deploy and support proof-of-value and proof-of-concept engagements.
• Translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.
• Serve as a trusted advisor during evaluations, competitive situations, and executive discussions.
• Develop customer-facing documentation, technical summaries, and solution narratives.
• Lead technical training sessions based on customer use cases and POV findings.
• Support marketing events, conferences, webinars, and speaking engagements.
• Collaborate with Product, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support teams to share field insights and improve execution.
• Travel as required, typically 25–50%, depending on region and business needs.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a related technical role.
• 5+ years of customer-facing technical, pre-sales, or customer support experience.
• Experience supporting complex cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise platform sales cycles with enterprise customers.
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, identity and access, governance and risk, and security operations.
• Required strong working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, firewalls, DNS, NAT, and network segmentation.
• Familiarity with capturing network traffic via SPAN ports, port mirroring, TAPs, packet capture brokers, NetFlow, and network telemetry.
• Ability to understand and explain how security platforms integrate with customer network environments to collect data, provide visibility, and support technical validation during demos, POVs, and POCs.
• Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
• Ability to engage effectively with technical practitioners, business stakeholders, and executive buyers.
• Demonstrated track record of contributing to technical wins, deal progression, and successful customer outcomes.
• BS degree in Computer Science, MIS, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience with IAM or IGA solutions
• Background in Security Operations or Security Engineering
• Experience with asset discovery across IoT, OT, or IoMT environments
• Exposure to vulnerability management or risk-based vulnerability programs
• Security, cloud, or relevant technical certifications preferred
• Linux or Python scripting experience

What Success Looks Like

• Quickly becomes productive and adds value to active sales pursuits.
• Delivery of high-quality demos, POVs, and POCs that advance pipelines.
• Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and Sales partners.
• Demonstrates strong technical credibility across complex opportunities.
• Connects technical solutions to measurable business outcomes.
• Contributes to improved win rates, stronger deal quality, and scalable Solution Consulting execution.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $168,750 - $200,000 plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, Washington, D.C., New York City, N.Y., Detroit, MI, Phoenix, AZ, Miami, FL, Denver, CO., Remote (USA)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮

Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝

The Analytics Engineering team's mission is to make data consistent, trustworthy, and easy to use. We build the dimensional models that power business decisions, and we own the integrity of the data those decisions rest on.

We work in a semi-embedded structure: Analytics Engineers sit close to the Data Analyst teams they support while remaining part of a central Analytics Engineering practice. Day to day, that means translating business questions into technical requirements, modeling ingested source data into shapes the business can actually use, and partnering with engineering teams on the upstream data we depend on.

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help shape that architecture as it grows. You'll build and iterate on our star schema, surfacing models that Data Analysts and stakeholders across the business can self-serve against with confidence. Done well, this work raises the data literacy of the entire company — and we take that seriously.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL 🤹

Be a trusted builder, architect, and consultant on the analytics data we surface to our stakeholders. You'll learn the intricacies of our source data, how we transform it, how we monitor for integrity, and continue to move the needle on the partnership needed to maximize value for the business.

You will:

• Design and build dimensional models that scale (we use dbt + BigQuery) Translate ambiguous business questions into dimensions, facts, and grain decisions that hold up as the business changes Make tradeoffs between normalization, performance, and usability, and document the reasoning behind them Reduce technical debt in the dbt project: model layering, naming and testing standards, macro reuse, and incremental strategy

• Own data quality and monitoring for the models you build Define what "correct" means for each model and instrument data quality checks to monitor it Build and improve the alerting and triage process so data issues are caught proactively Lead root-cause investigations on data discrepancies across the pipeline, from source event or system of record through to the analytics layer Partner with Data Engineering and product engineering teams on upstream contracts and instrumentation quality

• Be the connective tissue between source data and business definitions Support technical definition of core business measurement and drive alignment when stakeholders disagree Partner with Data Analysts and BI to ensure models enable stakeholder self-service analysis Translate business needs into technical requirements and prioritize work against them Raise the bar on the team through code review, design review, and documentation

ABOUT YOU 🦄

• 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or related roles.

• Deep data modeling expertise. You have designed dimensional models from scratch and integrated them into a cohesive analytics architecture to serve your stakeholders. You understand grain, SCD types, and fact table design tradeoffs.

• You can handle complex modeling scenarios, such as conforming dimensions across business use cases, modeling many-to-many relationships, handling late-arriving and restated data, and keeping models usable as the source systems evolve.

• You treat data quality as a design problem, not a cleanup task. You have built testing and monitoring into pipelines, defined SLAs or expectations with data owners, and managed the on-call/triage side of keeping data trustworthy.

• You judge your work by its usability to your stakeholders over the long-term, not just by speed of delivery, underlying architecture elegance, or immediate use case.

• Production dbt experience. You understand model materialization strategies, testing, macros, and how to keep a growing project maintainable.

• 2+ years of experience with BI tools (Looker preferred) and an understanding of how modeling choices shape what's possible in the analytics layer.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholder & business decisions.

jobs.title: Space Electronics Systems Engineer II
jobs.description:
SEAKR is seeking a Space Electronics Systems Engineer II to support the design, development, testing, and integration of electronic subsystems for our next‑generation products. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, mechanical, power, and software teams to deliver reliable, radiation‑tolerant electronics that meet project specifications.

Core Responsibilities

• Subsystem Design & Implementation – Assist in developing detailed designs for avionics, payload electronics, power‑distribution units, and environmental control systems based on high-level architecture. Produce derived specifications, block diagrams, and support test planning.
• Component Evaluation – Research and recommend commercial or radiation‑hardened components (COTS, rad‑hard) under the guidance of senior engineers to meet mission specifications.
• Hardware Prototyping – Participate in prototype build, assembly, and preparation for production-grade manufacturing.
• Test Execution & Data Analysis – Execute system‑level test plans (electrical, functional, EMI/EMC, vibration, thermal). Collect and analyze test data to support verification efforts and report findings.
• Systems Integration Support – Help maintain electronic interface control documents (ICDs, EID). Coordinate with hardware, power, software, and mechanical teams to resolve interface issues.
• Documentation – Assist in producing design specifications, test procedures, and operational manuals. Contribute to the living knowledge base for future teams.
• Communication – Ability to understand technical requirements, translate customer needs into engineering tasks, and communicate progress within the team.
• Team Collaboration – Work effectively within cross‑functional teams, participate in design reviews, and support peer engineers.

Required Qualifications

• Education – Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Experience – 2–5 years of systems engineering experience, preferably in the space or defense industry.
• Technical Expertise – Solid knowledge of digital and analog electronics design (mixed‑signal, high‑speed). Familiarity with Requirements Management Environment (RME) tools. Basic understanding of radiation effects (TID, SEE) and mitigation techniques. Experience working with embedded microcontrollers/FPGA.
• Testing & Validation – Experience executing electrical, EMI/EMC, thermal vacuum, vibration, and functional test plans. Ability to interpret test data for design feedback.
• Soft Skills – Good analytical, problem‑solving, and communication abilities. Strong teamwork and adaptability.

Preferred Skills

• Familiarity with RF processing system architecture and testing.
• Knowledge of space‑qualified microprocessors or FPGA families.
• Understanding of system power calculations throughout a design cycle.
• Awareness of space‑qualifying standards: NASA SP‑3008, ECSS‑E‑ST‑20C, MIL‑STD‑1553, SpaceWire, etc.

Compensation: Base salary range is $90,000-130,000/year, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA.

SEAKR is an Equal Opportunity Employer - All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

US Citizenship Required

jobs.title: Temporary Transportation & Trade Compliance Coordinator
jobs.description:
Our Story

Launched in 2015, Sol de Janeiro is a globally recognized, award-winning beauty brand, drawing inspiration from Brazil’s beauty rituals, warmth, and spirit. Sol de Janeiro delivers a sensory experience beloved by multi-generational consumers worldwide, with clinically proven results, transformative textures, and transportive fragrances.

Headquartered in New York and launched as a digitally native brand, we have expanded globally with teams in Paris, London, and Germany. Our commitment to excellence has earned high-profile honors, including being named one of TIME100’s 2024 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s 2024 World's Most Innovative Companies, and WWD Beauty Inc’s Power Brands of 2024, underscoring its leadership in the beauty industry and outstanding workplace. These accolades highlight our dedication to being a leading brand in the beauty industry and an exceptional workplace.

What You’ll Do

The Transportation & Trade Compliance Coordinator keeps inbound and outbound freight moving, from contract manufacturer pickup to confirmed delivery and goods receipt in SAP. Most of the role is transportation: scheduling and routing shipments, managing carrier costs and keeping every movement recorded accurately. The role also supports Customs with classification, documentation and compliance work, and reports to the Director, Transportation & Customs Compliance.

What You’ll Be Working On

Transportation (primary focus)

• Coordinate inbound freight from contract manufacturers (CMs): confirm ready dates, pallet counts and shipping documents, then schedule pickups.

• Plan and book outbound shipments against due dates, working with the warehouse on ship-ready status and pickup appointments.

• Pull freight estimates and quotes from carriers, comparing cost and transit time to pick the best option for each shipment.

• Negotiate rates with carriers on spot and recurring lanes, and bring recommendations to the Director.

• Schedule and route shipments across parcel, LTL and FTL; re-book quickly when a carrier rejects, misses or delays a load.

• Create and update shipments in SAP, post Goods Receipts and Goods Issues, and keep delivery dates current.

• Resolve quantity, PO and SAP discrepancies with CMs, the warehouse and Planning; escalate system issues to the right owner.

• Track shipments to delivery, keep the Transportation Tracker current (ETD, ETA, actual delivery) and flag delays early.

• Collect signed BOLs, proof of delivery and shipping documents, and hand complete cross-border paperwork to Customs.

• Check carrier invoices and accessorial charges, flag discrepancies and file freight claims for loss or damage.

Customs and trade compliance (supporting)

• Classify products and maintain the master classification file for new SKUs and duty rates, working with Merchandising on product launches.

• Prepare commercial invoices and proformas not supported by SAP, and manage broker clearance requests through the Customs inbox.

• Support country-of-origin certifications, free trade agreement documentation, drawback submissions and monthly duty forecasting.

• Perform internal entry audits and keep classification rationale on file, escalating technical decisions to the Customs lead.

Must Haves

Required

• 2+ years in transportation, logistics, freight coordination or supply chain operations.

• Hands-on SAP experience, including deliveries and Goods Issue / Goods Receipt postings, or the equivalent in another ERP.

• Experience booking and tracking shipments with carriers across parcel, LTL and FTL.

• Working knowledge of freight documents: bill of lading, proof of delivery, packing list, commercial invoice.

• Strong Excel skills: filters, lookups, pivot tables and keeping trackers clean.

• Comfort working across two functions and shifting priorities between Transportation and Customs as volume requires.

• Clear, professional written and phone communication with outside partners.

Preferred

• Experience working with contract manufacturers or third-party suppliers on inbound freight.

• Experience with a transportation management or shipment visibility platform.

• Experience with cross-border (US/Canada) shipments and working with customs brokers.

• Working knowledge of tariff classification, customs entries, country of origin or free trade agreement documentation.

• Experience with freight invoice audit or freight claims.

• Diploma or degree in supply chain, logistics or business.

#LI-hybrid

Salary Range

$30—$35 USD

Why Sol de Janeiro?

• Competitive salary and bonus program for full-time team members

• Flexible hybrid work environment with opportunities for collaboration and growth

• Inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and celebrates individuality

• The chance to be part of a fast-growing, award-winning global beauty brand

The information contained herein is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee, as these may change or new ones may be assigned at any time.

Data and Experimentation

Evaluation and Integration

​Desired Education:

jobs.title: ServiceNow Business Analyst
jobs.description:
LightFeather is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst to lead the requirements gathering and process design for our federal agency clients. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between federal business stakeholders and our technical development teams. You will be responsible for translating complex mission requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions, ensuring compliance with federal standards, and maintaining the highest quality of data in our backlog.. This is a Full Time, Remote Position.

• Location: Fully Remote (EST hours)

• Job Type: Full-time

• Salary: $110,000–$130,000 annually, based on experience

• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements and the need to obtain and maintain a Secret-level security clearance

Responsibilities

• Lead client workshops and focus groups to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, ensuring alignment with agency mission goals.

• Translate high-level business needs into comprehensive user stories, acceptance criteria (AC), and functional specifications within Agile/Scrum frameworks.

• Conduct gap analysis to identify the delta between current legacy processes and ServiceNow "Out of the Box" (OOTB) functionality.

• Collaborate directly with the Agile Coach to design, document, and distribute new Agile processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that support all ServiceNow delivery teams. Ensure these processes drive consistency, efficiency, and alignment across the broader program.

• Review all user stories and requirements for accuracy, completeness, and ambiguity. Ensure every story meets the team's "Definition of Ready" before it is approved for sprint planning.

• Provide guidance and mentorship to junior developers and junior analysts. Help them understand business context, federal domain constraints, and ServiceNow best practices to foster their professional growth.

• Conduct peer reviews of functional designs and test scripts to maintain high standards of quality control across the delivery team.

• Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and data models to visualize end-to-end service delivery.

• Advise government stakeholders on ServiceNow best practices, steering them away from excessive customization that creates technical debt.

• Collaborate with System Architects to ensure functional designs are technically feasible.

• Ensure all solution designs adhere to federal IT standards, including Section 508 compliance (accessibility) and FISMA/NIST security controls.

• Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, creating test scripts and coordinating testing sessions with government personnel.

• Create federal-grade deliverables, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), User Guides, and Training Decks.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

• U.S. Citizenship

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Level security clearance.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3 years dedicated to the ServiceNow platform.

• Proven experience working in the federal contracting space (DoD, DHS, or Civilian agencies).

• Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

• Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and at least one other major workflow (e.g., ITOM, HRSD, SPM, ITAM, Custom Applications).

• Strong experience with Jira, ServiceNow Agile, or Azure DevOps for backlog management.

• Proficiency in Visio, LucidChart, or similar tools for process mapping.

Preferred:
