jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Serval http://serval.com is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. 




THE MISSION

We’re scaling at a historic pace with a lean finance team, which only works if that team runs on systems, not spreadsheets. Today our finance data lives in disconnected places: ERP, CRM, Bill pay systems, our billing and usage data, payroll, and a lot of exports. Reconciliations, close tasks and reporting take more hands than they should.

You are the technical backbone of Serval Finance. Think of the role as an accounting automation engineer: you connect our finance data, build the data foundations behind sales, marketing and cost reporting, and automate manual accounting workflows, Serval first. Serval runs on Serval, and you will be one of its most demanding internal builders.

The role has two parts:

 - Finance transformation (most of your time). Own the finance systems roadmap, build automations and agents on Serval, and create a single, trusted view of our revenue, go-to-market and cost data so leadership can see where to invest, faster.

 - Corporate accounting (part time). Run and automate parts of the close yourself: account reconciliations, complex calculations, and day-to-day operations such as Ramp bills and corporate card management.

You'll report to Francisco Meyo, VP, Controller, and work closely with our Head of Finance, RevOps, Engineering, Sales and Marketing leadership, and our revenue accounting team.




WHO YOU ARE

 - A builder at heart. You scope what matters, prototype it and ship it yourself. You have built agents and automations that run in a real finance operation and that people still use.

 - Fluent in both languages. You understand the close, reconciliations and revenue well enough to spot what to automate, and you can write a spec an engineer respects.

 - A systems thinker. You design for the long run: clean data models, one source of truth, controls and audit trails built in, and workflows that flag their own exceptions.

 - Living on the AI frontier. You bring new techniques to the team as fast as the field moves, and you judge them by hours saved and errors removed, not by novelty.

 - Hands-on and unprecious. You will reconcile an account or code a Ramp bill today, and make sure nobody has to do it by hand next month.

 - Comfortable in ambiguity. You own your work end to end, set your own priorities from a messy backlog, and move without waiting to be told what to build next.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead finance transformation

 - Map manual workflows across Finance, rank automation opportunities by time saved and risk reduced, and own a prioritized backlog and roadmap.

 - Design and deploy Serval-first agents and workflows for reconciliations, journal entry preparation, accruals, close task tracking, variance analysis and reporting.

 - Own project plans, milestones and risks across initiatives, and report status to the VP, Controller and Head of Finance.

 - Evaluate and pilot new finance tools when Serval is not the right fit, and build the business case for adoption.

Build the data foundations

 - Connect Rillet, Salesforce, Ramp, our billing and usage data, payroll and marketing systems into one trusted finance data layer.

 - Build the data models behind sales, marketing and cost reporting, so bookings, pipeline, spend and unit economics come from one source of truth rather than exports.

 - Replace manual spreadsheets with automated dashboards that show leadership where we can invest, faster.

 - Act as Finance's primary partner to Engineering and RevOps on integrations and internal tooling, translating requirements into technical specs.

Run and automate corporate accounting (part time)

 - Own a set of close tasks hands-on, including account reconciliations and complex calculations, then automate them to shorten the close.

 - Manage day-to-day operations such as Ramp bills, corporate cards, vendor setup and spend approvals, and automate the routine flow.

 - Optimize Rillet as our ERP: chart of accounts, subledgers, workflows and reporting.

Keep it auditable

 - Design human-in-the-loop controls, audit trails and documentation so automated outputs are accurate and ready for external audit.

 - Write runbooks, train the Finance team on new tools, and own what you ship in production.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Experience: 6 to 10 years combined across accounting or finance operations and finance systems, including leading at least one implementation or transformation from planning through testing, training and go-live.

 - Hands-on AI build experience: you have built and deployed AI agents, LLM workflows or automations that run in production. Not AI-curious; you have shipped.

 - Accounting fluency: strong working knowledge of the close, reconciliations, accruals and revenue, enough to own close tasks yourself and spot what to automate.

 - Data skills: SQL and comfort building data models and dashboards from messy source systems such as an ERP, a CRM and spend tools.

 - Scripting: Python or similar for automation and integration work.

 - Integration experience: APIs, workflow or integration tools, and working directly with engineers on technical requirements.

 - Communication: you can explain a system design or a data gap to a non-technical executive and get a decision.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Rillet, Ramp, Salesforce or a modern data stack (warehouse, dbt, BI tools).

 - Exposure to Serval, as a customer, user or builder.

 - Background at a high-growth software or AI company.

 - Familiarity with internal controls, SOX or supporting external audits.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

 - Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

jobs.title: VP, Global Controller
jobs.description:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.


ABOUT DANDY

Dandy is seeking an accomplished leader to own the entire global Accounting and Treasury function within our Finance organization. This role will be the primary accounting partner to the C-suite as we continue to scale the company internationally and prepare for IPO.

We are looking for a senior leader with experience in rapidly building, developing and implementing financial systems, reporting, planning, cash management, and accounting policy. With the accounting function playing a critical role in Dandy’s vertical integration and international expansion, the ideal candidate must be excited to roll up their sleeves and become a part of the business. You will lead the build-out of a scalable accounting team to support a rapidly growing, complex and data intensive operating business, whilst also preparing the financial systems and processes for IPO.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Close, reporting and consolidation

 - Own financial reporting end to end: close, consolidation and account reconciliation. Move the monthly close from ~7+ days today to 3–4 days.

 - Lead the shift from annual to quarterly reporting. Deliver consistent quarterly closes and financial statements, including SEC-ready disclosures such as segments and EPS.

 - Set and enforce close standards. Own issues openly, explain results and close status clearly, and set a high bar across the team.

 - Push accounting upstream. Partner with People, Ops and FP&A so data is right in the source systems (HRIS/payroll, billing, procurement) before close starts.

IPO readiness, controls and audit

 - Own the relationship with our Big 4 auditor.

 - Lead SOX readiness: control gap assessment, remediation, segregation of duties, and access and change-management controls across financial systems.

 - Write and maintain formal accounting policies and technical accounting memos (revenue recognition, leases under ASC 842, stock comp, complex instruments, purchase price allocations).

Global and international

 - Be the primary accounting stakeholder for international expansion as we grow from a handful of entities to many more across Europe, LATAM and APAC.

 - Partner with Tax on transfer pricing, intercompany agreements, VAT and indirect tax, and a quarterly tax provision.

 - Simplify intercompany processes and build a consolidation model where new entities fit into the existing process instead of needing a new one each time.

 - Support global treasury and banking, including international banking partners and multi-currency AP and payments.

Manufacturing and cost accounting

 - Partner with Operations and FP&A on cost accounting for our labs: inventory, cost cards, labor allocation, and the fixed assets behind the scanner fleet and manufacturing equipment.

 - Make sure cost and margin data is accurate enough for leadership to make capital allocation and gross margin decisions.

Systems, FinOps and automation

 - Own the accounting systems roadmap, centered on NetSuite. That covers integrations with billing, Stripe, Avalara, the HRIS/payroll system, procure-to-pay, and fixed asset and lease tools.

 - Replace manual, spreadsheet-based processes with automated, auditable ones, and leverage AI tools

 - Partner with Business Systems on ITGCs, data governance and finance system administration.

Team leadership

 - Lead, develop and grow a global team across the US and LATAM: accounting, AP, AR/billing, payroll, treasury and international.

 - Design the target org over time and build the key public-company functions: technical accounting and SEC reporting, internal controls/SOX, and FinOps.

 - Work across Finance so information flows quickly and accurately between Accounting, FP&A, Tax and Treasury.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 12+ years of accounting experience, with senior accounting leadership at a high-growth, operationally complex company

 - Big 4 audit background

 - Hands-on experience preparing a company for IPO readiness or operating as a public company: SOX, SEC reporting, quarterly close

 - Ideally experience in a manufacturing, supply chain, or hardware-plus-services business, including inventory and cost accounting

 - A track record of building scalable accounting systems and processes, not just being a strong technical accountant

 - Multi-entity, international consolidation experience, including transfer pricing, intercompany and FX

 - Visible, accountable leadership: you own problems openly and lead your team through hard closes

 - Integrity and a practical, solution-oriented approach

 - Excellent communication, interpersonal and analytical skills. You can build trust with executives, auditors and peers at every level

 - Willingness to learn adjacent areas such as FP&A, Tax, People systems and Operations

 - Strong prioritization and project management in a fast-paced environment

 - Comfort in an innovative, disruptive culture

 - Tools: expert in NetSuite and Excel/Google Sheets; comfortable using AI to automate work


BONUS POINTS FOR

 - CPA and/or advanced degree

 - Experience at a tech or high-growth company, especially one that combines manufacturing or hardware with software

 - Experience implementing or remediating ERP, procure-to-pay or HRIS systems

 - Experience with purchase price allocations and integrating acquisitions

jobs.title: Senior Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
The Senior Director of Business Development is a multifaceted leadership role responsible for maintaining industry awareness, generating leads, managing customer relationships, obtaining requests for proposals, and leading the Business Development team. The ideal candidate will possess a robust network of professional connections within the space industry.

This individual will collaborate with executives to develop and execute SEAKR’s business development strategy through the pursuit of high-win-probability opportunities. The Director is also responsible for identifying new business opportunities and developing capture strategies to support executive management bid/no-bid decisions. To strategically position the company for future business opportunities, the Director is expected to provide clear input regarding future product offering needs as part of the IRAD planning and budgeting process.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate expertise in sales, negotiations, finance, and growth strategies while embodying an entrepreneurial mindset. This is a full-time exempt position that will serve as a key representative and “face of the company” within the industry. The Director is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy and sound judgment while maintaining strong alignment with executive leadership, effectively leading the Business Development team, adhering to company policies and processes, and delivering measurable business results.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

Strategic Planning: Develop and execute business development strategies to drive growth and achieve company objectives. Collaborate with executives to develop, articulate, and execute a business development strategy with short-, mid-, and long-term goals by providing input from industry, market, and competitive analysis, customer needs assessments, customer feedback, product definition feedback, and future mission requirements.

Sales and Revenue Growth: Drive sales initiatives and achieve revenue targets through effective business development strategies. Coordinate with executives to define and execute strategies to grow product segment market share and profitability through market opportunity evaluation and segmentation, value proposition development, product positioning, pricing strategy, branding and channel strategy, and communications strategy development.

Client Relationships: Establish and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including government agencies, defense contractors, and commercial aerospace companies. Establish and nurture customer relationships to understand current and future needs and promote alignment of the company’s current and future capabilities to meet those needs.

Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop members of the Business Development team to build a high-performing and accountable organization. Establish clear priorities, expectations, and ownership across the team; provide regular feedback and coaching; monitor performance and workload; and ensure team members have the direction, resources, and support necessary to successfully execute their responsibilities. Maintain an appropriate level of engagement and presence with the team to support collaboration, development, and effective execution of business development priorities.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the leadership team, engineering, business capture, and product development teams to align business development efforts with company goals. Align with the capture team to define technical, strategic, and business insight for RFI, ROM, whitepaper, and proposal responses.

Market Analysis: Identify and analyze market trends, customer needs, and the competitive landscape to uncover new business opportunities. Supervise marketing execution, including content for SEAKR’s website, product and marketing literature, trade show presence, trade journal articles, white papers, press releases, presentations, and datasheets. Represent the company at appropriate industry events, conferences, trade shows, and customer engagements to promote products and services.

Business Development Execution and Delegation: Establish clear ownership and accountability for business development activities across the team. Effectively delegate customer engagements, opportunity development, and other business development responsibilities to ensure appropriate coverage, develop team capabilities, and maximize organizational effectiveness. Maintain visibility into team activities, customer engagements, pipeline development, and key opportunities to ensure alignment with company priorities.

Policy and Expense Management: Demonstrate consistent compliance with company policies, procedures, and internal controls, including all Travel and Expense requirements. Utilize the company’s designated travel and expense management system (Concur) for business travel booking and expense reporting, as required by company policy, and ensure expenses are accurately documented and submitted in a timely manner. As a people leader, reinforce these expectations with members of the Business Development team and model appropriate stewardship of company resources.

Travel: Must be available to travel for business approximately 30%–50% of the time based on customer, program, and business needs. Travel should be purposeful and aligned with business development priorities, customer engagement requirements, and company objectives, while maintaining appropriate availability and presence to effectively lead and support the Business Development team. The Director is expected to exercise sound judgment in determining when in-person travel is necessary and when business objectives can be effectively accomplished through other means.

Supervisory Duties

• Provide direct leadership and oversight of members of the Business Development team.
• Establish individual and team priorities, goals, and performance expectations aligned with company objectives.
• Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, performance management, and professional development to team members.
• Effectively delegate responsibilities and customer engagements to develop team capabilities, ensure appropriate coverage, and maximize organizational effectiveness.
• Monitor team performance, workload, customer engagement, and execution against business development priorities.
• Assess organizational capabilities and resource needs and support the continued development and growth of the Business Development function.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, communication, and compliance with company policies and processes.

Education or Formal Training

• The ideal candidate will have a technical background and a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, with an emphasis in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
• A Master’s degree in Engineering Management or Program Management, or an MBA, is preferred.

Experience

• At least 15 years of technical business development experience, with demonstrated experience in the aerospace and/or space markets preferred.
• Demonstrated experience developing and executing business development and growth strategies within a technical environment.
• Proven experience developing and maintaining relationships with government, defense, aerospace, and/or commercial space customers.
• Demonstrated leadership experience, including managing, coaching, developing, and holding team members accountable for performance and results.
• Experience managing multiple business development opportunities, customer engagements, and capture activities simultaneously.

Security Clearance The candidate will either possess a TS/SCI with polygraph clearance or be capable of obtaining the required clearance.

Skills  Demonstrate strong analytical, negotiation, leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.

Compensation: Base salary range is $225,000-275,000, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA.

SEAKR is an Equal Opportunity Employer - All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

US Citizenship Required

Applications will be accepted until 11/06/26.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
LightFeather is seeking a ServiceNow Platform Engineer to own a new ServiceNow environment for a federal program. This position offers the opportunity to build an environment from the ground up (provisioning, configuration, security hardening, integration enablement, and readiness validation) within a secure federal enclave, and to serve as the platform owner supporting module implementation (including CMDB), platform upgrades, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is a hands-on platform expert who is comfortable taking an environment from zero to production and staying with it as it grows.

Major responsibilities include standing up, configuring, securing, and maintaining the ServiceNow platform, establishing the design and administration standards that keep the environment stable, and collaborating with security, infrastructure, and program stakeholders to deliver a compliant, production-ready platform.

• Location: Hybrid in Washington, D.C. 20036

• Job Type: Full-time

• Salary: $180,000–$200,000 annually, based on experience level.

• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements. Top Secret clearance is required. Candidates holding an active Secret clearance are encouraged to apply, and LightFeather sponsors an upgrade to Top Secret for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities

• Stand up and configure a new ServiceNow environment within a secure federal enclave, establishing the instance architecture, baseline configurations, and administration standards

• Install, configure, and maintain MID Servers and establish secure connectivity within the environment

• Configure authentication, authorization, and access management (LDAP/Active Directory, SSO/SAML, role-based access controls)

• Harden the platform in accordance with federal security and operational standards, including NIST and FISMA requirements and applicable DISA STIGs, and support Assessment and Authorization (ATO) activities

• Establish and maintain platform administration baselines, including system properties, plugin activation, instance security settings, and upgrade and patch management processes

• Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise systems using REST/SOAP web services and IntegrationHub, as permitted within the environment

• Support ongoing implementation and optimization of platform modules, including ITSM and CMDB, in collaboration with the broader team

• Maintain update sets, environment documentation, build procedures, and technical design records

• Utilize an Agile/Scrum methodology to manage platform and development work

• Participate in client calls and technical discussions, coordinating with security, infrastructure, and program stakeholders to resolve dependencies and design gaps early

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, and engineering on the ServiceNow platform

• Demonstrated experience standing up new ServiceNow instances or leading instance-level builds and migrations

• Strong scripting ability (server-side and client-side JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes)

• Experience with MID Server installation and configuration, and with platform integrations using REST/SOAP web services

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks (NIST, FISMA, STIGs)

• Experience working on project teams that leverage Agile/Scrum

• Demonstrable ability to communicate and listen well with business and technical people, regardless of title, with good self-awareness

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in federal or defense contracting environments, particularly in classified, air-gapped, or otherwise isolated networks.

• ServiceNow CAD (Certified Application Developer) or a CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist) certification.

• Hands-on experience with CMDB, ITOM, or Discovery.

• Experience with release coordination, version control, environment management, and automated testing strategies, including the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).

• Experience supporting Windows Server implementation, upgrades, and integrations as required by the environment.

jobs.title: Manager, Inventory & Demand Planning
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Zenni pioneered the online eyewear industry in 2003 with a mission to make eyewear affordable and accessible for everyone. With complete prescription pairs starting under $10, Zenni offers adults and children the freedom to see clearly and express themselves through a wide selection of high-quality prescription glasses, sunglasses, protective eyewear, and non-prescription frames - curated with fashion, function, and style in mind.

Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, Zenni has redefined the traditional retail model, emerging as the premier destination for online eyewear in the United States while surpassing 70 million frames sold globally.

Zenni is proud to be the Official Eyewear of the San Francisco 49ers, Columbus Crew, Monster Jam, WWE, Team Liquid, and more. Zenni has collaborated with designers and tastemakers on exclusive collections, including Chase Stokes and George and Claire Kittle. For more information, visit zenni.com.

About the Role

The Manager, Inventory and Demand Planning drives optimal inventory planning and investment to support optimal sales performance and margin execution.  This role blends strategic inventory financial and unit planning with operational demand forecasting to ensure inventory alignment with customer demand.  This role is responsible for driving subcategory in stock position, guiding a team of planners, and maintaining strong governance over sales targets, gross margins, and inventory performance.

In addition to managing team operations, this role will actively serve as a key player by directly owning and managing designated product categories for end-to-end planning across assigned commodities (Frames vs. Lens) and subcategories. Furthermore, the Manager will help lead the deployment and continuous enhancement of new planning systems, incorporating AI, and reporting & analytics tools. This leader will scale our planning capabilities and elevate organizational forecasting precision.

The ideal candidate blends strategic financial oversight with tactical demand planning at an item-level—managing subcategory Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgets, leading high-priority "A" SKU strategy at the factory/location level and ensuring optimal system logic for secondary product tiers.

Responsibilities:

• Financial & Strategic Planning (Monthly / Quarterly)

• Planning Execution & Governance: Review of monthly and quarterly sales, margin, and inventory reviews across subcategories, tracking performance against targets and resulting Open-to-Buy (OTB).

• Direct Category Ownership: Manage and own the end-to-end financial and demand planning for specific assigned subcategories alongside team management duties.

• Commodity & Subcategory Inventory & Open to Buy Strategy: Balance portfolio goals across primary commodities (Frames vs. Lens), optimizing gross margin and working capital.

• Inventory Allocation & Consolidation: Direct strategic stock reallocations, inventory consolidations, and safety stock adjustments across locations to prevent liabilities, stock outs, and maximize turnover.

• Team Supervision & Development: Manage and coach Merchandise Planners, establishing clear operational KPIs, workflows, and functional development plans.

• Demand Planning & Forecasting (Weekly / Operational)

• Systems & Analytics Deployment: Lead the integration, utilization, and ongoing refinement of planning software, algorithm tuning, analytical reporting tools, and AI capabilities across the team.

• Focus SKU Oversight: Direct hands-on planning and location/factory-level forecasting for core best-selling SKUs (50–100 items per planner), while maintaining and refining logic for B, C, and D SKUs.

• KPI & Risk Tracking: Lead weekly operational reviews of sales performance, forecast accuracy, out-of-stock (OOS) risks, and New Product Introduction (NPI) on-time deliveries.

• Lifecycle & Discontinuation Management: Oversee sell-through plans for discontinued items to ensure minimal liability to exit inventory and minimize write off risk.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven track record of working seamlessly with cross-functional teams (Product Category teams, Marketing, Procurement, Warehousing & Logistics) to align business strategies and execute unified plans.

• Work closely with the Procurement team to ensure that timely purchases are made fulfilling open to buy requirements.

Basic Qualifications:

• Analytical Leadership: Strong ability to synthesize large datasets, translate numbers into actionable strategies, and present clear solutions to management.

• Financial Acumen: Expertise in translating item-level demand into dollar projections, gross margins, and working capital requirements.

• Predictive Forecasting: Deep understanding of promotional lift, seasonal curves, sales velocity, and historical trend modeling.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to build strong partnerships across teams and integrate diverse input into a unified demand plan.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

• Technical Proficiency and AI adaptability: Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, complex formulas, pivot tables, data structuring), and adopting artificial intelligence into functional requirements.

• Enterprise Systems: Hands-on experience implementing, using, and managing teams within enterprise planning software (e.g., Anaplan, Blue Yonder, SAP APO/IBP, Oracle Retail).

• Experience: 4–6+ years of progressive experience in merchandise financial planning or demand planning, including direct category ownership and supervisory experience.

U.S. Perks & Benefits:

• Annual Bonus Program

• Healthcare: 100% premiums covered for medical, dental, and vision for employees (50% for dependents)

• Basic Life and AD&D with option for additional voluntary coverage

• Short and long term disability coverage

• 401k with up to 4% match

• EAP and Spring Health that gives you and dependents access to free therapy and coaching

• Free access for you and your family to our digital wellness platform - Wellness Coach

• FTO (Flex Time Off) in addition to our Week of Zen - the time between Christmas and New Year’s to relax and recuperate

• Fully Paid Parental Leave - 16 weeks for birthing and non-birthing parents

• Family forming & fertility support and services through Maven

• Annual Zenni Gift Card - to use towards our products!

(U.S. ONLY) Please Note: We are registered in some, but not all states. If you are located in one of the following states full time, we welcome you to apply: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Virginia.

At Zenni Optical, people remain the heart of our mission, even as we embrace technology that moves us forward. While we recognize the immense promise of AI, we are equally mindful of its limitations and use these tools strictly to assist our Talent Acquisition team rather than replace human judgment. We utilize AI tools as a collaborative partner to create content–such as job descriptions, interview questions, and outreach messaging–and review resumes, but we maintain a firm commitment to human-led hiring where AI never makes a final decision. Every selection is determined by a member of our team to ensure every candidate is personally valued by a human rather than an algorithm.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We strive to build a diverse team of individuals with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t feel you meet all the qualifications.

Zenni Optical is an equal opportunity workplace and considers applications without regard to race, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Principal Data Architect
jobs.description:
About ParetoHealth

ParetoHealth is redefining the way employers fund healthcare. As the largest and fastest-growing benefits captive in the United States, we help thousands of small and midsize employers take control of healthcare costs through a smarter, more sustainable model.

Our mission is simple: give small and midsize employers the scale and protection they need to eliminate volatility and lower healthcare costs.

By combining data-driven insights, innovative risk management, and the collective purchasing power of our community, we enable employers to reduce volatility, improve long-term outcomes, and reinvest savings into their businesses and their people.

Headquartered in Philadelphia, ParetoHealth is growing rapidly and transforming one of the country's largest industries. Our success is fueled by talented people who are united by our four core values: Fire in the Belly, For the Greater Good, See the Field, and Get It Done Right. These values shape how we innovate, collaborate, make decisions, and deliver exceptional results for our clients and one another.

If you're energized by solving complex challenges, thrive in a high-growth environment, and want to help reshape the future of healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

Please note that ParetoHealth does not provide employment visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship both now or in the future.

Position Summary:

As Principal Data Architect, you will define and drive the enterprise data architecture strategy across ParetoHealth, enabling trusted, connected, secure, and AI-ready data products that power business intelligence, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation.

You will work across business, product, engineering, analytics, and AI teams to translate complex business needs into scalable data platforms and architectures. You will bring deep expertise in modern data architecture, strong technical judgment, and the ability to navigate complex data ecosystems, ideally within healthcare, health insurance, employee benefits, or financial services.

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role for someone who can think strategically, influence across the organization, and drive implementation from vision to execution.

Key Responsbilities:

Enterprise Data Architecture & Strategy

• Define and evolve the enterprise data architecture, data models, integration patterns, and technology standards to support ParetoHealth’s business and technology strategy.

• Design scalable, resilient, and cost-effective data architectures across operational systems, analytical platforms, and data products.

• Establish canonical data models and shared business entities across domains, enabling consistent definitions and reliable data exchange.

• Drive architectural decisions that balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability, flexibility, and maintainability.

Modern Data Platforms & Engineering

• Architect modern cloud-based data platforms and lakehouse or warehouse solutions that support batch, streaming, and near-real-time data processing.

• Establish patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data quality, metadata management, lineage, and observability.

• Enable interoperable data products and APIs that make trusted data accessible to applications, analytics, and AI systems.

• Partner with engineering teams to establish best practices for data modeling, platform reliability, performance, security, and cost optimization.

Healthcare & Insurance Data

• Design data architectures that integrate complex, fragmented data across healthcare, health insurance, employee benefits, employer groups, claims, eligibility, provider networks, and financial systems, as applicable.

• Develop a strong understanding of healthcare benefits and insurance business processes, data entities, and industry-specific interoperability requirements.

• Enable secure and governed access to sensitive healthcare and personally identifiable information, incorporating HIPAA and other applicable regulatory and privacy requirements.

• Translate complex healthcare and insurance data into consistent, usable models that support business operations, financial analysis, cost transparency, and better decision-making.

AI, Analytics & Data Products

• Build an AI-ready data foundation that enables machine learning, generative AI, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation.

• Define architectures for high-quality, contextual, discoverable, and governed data that can be safely consumed by AI applications.

• Partner with data science, analytics, product, and engineering teams to enable predictive insights, operational intelligence, and data-driven product innovation.

• Establish data product principles that emphasize business ownership, trusted metrics, reusability, and measurable business outcomes.

Technical Leadership & Governance

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering, product, business, security, and executive stakeholders.

• Define architectural standards, reference architectures, design principles, and technical roadmaps.

• Drive alignment across teams and influence decisions without relying solely on formal authority.

• Mentor senior engineers and data architects, raise the bar for technical excellence, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications / Skills:

• 12+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data platforms, or related technical disciplines, with demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale architecture.

• Proven track record designing and implementing modern cloud data platforms and complex data integration architectures.

• Strong expertise in data modeling, dimensional and relational modeling, distributed data processing, data pipelines, and data platform design.

• Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, cloud-native data services, Kafka or equivalent streaming technologies, dbt, and contemporary orchestration tools.

• Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, access controls, privacy, and security.

• Experience architecting data platforms that support enterprise analytics, operational applications, and AI/ML use cases.

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence senior technical and business stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to move from architecture strategy to practical implementation and measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in healthcare, health insurance, employee benefits, healthcare technology, or payer/provider ecosystems.

• Familiarity with healthcare data standards and interoperability frameworks such as FHIR, HL7, X12, and relevant claims and eligibility data formats.

• Experience working with sensitive healthcare or insurance data in regulated environments, including HIPAA compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of healthcare economics, medical and pharmacy claims, stop-loss insurance, self-funded employer health plans, or benefits administration.

• Experience building governed data products and AI-ready platforms that enable advanced analytics and intelligent automation.

• Experience modernizing legacy data ecosystems and integrating data across acquisitions, multiple platforms, or fragmented enterprise systems.

Perks & Benefits:

• Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits.

• Flexible PTO

• 401k company contribution

• Tuition reimbursement

• Professional development allowance

• Transportation allowance and daily parking reimbursement

• Engaging hybrid work environment

We are guided by our values:

Fire in the belly

The drive to learn, to improve, and to deliver outstanding value every day.

See the field

The ability to see the big picture and prepare to meet tomorrow’s needs.

Get it done right

The passion to produce at higher rates and to the highest standards.

For the greater good

A united community creating better health benefit solutions for all.

jobs.title: Data Manager Consultant (Remote)
jobs.description:

Join our team: you can be part of making a difference in peoples’ lives and experience a fulfilling and rewarding career!

The Data manager will be responsible for leading data management (DM) activities for clinical trials including database set up, study conduct and close-out. The Data manager will work collaboratively with a cross functional team to maintain project timelines and to deliver high quality DM deliverables. Key responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

• Lead Data management activities and ensure study deliverables meet timelines and quality standards.

• Review of Clinical research documents (e.g. protocols, Case Report Forms).

• Create and review electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) specifications.

• Develop critical DM documents such as the Data Management Plan, Data Validation Plan, eCRF Completion Guidelines, Data Entry Guidelines and Data Review Plan. Develop edit rules/checks, query logic and query messages.

• Develop User Acceptance Testing Plan and perform testing on data entry screens and edit checks.

• Create and provide training to the clinical team and sites.

• Perform ongoing data review/reconciliation activities and provide metrics and patient trackers to monitor data clean up.

• Perform database lock/unlock and freeze/unfreeze activities as appropriate for statistical review, interim analysis, and final database lock.

• Coordinate the archiving of study databases and related documents

• Create Data Transfer Specifications and perform external vendor reconciliation.

• Perform SAE reconciliation.

• Work to maintain/improve client satisfaction by ensuring high quality service, communication and management of clinical data.

Qualification

• Bachelor’s degree in clinical/pharmacy biological/mathematical sciences or related field or nursing degree.

• Atleast 3 years data management and/or related work experience in a pharmaceutical industry.

• Working knowledge of Clinical research and clinical trial process and related regulatory requirement and terminology.

• Strong knowledge and experience in several Electronic Data capture systems such as Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm, OpenClinica and Medrio.

• Perform duties in compliance with SOPs, GCP and ICH guidelines.

• Ability to prioritize and to adapt quickly in fast-paced and changing industry conditions.

• Ability to lead a study or data management team independently.

jobs.title: Business Office Director
jobs.description:
Nestled in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood on a nine-acre campus, the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL) is the leading senior services organization in Northern California. Our continuum of care includes: the Frank Residences assisted living and memory care; the Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center, offering long-term skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation, an acute geriatric psychiatric unit for adults over the age of 65; and our Foundation.

Founded in 1871 and formerly known as the Jewish Home, our legacy grounds us as our vision propels us forward. Today, we've evolved to support more than 2,500 older adults each year through innovative, comprehensive programs rooted in the Jewish values of compassion, community, and excellence. We are equally proud of our inclusive culture, where 950 team members of diverse faiths and backgrounds work together in shared purpose.

WHY WORK WITH US

• Mission-driven nonprofit organization

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Meaningful work that positively impacts the lives of older adults every day

• Inclusive community, welcoming to all (you do not need to be Jewish to live or work here)

• Supportive, team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

• Collaborative leadership focused on enhancing the employee experience

POSITION SUMMARY

As the Business Office Director, you will oversee day-to-day billing, collections, cash posting, and resident account operations for the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL). You will lead Patient Financial Services (PFS) staff and ensure claims are submitted accurately and timely, payments are posted correctly, and accounts receivable are actively managed to resolution across all payer types. This role serves as a key financial resource for residents and families and works closely with Admissions, Case Management, MDS, Accounting, and other departments to ensure complete and accurate billing information, strong revenue cycle performance, and compliance with applicable reimbursement requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Billing & Claims

• Oversee the timely and accurate generation and submission of claims (UB-04/837I) to Medicare, Medi-Cal, and managed care payers, including crossover claims for dual-eligible residents.
• Maintain a clean claim rate above 95% and ensure claims are submitted within five (5) days of the billing cycle.
• Participate in the monthly Triple Check process with Nursing, MDS, and Case Management to confirm charges and supporting documentation are accurate before claims are released.
• Ensure payer-specific billing requirements are followed and work with responsible departments to resolve missing, incomplete, or inconsistent billing information.

Cash Posting & Reconciliation

• Oversee the posting of Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) and Explanation of Benefits (EOB) payments in PointClickCare (PCC) and ensure payments are applied to the appropriate accounts.
• Identify underpayments, overpayments, and rejected payments and escalate significant payer issues to the Chief Financial Officer.
• Collaborate with Accounting to reconcile cash receipts to bank activity and the general ledger each month.

Denials & Appeals

• Review remittance advice for denied, rejected, or delayed payments and ensure technical rejections are corrected and resubmitted.
• File and track payer appeals, including Medicare redeterminations and Medi-Cal Treatment Authorization Request (TAR) denials.
• Monitor and report denials by root cause and identify recurring issues requiring staff education, workflow changes, or process improvements.
• Work toward maintaining a denial rate below 5%.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

• Review accounts receivable aging reports weekly and prioritize collection activity by payer and aging category.
• Ensure appropriate payer follow-up occurs on all outstanding claims older than 30 days.
• Maintain clear biller assignments by payer and regularly review individual portfolios to identify unresolved or aging balances.
• Work toward maintaining days in accounts receivable below 45 days and resolving 98% of collectible balances within 90 days.
• Provide detailed aged accounts receivable and collectability assessments to support bad-debt reserve calculations and year-end audit activities.

Resident & Family Accounts

• Issue monthly private-pay statements and serve as a primary point of contact for residents, families, and responsible parties regarding billing and account questions.
• Establish payment plans and apply the organization’s charitable care policy when appropriate.
• Manage the resident trust fund in accordance with applicable federal and state requirements.
• Oversee petty cash and on-site payment collections.

Eligibility & Admissions Support

• Partner with Admissions to verify insurance eligibility and coverage at admission and monthly using payer portals and eligibility tools, including Availity.
• Confirm authorizations, payer information, financial classifications, and billing types are accurately established in PointClickCare.

Reporting & Revenue Cycle Operations

• Prepare monthly business office reports for the Chief Financial Officer, including collections, accounts receivable aging, denials, payer mix, and days in accounts receivable.
• Serve as the Patient Financial Services representative on the Revenue Cycle Team.
• Support PointClickCare optimization initiatives, including workflow improvements and staff training.

Staff Leadership & Development

• Supervise, schedule, train, and develop billing and collections staff.
• Establish work procedures and hold staff accountable for established performance goals.
• Maintain current business office procedures and ensure staff receive appropriate training regarding payer, reimbursement, and regulatory changes.
• Promote accountability, accuracy, customer service, and effective collaboration within Patient Financial Services and across departments.

Compliance

• Ensure billing, collection, and resident account activities comply with applicable CMS, Medicare, Medi-Cal, HIPAA, and organizational requirements.
• Maintain current knowledge of reimbursement and regulatory changes affecting billing, collections, and revenue cycle operations.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

JOB DETAILS

• Pay Rate: $159,361 – $176,135 annually
• Hours: Full-Time, Exempt
• Shift Schedule: Business Hours | Monday – Friday
• Days Off: Saturday & Sunday
• Working Days: Monday through Friday

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Associate degree in Business, Accounting, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
• Minimum of three (3) years of healthcare billing and collections experience, including at least two (2) years of experience supervising business office staff.
• Working knowledge of Medicare, Medi-Cal, and managed care billing requirements for skilled nursing or long-term care and acute geriatric psychiatric care.
• Experience managing accounts receivable and collection activities.
• Proficiency with billing software and electronic health record systems.
• Strong understanding of healthcare billing, claims submission, reimbursement, collections, and revenue cycle processes.
• Strong customer service skills with the ability to effectively communicate with residents, families, payers, and internal stakeholders.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and operational responsibilities simultaneously.
• Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive financial and resident information.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
• Experience with PointClickCare (PCC) and Inovalon.
• Experience in a nonprofit, geriatric, senior living, skilled nursing, or related healthcare environment.
• Experience managing a resident trust fund.
• Revenue cycle certification, such as Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
• Ability to stand and move throughout office and campus environments as needed.
• Ability to perform repetitive keyboarding and other fine motor activities associated with computer-based work.
• Ability to communicate effectively in person, electronically, and by telephone.
• Good visual and auditory acuity to perform the essential functions of the position.

OUR INVESTMENT IN YOU

Comprehensive benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage; a 403(b) Retirement Plan; Paid Time Off (PTO); Tuition Reimbursement; Commuter Benefits; and Weekday Shuttle Service to and from Glen Park BART Station.

The San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.



This is Bedrock's first dedicated Safety Technical Program Manager, a role built to establish the execution structure that lets us roll out new autonomy capabilities quickly without compromising safety rigor. As we scale to new machine types and expanded operational domains, we are evolving our safety practices toward more explicit, strategic execution.

You will own program execution for the safety, systems engineering, and state estimation work that makes autonomous heavy equipment safe to operate in the real world. This is a hands-on individual contributor role driving alignment and delivery across engineering, safety, autonomy, hardware, and field operations through influence, structure, and clear communication. You will be the connective tissue between safety strategy and technical delivery, making sure requirements are traceable, dependencies are visible, and risks surface early enough to act on. We are a startup that values agility. We believe that speed and safety are compatible when the traceability behind them is solid.



What you'll do

 - Own planning and strategic execution for the safety and systems portions of the autonomy roadmap, from requirements through validated field deployment.

 - Support safety requirements being traceable, reusable across platforms and sites, and integrated into roadmaps from inception, partnering with safety and systems engineering on hazard analysis, validation evidence, and release readiness.

 - Build and maintain the validation plan spanning simulation and on-site testing, ensuring system-level changes are verified before they reach customers.

 - Map and actively manage dependencies and tradeoffs across systems, hardware, software, state estimation, and safety, weighing safety impact alongside schedule impact and identifying single points of failure on the critical path before they slip.

 - Drive program reviews, risk, and change management for multi-disciplinary, safety-critical initiatives, and provide reporting on roadmap health, delivery status, and safety implications clear enough to support both executive decisions and customer-facing discussions.

 - Translate field signals into prioritized engineering work and tracking issues to resolution.



What you'll bring

 - 7+ years of technical program management experience, including 2+ years leading programs involving safety-critical or high-integrity systems.

 - Domain experience in robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace, or another physical-world safety-critical domain, with a working understanding of the software, firmware, and hardware stacks behind real-world autonomy.

 - Working familiarity with a functional safety standard, such as ISO 26262 or IEC 61508, and how it shapes program structure, evidence, and release gates.

 - Enough working fluency in statistics and probability to interpret validation results and reliability metrics critically, not just track that they exist.

 - Understanding of the rigor, validation, and cross-functional coordination required to operate reliably in the physical world.

 - A track record of managing complex, cross-functional programs under ambiguity, taking systems from concept to production.

 - The ability to operate at a deep technical level and to distill complex risks and interdependencies into aligned, actionable plans for engineers and executives alike.

 - Strong dependency, risk, and change-management instincts in environments where safety and schedule are both non-negotiable.

 - A track record of thriving in fast-paced, high-ownership environments, with startup experience strongly preferred and a bias toward building structure that helps us scale through complexity.

 - Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.



Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Title: Senior Data Analyst

Location: Austin, TX (hybrid) or Dallas, TX (Hybrid)

Reports To: Senior Manager, Insurance Analytics

About Hippo:

Hippo was built on a promise: make homeownership effortless. Nearly a decade later, that mission still drives us. We use technology and data to help our customers stay ahead of problems and protect what matters most.

Today, that same tech-native approach powers our work beyond homeowners. Hippo operates as a diversified carrier platform, partnering with MGAs to deliver tailored program solutions that help them grow and deliver better customer experiences. Behind that work is a team that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

If you're energized by building what's next, we'd love to meet you.

About You:

The Senior Data Analyst will play a key role in supporting Hippo’s Business Enablement & Insights function, with a primary focus on Sales, Marketing, and growth analytics.

This role will support new product launches, market expansion, and ongoing growth initiatives by building a clear view of performance across the full customer funnel, from marketing spend and leads through quotes, binds, premium, and ongoing customer performance. The analyst will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data Science, and Data Engineering to understand what is driving performance, identify issues and opportunities, and provide the analysis needed to make informed business decisions.

This role goes beyond reporting. The analyst will be expected to connect data across multiple sources, diagnose performance changes, support forecasting and experimentation, and translate findings into clear recommendations for the business.

As part of a centralized analytics team, this individual will also help improve the underlying data, metrics, and analytical processes needed to support growth initiatives and the broader Sales & Marketing organization.

• You have a bias for action and enjoy taking analytical questions from problem definition through recommendation

• You have experience supporting growth, marketing, sales, product, or other customer-facing analytics

• You are comfortable working across the full funnel and understanding how marketing activity translates into customers and business results

• You go beyond reporting metrics and focus on understanding why performance changed and what the business should do about it

• You are comfortable working with imperfect or evolving data and can help identify and resolve data quality and measurement gaps

• You are curious, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying trends, risks, and opportunities

• You can take complex analysis and communicate it clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• You thrive in a cross-functional environment and are comfortable working with evolving priorities

What You’ll Do:

• Build and maintain reliable views of the customer funnel across marketing spend, leads, quotes, applications, binds, premium, and conversion

• Analyze marketing channel performance across metrics such as CPL, CAC, CPB, conversion, lead quality, and premium to help inform investment decisions

• Support customer and market segmentation by analyzing customer, home, geographic, channel, and conversion characteristics

• Partner with Marketing and Data Science on experimentation, including defining hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, sample-size requirements, and post-test analysis

• Support forecasting and AOP planning through scenario modeling across marketing spend, conversion, CAC, premium, capacity, and market expansion assumptions

• Develop state- and market-level performance analysis to support launch sequencing and measure performance as new products or initiatives expand

• Monitor performance after launch and proactively identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities

• Partner with Data Engineering and other teams to improve attribution, tracking, data quality, and integration across systems such as Salesforce, marketing platforms, product analytics, and policy data

• Help transition recurring manual analyses into scalable datasets, dashboards, and monitoring processes

• Develop executive-ready insights and recommendations that clearly explain what happened, why it happened, and what action should be taken

• Provide analytical support across the broader Sales & Marketing portfolio as priorities evolve

Must Haves:

• 3–5 years of experience in business analytics, growth analytics, marketing analytics, strategy, or a related field

• Strong SQL, Excel, and data visualization skills; Tableau experience preferred

• Experience analyzing customer or marketing funnels, conversion performance, customer acquisition, or related growth metrics

• Experience working with multiple data sources and identifying data quality, attribution, or measurement issues

• Strong analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to move from a performance trend to root-cause analysis and recommendation

• Experience with forecasting, scenario modeling, or business planning

• Ability to translate complex analysis into clear and actionable insights for senior stakeholders

• Strong communication and cross-functional partnership skills

• A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of ambiguous analytical problems

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities

Nice to Have:

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, financial services, or another highly regulated industry

• Experience with marketing attribution, digital marketing analytics, or experimentation

• Familiarity with customer segmentation, LTV, retention, or predictive modeling concepts

• Experience supporting a new product launch or geographic expansion

Hippo treats its team members with the same level of dedication and care as we do our customers, which is why we’re fortunate to provide all of our Hippos with:

We also offer a 401(k)-retirement plan, short & long-term disability, employer-paid life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
HELP BUILD THE NEXT CATEGORY-DEFINING AI COMPANY

AI has transformed how we write, communicate, and build software. The next frontier is even bigger: transforming how businesses actually operate. That's what we're building at Sola.

Sola is an AI-native platform reinventing enterprise process automation and disrupting legacy RPA tools. Our AI agents can execute complex workflows across any application, browser, desktop, or legacy system—free from the limitations and fragility of traditional automation tools. Users simply record their screen, and Sola creates a custom agent to run that process at scale.

The opportunity at hand is enormous. Nearly every enterprise, across every industry, runs on processes that are still painfully manual. We're building the technology to change that. And we're just getting started.

We're hiring a small group of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bring Sola to the world's largest enterprises and rewrite the playbook for how automation is built in the enterprise.

 


WHY SOLA? WHY NOW?

 


A MASSIVE MARKET READY FOR REINVENTION.

Enterprise automation is one of the biggest opportunities in AI. Legacy automation platforms have been constrained by rigid rules, complex implementations, and brittle workflows.. Sola is changing that with AI agents that can reason, adapt, and execute work across enterprise systems: the next generation of a massive software category.

 


REAL TRACTION. SERIOUS MOMENTUM.

Sola today powers enterprise workflows across healthcare, finance, legal, logistics, and more, including at Fortune 500 companies. We've closed seven-figure enterprise deals with a lean team. The product is proven. The market is responding. Now we're building the team to scale it.

 


BUILD ALONGSIDE LEADERS WHO'VE DONE IT BEFORE.

Work alongside David Fullerton, formerly CTO of Heap (Series C to acquisition) and Stack Overflow (Series A to E), as well as Sola's founders Neil Deshmukh and Jessica Wu. You'll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional engineers and help shape how the company grows.

 


EARLY-STAGE OWNERSHIP. EXCEPTIONAL UPSIDE.

Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Conviction, and Y Combinator, Sola has raised more than $20M to build the future of enterprise automation.

We’re still early enough that individual contributions can meaningfully influence the company’s trajectory, and you’ll have a direct influence on how the FDE role evolves over time.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Sola, you'll combine hands-on technical execution with customer-facing communication and partnership.

 - Dive deep on customer workflow failures using logs, browser tools, APIs, and code, then implement and verify fixes

 - Build custom integrations and contribute production code to Sola's platform, turning recurring customer needs into reusable improvements

 - Join customer calls alongside Customer Success, ask questions that clarify the problem, and own the solution through resolution

 - Help customers onboard and adapt their workflows to Sola, including occasional travel for customer onboarding and key projects as needed

 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're open to early-career engineers, new graduates with demonstrated programming ability, or strong customer-facing engineers who are comfortable writing production code.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you have:

 - Strong technical foundations, whether from a CS degree with demonstrated coding abilities, or hands-on experience in a strong technical environment

 - Flexibility to move across different customer environments, with a solid understanding of how core web technologies work and the ability to dive into complex desktop or legacy systems

 - A strong sense of curiosity and a drive to go anywhere needed to solve tricky customer problems

 - Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical findings into clear non-technical explanations

You'll work 5 days a week out of our office in NYC (we'll cover relocation!) and occasionally travel to customers as needed.

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Sola offers competitive salary plus meaningful equity at Series A stage. Exact compensation is based on experience and level.

We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, daily meals together in the office, flexible PTO (4 weeks per year), and relocation support for candidates not already based in NYC.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Data/ML
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

As Group Product Manager for Data/ML, you'll drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Discord's Machine Learning Platform and its applications, particularly to Advertising, while also championing how the broader company uses data to make product decisions. This is a horizontal role reporting to the VP of Product, Business that touches nearly every product team at Discord, as well as core technical teams, so you'll need to be comfortable driving alignment across stakeholders whose goals are sometimes in tension.

What you'll be doing

• Guide the product philosophy, vision, and roadmap for Discord's ML Platform and its key use cases (Personalization, Notifications, Safety, Advertising, Recommendations).

• Own performance against key data and ML business metrics, and proactively report progress to stakeholders across the company.

• Collaborate deeply with Applied ML, ML Platform, and Data Science to build and prioritize the ML roadmap for our Advertising products.

• Advise product teams across Discord on how to build and instrument their products with data-first capabilities from the start.

• Drive cross-functional execution across all product areas, working with engineers/MLEs, security, legal, and policy partners as needed.

What you should have

• 8+ years of combined experience in data science and product management, including direct, hands-on experience as a data scientist or in a similarly quantitative role before moving into product.

• 3-5+ years of product management experience owning algorithmic, data-driven systems (e.g., bidding, ranking, personalization, and/or recommendations systems), including responsibility for prioritization, trade-offs, and timelines.

• Proven ability to analyze and synthesize data directly, not just interpret it secondhand, including comfort with the statistical and quantitative fundamentals behind modern ML systems.

• Demonstrated technical proficiency working closely with ML/data engineers, including familiarity with ML fundamentals, enough to cut through the buzz and separate what's practical at scale from what isn't.

• Experience operating across international or distributed teams and stakeholders.

Bonus Points

• Experience in performance advertising and real-time bidding specifically.

• Proficiency in modern BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, or similar).

• Passion for games, gaming, or online communities.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

For this role, the Hiring Manager would like folks to be in the office 3 days a week.

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Base Salary

$304,000—$380,000 USD

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

jobs.title: Hardware Integration & Test Electrical Engineer III
jobs.description:

You will coordinate and perform the integration and characterization of the product and help lead / assist with the implementation of continuation engineering changes as needed. This role includes planning the activities for product integration, characterization and test and then performing those efforts in the lab using standard lab equipment to troubleshoot issues that occur during test to ensure quality final product. If you like hands-on hardware test in a lab environment, this position is a perfect fit.

• Read and understand digital and analog schematics.
• Review and clarify production travelers and test procedures.
• Test and troubleshoot complex electronics systems from the component level to the system functionality level.
• Read and edit software test scripts.
• Analyze production metrics and lead efforts to increase production yield or clarify test flows.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills are necessary to be successful.
