• Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent preferred.

Experience

• Minimum of 7 years of program or project management experience within telecommunications, technology, or related industries.

• Minimum of 3 years managing customer-facing or partner-facing implementation and delivery programs.

• Proven success managing complex service deployments, network implementations, or technology rollouts.

• Experience coordinating multiple workstreams across engineering, operations, commercial, and external partner organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting wireless, mobile network, satellite communications, or telecommunications services.

• Experience working with network operators, technology vendors, system integrators, or enterprise customers.

• Knowledge of service delivery, deployment, readiness, and operational support functions.

• Experience managing phased deployments, pilot programs, field trials, or commercial launches.

• Multi-country or global program delivery experience.

• Experience within highly regulated or mission-critical operational environments.

• PMP, SAFe, Agile, or other project/program management certifications.

Soft Skills

• Strong leadership and organizational skills.

• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication abilities.

• Outstanding stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Proven ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative, team-oriented, and service-focused mindset.

• Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.

• High attention to detail and commitment to execution excellence.

Technology Stack

• Project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira)

• Collaboration and documentation platforms (e.g., Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams)

• Program reporting and dashboard tools

• Issue and risk management tracking systems

• Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio

• Workflow automation and productivity platforms

• AI-enabled tools for planning, reporting, documentation, and productivity

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.

• Occasional travel to partner locations, operational facilities, testing sites, and project meetings.

• Ability to work within technical, laboratory, network operations, or deployment environments as required.

• Ability to effectively collaborate with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

• Ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

• Flexibility to support critical deployment milestones, service launches, and operational readiness activities when needed.

This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands.

AST SpaceMobile is an Equal Opportunity, at will Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Product & Merchandise Analytics
jobs.description:
Vuori is looking for a Product Manager to join our Product & Merchandising Analytics pod, supporting Product Development, Merchandising, Merchandise Planning, Wholesale, and Supply Chain, in partnership with ERP and business systems teams.

You will partner with the Director to shape the analytics roadmap and independently lead initiatives from discovery through delivery and adoption. Your work will support decisions across the product lifecycle, including product cost and margin, assortment strategy, planning, distribution, and inventory management.

You will work directly with business leaders, analytics leads, engineers, and reporting developers to identify problems worth solving and deliver the data and tools needed to solve them. We’re looking for someone who can challenge assumptions, navigate competing priorities, and turn an open-ended business question into a clearly scoped solution. You should be equally comfortable discussing business tradeoffs with senior leaders and working through metric definitions and data requirements with the delivery team.

What you'll get to do:

• Shape the roadmap and own initiatives. Partner with the Director to define priorities for Product & Merchandising Analytics, independently managing initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and day-to-day product decisions.
• Lead discovery. Understand how teams make decisions and where they encounter friction. Challenge assumptions and determine whether the right solution is reporting, improved data, automation, or a change to the workflow.
• Prioritize for business value. Evaluate requests based on business impact, urgency, effort, and dependencies. Recommend what to pursue, defer, or stop, and secure alignment when needs compete.
• Define what needs to be built. Translate business questions and operational workflows into clear requirements, metric definitions, data needs, and acceptance criteria. Establish scope and success measures before development begins.
• Drive delivery with the scrum team. Own the product backlog and partner with engineers and reporting developers on sprint planning, scope decisions, and issue resolution to keep work moving.
• Establish reliable data and consistent definitions. Partner with business owners and engineering to connect product, assortment, planning, sales, inventory, purchase order, and ERP data. Resolve conflicting definitions, validate results, and make data limitations clear.
• Lead validation, rollout, and adoption. Coordinate business testing, resolve issues before release, and ensure teams understand how to use solutions within their existing workflows.
• Own outcomes after launch. Use adoption, business feedback, and agreed success measures to assess impact, guide improvements, and retire reporting that is no longer needed.
• Manage cross-team dependencies. Coordinate with other analytics pods and business systems teams on shared metrics, data definitions, and delivery dependencies, avoiding conflicting solutions and duplicate work.
• Apply AI where it adds value. Identify opportunities for AI-enabled insights and workflow automation. Prototype and validate ideas, partnering with Engineering and DS&AI on Product-led, jointly built, or Engineering-led solutions as appropriate. Use approved AI tools in your own work to improve discovery, specifications, analysis, and prototyping.
• Keep stakeholders informed and decisions moving. Communicate priorities, progress, tradeoffs, and risks clearly. Bring recommendations, surface decisions that need leadership input, and escalate issues before they become delivery blockers.

Who you are:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, analytics, BI, or a senior analyst role, ideally supporting product, merchandising, planning, wholesale, or supply chain functions.
• Exceptional stakeholder management skills. You can lead discussions with senior leaders, gather requirements across functions, and turn competing needs into tangible, aligned outcomes.
• Very strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
• Strong understanding of retail and product lifecycle analytics, including assortment, seasonality, product cost, margin, sell-through, inventory productivity, and demand and supply planning. DTC, apparel, retail, or branded consumer goods experience is strongly preferred.
• Hands-on experience with a data semantic layer or modern BI platform, such as MicroStrategy, Looker, Power BI semantic models, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or equivalent.
• Ability to translate business processes into data and analytics requirements, including metric design and definition, data grain, hierarchies, relationships, data quality, edge cases, and versioning.
• Experience building analytics products for both leadership and operational users, with an understanding of how to drive adoption and turn data into decisions.
• Awareness of AI applications in analytics, including automated insights, semantic search, natural language to SQL, and workflow automation, with a willingness to prototype, experiment, and use AI tools in your own workflow.

Our investment in you:

At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees:

• Health Insurance
• Savings and Retirement Plan
• Employee Assistance Program
• Generous Vuori Discount & Industry Perks
• Paid Time Off
• Wellness & Fitness benefits

The salary range for this role is $137,300 per year - $176,610 per year. This role is bonus eligible.

Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor - Fashion Place
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $15.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. jobs.title: Premium Auditor II
jobs.description:
Pie's mission is to empower small businesses to thrive by making commercial insurance affordable and as easy as pie. We leverage technology to transform how small businesses buy and experience commercial insurance.

Like our small business customers, we are a diverse team of builders, dreamers, and entrepreneurs who are driven by core values and operating principles that guide every decision we make.

The Premium Auditor II is responsible for conducting comprehensive premium audits across diverse industries using mail, phone, and virtual platforms. This role involves reviewing payroll records, tax returns, and financial documents to ensure accurate policy coverage and compliance with regulatory guidelines. The auditor applies classification codes using NCCI, PAAS, and state-specific requirements, thoroughly documents findings, and prepares detailed audit worksheets.

How You’ll Do It

Core Audit Execution

• Conduct comprehensive premium audits via mail, phone, and virtual platforms across various industries and business types.

• Review and verify payroll records, tax returns, 1099s, and supporting financial documentation with meticulous attention to detail.

• Analyze business operations to identify all relevant exposures and ensure proper policy coverage.

• Identify and apply appropriate classification codes using NCCI guidelines, PAAS, and state-specific bureau requirements.

• Document audit findings thoroughly and prepare detailed audit worksheets.

• Ensure all audit work complies with established business rules and regulatory guidelines.

Insured Relationship Management & Communication

• Communicate professionally with policyholders via phone, email, and virtual meetings to gather required documentation.

• Conduct thorough interviews to understand business operations, employee roles, and exposure classifications.

• Explain audit processes clearly to insureds and address questions about documentation requirements.

• Build positive relationships while maintaining professional boundaries throughout the audit process.

• Handle initial concerns and questions about audit procedures (not billing-related issues).

• Coordinate schedules and follow up appropriately to ensure timely audit completion.

Virtual & Technology-Enhanced Audit Capabilities

• Conduct virtual audits using screen-sharing and remote access technologies.

• Guide insureds through document sharing and virtual collaboration platforms.

• Utilize emerging audit technologies and software to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

• Adapt audit methodologies based on insured capabilities and preferences.

• Maintain security protocols for remote document review and virtual meetings.

Data Analysis & Classification Expertise

• Analyze complex payroll structures, contractor relationships, and employee classifications.

• Research and apply appropriate workers' compensation classification codes across multiple states.

• Identify potential misclassifications and exposure gaps that could impact coverage.

• Review business operations for changes since policy inception that may affect classifications.

• Ensure proper documentation of all exposures for accurate premium calculations.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

• Ensure all audit documentation meets regulatory standards and company policies.

• Complete audits within established timeframes while maintaining thoroughness.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of all insured information and business data.

Process Development & Continuous Improvement

• Provide regular feedback on audit procedures and technology effectiveness.

• Participate in process development meetings and contribute improvement recommendations.

• Document best practices and lessons learned for future training materials.

• Support implementation of new audit technologies and methodologies.

The Right Stuff

• Minimum 3-4 years conducting Workers Compensation premium audits.

• Knowledge of NCCI classification systems and state bureau requirements.

• Experience working directly with business owners and financial personnel.

• Multi-state audit experience preferred.

Technical Competencies:

• Strong understanding of payroll systems, tax documentation, and business financial records.

• Proficiency with classification systems (NCCI, PAAS) and state-specific regulatory requirements.

• Experience with virtual meeting platforms and screen-sharing technologies.

• Advanced skills with audit software, Google Workspace applications, and emerging technologies.

• Ability to analyze complex business operations and identify relevant exposures.

• Understanding of contractor vs. employee relationships and classification implications.

Communication & Relationship Skills:

• Excellent verbal communication skills for professional phone and virtual interactions.

• Strong written communication abilities for follow-up correspondence and documentation.

• Proven ability to explain complex audit concepts clearly to business owners.

• Experience building rapport with diverse business contacts across various industries.

• Cultural sensitivity and professional demeanor in varied business environments.

• Ability to manage potentially sensitive conversations about business operations.

Core Competencies:

• Analytical Thinking: Ability to understand complex business operations and identify all relevant exposures.

• Attention to Detail: Meticulous review of financial records and accurate identification of discrepancies.

• Customer Focus: Commitment to building positive relationships while maintaining audit integrity.

• Adaptability: Flexibility to work with evolving technologies and audit methodologies.

• Sense of Urgency: Ability to manage multiple audits efficiently while maintaining quality standards.

• Professional Curiosity: Desire to understand business operations thoroughly and ask relevant questions.

These tools help us identify qualifications and prior work experiences that align with the requirements of the role. We may also use AI assistant video tools during interviews to support note-taking and candidate evaluation. All AI-powered outputs are still subject to human oversight and decision-making at multiple stages of the process. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to Pie utilizing these AI technologies to assist in our evaluation process.

Base Compensation Range

Compensation & Benefits

• Our core values are more than just a poster on the wall; they’re tangibly reflected in our work

jobs.title: Assistant, Digital Content (Part-Time/Seasonal)
jobs.description:
Monumental Sports & Entertainment (MSE) is one of the leading integrated sports and entertainment companies globally. MSE’s portfolio spans premier professional sports teams, world-class venues, and next-generation media properties, with marquee assets including the NHL’s Washington Capitals, NBA’s Washington Wizards, WNBA’s Washington Mystics, NBA G League’s Capital City Go-Go, Capital One Arena, and Monumental Sports Network, along with an investment in Team Liquid.

Rooted in the nation’s capital, MSE brings Washington, D.C's distinct influence, ambition, and leadership to the global sports and entertainment landscape. The company harnesses the power of its platform to drive continuous innovation and deliver extraordinary experiences that inspire and unite our community, our fans, and our people.

Our success is powered by talented people who bring passion, creativity, and collaboration to everything they do. If you're looking to build your career in a dynamic, fast-paced organization that's shaping the future of sports and entertainment, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview

The Digital Content Publisher supports the publishing, programming, and presentation of content across Monumental Sports Network’s digital platforms. This role helps ensure live events, original programming, podcasts, highlights, and other video content are published accurately, on time, and optimized for the best fan experience. The ideal candidate is organized, meticulous, comfortable working within digital content platforms, and able to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced sports media environment. They will support live programming and adapt to evolving content needs.

Are you passionate about digital media, sports content, and creating engaging experiences for fans? If so, we'd love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

• Support the daily publishing and scheduling of video content across Monumental+, Monumental Sports Network digital properties, YouTube, and other owned and operated platforms.

• Plan, distribute, revise, and manage live events, full episodes, highlights, clips, podcasts, trailers, promotional content, and other digital video and audio assets.

• Build and maintain content pages, collections, trays, playlists, and other merchandising placements within Monumental+.

• Curate content placement across digital platforms to improve discoverability, support programming priorities, and build a consistent user experience.

• Add and preserve accurate titles, descriptions, artwork, thumbnails, tags, categories, availability windows, and other publishing-related information inside content management systems.

• Perform quality assurance checks before and after publishing to confirm content, metadata, artwork, links, and playback experiences are accurate.

• Support digital programming related to the Capitals, Wizards, Mystics, Go-Go, and other Monumental Sports Network live events and seasonal highlights.

• Work closely with Content Strategy, Production, Product, Marketing, and other internal teams to collect assets and complete publishing plans.

• Assist in managing programming calendars, publishing trackers, content inventories, and other operational documents employed by the Content Strategy team.

• Aid in the upkeep and arrangement of the network’s digital content library.

• Troubleshoot publishing issues and bring up technical problems to the appropriate Product, Engineering, or platform teams when necessary.

• Monitor digital platforms for outdated, duplicated, incorrectly merchandised, or improperly published content and assist with ongoing platform cleanup.

• Provide support for publishing requirements during evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed by the network’s live sports and programming schedule.

• Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

• Keen focus on accuracy and excellent organizational abilities.

• Capacity to handle several publishing projects and deadlines at the same time.

• Comfortable adapting to and operating within content management systems and other digital publishing tools.

• Strong written communication skills and editorial judgment.

• Familiarity with digital video, streaming platforms, YouTube, or sports media is preferred.

• Experience with CMS platforms, digital publishing, video operations, or content management is preferred.

• Ability to work independently while communicating clearly with a collaborative, cross-functional team.

• Interest in sports, streaming, digital media, or content programming is strongly preferred.

• Availability to commit around 25 hours weekly, with adaptability for live broadcasts and urgent content requirements.

Pay Rate: $25.00 USD/hour

jobs.title: CNC Set-Up Machinist - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
This is a hands-on role that will set up and operate CNC mills and lathes, create and modify programs, troubleshoot machining challenges, and ensure finished parts meet demanding quality specifications. An important part of this position is training team members, improving production efficiency, and maintaining safe, reliable machining operations.

** This position is eligible for a $1500 sign on bonus ($750 at 90 days, $750 at 180 days) **

Shift:  Monday - Thursday, 3:00 pm - 1:00 am

Day-to-Day

• Set Up & Operate CNC Equipment: Independently set up and operate CNC mills and lathes, ensuring efficient production and consistent part quality.
• Program & Optimize: Write, edit, and modify CNC programs at the machine to improve machining efficiency, optimize cutting paths, and reduce cycle times.
• Deliver Precision: Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and production orders to manufacture parts with multiple dimensions and tight tolerances.
• Inspect & Verify: Perform accurate first-piece and final inspections using calibrated measuring instruments, maintaining required documentation and quality records.
• Solve Technical Challenges: Select appropriate tooling, troubleshoot material and tooling failures, identify drawing discrepancies, and make necessary machining adjustments.
• Train & Support Teammates: Assist machinists with machine setups, programming, blueprint interpretation, quality procedures, and efficient operating techniques.
• Maintain Program Control: Manage CNC program versions using Cimco DNC software and help ensure programs remain accurate and controlled.
• Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve machining processes, tooling, cycle times, and overall productivity in collaboration with Engineering, Quality, vendors, and fellow machinists.
• Support Safe Operations: Follow Pyrotek safety requirements, applicable ISO management system standards, and established quality and operating procedures.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED/TASC, plus at least five years of CNC machining experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Demonstrated ability to set up and operate CNC mills and lathes with minimal supervision.
• Experience reading and interpreting blueprints, technical drawings, and production orders.
• Working knowledge of machining theory, tooling, offsets, program editing, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
• Ability to write and modify CNC programs and produce parts to specified tolerances.
• Experience performing inspections and using calibrated measuring instruments.
• Strong troubleshooting, mathematical reasoning, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively, collaborate with others, and help train and develop fellow machinists.

Preferred Qualifications

• Accredited certification in CNC machining and programming.
• Working knowledge of GibbsCAM software.
• Experience using Cimco DNC software for CNC program management.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, barcode scanners, and Microsoft Office.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This position works in a manufacturing environment with exposure to loud noise, moving mechanical parts, and fumes or airborne particles. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required.

The role requires standing and walking for extended periods, bending, reaching, and using hands and fingers for precise work. The position also requires the ability to lift up to 75 pounds occasionally and up to 25 pounds frequently.

This role is ideal for lab professionals who value accuracy, organization, and consistency, and who want to grow their skills beyond traditional lab or hospital settings.

Career Growth Opportunity

Summit strongly supports internal growth. High-performing Laboratory Technicians / Phlebotomists have the opportunity to progress into a Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) role, which offers:

• Increased responsibility

• Broader study ownership

• Higher compensation

• Long-term career growth within clinical research

If you’re curious about research and want a role that can evolve with you, this position offers a clear entry point.

Position Details

• Position Type: Full-time

• Schedule: Monday–Thursday, 7:00am–5:30pm (4x10 schedule)

• Location: Onsite in Portland, OR (no remote or hybrid)

The Role

The Laboratory Technician / Phlebotomist is a key member of the clinical research team, supporting studies through specimen collection, processing, documentation, and shipment in compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), study protocols, and safety regulations.

You’ll work in a controlled clinical research environment with scheduled visits, detailed protocols, and strong operational support, allowing you to focus on quality and precision.

Who Thrives in This Role

• Lab professionals who value precision over speed

• Phlebotomists looking for predictability and balance

• Candidates curious about clinical research and career growth

• Team players who take pride in quality, compliance, and patient experience

Responsibilities:

• Laboratory and Clinical Procedures Perform phlebotomy, urine collection, and sample processing (centrifuging, aliquoting, labeling). Prepare lab kits for each subject based on study protocols. Ship biological specimens following IATA guidelines and protocol requirements. Maintain specimen logs, shipping records, temperature logs, and other documentation. Conduct point-of-care tests (e.g., urine drug screens, pregnancy tests). Assist with patient procedures including vital signs, ECGs, and physical/neurological exam setups. Clean and sanitize lab equipment and work areas daily. Perform and document equipment calibration and ensure safety compliance (OSHA, HIPAA).

• Data and Documentation Accurately record lab results and maintain electronic and paper logs in systems such as CRIO or eCRFs. Respond to and resolve electronic data queries. Verify accuracy and completeness of data entries and study documentation. Participate in quality control and assurance initiatives to ensure regulatory compliance.

• Operational Support Monitor and maintain inventory of lab kits and supplies. Order dry ice and other lab necessities. Destroy expired kits and log per protocol. Support preparation of study-specific training materials and lab manuals. Collaborate with study coordinators and medical staff to meet visit protocol requirements. May assist with infusion monitoring under clinician supervision.

Requirements:

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Tax Manager to join our Finance team in Culver City, California, on a hybrid basis, working two days per week from our office.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. As Scopely continues to grow its global footprint and portfolio, we are seeking a Tax Manager to join the Finance team. Reporting to the VP, Global Tax, this role will help manage Scopely’s domestic and international tax matters across compliance, provision, planning, reporting, and risk management.

The Tax Manager will be a hands-on partner to the business, working closely with Finance, Accounting, and other teams to translate tax requirements into practical, scalable processes and advice. This is an opportunity to help shape a high-performing global tax function in a fast-moving interactive company.

What You Will Do:

• Own the day-to-day coordination of Scopely’s tax compliance calendar, partnering with external advisors and internal stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate federal, state, local, and international filings, estimates, extensions, and payments.

• Prepare or review quarterly and annual income tax provision calculations and related disclosures under ASC 740, including current and deferred tax, effective tax rate analysis, return-to-provision items, and cash tax summary.

• Manage tax accounting records and reconciliations, including provision workpapers, tax account roll-forward, and variance analysis in support of the consolidated financial statements.

• Coordinate federal, state, local, and international tax audits, notices, and information requests with tax authorities, auditors, and outside advisors.

• Research tax law and assess the implications of legislative changes and new business initiatives; communicate practical recommendations to non-tax stakeholders.

• Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and other teams to obtain complete information and embed tax requirements into business processes and systems.

• Help build and improve the tax function through standardized processes, internal controls, tax technology, automation, documentation, and data-quality checks.

• Assist the VP, Global Tax with M&A, tax due diligence, ad hoc projects, and other strategic initiatives that support Scopely’s continued expansion.

What You Will Bring:

• A combination of Big Four or other public accounting experience and in-house industry experience is highly preferred.

• Experience managing external tax advisors and tax authorities while remaining hands-on and accountable for the underlying work product.

• Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ASC 740, including current and deferred tax calculations, effective tax rate analysis, and uncertain tax positions. Knowledge of IFRS is a plus.

• Proficiency with CCH, RIA, or comparable tax software and research tools. Experience with tax data, workflow, and automation, and AI tools. Familiarity with OneSource, Corptax, Alteryx a plus.

• Strong analytical and research skills, with the ability to understand complex issues, assess risk, and document clear, supportable positions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills required, including the ability to translate technical tax concepts into practical guidance for non-tax stakeholders.

• Collaborative, self-motivated, and resourceful, with a strong sense of ownership, consistent attention to detail, and the ability to manage shifting priorities and competing deadlines.

jobs.title: Compensation Lead
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Compensation Lead to build Perplexity's compensation function and own its day-to-day execution. You'll build the programs and processes that support how we hire, recognize, and retain people.



You should be comfortable moving between program design and an individual offer, building longer-term structure while keeping today's decisions moving. The goal is a compensation approach that is competitive, financially sound, and clear enough for people to use, without adding unnecessary complexity.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Build the compensation foundation. Assess existing practices, data, and tools; prioritize the gaps; and develop recommendations on compensation philosophy, market positioning, and cash and equity guidelines.

 - Develop salary ranges and market benchmarks. Establish a consistent approach to pricing roles across functions and locations. Partner with People and business leaders on job scope and leveling, and explain where market data is useful or incomplete.

 - Own day-to-day compensation decisions. Be the primary partner for offers, promotions, pay adjustments, and compensation questions. Evaluate recommendations against market data, internal equity, and budget, with clear approval paths for exceptions.

 - Design and run compensation reviews. Build the calendar, planning models, manager guidance, and approval process. Coordinate with Finance, People Operations, Payroll, and equity partners to carry decisions through to accurate implementation.

 - Inform leadership decisions. Model the cost and employee impact of proposed changes to salary and equity programs. Present a recommendation and its trade-offs, then own execution once approved.

 - Identify and address inconsistencies. Assess pay compression and potential inequities across teams, levels, and locations. Partner with People leadership and Legal on appropriate reviews and recommend actions.

 - Build processes people can use. Establish decision records, recruiter and manager guidance, and clear explanations of compensation programs. Improve recurring workflows so consistent decisions don't depend on individual knowledge or one-off conversations.

 - Own the data and tools behind the work. Establish reliable compensation records, select and manage benchmarking resources, and improve reporting and quality checks. Use approved automation and AI tools where they help, with appropriate protection for employee information and verification of results.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience building compensation programs: You've established or substantially rebuilt compensation frameworks and processes with limited infrastructure, and stayed accountable for running them after launch.

 - Technical compensation depth: Hands-on experience with market pricing, salary ranges, cash and equity programs, compensation reviews, and individual pay recommendations.

 - Strong analytical judgment: You can build and audit models, reconcile imperfect data, and explain your assumptions. You know when a benchmark is a useful comparison and when it misses the role.

 - Ability to influence decisions: You can turn analysis into a clear recommendation, discuss trade-offs with leadership, and constructively challenge an approach that isn't working.

 - Independent, hands-on execution: You can set priorities, build a workable process, and manage urgent requests without losing progress on longer-term work. You're comfortable being both the person designing the program and the person checking the data.

 - Discretion and clear communication: You handle sensitive information carefully and explain compensation decisions in language that recruiters, managers, and employees can understand.

jobs.title: Group Director, Consumer Services
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A Day in the Life

The Group Director, Consumer Services is Power Digital's senior client relationship and revenue leader for lead-generation-driven businesses across personal finance, home services, hospitality, and other D2C verticals. Your clients live and die by lead volume, lead quality, and speed-to-lead — cost-per-lead, call and booking conversion, and the marketing-to-sales handoff move faster and get scrutinized harder than in almost any other vertical, and you manage your portfolio the way a fund manager runs a book: you know which accounts compound, which lead flow is at risk of drying up or degrading in quality, and exactly where to spend your time. You are the executive a client calls when a sales team starts complaining about lead quality or a call center falls behind on response time, and the leader an Account Director never wants to let down. The roles you consistently play day-to-day are: portfolio growth owner, talent multiplier, tech forward leader and AI systems thinker.

At Power, retention is the floor, not the job. You are commercially driven first: you personally own executive relationships and expansion revenue for the top of your portfolio, and you hold your team to the same standard. In Consumer Services, that means staying closer to lead quality, speed-to-lead, and the marketing-to-sales handoff than almost any other Group Director role requires — because in this vertical, a drop in lead quality or a slow call response shows up in a client's sales pipeline well before it shows up in a quarterly plan. You coach Account Directors and their teams to operate as AI-Native Growth Directors — faster, sharper, and less buried in manual work than the role has ever required before. You decide which AI tools and workflows the division adopts. Your influence runs beyond Client Experience: you shape your Division's go-to-market position, you're a thought partner to your Managing Director and VP, and you represent Power Digital in market on Consumer Services and lead-gen strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own net revenue retention and expansion MRR for the division; treat expansion as the primary commercial lever of the role and own the division's monthly service expansion target

• Personally own executive relationships across the top 30–40% of the portfolio by MRR — direct relationship, not delegated

• Run monthly, relationship-focused executive check-ins with top-tier accounts and 1x1 check-ins with every priority account

• Maintain an accurate, self-owned retention forecast on a weekly basis — accountable for the accuracy of the division's retention data

• Track vertical-specific marketing signal such as cost-per-lead, lead-to-booked-appointment or lead-to-sale conversion, and speed-to-lead/call response time, since a breakdown in lead quality or responsiveness shows up in a client's sales pipeline before it shows up in a QBR

• Diagnose risk early and install fixes, not just responses; lead or co-lead quarterly plans for the top 10% of the portfolio, weighted toward strategic outcomes over metrics recaps

• Partner with Account Directors to build value-based, consultative business cases — expansion should drive value, not be sold

• Identify and lead common Consumer Services expansion paths, including local and multi-location paid search/local SEO expansion, call tracking and lead-routing optimization, and cross-sell into adjacent lead-gen offers (e.g., financing programs, service plans, membership offers)

• Keep the Salesforce pipeline current and accurate — stages, forecast, and next steps updated weekly

• Serve as the frontline for product and vertical innovation, feeding client signal into Power Circuit

• Build and evolve vertical-relevant reporting frameworks for Consumer Services, including metrics such as cost-per-lead, lead-to-sale conversion rate, and call/booking quality

• Lead or play a key leadership role in final-round pitches for prospective clients where support is needed (e.g. $25k+)

• Bring vertical point of view and executive credibility to new business

• Partner with Sales to sharpen positioning, collateral, and win rate for the division's go-to-market

• Directly manage Account Directors and oversee the Associate Account Director pod that supports them

• Coach every direct report to operate as an AI-Native Growth Director, not a task manager — faster diagnosis, more client-facing time, less manual reporting

• Evaluate the team on Pulse sentiment, health scores, and expansion weekly — not just activity

• Raise the floor on AI adoption — no one on the team operates the old way

• Own hiring, staffing, capacity, and career pathing for the division; facilitate DAPs and career progression conversations

• Practice radical candor; deliver timely, actionable feedback that accelerates careers

• Identify and develop key talent for future Sr. Account Director & Group Director roles

• Lead training on vertical-specific and AI-native tools, processes, and strategies

• Vibe-codes prototypes to automate repeatable tasks, surface better insights, and test hypotheses quickly

• Designs AI workflows for the team — builds the system, not just uses the tools; models AI-forward behavior

• Runs Omega and Iris across the full portfolio and acts on the patterns they surface

• Decides which AI tools and workflows get adopted, when, and how across the division

• Owns division-level AI quality tradeoffs — where AI accelerates output, and where it must never touch client-facing work unreviewed

• Builds and evolves Power Circuit solutions specific to the division with AI-assisted research; runs a monthly audit to confirm adoption

• Collaborates with the innovation team on enhancements and optimizations that better serve the division's clients

• Consulted on the division P&L and accountable for the profitability of the portfolio

• Forecast the four pillars — Churn, Service Expansion, New Business, Efficiency — in partnership with the MD and VP

• Use the P&L and strategic growth bets to build the business case for headcount and investment; drive efficiency through technology, AI, and process improvement

• Own resolution of every escalation in the direct portfolio

• Partner with Data Intelligence, Media Planning, and Activation teams to keep strategy and execution connected

• Represent Power Digital in market — speaking, content, and client-facing points of view

• Become the internal knowledge hub other leaders turn to for vertical and division expertise

Role Requirements

• Department leadership and management experience required — has led Account Directors or senior marketers as direct reports

• 10+ years of leadership experience in a digital marketing agency, with lead-generation client work across personal finance, home services, hospitality, or other D2C verticals at the AD level or above

• Experience managing a P&L for profitable growth

• Deep marketing fluency in lead-gen funnels — cost-per-lead, cost-per-acquisition, call tracking, speed-to-lead, and the marketing-to-sales handoff; understands where that connection breaks down (e.g., a lead quality issue that isn't actually a marketing problem) and how to fix it structurally

• Channel and program strategy expertise — has built or overseen local and multi-location paid search, local SEO, and call-driven marketing programs, not just supervised execution

• Measurement expertise: attribution methodology for offline conversions such as calls, bookings, and in-store or in-home visits, where common models fall short for multi-location or regulated lead-gen businesses, and how to present alternative methodologies to a skeptical CFO or finance stakeholder

• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance considerations relevant to lead-gen verticals (e.g., TCPA, state licensing in personal finance) and how they shape campaign and call-handling design

• Has presented to and pushed back on C-suite and VP stakeholders when the data supported it — can hold a credible, data-backed conversation with a skeptical owner, GM, or finance executive about marketing's contribution to lead volume and quality

• Expertise in contract negotiation, client retention, and client growth

• Proven track record delivering high NPS and retention metrics across a portfolio

• Extensive knowledge of owned, earned, and paid marketing channels — content, SEO and local SEO, paid search, paid social, and programmatic

• Familiarity with Consumer Services-specific platforms and tools: call tracking and lead-routing platforms, local SEO/listings management tools, CRM systems, and multi-location or franchise marketing platforms

• Entrepreneurial spirit — energized by building, not just operating; contributes to product and go-to-market strategy, not just client management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Primary: Meet or exceed a 60% Expansion-to-Churn Ratio (ETCR) on a trailing 3-month average

Secondary Expectations:

• 105% net revenue retention (trailing 6-month average)

• 100% MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) Growth target achievement (set annually)

• $200K in monthly service expansion pipeline creation across the division

• +90% employee retention rate

• Portfolio NPS at or above 8 (trailing 12 months)

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Division Business & Team Leadership

• New Business & Service Expansion Leadership

• Product Quality, AI & Systems Development

• Client Portfolio Ownership

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

jobs.title: TPM

AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager (TPM) to join our Program Management Office (PMO) and lead the execution of complex technical initiatives across an advanced telecommunications ecosystem. This role is responsible for driving cross-functional projects from planning through deployment, coordinating engineering, operations, and product teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet business and customer requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with technical knowledge of telecommunications networks, enabling them to effectively manage delivery efforts, align stakeholders, mitigate risks, and ensure successful project outcomes across multiple technology domains.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and manage project plans, including scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, and success criteria.

• Lead execution of complex technical projects from initiation through deployment and operational handoff.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, product, and delivery organizations.

• Monitor project progress, communicate status updates, and provide regular reporting to leadership and key stakeholders.

• Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and proactively manage issues to minimize delivery impacts.

• Translate technical and business requirements into actionable project plans and execution roadmaps.

• Support the deployment and integration of telecommunications solutions across multiple network domains.

• Coordinate testing, validation, certification, and rollout activities to ensure solution quality and operational readiness.

• Facilitate collaboration between research, engineering, and operational teams to transition new capabilities into production environments.

• Analyze performance metrics and project outcomes to identify opportunities for process and operational improvements.

• Drive accountability across teams and vendors to ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives.

• Support troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution efforts for complex technical and operational challenges.

Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Master’s degree preferred.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) or related certification is a plus.

Experience

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in telecommunications engineering, network delivery, technical program management, or related technical project leadership roles.

• Experience managing large-scale, cross-functional technical projects in telecommunications, networking, or technology environments.

• Demonstrated success delivering complex integration, deployment, or infrastructure initiatives.

• Experience working with service providers, network operators, technology vendors, or large enterprise organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting wireless, mobile, satellite, or next-generation communications networks.

• Knowledge of radio access networks (RAN), core network technologies, transport networks, IMS, OSS/BSS, or related telecommunications systems.

• Familiarity with network testing, validation, integration, and performance optimization methodologies.

• Experience working with cloud-native technologies, virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), or network automation.

• Understanding of telecommunications standards, regulatory environments, and industry best practices.

• Exposure to emerging wireless technologies, edge computing, and advanced network architectures.

• Experience managing multi-vendor programs and complex technical integrations.

Soft Skills

• Strong project management and organizational skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication abilities.

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Demonstrated leadership and decision-making abilities.

• Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to execution excellence.

Technology Stack

• Project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence)

• Collaboration and communication platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams, SharePoint)

• Technical documentation and requirements management tools

• Network monitoring, testing, and performance analysis platforms

• Data analytics and reporting tools

• Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio

• AI-enabled productivity and project management tools

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.

• Ability to work within technical, laboratory, operations, or testing environments as required.

• Occasional travel to customer sites, partner locations, operational facilities, or project meetings.

• Ability to participate in meetings across multiple time zones and global teams.

• Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.

• Flexibility to support critical project milestones, deployments, and operational activities when needed.

jobs.title: Principal Research Scientist I, Checkpoint Immunology
jobs.description:
The Checkpoint Immunology group is seeking an experienced Principal Research Scientist I to advance novel immune checkpoint programs for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. The successful candidate will provide scientific leadership across discovery and translational research activities, driving innovative therapeutic concepts from target identification through candidate nomination.

This role is ideal for a scientist who combines deep immunology expertise with a strong drug discovery mindset, enjoys solving challenging biological questions in emerging areas of science, and thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Responsibilities

• Lead the scientific strategy and execution of one or more discovery-stage immunology programs.
• Drive biological understanding of novel immune regulatory pathways and translate insights into therapeutic opportunities.
• Lead from the bench by designing, executing, and interpreting critical experiments while mentoring other scientists.
• Build scientific capability within the team and foster a strong drug discovery mindset
• Integrate biology, pharmacology, translational sciences, and external collaborations to advance program objectives.
• Coordinate cross-functional workflows and drive alignment across multidisciplinary teams.
• Ensure high-quality project planning through sound experimental design, early risk assessment and robust contingency planning through integrated timelines
• Contribute to PK/PD, translational, and biomarker strategies that support candidate selection and development decisions.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture through mentorship, scientific rigor, and effective teamwork.

Required

• PhD with typically 6+ years of experience; MS or equivalent education with typically 12+ years of experience; or BS or equivalent education with typically 14+ years of extensive experience in Immunology, Cell Biology, Pharmacology, or related discipline.
• Significant experience in immunology drug discovery; proven ability to innovate and deliver new or improved lead and candidate molecules
• Experience with biologics, bispecific antibodies, multispecific therapeutics, or other immune-modulating modalities
• Strong expertise in immune cell biology, autoimmune disease, immune regulation, and/or checkpoint biology.
• Demonstrated ability to independently lead scientific strategy and execution in a matrixed environment.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred

• Experience advancing programs from target validation through candidate nomination.
• Experience designing and interpreting in vitro and in vivo pharmacology studies, including PK/PD assessments.
• Translational research and biomarker development experience.
• Proven ability to integrate cross-functional activities and drive execution across complex research programs.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a scientist who can lead biology in areas where the path forward is not yet defined, remain closely connected to the science and the laboratory, integrate activities across diverse functions, and help build a cohesive, collaborative team. This individual will be recognized for scientific excellence, strong execution, mentorship, and the ability to translate complex biology into impactful therapeutic strategies.

jobs.title: Pipeline Req - Senior Manager, Sales Engineering
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for to identify interested prospects for future "Senior Manager, Sales Engineering" roles based in New York City Metro of the United States, reporting to our Director, Sales Engineering.

You will lead and grow the sales engineering organization for the core portfolio, including the Gen AI market, across the Central region in the US. You will align closely with GTM Sales Leaders, Product Management, and Engineering to execute strategic solutions and close deals for customers and partners.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Recruit, mentor, and develop the sales engineering team

• Refine and scale core sales engineering processes including discovery, technical qualification, and proof-of-concept

• Partner with sales leadership and clients to design and present business solutions that drive revenue growth

• Work within a matrixed environment to promote and support the Zscaler portfolio through value-based selling

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

jobs.title: Director, Design & Development
jobs.description:
The Director, Design & Development, is responsible for leading a diverse fashion creative team and driving a creative vision rooted in the contemporary consumer, while supporting and owning category growth objectives. This role provides creative and strategic leadership across a broad portfolio, overseeing all Fashion & Living responsibilities spanning Universal Studios, Illumination, DreamWorks Animation, TV and E-commerce businesses for licensing and Parks.  In addition, the role fosters a professional and inspiring creative environment that encourages smart, innovative design solutions at every level.

Responsibilities

Creative Leadership & Vision

• Lead and oversee the creative vision across multiple categories, ensuring brand consistency, innovation, and elevated design execution.
• Develop innovative concepts, visual storytelling, and brand-right creative solutions that resonate with target consumers and strengthen brand equity.
• Act as the creative bridge between licensors, licensees, retail partners, and internal teams to maximize brand value through design.
• Ensure alignment between creative vision, brand strategy, and commercial objectives across all product categories.
• Influence cross-functional stakeholders across Category Management, Retail Development, Licensing, and Parks to align creative strategies with business priorities.
• Maintain exceptional standards of design quality, craftsmanship, and execution across all creative outputs.
• Drive informed creative solutions by leveraging global and local market trends, consumer insights, and emerging cultural influences.

Product Development & Design Execution

• Partner with Retail Buying teams, licensees, and Category Leadership to develop strategically aligned and commercially viable product assortments.
• Lead and manage all creative aspects of fashion and product design, ensuring trend-forward development and timely execution.
• Actively participate in concept development, sketching, illustration, and visual asset creation.
• Interpret and evolve style guides while creating original graphic assets, design applications, and innovative expressions of IP.
• Translate trends in materials, silhouettes, fashion aesthetics, and consumer behavior into compelling licensed products.
• Create impactful presentations and creative assets for regional and internal stakeholders, licensors, licensees, and retail partners.
• Demonstrate strong expertise in composition, typography, color theory, and fashion design principles including manufacturing and printing processes, assortment planning, graphic and pattern development, branding and trim development

Licensing & Brand Stewardship

• Manage end-to-end licensor approvals, ensuring all products meet brand standards, contractual obligations, and creative expectations.
• Interpret and elevate licensor feedback, refining product design while maintaining authenticity and brand integrity.
• Partner closely with intellectual property holders to create differentiated and market-leading product experiences.
• Balance creative excellence with commercial viability to deliver elevated products that perform in the marketplace.

Business Ownership & Financial Management

• Partner with Category and Retail Leadership to drive quarterly and annual business performance and sales results.
• Own and communicate creative budget management aligned with key business priorities and initiatives.
• Track and manage budgets related to product development assets, creative resources, and design execution.
• Align creative investments with strategic business goals and growth opportunities.

Team Leadership, Performance & Talent Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop the Fashion Design team, fostering innovation, accountability, and creative excellence.
• Drive annual performance management by establishing clear team and individual goals and maintaining a consistent cadence of quarterly 1:1 development conversation.
• Create and support meaningful career pathways and succession plans.
• Lead creative reviews and critiques with professionalism, actionable feedback, and high standards.
• Set the tone through strong ownership, collaboration, attention to detail, and a culture of continuous improvement.
• Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned to meet the evolving needs of the team and business.
• Ability to travel as required to support business and operational needs.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $150,000 - $180,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

• 10+ years of experience in creative design, product development, and creative leadership within fashion, consumer products, entertainment, or licensing environments.
• 5+ years of experience leading and managing creative teams of 5–20 employees, fostering collaboration, creativity, and high-quality execution.
• Bachelor's degree in Fashion Design, Product Design or a related creative discipline.
• Strong portfolio demonstrating concept development, technical expertise, and commercial product success.
• Strong knowledge of clothing construction, garment engineering, fit development, patternmaking, and apparel manufacturing processes.
• Experience working with domestic and international factories, production partners, and sourcing teams.
• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, PLM systems, and CAD tools.
• Experience leveraging emerging design technologies, including AI-assisted design tools, digital product visualization, and creative workflow innovation.
• Deep understanding of textiles, trims, fabrication, washes, finishing techniques, and production methods.
• Experience with manufacturing of both soft and hard goods for fashion, accessories and footwear product categories; experience in branding and packaging for consumer goods.
• Strong track record of managing style guides and the licensor approval workflow.
• Exceptional illustration, conceptual development, and trend-forecasting skills.
• Demonstrated leadership skills; highly organized, proactive self-starter.
• Global Design Industry experience a plus.
• Be available for domestic and international travel.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with multiple shifting priorities.

jobs.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We recently launched a new brand visual identity and are looking for a Senior Designer to help bring it to life across the organization. This is not a traditional graphic design role. You will partner with Marketing and the Creative Director to translate the new identity into a scalable design system that shapes how the brand appears across presentations, thought leadership, reports, social media, events, digital communications, internal communications, and client-facing materials. The focus is not simply creating deliverables, but building the templates, standards, assets, and systems that enable consistent, sustainable brand application across every touchpoint.

What You'll Do

• Lead Brand Implementation: Translate and implement the new visual identity across key internal and external channels, assessing existing materials, evolving standards, and ensuring consistent application of the brand.

• Build Brand Systems & Templates: Create scalable templates, reusable design components, and visual standards that support consistency across presentations, reports, digital content, social media, events, and communications.

• Design & Execute: Produce high-quality design work across print, digital, presentation, social, and event materials while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Develop Visual Assets: Build and manage the brand's visual asset library, define imagery and graphic standards, and create supporting motion graphics and multimedia assets.

• Create Long-Term Sustainability: Establish the documentation, governance, asset libraries, and processes needed to ensure the brand can be effectively maintained and extended over time.

What We're Looking For

Required

• 7+ years of experience in brand, visual, or graphic design.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating brand implementation across multiple touchpoints.

• Expertise in typography, layout, composition, and information design.

• Experience developing design systems, templates, standards, and reusable frameworks.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).

• Advanced PowerPoint design and template-building experience.

• Advanced knowledge of Figma.

• Ability to balance strategy, creativity, and production execution.

• Strong organization, project management, and attention to detail.

• Submission of a portfolio demonstrating design expertise and versatility across channels and formats.

Preferred

• Experience supporting a rebrand or visual identity rollout.

• Experience in consulting, professional services, B2B, technology, executive education, or corporate communications.

• Motion graphics experience.

• Experience managing digital asset libraries.

• Experience working with executive audiences.

• Experience building systems for both designers and non-designers.

Ideal Candidate

You are a systems thinker who enjoys building solutions that scale, combining strategic thinking with hands-on design execution. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, influencing stakeholders through strong creative judgment, and creating work that is both visually compelling and highly practical.

What Success Looks Like

• Priority brand applications have been transitioned to the new identity.

• Existing templates have been intentionally retained, adapted, rebuilt, or retired.

• Presentation, document, social, and communication materials operate from consistent design systems.

• A robust library of templates, assets, imagery, and components is in place.

• The brand is expressed consistently across internal and external touchpoints.

• Teams have the guidance and tools needed to maintain the identity going forward.

• A roadmap exists for future implementation and evolution.
