jobs.title: Channel Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Hypori, Inc. is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com.

Hypori is looking for a hands-on Channel Sales Engineer to join our growing commercial sales team. You will be the technical engine behind our channel program, enabling engineers at MSSPs, MSPs, RPOs, and C3PAOs to sell, scope, and deploy Hypori on their own. You will work alongside the Channel Account Manager and report to the VP of Commercial Sales.

Most of the 100,000+ companies in the Defense Industrial Base buy security through the partner that runs their IT, and those partners only sell what their own engineers trust. Hypori is proven at scale, with more than 95,000 Department of War users and IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, CMMC 2.0 Level 2, and SOC 2 Type II. The channel program is new, and the person in this seat builds its technical foundation. Success is measured by partner-sourced pipeline, technical win rate, and partners who can run a deal without you.

Responsibilities

• Build the partner technical certification path with the Channel Account Manager

• Enable partner engineers to demo, scope, and deploy Hypori without us in the room, taking every new partner from signature to first deployment

• Maintain reference architectures, deployment guides, and partner lab environments

• Equip partner sellers and compliance leads to defend the CMMC scope reduction argument

• Understand the why first: why the partner’s or client’s current setup isn’t enough, why now, why Hypori, and why not the status quo

• Lead discovery, demos, and proof-of-value engagements on partner-led deals against agreed success criteria

• Use MEDDPICC to validate technical decision criteria, build technical champions, and flag unqualified deals early

• Scope deployments across identity, multi-tenant design, app delivery, licensing, and the assessment boundary

• Answer security questionnaires, RFIs, and shared responsibility requests

• Help partners package Hypori into managed service offerings with multi-tenant administration and RMM, PSA, and SIEM integrations

• Bring partner and field requirements to Product and Engineering

• Support channel campaigns, webinars, and events, including CMMC CON

• Over time, help stand up the technical foundation for a broader security reseller and solution provider channel

Qualifications

• 3–5 years as a sales engineer, solutions engineer, or solutions architect at a SaaS cybersecurity vendor, MSP, or MSSP

• A track record supporting cybersecurity sales, with measurable technical win rates

• Hands-on experience enabling MSP or MSSP partners, including building your own certification and enablement content

• CMMC 2.0 and NIST SP 800-171 depth. Be ready to scope an assessment boundary and defend scope reduction in the interview

• Endpoint security architecture expertise across mobile, identity, and data protection

• MEDDPICC fluency and strong Salesforce hygiene

• Location: Remote, United States, with travel up to 40 percent to partner sites and industry events

Who You Are

• Speed: You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week

• Focus: You spend your time on the partners and deals that will actually move

• Extreme ownership: Partner readiness and technical wins are yours. No excuses

• Accountability: You do what you say, when you say. You flag slips early

• Coachability: You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better

• Humility: You know what you don’t know, and you say so

• Creativity: You find new ways to make partner engineers self-sufficient

Preferred Attributes

• Technical credibility: The bar is high. You need credibility with a partner’s lead engineer and compliance lead, on your own

• CMMC and 800-171: CUI vs. FCI, the 5 asset categories, how an unmanaged device moves from CUI Asset to out of scope, the External Service Provider question, FedRAMP Moderate equivalency under DFARS 7012, and SPRS scoring

• Microsoft 365 GCC High: Commercial vs. GCC vs. GCC High, enclave vs. full-tenant migration, and where Hypori shrinks the GCC High footprint

• Endpoint and mobile security: MDM, UEM, MAM, mobile threat defense, EDR, enterprise browser, VDI, and DaaS. You know where the data rests in each

• Identity and networking: SSO, SAML, SCIM, conditional access, Entra ID, Okta, derived credentials for CAC and PIV, and cloud networking in AWS and Azure

• Prior time at an MSP, MSSP, RPO, or C3PAO serving defense contractors

• CMMC CCP or CCA, CISSP, Security+, or Microsoft security certifications

• Experience in an early-stage channel program

• Military service or Department of War civilian experience

About Us

Compensation: $200,000 – $225,000 on-target earnings, split 80/20 between base salary and variable compensation ($160,000 – $180,000 base salary, commensurate with experience), plus equity. Targets are based on partner-sourced channel bookings, partner technical certifications, and technical win rate.

About Us

Hypori Inc. provides a generous benefits package for full-time employees that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, and life and disability packages. We also invest in our employees' futures by providing a 401(k) plan with employer-matching contributions that vest starting from your first day of employment. In addition to the base compensation, Hypori also offers a performance bonus, which is primarily contingent upon company-wide performance. We are dedicated to investing in the tools and skills required to be strong, collaborative colleagues and people managers to help build and retain a strong workforce.

Hypori is an Equal Employment and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At Hypori, we are committed to creating and promoting an inclusive workplace that embraces differences and perspectives – making us a stronger, more successful company. In doing so, we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should contact people@hypori.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead
jobs.description:
Traba is the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain. We started in staffing, the biggest operational pain point for the manufacturing and logistics customers we serve, and used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships. But our edge is more than data: by connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale.

We are backed by Khosla Ventures, Founders Fund, and General Catalyst.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptional Strategic Finance Lead to join our team as a right-hand partner to our Head of Finance and Department Leads. In this critical role, you'll help drive our next phase of growth by supporting strategic decision-making and leading key financial and operational initiatives. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and finance in a fast-moving, mission-driven company.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Partner closely with the Head of Finance and CEO to drive strategic financial planning, decision-making, and fundraising efforts

 - Support the development and execution of financial strategy, resource allocation, and growth initiatives, especially across GTM and Operations

 - Partner cross-functionally to drive analysis, build financial models, and recommend business decisions across areas such as business expansion, pricing and packaging and capital efficiency

 - Drive financial discipline across the organization, ensuring accuracy in all financial data and operations

 - Track and optimize key operating metrics including revenue retention, profitability margins, and unit economics




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 4 - 6 years in investment banking, consulting, private equity, growth equity, venture capital or strategic finance at a high-growth startup

 - Exceptional work ethic and bias toward action

 - Relentless attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

 - Proactive mindset with strong business judgment

 - Direct communication style with ability to drive results through influence

 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with startup hours
   
   


SALARY RANGE DETAILS:

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, with a highly competitive equity package. We want you to share meaningfully in the long-term upside of what we are building. Full benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, commuter benefit, flexible PTO, and dinner provided for NY employees.




LOCATION AND WORK STYLE

This role is based onsite in New York City, five days per week. We build in person, it is how we move fast, make decisions in real time, and hold a high standard together.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets.




BENEFITS

 - 💰 Competitive Salary

 - 🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

 - 🍽️ Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass & stocked kitchen for NY employees

 - 🚍 Commuter benefit

 - 🎤 Team building events

 - 🏋🏽 Gympass Benefit

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health




OUR VALUES

Dream Big - We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Olympian’s Work Ethic - Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

Growth Mindset - We confront the toughest challenges head-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience.

Customer Obsession - We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high-quality products and services that solve these often overlooked communities’ problems.




WHAT IS LIGHT INDUSTRIAL LABOR?

Light industrial labor drives the efficiency of global supply chains, encompassing essential, entry-level roles in warehouses and distribution centers. These workers pack boxes, load trucks, and manage day-to-day operations that ensure goods move seamlessly to meet growing consumer and business demands. It’s a $200B+ global market and a critical part of keeping goods moving smoothly in today's economy.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Mid Market Sales
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and every team member directly impacts our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in execution, transparency, and collaboration.

What You’ll Do

As Senior Director of Sales for the Mid-Market segment, you will lead Brex’s Mid-Market organization, overseeing four frontline sales leaders and ~20 Account Executives. Reporting to the SVP of Sales, you’ll own segment performance, develop the management team, and shape the strategy and operating cadences that support the organization’s next phase of growth.

This is a second-line leadership role that combines strategic planning with hands-on sales leadership. You’ll coach managers, develop exceptional talent, and build repeatable systems that drive pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and consistent deal execution. You’ll establish clear priorities and lead teams through growth and change while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration. Working across go-to-market functions, this leader will empower the organization to win competitive deals and translate successful approaches into stronger execution across the segment.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in one of our offices in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, or Salt Lake City. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop frontline sales managers to consistently achieve Mid-Market new-business targets

• Own segment strategy and execution, translating business priorities into clear goals, manager expectations, and measurable outcomes

• Hire and develop exceptional sales talent, build leadership bench strength, and maintain a high bar for coaching and performance management

• Build and scale operating cadences across outbound prospecting, account prioritization, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting

• Use data to diagnose performance gaps, prioritize improvements, and measure their impact on pipeline quality, conversion, and sales productivity

• Coach managers on qualification, competitive differentiation, and strategic deal execution; participate in key customer opportunities while strengthening the team’s ability to win independently

• Partner with Sales Development, Marketing, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Product, and post-sale teams to generate pipeline, remove friction, and deliver on customer commitments

• Lead teams through growth and change by communicating clear priorities, building commitment, and reinforcing consistent execution and accountability

• Model ownership, urgency, humility, and a company-first mindset while contributing to broader go-to-market initiatives

Requirements

• 10+ years of B2B sales experience, with demonstrated success in Mid-Market or comparable upmarket environments and a consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets

• 3+ years of experience managing managers in a second-line sales leadership role, with measurable business results delivered through the frontline management team

• Strong operating and analytical rigor, including experience building forecasting, pipeline management, and inspection systems that improve execution and predictability

• Experience leading outbound-oriented sales teams and helping sellers prioritize large books of accounts while maintaining deal velocity

• Strong sales judgment and competitive-selling experience, with the ability to coach managers through qualification, stakeholder engagement, differentiation, and complex deal decisions

• A proven approach to hiring, coaching, and performance management, along with experience leading teams through meaningful growth or organizational change

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with examples of aligning stakeholders, navigating disagreement, and delivering shared business outcomes

• Clear communication and sound judgment under ambiguity; comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close to customers, managers, and execution

• Experience in fintech or spend management, selling to finance buyers, partner-led selling, or leadership spanning new business and post-sale is helpful but not required

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $343,520 - $429,400. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing Promotions
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Beam Therapeutics is a biotechnology company committed to establishing the leading, fully integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. To achieve this vision, Beam has assembled a platform with integrated gene editing, delivery and internal manufacturing capabilities. Beam’s suite of gene editing technologies is anchored by base editing, a proprietary technology that is designed to enable precise, predictable and efficient single base changes, at targeted genomic sequences, without making double-stranded breaks in the DNA. This has the potential to enable a wide range of therapeutic editing strategies that Beam is using to advance a diversified portfolio of base editing programs. Beam is a values-driven organization committed to its people, cutting-edge science, and a vision of providing life-long cures to patients suffering from serious diseases.

Position Overview:

Beam is seeking a dynamic and experienced Associate Director, Marketing Promotions to play a critical role in the development, approval, and execution of promotional materials supporting risto-cel our gene therapy asset in SCD.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Brand Strategy and Marketing, this role will lead the end-to-end execution of promotional tactics, including MLR submission and approval, and digital marketing execution, while supporting broader brand strategy across HCP and Patient Marketing. The successful candidate will bring strong experience partnering with field teams, managing agencies, and working cross-functionally in a highly regulated environment.

Responsibilities:

Promotional Development & Execution

• Lead the development of promotional materials, including print, digital, and field-facing assets, from concept through MLR review, approval, and final production for HCP and patient audiences, working closely with HCP and Patient marketing leads.

• Drive effective rollout of approved promotional tactics to sales teams, in close collaboration with HCP and Patient Marketing leads, Sales, Sales Training, and Commercial Operations.

• Ensure promotional materials effectively translate brand strategy into clear, actionable field tools.

Digital & Multichannel Execution

• Lead execution of digital marketing tactics, including email, web, virtual engagement tools, and non-personal promotion.

• Manage media agencies to optimize channel mix, implement tactics, measure performance, and optimize future tactics accordingly across HCP and patient audiences.

• Ensure digital tactics align with brand strategy and compliance requirements.

• Performance & Budget Management. In collaboration with insights team, establish, integrate and track KPIs, performance metrics, and ROI for marketing activities.

• Monitor product performance and propose promotional adjustments based on market dynamics.

Qualifications:

• BS in relevant field, advanced degree preferred.

• Typically 10+ years of experience with 7+ years of experience in biotech or pharmaceutical marketing, preferably in rare disease or cell and gene therapies.

• Demonstrated experience leading promotional material development and MLR review.

• Strong experience managing external agencies (creative, digital, production).

• Experience executing digital and multichannel marketing tactics in a regulated environment.

• Ability to work effectively in a highly cross-functional organization.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.

• Product launch experience preferred.

• Strong analytical skills; comfortable navigating complex and ambiguous environments.

The salary range below reflects the full-time base salary range we expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. Base pay will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, scope of job, internal comparisons, and market data.

Beam Pay Range

$185,000—$225,000 USD

jobs.description:

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This is a role on a “startup" within the organization where we’ll move fast, win our earliest customers in verticals outside of public safety, and build repeatable sales motions and successful partners.

People who are currently in Business Development roles and Sales Support with a focus on lead generation are the ideal candidate.

This is a quota carrying position. Our Enterprise Sales Development Representatives partner with our Strategic Account Executives to build and implement an effective sales pipeline strategy to drive the adoption of select products and services to our Enterprise markets. At the same time, we want to ensure our Enterprise Sales Development Representatives operate with a sense of grace and professionalism that ensures a delightful customer experience. All of this is done in tight coordination with our Enterprise Sales Operations & Marketing partners.

Enterprise Sales Development Representatives are customer-focused and creative. They are able to think strategically and effectively adjust their approach to meet the needs of our customers. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Technology Operation
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

As the Senior Manager, Enterprise Technology Operations, you will manage the Enterprise Technology budget and forecast, vendor contracts and renewals, headcount and contractor tracking, and leadership reporting. You are the single point of contact for Finance, Sourcing and the leadership team.

This is a senior individual contributor role. The leadership team will rely on you for an accurate, current view of spend, vendors, and headcount, and for recommendations based on it. You will be the first person in this role and will build the processes and reporting.

What You'll Do

• Manage Enterprise Technology budget and forecast for software, services and contractors, including the annual plan, monthly forecast, variance analysis and reconciliation with Finance.

• Maintain a single view of spend across the portfolio by domain, vendor and cost type, used by the leadership team and Finance.

• Maintain a complete view of the vendor portfolio: vendors, contract terms and commitments, costs and renewal dates.

• Lead renewal planning for major contracts in partnership with Sourcing, including timeline, negotiation position and coordination with Legal and other stakeholders.

• Analyze license utilization, overlap and cost across software portfolio, and recommend to Technical Product and Engineering what to expand, consolidate or retire ahead of each renewal.

• Report the cost of running each domain and system to the leadership team as an input to buy, configure or build and prioritization decisions.

• Track headcount, open roles and contractors against the approved plan, and keep the position list current for Finance and other stakeholders.

• Provide cost, licensing and contract analysis for buy, configure or build evaluations.

• Work with FP&A on leadership reporting for Enterprise Technology, adding vendor spend, renewals, hiring status and operating metrics to the financials.

What We're Looking For

• 12+ years in technology business operations, technology finance, vendor management or an equivalent role in engineering organization, including at least 3 years managing a multi million dollar software and services budget.

• Experience running an annual budget and monthly forecast for a technology team, including variance analysis and reconciliation with Finance.

• Experience managing a vendor contract portfolio, including renewals, negotiation support with a Sourcing or Procurement team, true-ups and SOW.

• Working knowledge of SaaS licensing models and cloud cost management, and experience with procure-to-pay and contract management systems.

• Understands the boundary between commercial ownership and technical or delivery ownership, and works within it.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Coupa or a comparable procure-to-pay platform.

• Experience with contract management systems.

• Compliance sensitive or audit controlled procurement and spend processes.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

• Employer paid commuter benefit

• Support program for new parents

• Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

• Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

• Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

• Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

• Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Associate II, Fund Administration supports Ren’s donor-advised fund (DAF) operations by opening and maintaining new donor-advised funds promptly and accurately. Reporting to the Sr Manager, Fund Administration, this early-career professional applies established procedures and guidelines to prepare investment account paperwork and record data in Ren’s CRM and data management systems.

The role communicates with financial professionals and their associates to gather the information needed to open new DAFs and their accompanying investment accounts. Work is of limited scope, follows standard practices, and is reviewed periodically against defined procedures. The position receives general instruction on day-to-day work and new assignments and builds stable working relationships across the Fund Administration team and its internal partners.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Open new donor-advised funds (DAFs) by following established standards, timelines, and procedures, escalating exceptions to the Sr, Fund Administration.

• Review submitted DAF applications for completeness and accuracy against defined guidelines, and gather any missing information from financial professionals and their associates.

• Prepare and complete investment account paperwork, and coordinate with Ren’s authorized signers to obtain required signatures.

• Partners cross functionally with other teams to support the accurate opening and ongoing maintenance of funds.

• Enter and maintain DAF and investment account information and statuses in Ren’s CRM, data management, and financial management systems so that records stay current and accurate.

• Request and verify investment account login credentials, add them to the aggregation software according to each custodian’s process, and assist in establishing online access to open investment accounts.

• Deliver consistent, high-quality service by making outbound calls and responding to inbound calls and emails from financial professionals and associates about DAF and investment account paperwork and requests.

• Apply standard practices to identify and resolve routine processing issues, recognizing when a situation calls for guidance or an occasional deviation from established procedure.

• Other duties as assigned.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Associates degree preferred

• 3 or more years of experience in operations, financial services industry, or related field

• Intermediate Microsoft Suites (Excel, Office and PowerPoint)

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize high work volume without sacrificing quality or efficiency

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Organized, detail-oriented, and strong problem-solving skills

• Strong time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Digital
jobs.description:
Bantam Communications is seeking a Senior Associate, Digital to plan and run the digital side of our advanced energy project campaigns. Our campaigns reach the people who decide whether a project moves forward, whether that is residents and local officials in a single county or the state and federal policymakers who shape the conditions for building. In this role, you will build digital plans, run and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, Google, and StackAdapt, manage email campaigns and landing pages, create and oversee organic content and community management, and present results and recommendations to clients. You will also build AI agents and workflows in Claude, including ad decks in Claude Design, that take repeatable work off the team’s plate, such as copy variants, campaign QA, and reporting. The role reports to the Director of Communications, with a dotted line to the Director of Technology & Innovation for AI workflows and platform work.



The ideal candidate already builds with AI in their day-to-day work and wants to keep pushing what it can do for campaigns. You can carry several campaigns at once, read performance data closely and act on it, and write clearly enough that a client can follow your recommendations and act on them. You thrive in a fast-moving, multi-client environment and take pride in getting details like targeting and disclaimers right, because in this work the details decide whether a campaign holds up.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Digital planning: Build digital plans for project campaigns, choosing the channels, audiences, and messages that build support among local residents, officials, and policymakers. Work with campaign managers to align each digital plan with the campaign's goals.

 - Paid campaigns: Build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta (Facebook), Google (Search, YouTube, and Display), and StackAdapt, covering lead generation, awareness, geofencing, and search. Manage county- and town-level targeting, budgets, pacing, and bids across several projects at once.

 - Build with AI: Build and maintain Claude agents and workflows for repeatable digital work, such as copy and creative variants, ad decks in Claude Design, campaign QA, and report generation. Review every output for accuracy and compliance before it reaches a client or goes live, and share what works with the team in collaboration with the Director of Technology & Innovation.

 - Landing pages and lead capture: Build and maintain ad landing pages and lead form integrations, and keep lead data clean and ready to hand off.

 - Measurement and analytics: Set up conversion tracking, pixels, and analytics so every campaign measures what matters. Analyze performance, including cost-per-lead, and use the results to refine targeting, creative, and spend.

 - Client reporting: Maintain live dashboards and deliver campaign reports that say plainly what happened and what should change. Present findings and recommendations to clients.

 - Email campaigns: Develop and manage email campaigns, including drip campaigns, and track open rates, link clicks, and other engagement metrics to improve content and timing.

 - Organic content and community management: Create and oversee monthly organic content calendars for each project, written to client-specific SEO, tone, and messaging conventions and routed for approval through HeyOrca. Oversee community management, including Facebook comment moderation, client-approved responses, and escalating threats or safety concerns per protocol.

 - Compliance: Manage ad accounts, page access, and partner permissions. Set up new and white label pages and “paid for by” political disclaimers, track platform policy windows, and handle ad rejections and appeals.

 - Advocacy campaign support: Support letter-of-support and advocacy campaigns, including Speak4 landing pages, RSVP and event promotion, and letter-of-support tracking.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 5 years of experience planning and running paid digital campaigns for political, issue advocacy, public affairs, or agency clients.

 - Hands-on experience building and optimizing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including targeting, budgets, and disclaimers.

 - A track record of building with Claude in real campaign work, including agents, ad decks, and Claude Design projects.

 - Experience building landing pages and connecting lead forms to a CRM or email platform.

 - Experience setting up conversion tracking, pixels, UTMs, and web analytics (GA4 or similar).

 - Ability to analyze campaign performance and present findings and recommendations clearly to clients.

 - Experience building and managing email campaigns, including drip campaigns, and tracking open rates, click-through rates, and other engagement metrics.

 - Experience creating organic content calendars and managing online communities, including comment moderation.

 - Able to manage several concurrent campaigns independently in a remote environment, with proactive project-management hygiene.

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist II, Computational Biology
jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon’s discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

Position

We seek a Senior Scientist in Computational Biology to drive diverse early drug discovery efforts across Eikon’s target portfolio. In this key role, the successful applicant will use their rigorous analytical skills in close collaboration with diverse discovery scientists to conceive and evaluate complex, progress-enabling experiments across our target portfolio. This person will also help shape how Eikon evaluates and adopts novel experimental systems and will partner with colleagues developing quantitative models to ensure that emerging computational methods remain grounded in sound biological reasoning.

About You

For this role, we are seeking an experienced, rigorous, and results-driven computational scientist with a strong track record driving high impact contributions to advance early research drug discovery programs. You are an enthusiastic and generous collaborator who is skilled in both traditional and emergent drug discovery technologies and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment uniting diverse disciplines and subject matter experts . This role will require someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and a strategic thinker who can draw on deep technical and biological knowledge to synthesize data from diverse internal and external sources to resolve nuanced scientific questions. You bring both scientific depth and methodological creativity to bear on emerging experimental systems and works closely with quantitative modeling colleagues to ground new computational approaches in strong biological reasoning.

What You’ll Do

• Drive the development and adoption of novel experimental systems and techniques relevant to Eikon’s target portfolio, collaborating closely with experimental and computational teams across programs.

• Develop and apply analytical approaches, statistical methods, and proof-of-concept tools to support new experimental strategies.

• Analyze multimodal data to evaluate experimental systems, identify enabling insights, and define the limits of interpretation for biological applications.

• Apply statistical, biological, and experimental expertise to evaluate complex experiments. Distill information from diverse sources to reach relevant and testable biological conclusions.

Qualifications

• Postdoc Fellowship plus 4 years of relevant experience or PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, or a quantitative field with deep expertise in statistics or method development, plus 7 years of relevant industry experience.

• Hands-on experience developing and applying methods for high-dimensional, multi-modal datasets, including experience designing, evaluating, and integrating high-throughput experiments. Ability to independently define analytical approaches for novel technologies, develop effective solutions, and validate results with minimal oversight.

• Proven experience analyzing complex genomics datasets across one or more technical modalities, such as bulk, single-cell, or spatial transcriptomics, pooled or arrayed CRISPR screens, MAVEs or other multiplexed reporter assays, high content imaging data, Perturb-seq, or other relevant technologies

• Experience working with large consortia and public datasets such as UK Biobank, TCGA, GTEx, ENCODE, gnomAD, and Human Cell Atlas.

• Expertise using one or more high level programming language (e.g., R, Python, or similar) to solve biological problems; well versed in modern coding and computing best practices such as cloud deployment, version control, containerization, etc.

• Demonstrated record of impactful research, evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals.

• Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Additional weight will be given to qualified applicants with experience partnering with computational/algorithms teams on statistical or machine learning model development and/or methodological development.

At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including:​

• 401k plan with company matching​

• Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%)​

• Mental health and wellness benefits​

• Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns​

• Generous paid time off and holiday policies​

• Life/AD&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee-paid life/AD&D policies ​

• Enhanced parental leave benefit​

• Daily subsidized lunch program when on-site​

The expected salary range for this role is $191,000 to $231,000 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise.

Eikon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment.

jobs.title: Return Specialist
jobs.description:
Our Story

At Adorama Rental Company, we are dedicated to empowering creators by working hand-in-hand to help them bring their vision to life—and beyond. As a trusted partner to the cinema community, we provide the tools, technical expertise, and innovative solutions that make the impossible possible.

• Growth Mindset: We set high standards, embrace failure, and are open to change.

• Be Customer-Centered: We focus on the end-to-end customer experience.

• Take Ownership & Dig Deeper: We are proactive, use data, and avoid shortcuts.

• Think Like a Start-Up: We move fast, stay flexible, and celebrate every win.

• Be Humble & Respectful: We assume positive intent, listen actively, and support one another.

What You'll Do

We are seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and dependable Return Specialist to join our team at a professional cinema camera and lighting rental house in New York City.

The Return Specialist receives, inspects, checks in, and processes camera, lighting, grip, and production equipment returned by film, television, commercial, and other production clients. This position plays a critical role in maintaining accurate inventory, identifying damaged or missing equipment, and ensuring gear is accounted for and ready for its next rental.

The ideal candidate has a strong work ethic, excellent attention to detail, an interest in film production equipment, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced rental environment.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Returns & Check-In

• Receive and process returned rental orders from production clients and crew members.

• Verify all returned equipment against rental contracts, packing lists, and inventory records.

• Confirm that all accessories, cables, power supplies, mounts, adapters, cases, and other components are accounted for.

• Identify missing, damaged, malfunctioning, or incorrectly returned equipment.

But you won’t be alone.

You’d be responsible for maintaining excellent day-to-day communications with clients, while aligning creative delivery across broad campaigns and business objectives, with oversight of delivering operational excellence. And while you won’t be expected to do any designing, you’ll need to understand the design-process and executional excellence across an entire suite of mediums.

The ideal candidate will have a creative background, not on the tools, but in the environment to include design, motion graphics, and film, alongside strong leadership, organizational and communication skills and a proven track record of project management delivery.

Client management skills will be critical as we define and build new operating models and key stakeholder engagement will assist Williams Lea in shaping a service delivery team that is fit for the emerging business changes and growth plan.

The Williams Lea business supports a wide network of clients, with a dedicated team and is supported by the wider Williams Lea senior management team.  The scope of services currently delivered, combined with the support of Williams Lea leadership engagement enables the account management team to truly take ownership in running their business, driving innovation and best practice, while delivering a world class business support service.

jobs.title: Threat Researcher
jobs.description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Threat Researcher to join our Threat Intelligence team.

This is an analyst role for someone who is equally interested in understanding threats and figuring out how to make intelligence useful.

You will conduct original research into active campaigns, attacker behavior, and emerging email and identity attack techniques. You will also draw on research and data produced by other parts of the Threat Intelligence organization. Your job is to connect those inputs, determine what is meaningful, and turn them into the right intelligence product for the audience and objective.

That might mean a concise threat brief for a security practitioner, a deeper analytical report, tailored intelligence content for Customer Success to use in a customer QBR, a briefing for a prospect, a webinar for a broader audience, or content supporting a high-priority sales pursuit.

The defining skill for this role is intelligence synthesis: combining technical research, data, threat context, and audience needs into a clear assessment and compelling narrative.

You will work closely with Threat Intelligence, Detection, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams. You will also interact directly with customers and prospects, bringing intelligence to life through briefings, presentations, webinars, and tailored content.

Success in this role is not measured by how many documents you produce. It is measured by whether you can identify the important intelligence, explain what it means, and put it in a form that helps the audience understand and act on it.

What You Will Do

Analyze & Research

• Independently scope and lead complex or ambiguous threat intelligence investigations into active campaigns, attacker behavior, TTPs, and emerging email and identity attack techniques. Determine appropriate research approaches, evaluate incomplete or conflicting evidence, and develop defensible intelligence assessments with limited direction.

• Use Abnormal's platform, internal telemetry and data, threat intelligence sources, and external research to investigate threats and develop intelligence assessments.

• Identify meaningful patterns, connections, and emerging trends across threat activity.

• Develop a strong understanding of how Abnormal detects and responds to the threats you analyze.

Synthesize Intelligence

• Independently synthesize complex and sometimes conflicting intelligence from disparate sources, determine the most consequential insights, and develop defensible assessments and recommendations tailored to the audience and decision at hand.

• Determine what is most relevant to a particular audience, customer situation, or business objective.

• Translate raw findings into insight, implications, recommendations, and a clear narrative.

• Adapt the depth, framing, terminology, and format of intelligence based on the audience.

• Connect technical threat activity to business risk and explain why it matters.

Create Intelligence Products

• Produce a range of intelligence deliverables, including:

• Threat briefs

• Analytical reports

• Intelligence content and narratives for customer QBRs

• Customer and prospect briefings

• Webinars and presentations

• Marketing and outreach content

• Executive-level intelligence summaries

• Create both rapid-turnaround intelligence products and deeper analytical work.

• Build reusable narratives, templates, and content structures that improve consistency and scale.

• Maintain high standards for sourcing, analytical accuracy, clarity, and editorial quality.

Engage Customers & Prospects

• Independently lead customer and prospect intelligence engagements, including complex or high-visibility threat briefings, webinars, and presentations. Adapt technical depth and narrative in real time, respond to challenging questions, and ensure the intelligence supports the audience's decisions.

• Work with Sales and Customer Success to understand the context behind a customer or prospect request and tailor intelligence accordingly.

• Respond to time-sensitive customer questions and high-priority pursuits with accurate, relevant, and well-sourced analysis.

• Develop trusted relationships with customer-facing stakeholders and use their feedback to improve intelligence products.

Partner Across the Organization

• Collaborate with Threat Intelligence and Detection teams to incorporate research and technical findings into customer-ready intelligence.

• Serve as a technical resource and mentor to P1 and P2 analysts, strengthening analytical judgment, research methods, intelligence synthesis, and product quality through coaching, peer review, and knowledge sharing.

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to understand upcoming customer moments, pursuits, and content needs.

• Provide targeted enablement and supporting materials that help GTM teams understand and use intelligence effectively.

• Feed insights from customer and field interactions back to Threat Intelligence teams to inform research and detection priorities.

Work Smarter

• Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and similar technologies to accelerate research, synthesis, drafting, tailoring, and editing.

• Develop practical workflows and automation that reduce time spent on routine work while maintaining analytical rigor.

• Apply appropriate human review and validation to ensure AI-assisted work is accurate, well-sourced, and analytically sound.

What We're Looking For

Must Have

• 4+ years of experience in threat intelligence, SOC operations, or a closely related cybersecurity discipline.

• Working knowledge of email and identity attack techniques and the ability to understand and explain IOCs, TTPs, attack campaigns, and threat behavior.

• Demonstrated experience conducting security research and producing written intelligence or security content for different audiences.

• Strong ability to synthesize technical research and data from multiple sources into clear intelligence assessments, narratives, and recommendations.

• Demonstrated analytical judgment in complex or ambiguous investigations, including the ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting evidence, determine the most consequential findings, and develop defensible assessments and recommendations with limited direction.

• Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms, intelligence-sharing communities, and threat hunting concepts.

• Strong writing skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical subjects clearly and concisely.

• Demonstrated ability to independently present complex technical intelligence to customers, executives, security practitioners, or other stakeholders, adapting communication to the audience and responding confidently to questions or challenges.

• Experience working directly with customers or cross-functional stakeholders and translating technical findings into business relevance.

• Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar tools to enhance research, analysis, and writing.

• Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing requests and deliver high-quality work on time.

• Ability to remain calm, accurate, and responsive in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations.

• Demonstrated ability to independently scope, prioritize, and deliver complex intelligence work from initial investigation through final assessment and customer-ready communication, while identifying opportunities to improve analytical quality and production workflows.

• Ability and willingness to strengthen the technical capabilities of other analysts through constructive peer review, knowledge sharing, coaching, and collaborative problem-solving.

• Demonstrated use of AI tools or automation to scale research, analysis, or content production.

• Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and common attack techniques, including phishing, business email compromise (BEC), credential harvesting, malware, and account takeover, with the ability to apply this knowledge to threat research, analysis, and intelligence assessments.

• Basic proficiency in SQL, including the ability to write and modify queries to retrieve, filter, and analyze datasets in support of threat intelligence research and investigations.

Nice to Have

• Experience in email security, phishing detection, anti-abuse systems, or email threat containment.

• Experience in detection engineering, incident response, and email security analysis.

• Experience with Abnormal Security or similar security platforms.

• Public-facing security content experience, such as published research, blogs, conference talks, webinars, or industry reports.

• Experience creating intelligence content for sales cycles, customer QBRs, or other customer-facing security engagements.

• Experience creating training or enablement materials for Sales, Customer Success, or other non-technical teams.

• Experience mentoring, coaching, or training earlier-career security analysts.

• Experience using Python or other scripting tools to automate data analysis, investigate threat activity, or improve intelligence research workflows.

• Security certifications such as Security+, GIAC (GCTI, GCIH), CISSP, CEH, or similar.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: Senior Demand & Supply Planner
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Planning team is seeking a world-class Senior Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. The Senior Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrated ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Proactive, able to take substantial responsibility across various functions, with a focus on speed and accuracy.

US Salary Range

$142,000—$188,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Mission Engineer - Tampa
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable.

You won't wait to be asked. You'll identify what's broken before it becomes a problem, build solutions that didn't exist yesterday, and earn the kind of trust that makes you indispensable to the agency — and to Axon.

In this embedded role, you are the primary owner of customer outcomes within a strategic account — accountable for the full lifecycle of Axon's ecosystem. You combine deep technical expertise, builder instinct, operational leadership, and executive presence to help agencies transform how they operate, not just adopt software. You embed for the long haul: opening the laptop onsite, shipping on Axon's stack, holding the room when it matters, and iterating on what you build until it sticks in production.

Success is measured by the agency's operational outcomes and working solutions in production — not product health, not activity, not slideware.

What You'll Do

This role is intentionally undefined in the day-to-day. Priorities shift with agency mission tempo, operational crises, and emerging opportunities. If you need a fixed playbook to succeed, this isn't the role for you.

Building is the job. You will use Axon's platform — AI Era, agents, workflows, integrations, and data tools — to design, build, and ship new capabilities on site. You own outcomes end to end across deployment, adoption, optimization, and ongoing success — as the accountable owner, not a coordinator of other teams' work.

Onsite Building & Platform Delivery

• Discover agency problems onsite and translate them into buildable, compliant solutions tied to mission outcomes

• Design and ship working tools on Axon's platform: AI agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and data pipelines — built and tested with real users and real data

• Build with Axon products, not around them — configure, integrate, and extend DEMS, Fusus, AI Era, Records, and related systems in the agency environment

• Iterate in the field until adoption sticks, then document patterns for reuse across accounts

• Apply responsible innovation guardrails — CJIS, evidence integrity, privacy — in every build. Ship working software, not slideware

• Troubleshoot onsite and coordinate root-cause resolution across Product, Engineering, Support, and Services when builds or integrations break

AI Build & Adoption

• Build and deploy AI-powered workflows (agents, prompts, RAG, evaluations) that solve defined agency problems — not generic experimentation

• Drive hands-on adoption with the people who use what you build daily

• Measure whether changes stick — usage, workflow impact, mission outcomes — and iterate when they don't

Operational Transformation & Leadership

• Assess workflows onsite, identify friction and mission impact, and define what to build before you build it

• Move from reactive support to proactive outcome design — arrive with hypotheses, validate with command staff and operators, then build to match

• Build trusted relationships with agency leadership and operational stakeholders; lead QBRs, mission reviews, and strategic planning

• Define success metrics and capture baselines before major deployments so impact is proven, not assumed

Field Intelligence & Growth

• Capture customer insights, workflow patterns, and adoption barriers; share field intelligence with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap decisions

• Turn one-off builds into reusable playbooks and operational frameworks

• Identify expansion opportunities based on demonstrated impact; partner with Sales on long-term account strategy

Onsite Engagement & Outcomes

• Maintain consistent onsite presence (approximately 3-4 days/week), closely connected to agency operations and evolving needs

• Track customer success metrics: time-to-first-production-use, adoption depth by role and site, workflow improvements, and mission outcomes

• Support Sales → Post-Sales onboarding and handoff, establishing goals and accountability from day one

What You Bring

Required

• Experience in customer-facing technical roles, program management, operational transformation, or complex deployment environments (typically 8+ years; varied experience welcome)

• Former law enforcement or military experience preferred, not required

• Proven builder: you have shipped working automations, agents, workflows, integrations, or AI-enabled tools in customer environments — configuring products, writing integration logic, and delivering production-ready solutions. Using AI to assist is expected; owning the build is required

• Comfort working across technical and operational domains: hardware, software, cloud, AI-enabled technologies, and integrated systems

• Strong communication with both technical teams and senior stakeholders, including command staff in mission-critical environments

• Full ownership mentality in ambiguous, fast-changing environments; ability to navigate competing priorities across Product, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Services

• Ability to obtain and maintain CJIS compliance and adhere to security standards

Preferred

• Experience in public safety, law enforcement, corrections, or other mission-critical operational environments

• Familiarity with Records, Evidence, digital workflows, AI-enabled platforms, or integrated public safety ecosystems

• Background in forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or operational transformation at scale

Additional Information

We recognize that candidates may bring strengths from different backgrounds and experiences. If your experience aligns closely with this role, we encourage you to apply.
This role is for builders who earn trust in the room — not for those looking for a predictable schedule or narrowly defined responsibilities. Every week looks different. That's the job.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401(k) with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, dental, and vision plans

• Fitness programs

• Emotional and mental wellness support

• Learning and development programs

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

We work across OpenAI to develop partnerships grounded in trust, usefulness, and measurable impact. Our work goes beyond individual launches and includes product education, partner feedback, and collaborative programs that create lasting value for partners and OpenAI.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced partnerships leader to develop and scale high-touch onboarding and enablement experiences for creators, brands and institutions.

You will help partners move from initial curiosity to meaningful, hands-on use of OpenAI’s products. This includes understanding their work and ambitions, designing tailored onboarding experiences, helping them develop authentic use cases, and ensuring they have the support needed to engage confidently over time.

You will serve as a trusted bridge between external partners and teams across OpenAI. You’ll translate product capabilities into relevant creative possibilities, bring actionable feedback and cultural insights back to the company, and develop an operating model that combines highly personalized support with the systems needed to scale.

In this role, you will:

Help stakeholders understand partner needs and identify recurring opportunities or friction points that could inform product development and company strategy.

 - Create feedback loops that show partners how their perspectives are heard and acted upon.

 - Develop playbooks, enablement materials, partner briefs, follow-up plans, escalation paths, and reusable resources that balance personalized engagement with repeatable systems.

 - Establish clear ownership and handoffs across Partnerships, Product, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Policy, and Support as the program scales.

 - Define and track meaningful measures of success, including partner engagement, time to activation, depth of use, relationship health, actionable product feedback, and partnership outcomes. Use qualitative and quantitative insights to improve, expand, and scale the program.

 - Build exceptional relationships through the judgment, discretion, and responsiveness required to earn trust over time.

 - Develop authentic use cases around a partner’s real goals rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.

 - Communicate and facilitate effectively, whether leading intimate working sessions or engaging senior and high-profile audiences.

 - Bring hands-on fluency with AI products and curiosity about how they can support creative work, expression, and connection.

 - Have strong program-management discipline, including experience developing workflows, standards, measurement, and scalable resources.

 - Move comfortably between highly personalized partner engagement and the behind-the-scenes operational work required to deliver it well.

jobs.title: Manager, Human Resources
jobs.description:
The Corporate HR team at NBCUniversal is looking for an HR Manager to support our Corporate Finance organization, while also serving as an on the ground HR resource for other Corporate Functions with employees in the Philadelphia office.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being close to the business, building strong relationships, and helping leaders and employees work through both the everyday and more complex people challenges that come up.

In this role, you’ll be a trusted HR partner to leaders and employees across Corporate Finance. Your work will cover employee relations, performance management, talent development, organizational and workforce planning, compensation, succession planning, and recruitment. Some days that may mean coaching a manager through a difficult employee situation; others may involve thinking through the structure of a team, identifying development opportunities, or helping plan for future talent needs.

We’re looking for someone who is practical, curious, and comfortable figuring things out. You’ll have room to take ownership, use your judgment, and bring ideas forward, while also having a strong HR team around you to collaborate with. You’ll work closely with partners across Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Total Rewards, HR Operations, Employment Law, and other HR teams depending on what the business needs.

Here you can:

• Serve as a trusted HR partner to Corporate Finance leaders and employees.
• Serve as an on-the-ground HR resource for employees and leaders across Corporate Functions in the Philadelphia office, helping address local needs and connect them with the appropriate HR partners and resources
• Coach and advise managers on employee relations, performance, development, and other people-related matters.
• Manage employee relations issues and workplace investigations, partnering with Employment Law when needed.
• Support key talent processes including performance management, compensation planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and employee development.
• Work with leaders to think through organizational needs, team structure, workforce planning, and talent priorities.
• Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring leaders to support recruitment and hiring needs.
• Help leaders and employees understand and navigate HR policies, practices, and programs.
• Use workforce data and employee feedback to spot trends, identify opportunities, and help inform decisions.
• Work closely with HR partners and subject matter experts to find solutions and get things done.
• Lead and contribute to HR projects and initiatives that improve how we support, develop, and engage employees.

Here you'll need:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Labor Relations or related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience
• At least 5 years of progressive professional HR experience
• Experience supporting leaders and employees across a range of HR matters.
• Employee relations experience, including handling sensitive issues and workplace investigations.
• Solid written and verbal communication skills.

What we'll look for:

• Good judgment and the confidence to work through challenging or sensitive situations.
• Comfortable being a visible HR presence in the workplace and building relationships across different teams and functions.
• Curious about AI and emerging technology, with good judgment about where these tools can make work simpler and more effective.
• A practical problem solver who can get to the heart of an issue and find a path forward.
• A self-starter who takes ownership and keeps things moving without needing a lot of direction.
• Resourceful and comfortable finding answers, bringing in the right people, and figuring things out along the way.
• Able to manage competing priorities and adapt as business needs change.
• Builds trust easily and can be both supportive and candid with employees and leaders.
• Curious about the business and interested in understanding how HR can help it succeed.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
