jobs.title: Vice President of Development
jobs.description:
VICE PRESIDENT OF DEVELOPMENT

ABOUT FULFILLMENT FUND

For nearly 50 years, Fulfillment Fund has transformed lives by empowering young people from educationally and economically under-resourced communities to graduate from high school, succeed in college, and launch meaningful careers. Since our founding, we have helped more than 37,000 Los Angeles students build pathways to higher education, economic mobility, and lifelong success through our college access, college success, and career readiness programs.

ABOUT THE POSITION

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and serving as a key member of the executive leadership team, the Vice President of Development will lead the growth and diversification of Fulfillment Fund’s comprehensive fundraising program. This strategic, results-driven leader will build on current development plans to expand philanthropic revenue, strengthen donor relationships, and create a sustainable pipeline of support for the organization’s long-term goals. As Fulfillment Fund approaches its milestone 50th anniversary, this leader will have a unique opportunity to help shape this landmark moment, celebrating the organization’s legacy while inspiring investment in its next chapter.

Partnering closely with the CEO, Board of Directors, and program, finance, and marketing teams, the Vice President of Development will expand relationships with foundations, corporations, and individual donors while using the anniversary to reengage longtime supporters and introduce new audiences to the mission. This leader will also strengthen the development department’s infrastructure, mentor and develop staff, and establish clear systems for accountability, forecasting, and performance. The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on fundraiser and compelling storyteller who brings a builder’s strategic mindset, strong executive presence, and the confidence to navigate organizational change with internal and external stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership

• Create and execute a comprehensive development plan in close partnership with the CEO, senior leadership, and Board of Directors, aligning fundraising priorities with the organization's multi-year strategic plan and long-term growth goals.

• Develop and execute a diversified fundraising approach that expands unrestricted revenue, strengthens recurring support, deepens engagement and stewardship of existing donors, and cultivates new sources of philanthropic support.

• Strengthen relationships with existing donors, ensuring they feel valued, engaged, informed and inspired to continue supporting Fulfillment Fund.

• Build and maintain a qualified fundraising pipeline, establishing clear performance metrics, realistic revenue forecasts, and transparent reporting on progress and challenges.

Board & External Relations

• Build trusted, collaborative relationships directly with Board members, understanding their individual interests, strengths, and networks, and inspiring meaningful engagement in fundraising strategy, donor cultivation, and philanthropic ambassadorship.

• Equip Board members with the messaging, resources, and guidance needed to leverage their networks, build relationships, and confidently represent Fulfillment Fund to prospective supporters.

• Represent Fulfillment Fund at donor meetings, community gatherings, and philanthropic events to strengthen visibility, credibility, and external partnerships.

• Communicate the organization's vision, impact, and future direction with confidence and transparency, building trust among donors, partners, and other stakeholders.

Fundraising & Donor Engagement

• Lead a diversified fundraising portfolio encompassing major gifts, foundation and corporate partnerships, annual giving, grants, planned giving, and special events.

• Develop and implement a major gifts program, establishing clear prospect identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies, while personally managing a portfolio of high-net-worth donors in partnership with the CEO and Board of Directors.

• Strengthen foundation and corporate partnerships by identifying new funding opportunities, developing compelling proposals, and overseeing grant strategy and funder stewardship to ensure alignment with organizational priorities.

• Expand and diversify the donor base through strategic prospecting, stewardship, and retention efforts, including opportunities for alumni engagement, grassroots giving, and participation from emerging generations of donors.

• Partner with program and marketing teams to translate student experiences, program outcomes, and organizational data into compelling stories and cases for philanthropic investment.

• Provide strategic fundraising leadership for the annual gala and other development initiatives in partnership with internal teams and consultants, while expanding revenue opportunities beyond traditional events.

• Leverage donor data, giving trends, and prospect research to inform fundraising decisions, strengthen engagement, and identify opportunities for growth.

Team Leadership & Development Operations

• Lead, develop, and grow the development team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations while fostering a collaborative, accountable culture grounded in trust, constructive feedback, professional development, and shared success.

• Strengthen development operations, including prospect management, donor tracking, portfolio assignments, reporting, and the effective use of Raiser's Edge and other fundraising systems.

• Partner closely with finance to develop accurate revenue forecasts, align fundraising projections with organizational budgets, and ensure timely and reliable financial and grant reporting.

• Build strong cross-functional relationships with program and marketing teams to coordinate fundraising activities, respond to emerging opportunities, and ensure effective communication and follow-through.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in Nonprofit Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

• A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in nonprofit fundraising or development, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.

• Proven success leading multimillion-dollar fundraising efforts, securing significant gifts from foundations, corporations, and individual donors, and developing diversified revenue strategies. Experience in education-focused fundraising, including relationships with educational foundations or alumni giving programs, is highly desirable.

• Demonstrated success developing a major gifts program, including prospect identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship, and translating fundraising strategies into actionable plans, qualified donor pipelines, and measurable revenue goals.

• Proven experience building, leading, and developing fundraising teams, including developing mid-career professionals, strengthening departmental operations, and establishing clear performance expectations.

• Highly collaborative senior leader with strategic vision, exceptional judgment, emotional intelligence, executive presence, and the ability to inspire confidence among staff, donors, senior leadership, and the Board.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate organizational change, manage competing stakeholder priorities, and build trust through transparency, adaptability, and consistent follow-through.

• Strong financial acumen, including fundraising budgets, revenue forecasting, performance metrics, and data-informed decision-making. Proficiency with donor management systems, prospect tracking, and fundraising analytics; experience with Raiser's Edge preferred.

• A collaborative, hands-on leadership style, with the initiative, decisiveness, and flexibility to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day execution.

• A high level of integrity, professionalism, emotional intelligence, and accountability, with a genuine commitment to developing others and advancing organizational success.

• A deep passion for Fulfillment Fund's mission, educational equity, and expanding opportunities for students from under-resourced communities.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Fulfillment Fund offers the following to eligible employees:

• Annual salary range: $165,000– $190,000 based on experience.

• Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) with match.

• Generous paid time off, including holidays, vacation, sick leave, and the week between Christmas and New Year’s.

• Hybrid work schedule with two in-office days per week.

• Professional development support within a collaborative, purpose-driven culture.

The organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering diversity and inclusion. The organization promotes equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. In doing so, we comply with local, state, and federal laws and regulations to ensure an equal employment opportunity for everyone. We don’t discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, ancestry, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, disability, citizenship, military service obligation, veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. Our policies and personnel practices are intended to ensure that all of us are treated equally with regard to recruiting, hiring, and advancement, and our decisions on employment are made to further the principle of equal employment opportunities for employees.

Envision Consulting has been retained by Fulfillment Fund to search for its Vice President of Development.

Applicants needing accommodation for any part of the application process may contact Envision Consulting at 626.714.7577 to request and arrange for assistance.

jobs.title: Senior Azure Platform / DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
SENIOR AZURE PLATFORM / DEVOPS ENGINEER




ABOUT MAKAI

Makai uses best-in-class AI and data to solve real-world operational and strategic challenges at scale. We help businesses with enterprise automation, human-machine teaming, product design and development, and market intelligence. Until now, people have had to learn and adapt to software. Makai creates solutions that adapt to people because technology will never be 100% accurate. People are essential for all of our human-machine teaming solutions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We build and run cloud platforms for our clients. A lot of the time that means standing up a reusable Terraform foundation and adapting it for each client and environment. You'd own these platforms: design them, build them from an empty subscription, keep them running, and act as the person who actually knows how the whole thing fits together.

This is a senior role with a lot of trust attached. The clients differ, the topologies differ, the pipelines differ. What stays constant is Azure and the expectation that you can size up an unfamiliar setup, make the right calls, and own the result.




THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL BE ABLE TO

 - Stand up new platforms from scratch: network, compute, data, and the pipeline to ship to them.

 - Make the architecture calls and live with them. That includes knowing when a Terraform change is a safe in-place update and when it's a destroy-and-replace you should never run blind against production.

 - Run migrations that carry real risk. Move a live platform onto a new foundation, read the plan correctly, write the runbook, and have a rollback ready before you start.

 - Keep platforms healthy over time: provider upgrades, drift, security, and not letting a shared foundation rot as more clients land on it.

 - Work directly with the client's own DevOps engineers. Often they're the ones running the apply and you're advising, so you need to explain a plan, unblock a failure quickly, and be someone the engineer holding the keys trusts.


QUALIFICATIONS

Azure experience is the hard requirement. You've built and run production Azure yourself, not just used modules someone else wrote. Specifically:

 - Azure networking is where most of the work lives: VNets and subnets, private endpoints and private DNS zones, NSGs and UDRs, NAT, Application Gateway and WAF, load balancers, and hub-and-spoke / Virtual WAN.

 - Terraform on Azure, with state treated as something you respect: workspaces, migrations, imports, remote backends, and the discipline not to force an apply through a lifecycle guard.

 - The delivery path: Azure Container Registry, VM Scale Sets and cloud-init, and CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub.

 - Azure data services: Postgres Flexible Server, managed Redis, Blob storage, and a real sense of their sizing, failover, and cutover risks.

 - Entra ID and RBAC: app registrations, service principals, role assignments scoped properly across subscriptions.

 - Clear writing and a level head on a live call. You can hand someone a runbook they can follow without you in the room.

 - Candidates must be authorized to work in the US. No visa sponsorship is available for this position.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Azure certs (AZ-104, AZ-305).

 - Temporal or similar workflow runtimes, and scripting (Bash, Python) for the glue.

 - Past consulting or client-embedded work. You've been the outside expert before.


HOW WE WORK

Small senior teams, real ownership. We'd rather have one engineer who understands a platform top to bottom than several who each own a slice.




CORE VALUES FOR MAKAI EMPLOYEES

 - Be a flexible, innovative and creative thinker

 - Be congenial and a team player

 - Be self-sufficient

 - Be self-driven with an ownership mentality

 - Have a strong work ethic

jobs.title: Premium Auditor I
jobs.description:
Pie's mission is to empower small businesses to thrive by making commercial insurance affordable and as easy as pie. We leverage technology to transform how small businesses buy and experience commercial insurance.

Like our small business customers, we are a diverse team of builders, dreamers, and entrepreneurs who are driven by core values and operating principles that guide every decision we make.

The Premium Auditor I is responsible for conducting standard premium audits for routine business structures for single and multiple entities using mail, phone, and virtual platforms. This role involves reviewing payroll records, tax returns, and financial documents to ensure accurate policy coverage and compliance with regulatory guidelines. The auditor applies classification codes using NCCI, PAAS, and state-specific requirements, thoroughly documents findings, and prepares detailed audit worksheets.

How You’ll Do It

Core Audit Execution

• Conduct standard premium audits via mail, phone, and virtual platforms across routine industries and business types.

• Review and verify payroll records, tax returns, 1099s, and supporting financial documentation with meticulous attention to detail.

• Analyze business operations to identify all relevant exposures and ensure proper policy coverage.

• Identify and apply appropriate classification codes using NCCI guidelines, PAAS, and state-specific bureau requirements.

• Document audit findings thoroughly and prepare detailed audit worksheets.

• Ensure all audit work complies with established business rules and regulatory guidelines.

Insured Relationship Management & Communication

• Communicate professionally with policyholders via phone, email, and virtual meetings to gather required documentation.

• Conduct thorough interviews to understand business operations, employee roles, and exposure classifications.

• Explain audit processes clearly to insureds and address questions about documentation requirements.

• Build positive relationships while maintaining professional boundaries throughout the audit process.

• Handle initial concerns and questions about audit procedures (not billing-related issues).

• Coordinate schedules and follow up appropriately to ensure timely audit completion.

Virtual & Technology-Enhanced Audit Capabilities

• Conduct virtual audits using screen-sharing and remote access technologies.

• Guide insureds through document sharing and virtual collaboration platforms.

• Utilize emerging audit technologies and software to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

• Adapt audit methodologies based on insured capabilities and preferences.

• Maintain security protocols for remote document review and virtual meetings.

Data Analysis & Classification Expertise

• Analyze standard payroll structures, contractor relationships, and employee classifications.

• Research and apply appropriate workers' compensation classification codes across multiple states.

• Identify potential misclassifications and exposure gaps that could impact coverage.

• Review business operations for changes since policy inception that may affect classifications.

• Ensure proper documentation of all exposures for accurate premium calculations.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

• Ensure all audit documentation meets regulatory standards and company policies.

• Complete audits within established timeframes while maintaining thoroughness.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of all insured information and business data.

Process Development & Continuous Improvement

• Provide regular feedback on audit procedures and technology effectiveness.

• Support implementation of new audit technologies and methodologies.

The Right Stuff

• Minimum 1-2 years conducting Workers Compensation premium audits.

• Working knowledge of NCCI classification systems and state bureau requirements.

• Experience working directly with business owners and financial personnel.

• Multi-state audit experience preferred.

Technical Competencies:

• Strong understanding of payroll systems, tax documentation, and business financial records.

• Working proficiency with classification systems (NCCI, PAAS) and state-specific regulatory requirements.

• Experience with virtual meeting platforms and screen-sharing technologies.

• Foundational skills with audit software, Google Workspace applications, and emerging technologies.

• Ability to analyze standard business operations and identify relevant exposures.

• Understanding of contractor vs. employee relationships and classification implications.

Communication & Relationship Skills:

jobs.title: Market Owner - Los Angeles, CA Metro Area
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Market Owner, you’re at the helm of a market consisting of at least four hospitals in one geographical area, and have a sense of ownership over everything that happens at each location. Hospital leaders, including Medical Directors and Hospital Managers, report to you. While they oversee their individual functions and the day-to-day at their locations, you are accountable for the growth, success, and support of every VEGgie in your hospitals, as well as the financial goals of the VEGs in your market. By finding ways to say YES, you empower your teams to do the unexpected, fostering an environment where innovation and care go hand-in-hand. You ensure that customers remain central to everything your hospitals do and uphold the VEG experience at every touchpoint. Passionate about building and protecting VEG's brand, you instill confidence in local rDVMs, ensuring they know their customers and patients are in trusted hands. You collaborate with experts across every VEG department, bringing the best resources to your hospitals and making it possible for your teams to create extraordinary patient outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Drive multiple hospitals in your market, ensuring operational, clinical, and cultural excellence across every location

• Coach and guide hospital leaders to drive growth, performance, and an outstanding customer experience

• Build deep relationships with referring veterinarians and community partners to elevate VEG’s reputation and referral network

• Own and manage your market’s P&L, evaluating financial performance, driving revenue growth, and building smart, sustainable budgets

• Champion training and development by identifying growth opportunities, implementing initiatives, and ensuring clinical and operational upskilling

• Hire and retain top talent, building high-performing, empowered teams through local networking, recruiting, and succession planning

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., HR, Legal, Technology) to bring resources, improvements, and innovations to your hospitals

• Monitor market trends and competition to drive local growth, explore new services, and identify future hospital locations

• Represent and protect the VEG brand in your region by engaging with your community and finding ways to give back

• Foster a culture where VEGgies feel seen, heard and valued and want to grow and make an impact

WHO WE NEED

• Come from any background (e.g. DVM, M.B.A., etc), and either have or are willing to gain clinical understanding

• 7 to 10 years of relevant experience

• Analytical, with the creative propensity to identify opportunities while staying focused on your mission

• An experienced leader, well-versed in developing high performing teams, operating a service business, and presiding over a multi-site operational business

• Live close to your hospitals and able to routinely work alongside your teams (for full days, varying days of the week, multiple times per month, with people in all roles)

• Able to be in the field; 25% work from home, 75% on-site at local hospitals or off-site meetings

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($240,000 - 260,000 based on experience), including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Reporting Manager
jobs.description:
Join Riverside Natural Foods Ltd., a Canadian-based, family-owned, and globally operating business, committed to leaving the world better than we found it. As a B-Corp certified, Triple-Bottom Line company, we proudly manufacture nutritious, 'better-for-you' snacks such as MadeGood and GOOD TO GO. We value teamwork, humility, respect, ownership, adaptability, grit, and fun.

We’re on an ambitious mission to double our business by 2030, and we need talented individuals like you to help us reach new heights. At Riverside, you’ll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that’s what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let’s tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Financial Reporting leads the accounting and financial reporting function at Riverside Natural Foods, with accountability for an accurate and timely month-end close, consolidated financial reporting and the annual external audit. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this role also leads corporate insurance renewals, owns the FX hedging strategy, and builds RNF’s risk assessment and internal controls framework in partnership with external consultants and business leaders.

This role combines strong technical accounting expertise with practical business judgment and the ability to independently advance multiple priorities. The Senior Manager anticipates emerging risks, challenges existing processes and turns complex financial information into clear stories and actionable recommendations. Through effective team leadership and influence across functions, this individual strengthens accountability, develops people and builds processes and controls that support RNF’s continued growth.

Primary Responsibilities

Accounting and Financial Reporting

• Own the accounting and financial reporting function, setting clear standards for accuracy, timeliness and accountability across the team and international accounting partners.

• Lead the month end and year end close, managing calendars, dependencies and issue resolution; review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, provisions, fixed assets and intercompany transactions.

• Lead global financial consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, supporting schedules and financial statement disclosures in accordance with ASPE.

• Oversee the general ledger chart of accounts and accounting policies to maintain reliable financial data and consistent accounting practices across entities.

• Translate financial results, significant movements and accounting judgments into clear narratives that explain business implications and actions required for Finance leadership and business partners.

• Oversee cash flow and working capital reporting and applicable government remittances and tax instalments, coordinating with internal owners and external advisors to ensure accurate and timely completion.

Annual Audit and Technical Accounting

• Lead the annual external audit from planning through final financial statement issuance, owning the timelines, audit readiness, supporting schedules, team deliverables and resolution of outstanding matters.

• Serve as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating internal stakeholders and international accounting partners to deliver a well-managed audit with timely escalation of significant issues.

• Research and resolve complex accounting matters, prepare and review technical position papers, and assess the reporting implications of new transactions and changes in the business.

• Drive timely resolution of audit findings and management letter recommendations, assigning owners and following through on corrective actions.

Risk Assessment and Internal Controls

• Build RNF’s risk assessment framework with external consultants and business leaders, using growth plans, historical issues and changes in operations to identify key risks and prioritize areas of focus.

• Assess whether key controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively, and partner with business owners to address gaps and implement practical process improvements.

FX Strategy and Corporate Insurance

• Own and lead RNF’s existing rolling 24-month FX exposure and hedging process, coordinating timely forecast updates with business partners and recommending how much currency exposure to hedge and when, in line with business needs and approved risk limits.

• Coordinate approved hedge execution with banking partners and authorized signatories; monitor exposures and hedge outcomes, and oversee related accounting, reconciliations and reporting.

• Lead the annual corporate insurance renewal from planning and data collection through coverage placement, coordinating brokers, insurers and internal stakeholders to meet renewal deadlines.

• Evaluate coverage, limits, deductibles, exclusions and premiums against RNF’s evolving operations and exposures; present renewal recommendations and address coverage needs arising between renewals.

Team Leadership and Continuous Improvement

• Lead and support the accounting team, providing clear direction, coaching and opportunities for ongoing professional development.

• Independently manage multiple concurrent priorities, balancing recurring reporting deadlines with audits, renewals and improvement initiatives; anticipate dependencies, resolve roadblocks and escalate matters with practical recommendations.

• Build trusted relationships across functions and influence stakeholders through clear communication, sound judgment and an understanding of business needs, securing commitment to changes and shared deliverables.

• Proactively identify what could become a problem as RNF grows; challenge established approaches and lead practical improvements in processes, systems and automation that strengthen reporting quality, controls and efficiency.

Key Qualifications

• CPA designation and a university degree in accounting, finance or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of progressive accounting and reporting experience, including 3+ years leading a team.

• Strong ASPE or IFRS knowledge and proven experience leading consolidation, month end close and annual audits.

• Experience assessing risks, evaluating internal controls and implementing practical improvements.

• Experience managing FX exposures, forecasts and hedging activities.

• Strong team leadership, coaching and development skills.

• Ability to independently manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment and anticipate issues.

• Strong financial storytelling skills and the ability to influence and partner across functions.

• Proven process improvement skills, strong Excel proficiency and ERP experience; SAP is an asset.

• Manufacturing or CPG experience are assets.

Please note this role is an existing vacancy.

Salary Range

$135,000—$145,000 CAD

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.

What we expect:

• Values-led: You’ll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life’s too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don’t enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We’re still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we’ll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we’re okay with that, as long as we’re staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We’re a flat organization with few silos which means you’ll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don’t be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn’t – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We’ll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can’t always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we’re all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don’t cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren’t obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We’re a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don’t brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn’t one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There’s more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:

If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!

Riverside Natural Foods Ltd. is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you have a disability and require accommodation in the interview process, please let us know when you apply. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, due to volume, please note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Disclaimer: As part of our recruitment process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including automated systems, to support the review and assessment of applications. These tools do not make final hiring decisions. All decisions related to screening, interviewing, and selection are made by our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

What you'll do:

As Sr. Director, Acquisition Marketing at NinjaTrader, you will own paid acquisition as a function — the strategy, the investment, the team, and the results. You are accountable for how efficiently and how far every dollar of a seven-figure monthly media budget scales, and for setting the multi-year direction of how NinjaTrader acquires traders worldwide.

Our domestic program is established and looking for scale. Our international program does not exist yet. You will sharpen what already works in the US while building paid acquisition across Europe and the rest of the world from a standing start — deciding which markets we enter, in what sequence, with what economics, and what it takes to operate compliantly in each. You will own that expansion end to end.

You will lead a team of performance marketers and a portfolio of agency and platform partners, set the standard for how acquisition work is planned and measured here, and serve as the acquisition voice on the Marketing leadership team. You will decide where we place our bets, and you will be accountable to the executive team for whether they paid off.

In this role you will:

Own the acquisition function and its strategy

• Set the multi-year vision and operating strategy for paid acquisition, and translate it into annual plans, targets, and investment decisions the business can hold you to

• Own full accountability for a seven-figure monthly media budget, including allocation across markets and channels, in-year reforecasting, and the tradeoff decisions that come with it

• Own acquisition performance against growth and efficiency targets, with deep fluency in CPA, CAC, lifetime value, payback period, and marginal CAC analysis

• Serve as the acquisition voice on the Marketing leadership team and present performance, strategy, and investment cases directly to the executive team

• Define how acquisition is planned, measured, and governed at NinjaTrader, setting standards other marketing functions build against

Build international from a standing start

• Own the buildout of paid acquisition across Europe and rest of world end to end, from market prioritization and entry sequencing through launch and scale

• Determine the operating model for each market — in-house versus agency, channel mix, localization approach, and the economics that justify entry

• Build the partnerships, vendor relationships, and internal capability required to run acquisition outside the US

• Work with Compliance and Legal to ensure acquisition activity meets local regulatory requirements in every market entered

• Establish the measurement framework that makes international performance comparable to domestic rather than anecdotal

Lead the team and the partner portfolio

• Lead, develop, and grow a team of performance marketers, owning hiring, structure, and capability as the function scales domestically and internationally

• Own the agency and platform partner portfolio, including selection, commercial terms, performance standards, and the decision to scale or replace

• Build the bench — develop people capable of owning channels and markets independently, and create the progression paths that keep them

Drive measurement, experimentation, and growth loops

• Own a rigorous experimentation program across paid channels, with clear hypotheses, clean test design, and readouts that convert into scaled decisions

• Partner with Analytics and Data Science to build multi-touch attribution and predictive cohort models that give the business a single trusted view of channel contribution

• Own acquisition reporting end to end, from daily pacing through executive narratives that turn numbers into a clear recommendation

• Direct performance creative strategy, running a continuous testing engine across concepts, formats, and hooks in partnership with Creative

• Design growth loops that compound paid investment with organic, content, and SEO programs

• Stay ahead of new channel launches, betas, and market shifts, and decide where NinjaTrader moves early

What you'll need:

• 12+ years of experience in growth or performance marketing, ideally in D2C subscription-based or fintech businesses, including significant time leading teams

• Demonstrated ownership of a paid acquisition function at scale, with accountability for budget, team, and results rather than execution of a defined plan

• Proven experience building paid acquisition in new international markets from the ground up, including market selection, operating model decisions, and navigating local regulatory requirements

• Track record managing seven figures or more in monthly media spend with strong unit economics

• Deep expertise across web and mobile paid channels, including Google, Meta, YouTube, programmatic, influencer/affiliate, iOS, and Android

• Strong command of CAC, LTV, ROAS, payback period, incrementality, and media mix modeling, with hands-on experience partnering with Analytics and Data Science on attribution design and predictive cohort modeling

• Experience building and developing a marketing team, including hiring, structure, and progression

• Experience owning agency and platform partner relationships, including commercial negotiation and performance management

• Executive presence, with a track record presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership and defending investment decisions

• Exceptional reporting and data storytelling, with the ability to move from raw data to a narrative an executive can act on

• Excellent strategic thinking with the ability to prioritize, make trade-offs, and operate decisively in ambiguity

Bonus Points for:

• Previous experience in B2C marketing for fintech companies

• Previous experience in the futures or brokerage industry

• Experience running paid and organic as one combined growth system rather than separate channels

• Experience scaling a function through a period of rapid international expansion

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $175,000 to $215,000.00 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 15%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).

Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. jobs.title: VP, People Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

The Role

Pindrop is looking for an exceptional VP of People Operations who knows what great looks like because they've helped build it. We are seeking a proven People leader who has successfully built, scaled, and transformed People functions and is excited by the opportunity to do it again, better.

Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer, you will serve as a trusted strategic partner and play a critical role in shaping the future of our People organization. We are looking for someone who brings the experience and judgment to lead today, along with the ambition and curiosity to continue growing toward broader enterprise leadership and, potentially, a future Chief People Officer role.

This is a role for someone who sees what needs to be done before being asked. You can identify opportunities across the business, develop a thoughtful strategy, build a comprehensive execution plan, align stakeholders, and lead initiatives from concept through implementation and measurable results. You bring structure to ambiguity, take ownership of outcomes, and set a high standard for execution excellence.

Just as importantly, you genuinely care about people and understand that building a strong culture and delivering business results go hand in hand. You balance empathy with accountability, are comfortable making difficult decisions, and believe that developing others is one of your most important responsibilities as a leader.

You will lead through coaching, empowerment, and clear expectations rather than micromanagement. You will operate comfortably at every altitude, influencing executive decisions while building the capabilities, systems, and team needed to execute exceptionally well.

This is an opportunity for an ambitious, accomplished People executive who wants to make a meaningful impact, build an exceptional organization, and continue growing toward the next chapter of their leadership career.

What You'll Do

1. People Strategy & Executive Partnership

• Partner closely with the CPO to translate business priorities into actionable People strategies that strengthen organizational effectiveness, talent capabilities, and business performance.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to executive and functional leaders, bringing informed perspectives, sound judgment, and data-driven recommendations on workforce planning, talent, organizational effectiveness, and people-related business challenges.

• Lead the Quarterly ELT Talent and Organizational Business Review, partnering with Talent Acquisition and HRBP leadership to deliver meaningful insights, identify organizational risks, and recommend actions.

• Proactively identify emerging talent and organizational challenges, bringing forward clear recommendations, business implications, risks, and proposed solutions rather than simply reporting on activity.

• Build strong cross-functional relationships and influence decisions across the organization, balancing employee needs, business priorities, and long-term organizational health.

2. Strategic Execution & Operational Excellence

• Own the People Operations strategy and operating model, establishing scalable systems, processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable the function to deliver consistently and effectively.

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness, operational efficiency, and employee experience, translating insights into actionable initiatives.

• Lead complex strategic initiatives from concept through execution, including business case development, comprehensive project planning, stakeholder alignment, implementation, change management, and measurement of results.

• Lead continuous improvement and AI transformation across the organization, bringing demonstrated AI fluency and a passion for championing its adoption. Drive AI education, training, and upskilling initiatives across the organization while leveraging AI, automation, and data to modernize processes, improve efficiency, and increase business impact.

• Build a disciplined operating cadence with clear priorities, accountability, executive checkpoints, and measurable outcomes, moving the People organization from reactive execution to proactive, strategic delivery.

• Lead continuous improvement across People Operations, challenging existing processes and leveraging AI, automation, data, and technology to simplify work, improve quality, and increase organizational impact.

• Establish performance measures and accountability across People Operations, ensuring initiatives deliver meaningful outcomes, sustainable adoption, and continuous improvement.

3. People Operations, Talent & Organizational Effectiveness

• Provide strategic leadership and accountability for HR Operations, HR Business Partners, employee lifecycle programs, People systems, data governance, and operational compliance, empowering functional leaders and team members to own day-to-day execution.

• Build and scale a strategic HRBP operating model that positions HR Business Partners as proactive advisors to business leaders, connecting talent strategy to organizational priorities and business outcomes.

• Lead through the team to deliver effective performance management, talent calibration, succession planning, leadership development, and employee experience programs.

• Partner with the CPO and Finance on compensation strategy, workforce planning, and organizational design, bringing forward insights, recommendations, and implementation plans that support business priorities.

• Ensure the People organization delivers accurate, actionable workforce data and analytics, using insights to identify trends, anticipate risks, and inform decisions.

• Partner with leaders to identify and address systemic barriers to organizational effectiveness, including leadership capability, accountability, communication, and employee engagement.

• Provide senior-level guidance on complex employee relations matters and organizational changes, ensuring decisions reflect sound judgment, consistency, legal considerations, and Pindrop's values.

4. People Leadership, Culture & Team Development

• Lead and develop a high-performing People team, establishing a culture of trust, accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and exceptional service to the business.

• Make the development of direct reports a leadership priority, investing in coaching, meaningful feedback, stretch opportunities, and intentional career development.

• Lead through empowerment rather than micromanagement, providing clear expectations, decision-making authority, and accountability while giving team members the autonomy and support to succeed.

• Build leadership capability and succession strength within the People organization, developing individuals who can operate independently, think strategically, and take on increasingly complex responsibilities.

• Set a high bar for quality, execution, and accountability, ensuring the team understands both what needs to be accomplished and the business impact of their work.

• Create an environment where individuals are encouraged to challenge ideas, bring forward recommendations, learn from mistakes, and take ownership of outcomes.

• Model a people-centered, business-minded leadership approach, demonstrating empathy, integrity, resilience, sound judgment, and the courage to make difficult decisions when necessary.

Who You Are

• A proven builder and operator. You have successfully built, scaled, and transformed People functions. You know what great looks like because you've personally delivered it.

• A strategic thinker and exceptional executor. You connect the dots across the organization, anticipate what's needed, and translate complex opportunities into thoughtful plans and measurable results.

• An independent, proactive leader. You bring recommendations, not just problems. You exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and know when to act, collaborate, or escalate.

• A developer of people. You genuinely enjoy coaching and growing others, building strong teams through trust, empowerment, accountability, and meaningful development.

• A people-first, business-minded executive. You care deeply about employees and culture while understanding the realities of running a business. You balance empathy with accountability and make difficult decisions with fairness and conviction.

• A credible executive partner. You are comfortable engaging with senior leaders, bringing a strong point of view, challenging assumptions constructively, and influencing decisions with confidence and maturity.

• An ambitious, continuous learner. You are motivated to keep growing as an executive, expand your capabilities, embrace new technologies, and develop toward broader enterprise leadership.

• A collaborative, low-ego leader. You welcome feedback, value different perspectives, build strong relationships, and take accountability for your decisions and results.

• A resilient change leader. You thrive in dynamic environments, bring clarity to ambiguity, and have the persistence to move complex initiatives forward.

Your Experience

• 15+ years of progressive People/HR experience, including senior leadership across multiple HR disciplines. Prior VP-level experience or equivalent scope strongly preferred, with a demonstrated history of career stability and multiple examples of 3+ years of sustained tenure over the past decade.

• Proven success building, scaling, and transforming People teams, operating models, and programs in high-growth technology or similarly dynamic environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy and planning through execution, adoption, and measurable business impact.

• Demonstrated AI fluency and hands-on experience applying AI to improve business outcomes, with a proven ability to champion adoption, build organizational capabilities, and lead AI training and upskilling initiatives.

• Proven ability to build high-performing teams, develop future leaders, and empower direct reports through coaching, delegation, and accountability.

• Strong executive presence, business acumen, and organizational judgment, with the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively, and translate People insights into actionable business strategies.

• Experience leveraging People technology, workforce analytics, AI, and automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and organizational effectiveness.

The Opportunity

This is more than an opportunity to lead People Operations. It's an opportunity to help shape how the People function operates, scales, and delivers value across Pindrop.

You will work directly with the Chief People Officer, gain meaningful exposure to enterprise-level talent and organizational decisions, and have the opportunity to influence how we build and develop our organization.

You will have the ability to challenge the status quo, introduce new ideas, build scalable solutions, and develop a high-performing team. We are looking for someone who wants to make a lasting impact, not simply maintain what exists.

For the right leader, this role offers the opportunity to continue expanding strategic influence, executive leadership capabilities, and readiness for future leadership responsibilities.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

• Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.

• Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.

• While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.

• Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!

• Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution

• Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.

• Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents

• One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!

• Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.

• Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.

• Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Remote: #LI-Remote

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range

$240,000—$285,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Assay Development (Contract)
jobs.description:
DELFI Diagnostics, Inc. (DELFI Diagnostics) is developing next-generation, blood-based tests that are reliable, accessible and deliver a new way to help detect cancer. Employing advanced machine-learning methods to whole-genome sequencing data, the DELFI ("DNA EvaLuation of Fragments for early Interception") platform is built to address the highest-burden health challenges. DELFI Diagnostics prioritizes solutions that have the potential to save lives on a global scale, including for historically underserved populations. DELFI Diagnostics’ platform relies on fragmentomics – the discovery that cancer cells are more chaotic than normal cells and, when they die, leave behind tell-tale patterns and characteristics of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) fragments. FirstLook Lung, for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, is DELFI Diagnostics’ first laboratory-developed screening test and can be part of routine blood work. FirstLook Lung uses millions of data points to reliably identify individuals who may have cancer detected through low-dose CT, including early stage disease with a negative predictive value of 99.8 percent. This test has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.
In our passionate pursuit to radically improve health outcomes, we serve humanity when we:
Lead with Science, Anchor in Pragmatism: We pioneer life-changing science by ensuring quality, transparency, and rigor at all times. We explore thoughtfully, experiment smartly, and deliver impact with conviction.
Build With & For All: We embrace diverse backgrounds to innovate and achieve together. We are not just building a product - we aim to disrupt the path of cancer for all - no matter geography or socioeconomic class 
Put We over I: We are a home for high-performing people. Through teamwork, we build collective intelligence. Each of us wins when those we serve and those who serve with us--win. We show up with empathy, humility, and integrity at every step of the journey.

jobs.title: Market Owner - South Florida
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Market Owner, you’re at the helm of a market consisting of at least four hospitals in one geographical area, and have a sense of ownership over everything that happens at each location. Hospital leaders, including Medical Directors and Hospital Managers, report to you. While they oversee their individual functions and the day-to-day at their locations, you are accountable for the growth, success, and support of every VEGgie in your hospitals, as well as the financial goals of the VEGs in your market. By finding ways to say YES, you empower your teams to do the unexpected, fostering an environment where innovation and care go hand-in-hand. You ensure that customers remain central to everything your hospitals do and uphold the VEG experience at every touchpoint. Passionate about building and protecting VEG's brand, you instill confidence in local rDVMs, ensuring they know their customers and patients are in trusted hands. You collaborate with experts across every VEG department, bringing the best resources to your hospitals and making it possible for your teams to create extraordinary patient outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Drive multiple hospitals in your market, ensuring operational, clinical, and cultural excellence across every location

• Coach and guide hospital leaders to drive growth, performance, and an outstanding customer experience

• Build deep relationships with referring veterinarians and community partners to elevate VEG’s reputation and referral network

• Own and manage your market’s P&L, evaluating financial performance, driving revenue growth, and building smart, sustainable budgets

• Champion training and development by identifying growth opportunities, implementing initiatives, and ensuring clinical and operational upskilling

• Hire and retain top talent, building high-performing, empowered teams through local networking, recruiting, and succession planning

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., HR, Legal, Technology) to bring resources, improvements, and innovations to your hospitals

• Monitor market trends and competition to drive local growth, explore new services, and identify future hospital locations

• Represent and protect the VEG brand in your region by engaging with your community and finding ways to give back

• Foster a culture where VEGgies feel seen, heard and valued and want to grow and make an impact

WHO WE NEED

• Come from any background (e.g. DVM, M.B.A., etc), and either have or are willing to gain clinical understanding

• 7 to 10 years of relevant experience

• Analytical, with the creative propensity to identify opportunities while staying focused on your mission

• An experienced leader, well-versed in developing high performing teams, operating a service business, and presiding over a multi-site operational business

• Live close to your hospitals and able to routinely work alongside your teams (for full days, varying days of the week, multiple times per month, with people in all roles)

• Able to be in the field; 25% work from home, 75% on-site at local hospitals or off-site meetings

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.
