jobs.title: Platform Creator Activation Specialist
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

What we're looking for

Chef-creators are at the core of what we do at CookUnity. We are looking for an enthusiastic Creator Activation Specialist to help CookUnity’s Chef Success team onboard and activate all-new platform creators and support creators in their early stages of growth with CU. In this role, you will learn what makes a CookUnity creator great and creatively support their business growth and platform success. In return, you’ll work in a rapidly growing space at the intersection of the food business, culinary creativity, and e-commerce. A successful Activation Specialist will play a key role in ensuring a positive, efficient, and smooth new creator experience throughout the onboarding process. Direct interaction with clients will take place regularly by telephone or web chat. As such, prior experience and comfort in a phone/chat-based customer support environment is a plus.

CookUnity offers the best chefs and culinary creators the ability to build and manage their platform food businesses successfully and with great ease.

Responsibilities:

• Onboarding and Activation of New Creators Facilitate the successful launch of new creator brands and products by creating customized onboarding materials, tracking timelines, and ensuring adherence to target launch dates.

• Creator Support and Education Provide guidance, resources, and front-line support across multiple channels (voice, email, chat, video) to help creators build thriving businesses on the platform.

• Compliance and Documentation Management Review, process, and maintain accurate records of onboarding documents to ensure compliance with CookUnity standards and guidelines.

• Process Coordination and Collaboration Collaborate with internal teams to align on requirements, policies, and workflows while monitoring and following up to ensure a seamless onboarding process.

• Continuous Improvement and Reporting Identify opportunities for process enhancement, contribute to service improvements, and support audits, reporting, and special projects to achieve performance goals.

What You Bring

We’re seeking a candidate with a passion for food and the culinary business, eager to support creators during a critical phase of their journey with CookUnity.

• Curious and enthusiastic about learning.

• Empathetic and attuned to creator needs.

• Self-driven and capable of thriving in a remote work environment.

• Strong sense of accountability and responsibility.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Familiarity with food production, culinary brands, and chef-driven businesses is a plus.

• A collaborative spirit with a desire to support teammates and grow professionally.

• Passionate about educating and supporting creators to achieve their goals.

• Flexible and open to adapting in a dynamic environment.

• Skilled in managing multiple onboarding projects and prioritizing effectively.

• Able to guide creators toward success during their initial platform launch.

• Dedicated to refining and scaling implementation processes.

• Focused on fostering strong creator relationships from onboarding kickoff through launch (9–12 weeks), ensuring a smooth transition to the Account Management team.

• Committed to meeting creator needs comprehensively and professionally.

Qualifications

• 1+ years of experience in onboarding or account activation for a culinary physical product business (preferred) or relevant post-secondary education or training in a culinary or foodservice management school

• Ability to work remotely during U.S. EST hours, with a start time no later than 10:00 AM EST.

• Experience managing multiple clients or accounts simultaneously.

• Proven customer relations skills.

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

• Proficiency with Google Suite, project management tools, and data visualization platforms.

• Capable of multitasking and thriving under pressure.

• Professional demeanor in all communications with creators, internal teams, and stakeholders.

• Experience in roles with administrative, operational, or supervisory responsibilities

Benefits

🩺  Health Insurance coverage

🌅 401k Plan

⛱ Unlimited PTO

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🥘 A generous amount of CookUnity credits to enjoy our amazing meals, added to your account, monthly

🧘🏽‍♀️ Wellness perks: access to fitness subsidies to build a healthy lifestyle

👩🏾‍🏫 Personalized Spanish coach

🚀 Awesome opportunity to join a company that is looking to change how we eat and how chefs work!

Compensation

All final pay rates will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Pay Range for this position

$85,000—$96,000 USD

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Marketing Engineer | US | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

• Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.

• Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.

• Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.

• Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.

• Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

• Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.

• Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.

• Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

• Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.

• Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.

• Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

• Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.

• Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).

• Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.

• Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.

• Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.

• Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.

• High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.

• Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

• Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.

• Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.

• Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.

• Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the US, the base compensation range for this role is $183,858 - $220,630. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager
jobs.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, California; Hybrid - Seattle
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Team

Equipment Monitoring (EM) is Motive's connected-asset product line, covering asset gateways, beacons, and environmental and door sensors. EM is one of Motive's high-growth business lines, and we have an ambitious roadmap to execute. The EM team owns the end-to-end customer experience, from the device to the cloud, web, and mobile software customers use every day.

About the Role

As the Cloud Software TPM for Equipment Monitoring, you will own the end-to-end delivery of EM programs across cloud software (backend, frontend, and mobile), from quarterly planning and sprint execution through customer launch and adoption. Most EM projects combine embedded, IoT, backend, and frontend work, and you will make sure those pieces come together into one cohesive plan with clear owners, milestones, and dependencies.

You will be accountable for the customer deliverables, release readiness, and measurable business outcomes of each program. Where a program involves hardware, firmware, or embedded work, you will partner closely with the hardware org TPM and embedded counterparts to work out dependencies and stay in sync on timelines and readiness, while driving the overall plan through to launch. Your ownership and delivery directly shape EM's impact on customers.

What You'll Do

• Plan: Partner with EM Product and Engineering to turn quarterly and half-year roadmaps into detailed cloud software project plans with milestones, owners, measurable customer and business outcomes, and risks.

• Connect the pieces: Track cross-team dependencies for each project across embedded, hardware, IoT/Platform, Product Ops, PMM, Design, and Support, partnering closely with the hardware org TPM on devices and international rollouts so projects don't stall in the gaps between teams and customer commitments are met.

• Own end-to-end delivery: Be accountable for each program from kickoff through customer launch and adoption, tracking milestones across concurrent programs, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early (scope, quality, and timeline), and driving decisions with stakeholders and leadership to keep delivery on track. Use customer feedback and support signals to close the loop after launch.

• Communicate: Maintain a single source of truth for program status, share weekly updates, and report program health, risks, and outcomes in monthly and quarterly business reviews, translating technical detail into business impact.

• Run the operating rhythm: Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and demos for EM cloud engineering, and drive release-readiness checkpoints so quality risks surface before launch.

• Improve how we work: Run intake and triage for ad-hoc requests, fix recurring execution gaps with durable solutions, and lead quarter- and project-level retrospectives.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in technical program management, with the technical fluency to engage credibly with engineers on architecture, tradeoffs, and delivery risks; a technical degree or equivalent experience is recommended.

• Proven track record leading large, ambiguous, multi-team cloud software programs (backend, web, mobile) with significant cross-team dependencies and measurable customer or business impact.

• Bias for action and root-cause problem solving over administrative tracking.

• Strong organization and communication; ability to lead and coach without authority across distributed teams and to translate technical detail into clear updates for leadership.

• Ability to define and track quality and delivery metrics (for example, escaped defects, reliability, predictability, customer feedback) and turn data into an action plan.

• Comfort in a fast-paced, changing environment, building process where little exists.

• Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools, strong knowledge of agile methods, and experience using automation (including AI tools) to keep programs visible without manual overhead for engineers.

Preferred Experience

• Exposure to connected-device or IoT products (firmware release cycles, device qualification, OTA updates), which helps in partnering with hardware and embedded teams.

• CSM or PMP certification.

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

• Working knowledge of U.S. benefits regulations, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, and applicable state leave laws.

• Experience working with benefits brokers, carriers, retirement recordkeepers, and third-party administrators.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Excellent communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

jobs.title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist - PM Shift  (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Us

DELFI Diagnostics, Inc. (DELFI Diagnostics) is developing next-generation, blood-based tests that are reliable, accessible and deliver a new way to help detect cancer. Employing advanced machine-learning methods to whole-genome sequencing data, the DELFI ("DNA EvaLuation of Fragments for early Interception") platform is built to address the highest-burden health challenges. DELFI Diagnostics prioritizes solutions that have the potential to save lives on a global scale, including for historically underserved populations. DELFI Diagnostics’ platform relies on fragmentomics – the discovery that cancer cells are more chaotic than normal cells and, when they die, leave behind tell-tale patterns and characteristics of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) fragments. FirstLook Lung, for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, is DELFI Diagnostics’ first laboratory-developed screening test and can be part of routine blood work. FirstLook Lung uses millions of data points to reliably identify individuals who may have cancer detected through low-dose CT, including early stage disease with a negative predictive value of 99.8 percent. This test has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.

In our passionate pursuit to radically improve health outcomes, we serve humanity when we:

jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Visual Keyholder, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, & consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will be responsible for executing the visual, commercial, and styling curation according to visual & commercial guidelines for the store. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Contribute to the total OMNI customer experience in your store by ensuring visual and commercial curation according to guidelines (In-direct)
• Representing yourself and the H&M Brand positively during customer interactions (Direct)
• Organize and plan your workload according to store activation plan and adapt based on business needs in collaboration with your Store Management team and Area Visual Manager
• Launch and maintain the latest global campaigns and sale activities on time according to H&M Brand Standards
• Ensure good garment care, stock levels, and give input on allocation to Store Management and Area teams
• Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
• Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
• Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, products, brands, competitors, and relevant influencers etc.
• Plan time for fashion & trend awareness to understand trend theory and mood boards for styling techniques and product presentation to anticipate our customer’s needs and enhance our shopping experience in store

Team & Development

• Share, inspire and educate your store teams, keep them updated with seasonal changes, fashion trends, relevant visual & commercial information, in-store communication, including price perception
• Coach and develop the Store team’s visual and commercial skills to secure high quality of product & commercial presentation according to guidelines
• Support & develop daily routines and best practices for your Store team to always ensure a consistent level of visual & commercial standard while maintaining customer service engagement
• Develop and coach talents and provide onboarding training to new colleagues
• Organize, provide, and carry out the visual & commercial upskilling for you and your colleagues
• Complete Visual Competencies & Commercial 4 All trainings based on Regional & Sales Market learning and development goals
• Support Sales Market and Area teams with expansion (store projects) needs

Visual & Commercial Execution

• Execute the visual & commercial curation & styling for the store based on commercial calendar, allocation, store activation plan and fashion trends according to mood boards and direction from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Carry out sample picking best practice routines including stockroom garment quantities, accessories, and shoes to ensure you create clear trends and stories according to inspiration from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Secure window & styling execution according to visual & commercial guidelines to create inspirational and commercial customer experience
• Provide good customer flow by maintaining commercial layout, fixtures, to secure the best trend story placement
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in windows and throughout the store following guidelines according to Global strategy and Sales Market requirements
• In collaboration with Facilities Management ensure all lighting is working correctly, aimed to highlight our products and display forms in windows and throughout the store
• Maintain and care for all display forms and interior material (fixtures & fittings) with sustainability in mind
• In collaboration with Area Visual Manager ensure your store navigation is maintained and kept up to date according to latest guidelines and store layout
• Ensure your store has enough quantities of sale and other activity including POS material according to local routines
• Keep sales floor and back of house clean, organized, and safe according to local security guidelines

Leadership & Operational Responsibilities

• Holds additional operational responsibilities, such as opening and closing the store, managing the cash register, and ensuring the store’s security protocols are followed
• Acts as a leader on duty when managers are not present, taking responsibility for the sales floor, resolving customer issues, and directing team members
• May delegate and oversee tasks for the store team during their shift
• Makes decisions related to store operations, including customer service escalations, staff breaks, and enforcing store policies
• Acts as a bridge between the team and management during non-visual tasks
• Balances visual merchandising with operational duties and customer service
• Prioritizes tasks based on immediate store needs, such as sales targets or operational issues

Who You Are

• For you to be a successful Visual Keyholder, you must be curious and creative; always looking for inspiration, proactive, solution focused, flexible, with effective communication skills to achieve results cross functionally
• We look for individuals with fashion interests and leadership skills who can apply their visual and commercial experience working in a dynamic environment to the role
• Experience with being solution focused to improve product presentation and commercial execution in store
• Good knowledge of visual, commercial, and operational best practises, routines, and tools
• Know how to manage, follow-up and act on selling equation and weekly sales reports
• A leader who can motivate and guide a team, ensuring store standards are upheld and colleagues are supported in their roles
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced retail environment
• Comfortable taking on keyholder responsibilities, including opening and closing the store, handling cash, and ensuring safety and security protocols are followed
• Skilled at providing exceptional customer service and resolving customer concerns with a solutions-oriented approach
• A collaborative team player who communicates effectively and fosters a positive, inclusive work environment
• Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to balance operational responsibilities and visual merchandising tasks while meeting deadlines
• Availability to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match 401k, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

jobs.title: Director, Retail Marketing
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

PAX is a leading global cannabis brand on a mission to enhance people’s lives, delivering well-being through pure products, unique experiences, and an unparalleled passion for the plant. For more than a decade, PAX has provided products that are simple, enjoyable, and trusted by millions. PAX has been recognized for its brand, culture and products by The New York Times’ Wirecutter, TIME, Fast Company, GQ, Gear Patrol, mg Magazine, High Times, and many more. PAX is committed to making a positive impact through PEACE BY PAX, its purpose-driven platform supporting social reform, safe access and sustainability.

We are incredibly excited about the progress of the movement, the tremendous growth of the industry, and inspired every day by our opportunity to help change lives through cannabis. Our culture is focused on putting people at the center of everything we do, making an impact together, and having fun along the way. Our team has an unparalleled passion for the plant and has helped build business at the forefront of consumer experience and well-being, including Apple, Google, Uber, Fitbit, Constellation, Honest Company, Beauty Counter, Eaze, Curaleaf, Wyld and more. PAX has raised over $430MM in capital from leading consumer and technology investors and is available for sale in some capacity in more than 40 countries around the world.

Location: Remote – U.S., with ~30% national and occasional international travel
Department: Marketing
Status: Full-time, Exempt
Reports to: VP, Marketing

SUMMARY

PAX is seeking a Director of Retail Marketing to transform how our brand shows up and performs at retail across U.S. cannabis dispensaries and global wholesale channels. This leader will define our retail marketing strategy, build a distinctive and scalable visual merchandising experience, and develop shopper marketing programs that drive awareness, conversion, and repeat purchase. Equal parts creative and commercial, the ideal candidate brings deep expertise in physical retail, a strong understanding of shopper behavior, and a proven ability to translate brand strategy into measurable sales growth. They'll lead a team and collaborate closely with Sales, Creative, Product Marketing, and external partners to bring a more cohesive, effective PAX retail experience to life.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Retail Strategy & Commercial Performance

• Develop and lead PAX's retail marketing strategy across U.S. dispensaries and global wholesale channels, aligning brand priorities, product launches, distribution growth, and revenue objectives.

• Establish channel and retailer segmentation strategies, defining differentiated levels of merchandising, marketing investment, and activation based on commercial opportunity and performance.

• Partner with Sales leadership to develop programs that accelerate sell-through, improve productivity per door, strengthen retail relationships, and drive profitable growth.

• Own retail marketing planning, budgets, resource allocation, and performance measurement, ensuring investments deliver measurable commercial returns.

Visual Merchandising & Retail Experience

• Lead PAX's visual merchandising strategy, creating a distinctive, premium, and consistent brand experience across dispensaries, smoke shops, and specialty retail environments.

• Develop scalable merchandising systems, including fixtures, displays, product glorifiers, signage, POS materials, and planograms tailored to different channels, store formats, and retailer tiers.

• Partner with Creative, Product Marketing, and external agencies to translate brand strategy and product innovation into compelling physical retail experiences that drive shopper engagement and conversion.

• Oversee merchandising development, production, deployment, and optimization, balancing creative excellence with cost efficiency, scalability, and measurable impact.

Shopper Marketing & Retail Activation

• Develop and oversee national retail promotional strategies spanning seasonal campaigns, product launches, evergreen offers, and strategic account programs.

• Establish promotional frameworks and guardrails in partnership with Sales and Finance, balancing incremental sales growth, profitability, and brand positioning.

• Lead retail education and advocacy strategies, including product training, sales enablement, budtender engagement, and retailer-facing content that strengthens product knowledge and recommendation.

• Direct field marketing, brand ambassador, and retail activation programs, ensuring consistent execution, strategic deployment, and measurable results.

• Partner with eCommerce, CRM, and Brand Marketing to develop retail-driven consumer engagement and retention initiatives that encourage trial, repeat purchase, and loyalty.

Leadership, Insights & Operational Excellence

• Lead and develop the retail marketing team and external partners, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and execution standards.

• Build a retail marketing performance framework measuring merchandising penetration, promotional effectiveness, retail execution, sell-through, and return on investment.

• Leverage sales data, shopper insights, field feedback, and competitive intelligence to continuously optimize programs and investment decisions.

• Establish scalable processes and cross-functional workflows that enable consistent execution across markets while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of progressive experience in retail, shopper, trade, or channel marketing, including significant leadership responsibility.

• Deep expertise in visual merchandising and physical retail brand development, with hands-on experience creating fixtures, displays, POS materials, and scalable merchandising systems.

• Proven success developing shopper marketing, promotional, and retail activation programs that drive measurable sales growth and return on investment.

• Experience building retail education, advocacy, and sales enablement programs that influence shopper conversion and retail associate recommendations.

• Background in premium consumer brands with third-party retail distribution, ideally within consumer electronics, beauty, beverage, lifestyle, CPG, or cannabis.

• Exceptional creative judgment, with the ability to translate brand strategy into compelling and commercially effective retail experiences.

• Strong analytical and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, evaluating promotional effectiveness, and optimizing marketing investments.

• Demonstrated ability to lead teams, agencies, and complex cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, multi-market environments.

• Willingness to travel approximately 30%, with occasional international travel.

PAX LABS PERKS & BENEFITS

• Competitive compensation, equity & bi-annual performance reviews

• Fully funded comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401K plan

• Generous PTO policy

• Paid Parental Leave

• Monthly wellness reimbursement

• Cell Phone reimbursement

• Employee Purchase Program for discounted PAX devices

• Weekly catered lunch, endless snacks and beverages

• Dog Friendly HQ in the Mission District of San Francisco

• Employee Assistance Program including access to online legal support

COMPENSATION

In addition to the benefits above, this role has a proposed base salary range of $160,000-200,000 per year, plus equity, subject to internal compensation review. The final salary offer will be determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, depth of experience, geographic location, and relevant education/training.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PAX VALUES

Put Consumers First - We are here to enhance their lives. We put their needs first in everything we do. We work together to deliver unique solutions for their benefit.

Build a Community - We are active and beneficial builders of a global community. We collaborate together to support sustainability, well-being and social equity efforts—both internally and externally—to establish cannabis as a force for good.

Innovate with Passion - We are passionate about enhancing the cannabis experience by making it positive, accessible and intuitive. We set the standards, innovate for consumers and find the yes as a team.

Be the Solution and Collaborate - We work as a team to achieve winning outcomes, knowing we each individually are the solution, but can only succeed together.

Lead with Humility and Transparency - We stay open and humble in everything we do. We value learning from each other, and cultivate transparency in our culture and products.

jobs.title: Payroll Analyst
jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

The Payroll Analyst runs accurate, on-time, compliant payroll for Heartflow's employees across multiple states and, where applicable, international locations. You will own day-to-day payroll processing, reconcile payroll data against the general ledger, and partner with HR, Finance, and Accounting to keep compensation, benefits, and tax data correct.

This role reports to the Senior Manager Payroll and is based in Rohnert Park.

Key responsibilities

• Process semi-monthly or bi-weekly payroll end to end, including hourly, salaried, and exempt/non-exempt employees, with accuracy and on-time delivery.

• Review and audit payroll inputs each cycle: new hires, terminations, pay changes, bonuses, commissions, retro pay, and deductions.

• Record equity-related payroll events, such as RSU vesting, NQ stock option exercises and ISO/ESPP disqualifying dispositions as directed.

• Reconcile payroll registers, tax filings, benefit deductions, and 401(k) contributions, and prepare journal entries and GL reconciliations for month-end close.

• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour and payroll tax requirements, including California-specific rules on final pay, overtime, sick leave, and RROP (regular rate of pay)

• Manage multi-state tax setup, registrations, and notices, and support year-end processing including W-2s and quarterly filings.

• Partner with HR and Benefits to keep HRIS and payroll system data synchronized and resolve integration or data discrepancies.

• Answer employee payroll questions promptly and confidentially and maintain clear self-service documentation.

• Support internal and external audits (financial, SOX, 401(k), workers' compensation) by preparing reports and documentation.

• Document payroll procedures and controls and identify opportunities to automate and improve processes.

• Build ad hoc payroll and labor cost reports for Finance, FP&A, and leadership.

• Perform pre and post payroll audits of earnings, deductions, taxes, hours, benefit elections

• Review payroll exception reports and research discrepancies prior to payroll finalization

• Partner with payroll vendors and internal teams to research system issues, data discrepancies, and payroll configuration concerns.

• Process off-cycle payments, payroll adjustments, reversals, voids, and check corrections as required

Required qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3–5 years of hands-on, full-cycle payroll experience, ideally in a multi-state environment.

• Working knowledge of federal and state payroll tax and wage and hour law, especially California.

• Experience with a major payroll platform such as ADP, Workday, UKG, Paylocity, or Rippling.

• Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and reconciliations.

• High attention to detail and a track record of accuracy under recurring deadlines.

• Sound judgment handling confidential compensation and personal data.

• Clear written and verbal communication with employees at every level.

Preferred qualifications

• Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC).

• Experience at a public company or a company preparing for or recently through an IPO, including SOX controls.

• Exposure to international payroll or managing a global payroll vendor.

• Experience in medical devices, life sciences, or another regulated industry.

• Experience implementing or migrating payroll or HRIS systems.

The expected base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $115,000 plus bonus.

• Lead, coach and motivate a sales team to activate plans and hit annual targets.
• Create a positive team environment and culture of empowerment and productivity.

What We’re Looking For:

• Highly analytical in order to create business recommendations from data sources
• Strong skills in selling, JBP, forecasting, execution and having a 360-degree business perspective.
• Excellent relationship building skills with proven sales success managing key account partnerships
• Advanced knowledge of syndicated data analysis, data metrics, shopper behavior, brand, competitive and category volumes
• Advanced communication, interpersonal and project management skills
• Expert negotiation skills to achieve winning solutions for the business and retailer
• Ability to leverage relationships to increase shelf-share, online placement and drive increased business
• Proven ability to lead, own and drive programs and processes
• Action oriented and excellent decision-making skills
• Strong economic thinking, financial acumen and entrepreneurship skills
• Proficient in retailer proprietary systems

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:

This role is an in-office role Monday-Thursday, and work from home on Fridays. We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. Job Title: People Operations Coordinator - Temp to FTE Opportunity, 3 month contract

Job Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.

• Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.

• HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.

• Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.

• PBP, ER & Programs Support. PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork. Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround. Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.

• Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.

• Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.

• Country Expertise. Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.

THE TEAM:

Our People Operations Coordinators, PBPs and specialists work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. Coordinators are the front door of the People organization: warm, responsive and exact, with the pride in getting it right that earns managers’ and employees’ trust. We are a global team across India, Mexico and the United States, we cover for one another, and we share what we learn so every pod gets better. We take on hard problems together, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for accountability, empathy and execution.Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

THE SKILL SET:

jobs.description:
Transform Your Career

We deliver unparalleled opportunities for growth and career advancement. Our dynamic, entrepreneurial culture supports your journey every step of the way.

Embrace new challenges and deliver real value to some of the world’s most influential financial institutions, including banks, insurance companies, wealth and asset managers, capital markets firms, private credit platforms, and fintechs. Work side by side with business leaders to solve complex client challenges and make a meaningful impact. Love what you do as part of a diverse organization committed to collaboration and continuous learning.

The Team – Financial Services Business Solution Engineering

Highspring’s Financial Services Business Solution Engineering team helps financial institutions solve complex business problems that cross traditional functional boundaries. We bring together strategy, business architecture, finance and accounting, risk, operations, data, AI, and technology to design and deliver practical business solutions.

Our work spans the front, middle, and back office, from lending origination and servicing platforms to finance and subledger architecture, risk transformation, enterprise data platforms, and AI-enabled operations. We turn complex business problems into executable solutions by connecting people, process, data, technology, governance, and controls.

Your Impact

As a Senior Consultant, you will work directly with client and Highspring teams to understand complex business challenges, design solutions, and help move those solutions into execution.

You will:

• Break down ambiguous business problems into clear issues, hypotheses, analyses, and actions.

• Assess current-state business processes, capabilities, operating models, controls, data, and enabling technologies.

• Design future-state solutions across people, process, data, technology, governance, and controls.

• Map end-to-end business processes and platform operating models, identifying interaction models, handoffs, dependencies, control points, and opportunities to simplify how work gets done.

• Support the design and modernization of lending origination, underwriting, servicing, payments, deposits, models, treasury, and other financial services platforms.

• Help design finance architectures spanning operational platforms, subledgers, general ledgers, consolidation, and financial and regulatory reporting.

• Assess and design how enterprise data platforms support business processes, reporting, analytics, risk management, AI, and decision-making.

• Translate business needs into data products, data requirements, integration patterns, semantic models, reporting requirements, and governance expectations.

• Understand how modern cloud and data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, and similar technologies can enable broader business solutions.

• Identify opportunities to redesign processes using AI, enterprise agents, workflow automation, and low-code technologies such as Microsoft Power Automate.

• Help design enterprise agents that connect data, workflow, and business rules to automate information retrieval, case management, exception handling, reporting, controls, and employee decision support.

• Translate business requirements into process, functional, data, control, and technology requirements that implementation teams can execute.

• Develop capability models, target operating models, process maps, business requirements, data requirements, decision rights, and implementation roadmaps.

• Help clients establish OKRs, KPIs, and performance-management frameworks that connect strategic objectives to measurable business outcomes.

• Support risk transformation across operational risk, enterprise risk, controls, regulatory change, resilience, and first- and second-line operating models.

• Support complex transformation programs, including M&A integration, finance transformation, regulatory change, enterprise data, AI, and technology modernization.

• Participate in client workshops, requirements-gathering sessions, and executive presentations.

• Build executive-ready analyses, recommendations, business cases, and implementation plans.

Your Experience

We are looking for people who are comfortable solving problems that do not come with a predefined answer.

Minimum Qualifications

• BA/BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Technology, or a related discipline.

• 3+ years of experience in consulting, financial services, transformation, business architecture, finance, risk, operations, data, or technology.

• Client-facing experience in professional services or highly relevant financial services industry experience.

• Strong structured problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Ability to understand how business processes, operating models, data, controls, and technology platforms work together.

• Experience translating business needs into requirements, solution designs, or implementation plans.

• Experience supporting business or technology transformation initiatives.

• Exposure to modern enterprise data platforms, cloud architectures, analytics, AI, automation, or workflow technologies.

• Ability to develop high-quality client deliverables with limited direction.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly.

• Comfort operating where the problem, solution, or path forward may initially be unclear.

• Curiosity about how emerging technology can fundamentally change how financial services work is performed.

• Willingness to travel at least 25%.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master of Business Administration or another relevant advanced degree, or equivalent professional experience.

• Experience with one or more financial services sectors, including banking, insurance, wealth and asset management, capital markets, private credit, or fintech.

• Exposure to acquisition integration, finance transformation, regulatory change, risk transformation, or technology modernization projects.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Power Automate, or comparable cloud, data, AI, and automation technologies.

jobs.title: Sr. Systems Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

We are seeking a Senior Systems Reliability Engineer to lead Reliability & Maintainability (R&M) activities across the product lifecycle. This role focuses on R&M architecture, data-driven analysis, comprehensive documentation, and test planning for reliability verification. You will engage directly with customer counterparts on R&M reviews and milestone events, including Reliability Scoring Conferences, Corrective Action Boards, and Milestone B/C Design Reviews.

Key Responsibilities:

Reliability & Maintainability Architecture

• Develop and maintain the R&M Program Plan and reliability architecture documentation, including the RAM-C (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability-Cost) Rationale Report

• Lead Failure Modes, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMEA/FMECA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) development across system architecture

• Develop R&M allocations and apportion reliability and maintainability requirements to lower-level items; support R&M requirements analysis and trade studies

• Draft Reliability Predictions (per MIL-HDBK-217 and related methods) and Maintainability Analyses; maintain traceability between R&M requirements, predictions, and demonstrated performance

• Lead Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) and Level of Repair Analysis (LORA); support Testability and Built-In Test (BIT) analysis

Data, Documentation & Test Planning

• Establish and own the Failure Reporting, Analysis, and Corrective Action System (FRACAS); maintain closed-loop failure data collection and trending from design through test, production, and sustainment

• Develop Failure Definitions and Scoring Criteria (FDSC) and reliability test plans tied to program milestones

• Lead reliability growth planning and execution of reliability growth and demonstration testing, including Environmental Stress Screening (ESS) and HALT/HASS where applicable

• Support Qualification Test Plan development, all-up-round testing, and flight and live-fire test reliability assessments

• Develop technical documentation including R&M standards, specifications, procedures, and user guides

• Review ground test, flight test, and live-fire test data to confirm R&M requirements compliance

Customer Engagement & Reviews

• Serve as primary point of contact with customers on R&M matters

• Present R&M analyses, RAM-C Rationale Report updates, and risk posture at Milestone Reviews (A/B/C) and design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR, PRR)

• Lead Reliability Scoring Conferences and Corrective Action Boards (CAB) with customer participation

• Coordinate responses to customer R&M data item deliverables and support In-Service Reviews

Risk Management & Process Improvement

• Lead Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations for failures identified through FRACAS

• Host corrective action reviews and ensure lessons learned are implemented across the program

• Coordinate R&M risk mitigation with Manufacturing Engineering, Logistics, Quality, and System Safety, including DMSMS/obsolescence and shelf-life and aging surveillance considerations

• Apply digital engineering and AI-enabled tools (predictive maintenance, digital twins, automated FRACAS analytics) to R&M processes

• Ensure compliance with MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, GEIA-STD-0009, and other applicable R&M standards

Basic Qualifications:

• 7+ years as a Reliability Engineer, R&M Engineer, or equivalent reliability-critical engineering role

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Systems, or Electrical Engineering, or Physics

• Expertise with MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, and related R&M standards

• Experience owning FRACAS, including failure tracking, root cause analysis, and corrective action closure

• Proven experience developing and executing reliability test plans, including growth testing, demonstration testing, and Environmental Stress Screening

• Experience engaging with customers on R&M reviews and milestone/design reviews (PDR, CDR, Milestone B/C)

• Strong system architecture knowledge and R&M requirements decomposition and allocation

• Extensive FMEA/FMECA, FTA, and RBD experience

• Failure investigation with proven corrective action implementation

• Technical writing for R&M program plans, rationale reports, procedures, and documentation

• Design review experience (PDR, CDR, MRR) with strong presentation skills

• Data collection, analysis, and trending for R&M metrics

• U.S. Citizenship

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's degree in engineering or related field

• 10+ years progressive R&M experience

• ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) or equivalent certification

• DoD or Navy R&M programs experience, aligned with SECNAV Reliability and Maintainability Engineering guidance

• Quantitative reliability growth modeling (e.g., Crow-AMSAA) and Weibull analysis

• Maintainability, Testability/BIT, LORA, and RCM experience

• Missile, hypersonic, or munitions systems experience, including all-up-round reliability, environmental stress screening, and shelf-life/stockpile surveillance programs

• Digital engineering and AI-enabled R&M tools (predictive maintenance, digital twins, automated FRACAS analytics)

• Active U.S. Security Clearance or ability to obtain

jobs.title: Product Development & Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Keep Growing with Nutrafol

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients -- and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too -- by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

About You:

The Product Development & Marketing Manager is a hands-on product innovation marketer who will help shape what we launch next. Sitting within the Product Development & Marketing team, this role turns consumer insights, clinical science and market trends into new products and line extensions across our dietary supplement and topical hair care portfolios, and guides them from early concept through stage-gate development to launch and beyond.

Reporting into the Sr. Manager of Product Development & Marketing, this role works across a dynamic portfolio of projects rather than a single fixed category, moving between dietary supplements and topical cosmetic innovation as business priorities evolve. You will partner closely with Brand Marketing, Consumer Insights, Education, Growth, Retention, Retail, Professional, Creative, Copy, Formulation, Packaging, Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Legal, Quality and Clinical & Medical Affairs, serving as the day-to-day contact who keeps each project on strategy, on time and on budget across our multi-channel business, including direct to consumer, Amazon, healthcare professionals, salons and prestige retail.

Responsibilities:

Competitive Landscape & Innovation Strategy:

• Own the competitive landscape from the product perspective, tracking competitor launches, formulations, ingredients, claims, clinical results, pricing and packaging across supplement and topical hair care.

• Build and maintain a centralized competitive intelligence hub, including product benchmarks, claims and ingredient matrices and pricing architecture, that serves as the single source of truth for the team and cross-functional partners.

• Support the Sr. Manager and Consumer Insights team to bring consumer research together with competitive and product intelligence, organizing the combined view into clear opportunity assessments and product recommendations.

• Deliver regular competitive readouts that flag threats and whitespace, and use them to inform the innovation pipeline and roadmap.

• Build compelling business cases for new concepts, including market sizing, consumer rationale, pricing, volume forecasts and margin targets, to secure stage-gate approval.

Product Development & Stage-Gate:

• Execute the stage-gate process and all deliverables for assigned projects across supplements and topicals, from ideation and concept through development, commercialization and launch.

• Write product, creative and copy briefs, defining the target consumer, benefits, claims ambition, format and cost targets, grounded in competitive benchmarks and product differentiation as approved by leadership.

• Develop product claims in partnership with Formulation and Clinical & Medical Affairs, grounded in how ingredients and studies support efficacy. Own them through Regulatory and Legal review to final approval for packaging, marketing and launch materials.

• Drive feasibility reviews with Packaging, Operations and Supply Chain for each concept. Confirm it can be manufactured, scaled and hit target cost of goods (COGS) and margin before each stage gate, and resolve any issues that would affect launch timing, raising risks to leadership as needed.

Positioning, Claims & Go-to-Market:

• Develop product positioning, value propositions, naming direction and core messaging that set new launches apart from the competition, aligning with senior Product and Brand leadership.

• Shape claims strategy in partnership with Clinical & Medical Affairs and Regulatory, ensuring structure/function and cosmetic claims are compelling, substantiated and compliant with FDA, FTC and NAD guidelines.

• Support development of new product assets that communicate efficacy and results (clinical before/afters, certification content, testing content, etc.).

• Build integrated go-to-market plans with Brand Marketing, Growth, Retention, Retail and Professional teams, tailoring launch strategies by channel and audience.

• Brief Creative, Copy and Packaging teams on launch assets that communicate efficacy, including clinical before-and-afters and testing content.

• Partner with Education to create sell-in materials, product training and FAQs for retail partners, healthcare professionals, stylists and Customer Experience teams.

• Collaborate with Medical Affairs to ensure clinical and scientific validation is reflected accurately in marketing communications.

Launch Performance & Lifecycle Management:

• Track post-launch performance against defined KPIs and competitive response, sharing learnings and recommending adjustments to positioning, claims or assortment.

• In partnership with the Sr. Manager, identify opportunities to strengthen the existing portfolio through reformulations, line extensions, new formats and updated claims.

Regulatory & Quality Partnership:

• Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance on compliance and product certifications for both dietary supplements and topical/cosmetic products.

• Proof packaging artwork and copy for accuracy, regulatory compliance and brand alignment.

Requirements:

• 5+ years in product development, innovation and/or product marketing within supplements, OTC, beauty or personal care; hair care or skincare preferred

• Proven track record of taking products from concept to launch through a cross-functional stage-gate process, ideally across omnichannel businesses

• Demonstrated experience conducting competitive analysis and product benchmarking, with the ability to organize complex market and consumer information into clear, actionable recommendations

• Strong business acumen, including building business cases, forecasts and pricing recommendations

• Working knowledge of claims substantiation and regulatory considerations for structure/function and/or cosmetic claims (FDA, FTC & NAD), including taking claims through Regulatory and Legal review

• Experience writing product, creative and copy briefs that drive clear, on-strategy work

• Ability to translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, compelling, consumer-friendly language

• Highly organized and detail-oriented; thrives managing multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; SPINS, Circana or Amazon data experience a plus

• Excellent written and verbal communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Nutrafol takes into consideration a wide range of factors in final compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package.

Salary Range:

$120,000—$130,000 USD

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Nutrafol is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, pregnancy (including breast feeding and related medical conditions), national origin, citizenship status, uniform service member status, age, genetic information, disability, and for employees working in California, ancestry, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, protected medical condition, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws.

Perks & Benefits

jobs.description:
The Corporate Finance Manager will play a critical role in driving the Company’s financial planning, forecasting, strategic analysis, and performance management processes. This highly visible position partners closely with executive leadership and business stakeholders across the organization to support strategic decision-making, evaluate financial performance, and enhance enterprise value creation.

The successful candidate will lead key planning initiatives, develop sophisticated financial models, deliver executive-level reporting and insights, and help shape the Company’s long-term financial strategy. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, exceptional financial modeling capabilities, and the ability to translate complex financial information into actionable business recommendations.

Responsibilities

• Assist with the development, consolidation, and review of the Company’s annual operating plan, long-range strategic plan, and periodic forecasts.
• Partner with senior leaders and department heads to evaluate business performance, identify opportunities, and support strategic initiatives.
• Coordinate quarterly earnings support activities, including preparing executive presentations, guidance analyses, and supporting materials for senior management.
• Develop, maintain, and enhance integrated three-statement financial models used for forecasting, scenario planning, capital allocation, and long-range planning.
• Perform financial analyses to support strategic decision-making, including investment evaluations, business cases, sensitivity analyses, and scenario modeling.
• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting packages, including variance analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and executive dashboards.

• Partner with Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations, Human Resources, and other functional teams to ensure alignment between financial plans and business objectives.
