• Support the implementation, optimization, and ongoing administration of Workday Adaptive Planning and other financial planning tools.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
• 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, investment banking, and/or private equity (will consider internships as well as academic projects)
• Advanced financial modeling skills with demonstrated experience building integrated operating and valuation models.
• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and corporate finance principles.
• Exceptional proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including executive-level presentation development.
• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning strongly preferred.
• Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, SQL, or similar platforms is a plus.
• Experience supporting public company reporting, earnings processes, or board-level reporting is preferred.
• Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
• Ability to synthesize large volumes of data into clear, concise, and actionable insights.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to effectively interact with executive leadership.
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Strong business acumen and intellectual curiosity with a desire to understand operational drivers and strategic outcomes.
• Highly self-motivated with a proactive, ownership-oriented mindset.
• Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.
• Strong project management and organizational skills.
• Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for automation, process optimization, and operational excellence.

The successful candidate will play a key role in providing project controls leadership, driving schedule performance, managing project reporting, and supporting the successful delivery of complex life sciences projects from planning through commissioning and closeout.

Responsibilities:

• Progress each project every month to ensure all projects are monitored for project controls in line with the monthly reporting cycle, checking accuracy and consistency of data.
• Report milestones of planned value and earned value data, % complete on projects and provide project commentaries.
• Attend project status meetings report on major material status; update forecast and schedule per progress discussion.

• Review schedules with project team members on a regular basis to ensure that accurate and timely data is incorporated in the schedule.
• Facilitate interactive planning sessions and quantitative risk assessments when required.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Agents and Intelligence
jobs.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.


Position Overview
Contracts embody the complex and dynamic DNA of an organization’s most critical business relationships. As a leading CLM platform, Agiloft has a unique opportunity to help businesses discover, understand, manage and leverage their contracts in innovative, practical, and effective new ways.
The Senior Product Manager – Agents and Intelligence, will be responsible for shaping and leading the development of agent-driven workflows at Agiloft, capturing data insights across our platforms, and leveraging those insights to deliver business value to our customers. You will identify high-value opportunities where agents can unlock efficiency across the contract lifecycle, drive usage and enhance the long-term value of the product. This role requires a blend of strategic vision and execution discipline: defining and tracking success metrics for agentic workflows, orchestrating updates to Agiloft’s APIs to ensure seamless data accessibility, observing and productizing data insights, and working across UX, engineering, legal knowledge engineering, and go-to-market teams to deliver innovative solutions that delight customers.
You will bring curiosity, insight, and a strong track record of innovation to create meaningful, user-centered product experiences. As a champion of agentic solutions, you will play a pivotal role in positioning Agiloft as the leader in applying intelligent agents to contract lifecycle management.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Accountant (Remote)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Corporate Accountant or Senior Corporate Accountant to support our growing business and take ownership of core accounting and financial operations.

This role is ideal for someone with strong accrual accounting experience who is comfortable managing day-to-day bookkeeping, financial reporting, month-end close, and accounting operations in a fast-paced environment.

You will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting internal controls, and ensuring smooth accounting operations across our business and subsidiaries. You will also support accounting transitions and integration efforts related to mergers and acquisitions.

We are open to candidates at both the Accountant and Senior Accountant levels, depending on experience and ability to independently manage accounting responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including accrual-based bookkeeping, journal entries, account reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.
• Own and support the month-end and quarter-end close processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
• Prepare and post journal entries for intercompany and subsidiary transactions.
• Perform monthly bank reconciliations and maintain accurate financial records across multiple entities.
• Manage accounting activities related to commissions, expenses, accruals, and other operational transactions.
• Prepare, analyze, and reconcile financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
• Maintain compliance with U.S. GAAP and support the development of effective internal accounting controls.
• Support accounting integration and financial transitions related to mergers and acquisitions.
• Identify opportunities to streamline month-end close processes, improve efficiency, and strengthen financial reporting.
• Partner with internal leadership, including finance and credit risk teams, to support operational and financial needs.
• Assist with pro forma financial analysis, financial planning, and other ad hoc accounting projects as needed.
• Take ownership of accounting processes and ensure continuity during business transitions.

• 2+ years of relevant accounting experience; candidates with more extensive experience will be considered for the Senior Accountant level.
• Strong hands-on experience with accrual-based accounting and bookkeeping is required.
• Solid understanding of U.S. GAAP, general ledger accounting, and financial statement preparation.
• Experience with month-end close, journal entries, bank reconciliations, and account reconciliations.
• Ability to understand and interpret P&L statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
• Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero, or similar platforms.
• Experience managing accounting operations independently or taking ownership of multiple accounting functions.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with multiple entities or subsidiaries.
• Background in small or medium-sized businesses, startups, or public accounting.
• Experience supporting M&A transactions, accounting integrations, or business transitions.
• Experience with commission accounting, internal controls, and accounting process improvements.
• Demonstrated ability to improve or accelerate month-end close processes.

Our Core Values

At the heart of everything we do are two values that guide how we work and grow together:

Candor – We believe in open, honest, and respectful communication. Candor helps us solve problems faster, build stronger relationships, and keep our focus on what truly matters. We encourage every team member to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions.

Impact – We measure success not by effort alone, but by the results we create. Whether it’s streamlining accounting processes, producing accurate financial insights, or enabling better decisions, we prioritize work that drives meaningful outcomes for our company, our customers, and our team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Software Engineer on Sierra’s Cloud Infrastructure team, you’ll own the foundation that every Sierra customer runs on. That includes our multi-tenant environments, where most of our customers and data live, and our isolated single-tenant environments for highly regulated enterprises. Sierra is expanding quickly across AWS and GCP, in regions across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. We expect to roughly double our number of deployments over the next year.

The work is very visible. Our deployments support the relationship with major customers, so you’ll see directly how your infrastructure affects customers and the business. Our challenges keep evolving, from scaling, reliability, and new compliance and regulations.



ON THIS TEAM, YOU WILL:

 - Design, build, and operate Sierra’s cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP (and soon Azure) using Terraform and Kubernetes.

 - Simplify and standardize our deployments so that adding a new region or environment is repeatable and predictable. We want to treat deployments like cattle, not pets.

 - Stand up and operate new multi-tenant regions and single-tenant environments for customers with strict regulatory or isolation needs.

 - Help build and run compliant environments, including our FedRAMP deployment.

 - Own and improve deploys and releases across our fleet, investing in tooling and developer experience so engineers can ship quickly and safely.

 - Build security guardrails that give enterprise customers confidence in our shared multi-tenant environment.

 - Work with our BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) team to make Sierra easy to deploy into customers’ own cloud environments.

 - Drive reliability across the platform through observability, incident response, root cause analysis, and postmortems.

 - Write production code, mostly in Go, to automate infrastructure and replace manual work with durable systems.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6+ years of hands-on software or infrastructure engineering experience, including building and operating production systems at scale.

 - Broad infrastructure experience on at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Breadth and fundamentals matter more than expertise in one specific cloud.

 - Deep expertise in at least one layer of the stack, such as compute, orchestration, networking, or deploys, plus a real interest in owning the layers next to it.

 - Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

 - Strong coding skills and a bias toward automation and tooling. Go experience is a plus.

 - A pragmatic, scrappy approach. You can start with a rough prototype and evolve it into production ready.

 - Curiosity and flexibility. You adapt to new clouds, tools, and customer requirements instead of forcing every problem into one familiar pattern.

 - A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


EVEN BETTER

 - Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and many regions or environments.

 - Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, HIPAA, or financial services).

 - Experience building deploy systems, CI/CD, or internal developer platforms.

 - Experience deploying software into customer-managed cloud environments.

 - An SRE background, or experience leading reliability and incident management programs.

 - Experience with distributed databases such as DynamoDB or Spanner.

 - Experience at a fast-paced startup or on a small infrastructure team with broad scope.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.location: Los Angeles, CA; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

To help us do this work, The Times is hiring a Director of Media Relations & Communications to support rapid response and issues management communications throughout the organization. You will advance and defend the reputation of the New York Times and its employees by creating and executing media relations strategies during emerging issues and high-stakes situations. You will be part of a team that develops and executes comprehensive rapid response strategies, handles complex media inquiries, and provides expert counsel to senior leadership on sensitive communications matters. The ideal candidate possesses exceptional judgment, a deep understanding of the media landscape, strong writing and communication skills, and the ability to thrive under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

This is a hybrid role based either in our New York City headquarters or our Washington, San Francisco or Los Angeles bureaus, reporting to the Executive Director of Media Relations and Communications. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days per week. This position requires regular after hours, weekend and on-call work.

Responsibilities:

Rapid Response & Media Relations: As a senior spokesperson for The New York Times, you will act as a primary media contact for urgent inquiries, implementing a robust rapid response framework and protocols to manage breaking news and critical issues across all media channels (traditional, digital, social). You will draft and rapidly disseminate accurate, consistent, and impactful statements, Q&As, talking points, and other communications materials under tight deadlines.

Issues Management: Working with colleagues across the communications team, you will develop and execute comprehensive issues management communications plans, collaborating with internal subject matter experts to gather accurate information and develop informed responses to complex issues.

Media Monitoring & Reporting: You will work closely with other members of the rapid response team to identify, monitor, analyze and respond to potential threats and opportunities in the media landscape, responding quickly to identified issues and creating plans to respond to them. You will also be responsible for reporting on your efforts in collaboration with the communications operations team.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of increasing experience in media relations, public affairs, or corporate communications, with a significant focus on rapid response and issues management.

• Proven track record of successfully managing high-profile, sensitive, and complex media situations, with a strong understanding of the evolving media landscape, including traditional, digital, and social media platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to think strategically and critically under pressure, making sound judgments and rapid decisions, with experience advising and collaborating with senior executives on communications strategy.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

• Experience managing a team of seasoned crisis communicators, helping them make decisions and guiding their strategic approach.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience working at a media organization, agency, campaign or large corporation with international reach and prominent presence on social media.

jobs.title: Head of Web Strategy and Experience
jobs.description:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency, empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs to build thriving travel advisory businesses. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel industry with AI woven through every part of the advisor's workflow, plus global supplier relationships, personalized training, and a vibrant community, all in one place. That's what lets advisors build businesses that scale, while their taste and service create trips no algorithm alone could plan. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career, whether full-time or part-time.

We're mission-driven and obsessed with our customers, and we believe humans and AI are both essential: the best work here comes from people and technology at their best, together. That's not just a philosophy about our product, it's how we build our team. Everyone at Fora gets hands-on with frontier AI tooling as part of the job. At Fora, you'll learn to be AI-fluent, with real experience applying AI to solve problems day to day, wherever you sit in the company.

Founded in 2021, Fora has grown to a team of 250+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City. In 2026, we closed a $60 million Series D led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued backing from Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've been named a LinkedIn Top Startup (2024), one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies (2023 and 2025), and one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies (2026).

Come build something that hasn't existed before.

About The Role

Our website is the front door to both sides of Fora. It's where future advisors decide whether this is the career for them, where established advisors decide if this is the place to grow their business, and where travelers find the advisor who will plan their next trip. It's one of our biggest growth levers, and right now it doesn't have a single owner. You'll be that owner: setting the strategy and goals, building the roadmap, and running the site like a growth business. If you care about what we're building for travel entrepreneurs, you'll feel at home here. You don't need category experience.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set direction with our founders and leadership team, then get into the details yourself: the briefs, the test plans, the analytics, the page that isn't converting. You'll partner closely with SEO/GEO, Content, the WAV and M&G Pods, Brand, Creative, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Data. Most of those teams won't report to you, so this role runs on clarity, data, and relationships.

In your first month, you'll deliver a web strategy and a detailed roadmap with core website metrics. Within a year, we want to see a double-digit lift in session-to-signup conversion against a holdout, one completed test every week, and a backlog that keeps growing. As the work outgrows one person, you'll make the case for the team and build it.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the web strategy. Define what the site is for, who it serves, and how we measure it, then turn that into goals and a prioritized roadmap that leadership signs off on and teams can build against.

• Grow quality advisor signups. Own conversion across the advisor journey, from first visit to application, including the homepage, core pages, paid landing pages, and persona routing. We goal on quality and LTV, not raw volume.

• Build the experimentation engine. Stand up a prioritized backlog, a testing framework with clear hypotheses, holdouts, and decision criteria, and a weekly cadence that compounds what we learn.

• Build the traveler path to an advisor. Partner with Product on advisor discovery and matching, and make the path from content and search to a booking inquiry clear and measurable.

• Shape the platform. Partner with Engineering on the CMS, page templates, component library, and design system so teams can launch and test pages without waiting on a sprint. Hold the bar on site performance, accessibility, and crawlability.

• Bring the brand to life on the web. Partner with Brand and Creative on information architecture, global navigation, and site strategy so the site feels elevated and converts.

• Build for people and AI agents. Partner with SEO/GEO so the site is structured, fast, and machine readable across search engines and AI answer engines.

• Own web measurement. Work with Data to get event-level web data in place and build reporting that ties the site to signups, activation, and LTV.

• Set the operating model. Define who owns what on the web across Growth, Brand, Creative, Content, Product, and Engineering, and run the intake, prioritization, and review rhythm.

• Use AI as core infrastructure. Build agents and automated workflows for research, page QA, test analysis, reporting, and content operations.

Requirements

• 10+ years in web strategy, digital experience, or growth at a consumer, marketplace, or technology company, including at least 4 years leading teams or major cross-functional programs

• A track record of increasing conversion at scale through structured experimentation, with tests you can walk us through (what won, what lost, and why)

• Experience optimizing against full-funnel economics (CAC, LTV, ROAS)

• Experience working in a headless CMS and with analytics and experimentation tools (e.g., GA4, Amplitude, BigQuery, Eppo, Coframe)

• Has shipped a site redesign, information architecture overhaul, or design-system rollout at a consumer, marketplace, or technology brand, and can show it in a portfolio or case study

• Can name the specific AI tools in your current workflow and give a concrete example, such as an agent or automation for page QA, test analysis, or reporting

• Has stood up a web or experimentation function, or owned a site's strategy, where none existed before

• Has aligned senior stakeholders across Brand, Product, Engineering, and Data without direct authority over them

Strongly Preferred

• Hands-on experience with React or Next.js and tag management, working alongside engineers

• Experience at a two-sided marketplace or platform where the site serves more than one audience

• Has led a website replatform, CMS migration, or brand relaunch without stalling the testing program

Compensation

Compensation for this role varies based on experience, with an indicative range of $200K–$240K + equity. Final compensation will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as we’re considering multiple levels for this role.

• Unlimited vacation

• Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)

• Dental & Vision Insurance

• Wellhub Memberships

• 401k plan with company match

• Commuter Benefits

• Supplemental Life Insurance

• Stock Options

This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views.

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers.

We’re here to serve

We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way.

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Authorization to work in the United States is required for full-time roles based in our New York City office. Fora is unable to sponsor or assist with U.S. work authorization. Roles based outside of the United States are not subject to this requirement.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Fora is committed to an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment. BIPOC and traditionally underrepresented candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. We will not discriminate and will take action to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Platform — Data Trust & AI Context
jobs.location: WA - Seattle; UT - Cottonwood Heights; CA - San Francisco
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role:

SoFi’s ability to deliver trusted member experiences, manage risk, meet regulatory obligations, and scale enterprise AI depends on data that is reliable, governed, understandable, and available when it is needed.

As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Group, you will provide hands-on technical leadership within the Data Trust pillar. Working alongside the Senior Manager and other Principal Engineers, you will design, build, and operate the distributed systems and reusable platform primitives that make data quality, privacy, metadata, lineage, access, and reliability enforceable by construction across the enterprise.

Your work will span three connected areas: establishing shared Data Trust capabilities, raising the reliability of data across batch and low-latency environments, and applying those foundations to a semantic context layer for trusted analytics and AI. By making business meaning, ownership, provenance, quality, freshness, and access policies machine-readable, you will help end users and AI systems work from consistent, governed context.

This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineering, data, security, privacy, legal, risk, analytics, and product teams. You will build reusable enterprise capabilities and reference patterns that partner teams can adopt, while domain teams retain ownership of their application-specific use cases and serving paths.

What you will own:

• Data Trust architecture and strategy: Define and execute the technical direction for data contracts, metadata and catalog modernization, lineage, data quality, privacy, and access controls. Translate business, regulatory, and engineering requirements into a coherent platform strategy and sequence investments for long-term impact.

• Declarative enforcement primitives: Build platform services, libraries, and reference patterns that make contracts, quality rules, privacy policies, and access requirements versioned, testable, observable, and automatically enforceable across the data lifecycle.

• Semantic context for analytics and AI: Establish the technical foundations for a governed semantic context layer that connects business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, quality, freshness, and access policy. Enable trusted discovery, analytics, and AI-assisted or agentic experiences without turning this role into a model-development function.

• Reliability across batch and streaming data: Lead the evolution of Data Trust capabilities across Snowflake, AWS data services, Kafka-based ingestion, and other batch or low-latency environments. Establish explicit SLOs, failure modes, correction paths, and operational ownership, supported by automated detection, containment, remediation, and recovery.

• Mission-critical operational rigor: Raise the standard for production data systems through observability, integrity checks, audit evidence, incident learning, and safe automation. Help move the organization from reactive troubleshooting and manual compliance activity toward proactive, measurable control.

• Cross-organizational technical leadership: Drive multi-quarter initiatives across teams and functions, earning alignment on difficult architectural tradeoffs and investment decisions. Serve as a trusted technical authority for Data Trust while mentoring senior engineers, strengthening design and implementation practices, and raising the broader engineering bar.

What success looks like in the first 12–18 months:

• A clear enterprise architecture and delivery path exists for Data Trust primitives spanning contracts, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and reliability.

• Priority data domains have materially improved coverage, observability, SLOs, and automated enforcement.

• The platform provides production-ready patterns for governing data in both batch and low-latency environments.

• Initial semantic context capabilities are operating in production and provide more reliable, traceable context for analytics and AI use cases.

• Manual investigation, recurring data failures, and compliance evidence-gathering are measurably reduced.

• Engineering and partner teams have adopted reusable standards and capabilities rather than creating isolated point solutions.

What you’ll need:

• Experience & Education: 15+ years of software or data engineering experience (or 13+ years with a Master’s degree) with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating distributed data platforms at enterprise scale.

• Platform Architecture Expertise: Deep experience designing horizontal, multi-tenant platform services that other engineering teams depend on. You understand the failure modes of distributed systems, eventual consistency, and how to balance latency, availability, and cost.

• Data Trust & Governance Depth: Practical, battle-tested experience building or managing components of the modern data trust stack, such as data contracts, metadata catalogs, data quality frameworks, end-to-end lineage, and fine-grained access control (RBAC/ABAC).

• Batch & Streaming Mastery: Advanced knowledge of modern data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake, Kafka (or similar streaming platforms), and AWS data services. You know how to govern data in motion just as effectively as data at rest.

• Hands-On Engineering: Mastery of one or more core programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and advanced SQL. You are comfortable writing production-grade code, conducting rigorous code reviews, and building declarative infrastructure (Terraform, CI/CD).

• Cross-Organizational Leadership: A history of successfully driving multi-team, cross-functional technical initiatives. You know how to build consensus across Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Product teams, translating compliance and risk requirements into frictionless engineering primitives.

• Operational Rigor: Experience managing Tier-0/mission-critical infrastructure. You build systems with a "trust but verify" mindset—relying on automated testing, drift detection, and circuit breakers rather than manual processes.

Nice to have:

• FinTech / Regulated Industry Experience: Prior experience operating in a highly regulated environment where auditability, data privacy (CCPA/GDPR), and data integrity are architectural requirements, not afterthoughts.

• AI Infrastructure Exposure: Experience building semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or context engines that ground LLMs and autonomous agents in governed enterprise data.

• Open Source Contributions: Contributions to relevant open-source data or metadata projects (e.g., Apache Iceberg, OpenMetadata, DataHub, Amundsen).

Compensation and Benefits

jobs.title: 2027 New Grad Low Observables Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance and Strike Low Observables Team are advancing into the next generation of LO Technology to enhance the survivability and effectiveness of unmanned air systems. Our Low Observables engineering team is responsible for designing, analyzing, testing, and sustaining stealth features that reduce radar (RCS) and infrared (IR) signatures, ensuring our systems remain undetectable in contested environments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an early career role open to engineers with a degree in aerospace, electrical, or mechanical engineering. Low Observables work sits at the intersection of all three: the shape of the air vehicle, the electromagnetic behavior of its surfaces, and the materials and processes used to build it.

You do not need prior stealth experience. Almost nobody arrives with it, because most of it cannot be taught outside a cleared program. We will teach you the LO-specific methods. What we are looking for is strong engineering fundamentals, comfort picking up unfamiliar analysis tools, and the judgment to tell a real result from a bad one.

You will be paired with an LO engineer and start on a scoped piece of a live program, not a training exercise.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Run broadband Radar Cross Section (RCS) analysis on components and full air vehicles, and learn to judge when a prediction can be trusted

• Support the design and development of Low Observable unmanned air systems, from early configuration trades through detailed design

• Build and improve the analysis tools, scripts, and validation workflows the team runs on

• Model LO materials and treatments, and help select and optimize them for specific components

• Support manufacturing and validation planning, including tolerances, inspection methods, and what is actually producible at rate

• Help plan and execute RCS measurement campaigns in indoor chambers and on outdoor ranges, then reduce and interpret the data

• Compare measured results against predictions, chase down the disagreements, and feed what you learn back into the models

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Must be pursuing or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

• Able to start in 2027.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Coursework in at least one of: electromagnetics or RF, aircraft or vehicle design, or materials and manufacturing processes

• Working knowledge of a scripting or analysis language such as MATLAB, Python, or C++

• Familiarity with a 3D CAD package such as NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or Creo

• Demonstrated hands-on engineering work: a capstone or senior design project, internship, undergraduate research, or a student competition team

• Ability to explain a technical result clearly, in writing and in a design review

• Exposure to any electromagnetic simulation tool, such as HFSS, CST, FEKO, or COMSOL. X-Patch, SENTRi, and McMoM2D are government codes and we do not expect you to have used them

• Coursework or project experience with composites, additive manufacturing, casting, or injection molding

• Experience with laboratory RF measurement: network analyzers, anechoic chambers, or antenna pattern measurement

• Experience reducing, visualizing, and sanity-checking measured data sets

• A prior internship or co-op in aerospace, defense, or another hardware-heavy environment

US Salary Range

$88,000—$117,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

The work

jobs.title: Mission Engineer - Albany
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable.

You won't wait to be asked. You'll identify what's broken before it becomes a problem, build solutions that didn't exist yesterday, and earn the kind of trust that makes you indispensable to the agency — and to Axon.

In this embedded role, you are the primary owner of customer outcomes within a strategic account — accountable for the full lifecycle of Axon's ecosystem. You combine deep technical expertise, builder instinct, operational leadership, and executive presence to help agencies transform how they operate, not just adopt software. You embed for the long haul: opening the laptop onsite, shipping on Axon's stack, holding the room when it matters, and iterating on what you build until it sticks in production.

Success is measured by the agency's operational outcomes and working solutions in production — not product health, not activity, not slideware.

What You'll Do

This role is intentionally undefined in the day-to-day. Priorities shift with agency mission tempo, operational crises, and emerging opportunities. If you need a fixed playbook to succeed, this isn't the role for you.

Building is the job. You will use Axon's platform — AI Era, agents, workflows, integrations, and data tools — to design, build, and ship new capabilities on site. You own outcomes end to end across deployment, adoption, optimization, and ongoing success — as the accountable owner, not a coordinator of other teams' work.

Onsite Building & Platform Delivery

• Discover agency problems onsite and translate them into buildable, compliant solutions tied to mission outcomes

• Design and ship working tools on Axon's platform: AI agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and data pipelines — built and tested with real users and real data

• Build with Axon products, not around them — configure, integrate, and extend DEMS, Fusus, AI Era, Records, and related systems in the agency environment

• Iterate in the field until adoption sticks, then document patterns for reuse across accounts

• Apply responsible innovation guardrails — CJIS, evidence integrity, privacy — in every build. Ship working software, not slideware

• Troubleshoot onsite and coordinate root-cause resolution across Product, Engineering, Support, and Services when builds or integrations break

AI Build & Adoption

• Build and deploy AI-powered workflows (agents, prompts, RAG, evaluations) that solve defined agency problems — not generic experimentation

• Drive hands-on adoption with the people who use what you build daily

• Measure whether changes stick — usage, workflow impact, mission outcomes — and iterate when they don't

Operational Transformation & Leadership

• Assess workflows onsite, identify friction and mission impact, and define what to build before you build it

• Move from reactive support to proactive outcome design — arrive with hypotheses, validate with command staff and operators, then build to match

• Build trusted relationships with agency leadership and operational stakeholders; lead QBRs, mission reviews, and strategic planning

• Define success metrics and capture baselines before major deployments so impact is proven, not assumed

Field Intelligence & Growth

• Capture customer insights, workflow patterns, and adoption barriers; share field intelligence with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap decisions

• Turn one-off builds into reusable playbooks and operational frameworks

• Identify expansion opportunities based on demonstrated impact; partner with Sales on long-term account strategy

Onsite Engagement & Outcomes

• Maintain consistent onsite presence (approximately 3-4 days/week), closely connected to agency operations and evolving needs

• Track customer success metrics: time-to-first-production-use, adoption depth by role and site, workflow improvements, and mission outcomes

• Support Sales → Post-Sales onboarding and handoff, establishing goals and accountability from day one

What You Bring

Required

• Experience in customer-facing technical roles, program management, operational transformation, or complex deployment environments (typically 8+ years; varied experience welcome)

• Former law enforcement or military experience preferred, not required

• Proven builder: you have shipped working automations, agents, workflows, integrations, or AI-enabled tools in customer environments — configuring products, writing integration logic, and delivering production-ready solutions. Using AI to assist is expected; owning the build is required

• Comfort working across technical and operational domains: hardware, software, cloud, AI-enabled technologies, and integrated systems

• Strong communication with both technical teams and senior stakeholders, including command staff in mission-critical environments

• Full ownership mentality in ambiguous, fast-changing environments; ability to navigate competing priorities across Product, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Services

• Ability to obtain and maintain CJIS compliance and adhere to security standards

Preferred

• Experience in public safety, law enforcement, corrections, or other mission-critical operational environments

• Familiarity with Records, Evidence, digital workflows, AI-enabled platforms, or integrated public safety ecosystems

• Background in forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or operational transformation at scale

Additional Information

We recognize that candidates may bring strengths from different backgrounds and experiences. If your experience aligns closely with this role, we encourage you to apply.
This role is for builders who earn trust in the room — not for those looking for a predictable schedule or narrowly defined responsibilities. Every week looks different. That's the job.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401(k) with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, dental, and vision plans

• Fitness programs

• Emotional and mental wellness support

• Learning and development programs

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Base Pay Range

$127,500—$204,000 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.title: Launch Pad Engineer, Fluid Systems
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LAUNCH PAD ENGINEER, FLUID SYSTEMS

SpaceX is currently seeking an individual to join the Launch Pad Engineering Team in Cape Canaveral, FL. As a member of the Launch Pad Engineering team, you will have the opportunity to utilize your multi-disciplinary knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop solutions to launch pad operations with the goal of maximizing efficiency without sacrificing safety or reliability.

While preparing the pads for launch, you will be responsible for ensuring all aspects of launch pad GSE (ground support equipment) have been properly inspected, configured, and tested to support Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy interface requirements. During integrated launch operations, you will be responsible for leading a team of technicians on the pads through operational procedures resulting in successful, on-time launches.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Serve as the responsible engineer for one or multiple launch pad fluid systems including compressible, incompressible, and/or cryogenic fluid systems

• Utilize knowledge of heat transfer, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, controls, and instrumentation to troubleshoot issues present in various launch pad systems

• Work with, and direct, a skilled technician workforce to carry out troubleshooting, maintenance activities, upgrades, and operational procedures

• Contribute to the development and improvement of the functional automation relating to the fluid system(s) for which you are responsible

• Identify and implement upgrades to launch pad hardware, software, and procedures – drive continuous improvement in these areas by interfacing regularly with various teams across SpaceX

• Develop and perform post launch data review for your respective system(s), both automated and manual

• Serve as the lead engineer for the pads during refurbishment and launch operations

• Represent SpaceX by presenting certification packages and engineering data to U.S. government agencies

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, chemical engineering, physics, computer science, or other engineering discipline

• 1+ years of professional experience working with fluid, mechanical, or low voltage electrical systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience working at a rocket launch/test facility and supporting launch/test campaigns

• Experience using and troubleshooting control systems for remote operations and instrumentation feedback

• Experience using CAESAR II or similar pipe stress analysis programs

• Experience using SOLIDWORKS, Siemens NX, or similar CAD software

• Experience using python or other programming languages for data review and analysis

• Experience testing and operating with or around hazardous systems (high pressure, high energy, hazardous gases & fluids, etc.)

• Familiarity with instrumentation and control components (pressure transducers, thermocouples, RTDs, strain gauges, accelerometers, flow meters, load cells, relays, solenoid, pneumatic valves)

• Knowledge of engineering standards and best practices such as ASME B31.3, ASME BPV Code Section VIII, and AFSPCMAN 91-710

• Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast paced environment

• Strong communication and presentation skills

jobs.title: Enrollment Pharmacy Technician
jobs.description:
About Healthcare.com
Healthcare.com is a healthcare technology company building smarter ways to connect people and partners with the coverage, care, and solutions they need.
We’re three businesses, one company. Through Marketplace, Pivot Health, and TrustRx, our work spans health insurance marketplaces, flexible health coverage, and pharmacy, giving us more ways to solve meaningful problems across the healthcare ecosystem.
Healthcare doesn’t stand still, and neither do we. We’re curious, collaborative, and always looking for better ways to solve problems, use technology, and make an impact.


About The Role
Love pharmacy but ready to leave the retail counter behind? As a Bilingual Enrollment Pharmacy Technician at TrustRx Pharmacy, you’ll put your pharmacy knowledge to work entirely by phone — no walk-in customers, no drive-thru line, no nights or weekends, in a calm, low-stress environment. You’re the friendly first voice patients, prescribers and referral partners hear when they reach us, helping them in English and Spanish to get set up quickly so patients receive their medications without delay.
Why you’ll like it here
A low-stress environment: No rush-hour lines, frustrated counter crowds or closing-time scramble — just a calm office, a supportive team and work that stays at work when your shift ends.
Phone only, no walk-ins: No counter lines, register or drive-thru window — just focused, one-on-one conversations from your own desk.
A predictable schedule: Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. No nights, weekends or closing shifts.
Scheduled breaks: Real breaks on a set schedule, not whenever the line finally dies down.
Competitive pay and strong benefits:20–24.50 per hour (based on experience) , plus company-funded HSA contributions of 2,000–4,000 a year and a 401(k) match from day one.
Training and support: Hands-on training on our systems and workflows, with a pharmacist and team always available for questions.
Your Spanish is an asset: Help Spanish-speaking patients navigate their care in their own language every day.
Key responsibilities
Welcome every caller: Serve as the first point of contact, in English and Spanish, for every patient, prescriber and referral partner (including law offices that refer patients to us) — from answering the phone and completing intake to following up on refills and address updates. New or returning, you’re the voice they hear first.
Patient and referral onboarding: Accurately record patient demographics, prescription, prescriber, insurance and referral information in the pharmacy system; maintain and update existing referral records.
Phone-based support: Help patients, physicians, law offices, sales reps and insurance providers by phone throughout a steady day, with clear workflows and a supportive team behind you. Resolve issues on the first call whenever possible.
Prescription and coverage coordination: Contact prescriber offices to obtain or clarify prescriptions and missing information, and work with insurance providers to confirm coverage.
Delivery coordination: Partner with the fulfillment team and carrier contacts (e.g., dedicated FedEx account managers) to schedule first fills, expedite deliveries and resolve workflow issues.
Sales partnership: Log detailed notes for every interaction, share account details with relevant departments and alert sales reps to account exceptions so referrals become active patients.
Clinical escalation: Route clinical questions and medication concerns to the pharmacist.
Process improvement: Spot opportunities to improve quality, workflow efficiency and internal procedures that drive referral conversions.
Compliance: Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA, Arizona State Board of Pharmacy rules and company policies at all times.
Required qualifications
High school diploma or GED.
Fluent in English and Spanish
Active Arizona Pharmacy Technician license, or a Pharmacy Technician Trainee license with the ability to become fully licensed.
Strong customer service background with professional phone etiquette and conflict-resolution skills.
Comfortable spending most of the day on the phone, with accurate data entry and proficiency in databases, Windows-based applications and software support systems.
Available Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
Preferred qualifications
National certification (PTCB CPhT or NHA ExCPT), or Pharmacy Technician Trainee status.
Working knowledge of prescription medications.
Specialty, mail-order or call-center pharmacy experience.
Experience handling referrals from physicians, law offices or sales teams.
Experience with insurance verification and prior authorizations.
Experience with pharmacy management systems and CRM tools.
Core competencies
Exceptional bilingual verbal and written communication, empathy and patience, proactive problem solving, strong multitasking, acute attention to detail, and the ability to stay calm and friendly on the phone throughout the day.
Work environment
On-site at our Phoenix, AZ pharmacy office, working from your own desk with a computer and headset. It’s a calm, low-stress, phone-based team setting with no walk-in customers, a set Monday–Friday, 9-to-5 schedule and scheduled breaks.

jobs.title: Launch Growth Marketer, Dash (Remote)
jobs.description:
We believe in the power of process and its potential to unlock growth in teams everywhere.

Who we are

Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco. We help our customers build, document, automate, and track recurring workflows. Our platform automates the work, enforces the standards, and proves compliance so our global customers can run their businesses. We service over 3k customers around the world, and are VC-backed by Accel, Salesforce, and Atlassian.

Our Mission

To make work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere.

Our culture

Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9-to-5. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections are what make teams strong, so we regularly do coffee chats, game-playing, story-telling, and more, to build strong relationships.

If you're entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you!

The Opportunity

Dash is a managed AI teammate for small teams, built by Process Street. It picks up the recurring work that falls between people — the follow-ups, the handoffs, the things everyone assumes someone else did — and does it in Slack or Microsoft Teams, checking with a human before anything goes out.

Dash is new, and most of the people who'd love it haven't heard of it yet. Your job is to change that, and to turn the attention you create into pipeline.

This is demand creation, not demand capture, and the distinction shapes everything. There's no proven channel to scale, no playbook to inherit, and no installed base to build referral or expansion programs on. Every source of growth has to be invented and proven before anyone can optimize it.

The role has four connected parts: create attention, produce the content that sustains it, convert it into pipeline, and keep finding the next advantage. They're one job. The campaigns only work because there's a content engine behind them, the content only compounds because there's a conversion engine in front of it, and none of it holds for long without constant experimentation.

Dash runs like a startup inside a funded one. Process Street has investors behind it. Dash has a small team, its own budget, and has to earn its next dollar — which is exactly why this role exists. Budget won't be the lever that makes a campaign succeed. Creativity, timing, partnerships, and earned attention will be. We want someone whose instinct is to manufacture reach rather than purchase it, and who treats a small budget as a design constraint rather than an obstacle. The same discipline applies to the direct marketing engine: spend should be deliberate, measured, and defensible against the pipeline it produces.

You'll have real leverage behind you. Much of our content, research, and distribution runs on an automated production layer, so one person here can put far more into market than they could at a company doing this by hand. You won't be limited by how much you can produce. You'll be limited by what you decide is worth making — and whether it's good enough to ship, backed by a system that moves as fast as you think.

What You'll Do

• Run stunts that earn attention. Conceive and execute the kind of campaign people stop for and share. This is a distinct craft, and we're hiring for it deliberately.

• Build launch moments. Time the creative, the paid push, and partner distribution to land together. One well-built moment is worth more than months of steady output.

• Build creative partnerships. Source, negotiate, and close deals with creators, communities, and complementary brands, including working out what makes each one worth their while.

• Invent channels, online and off. Prove new routes to an audience that doesn't know us yet, using events and activations as part of an integrated campaign, and be as quick to abandon what doesn't work as to pursue what does.

• Own the content calendar and the output. We publish at high volume across search, video, social, and community. You own what gets made, when it ships, and whether it's good enough.

• Direct the automated production layer. Brief the agents, review what comes back, correct what's wrong, and extend the system into new formats and channels. Make modern content — short-form video, images, ads, and written work — at a pace that only works if you use AI as a genuine force multiplier.

• Own discovery in both directions. Traditional search optimization and AI-assisted discovery, where a growing share of buyers now form their shortlist. Work the conversation through community and reply marketing where our audience already is, kept human rather than automated into noise.

• Hold the brand line. Dash has a distinct voice and personality. Everything that ships sounds like it, including the work the agents produced. You make the final call.

• Convert attention into pipeline. Stand up and operate the direct marketing engine, run the ad accounts across the major platforms, and keep a clear, measurable path from spend to qualified opportunity. Direct agencies and partners with content and context, challenge their thinking, and verify their numbers rather than accepting their reporting.

• Keep finding the next advantage. Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog with a visible record of what each one produced, assess new AI tools and formats weekly and adopt the few that matter, mine customer and market data for insight, and track what competitors are doing that's worth beating.

About You

• You've created demand for something people weren't looking for, and you can show what you did.

• You generate ideas that travel, and you can tell those apart from ideas that only sound good internally.

• You're commercially minded. Awareness that doesn't become pipeline doesn't interest you.

• You get more out of a small budget than most people get out of a large one.

• You work quickly and would rather run several experiments than plan one perfectly.

• You have a sharp eye for detail and can tell immediately when AI-assisted output is off or missing the point.

• You learn new tools fast, go deep on them without being asked, and enjoy that part most.

• You're comfortable across analytics, publishing, and advertising platforms, and you understand how search, AI-assisted discovery, and outbound fit together. Depth in every one isn't expected — the appetite to learn whatever an experiment needs is.

• You want responsibility for an outcome that's genuinely undecided.

Useful, but not required:

• Partnerships, influencer, or creator marketing, particularly deals you sourced and closed yourself

• Events or activations you've planned and run

• Building with AI tools, including agents, automations, and content workflows

• Short-form video production and editing

• Editing and copywriting

• Marketing a product distributed through a platform ecosystem such as Slack or Microsoft Teams

• Community and conversational marketing on X, LinkedIn, or Reddit

• A working growth stack: web and product analytics, search console, advertising platforms, CRM, and retention tooling

• A/B testing and conversion rate optimization

• Enough technical literacy to wire tools together, such as HTML and CSS, SQL, or no-code automation platforms

• Taking a product to market from zero rather than scaling one that already works

Our Benefits

• Unlimited PTO policy — most take 3–4 weeks, plus their major holidays, AND a company-wide week off in December.

• Company offsite and sponsored small-group meetups.

• Social time — coffee chats, games, story-telling, optional house tours.

• Equity for all full-time roles.

• Generous health insurance for US employees and their families, including dental and vision plans.

• A chance to shape how companies around the world run through the future of no-code automation.

Apply, even if you're not sure

Research shows that some people hesitate to apply unless they match every line of a job description. If this role excites you and you'd bring most of what we've described, we'd rather see your application than miss you. Tell us what you've built and what you'd do here.

Equal Opportunity

Process Street is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We're committed to building a team that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

A note on recruitment scams

All communication from our recruiting team comes from an @process.st email address. We will never ask you for payment, banking details, or equipment purchases at any stage of the hiring process. If you receive an offer or request that looks like it's from Process Street but doesn't come from an @process.st address, please don't respond, and let us know.

• Ability to leverage relationships to increase shelf-share, online placement and drive increased business
• Proven ability to lead, own and drive programs and processes
