jobs.title: IT Enterprise Applications Administrator, Atlassian Admin
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS Industries is looking for an IT Enterprise Applications Administrator (Atlassian Admin) to own the health, security, and day-to-day operation of our Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence environments across both our commercial and FedRAMP-authorized Atlassian tenants. Atlassian is where our engineering, IT, program, and compliance teams plan work, track delivery, handle service requests, and document how we operate. In a defense environment, that means keeping the platform fast and well-automated while holding it to strict data-handling, access, and audit standards. You will join the IT organization alongside infrastructure, cybersecurity, and service desk, and partner closely with the programs and engineering teams that depend on these tools every day.

• Team mandate: turn process pain points into clean workflows, reliable automations, and documentation people actually want to use, while keeping controlled information where it belongs. You will collaborate with IT, cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and program teams, and be the go-to expert on how work gets tracked and recorded at CHAOS.

• Ownership: complete ownership of the Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence platforms in both tenants, including tenant architecture, service desk and workflow design, permission design, the automation strategy, and the roadmap for standardizing, cleaning up, and scaling our instances as programs grow.

Responsibilities:

• Administer and maintain Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence in both the commercial and FedRAMP Atlassian tenants, including projects, spaces, issue types, workflows, schemes, custom fields, screens, permissions, and global settings.

• Manage Jira Service Management (service desk) projects and workflows, including request types, queues, SLAs, approval flows, customer portals, and knowledge base links to Confluence.

• Work directly with IT, cybersecurity, HR, facilities, program, and other teams to identify manual requests and processes, map them end to end, and design and build workflows and automations that route, approve, and fulfill them with less manual effort.

• Maintain clear boundaries between tenants: ensure controlled unclassified information (CUI) and export-controlled data are created, stored, and shared only in the authorized environment, and keep tenant configurations consistent where appropriate.

• Design, build, test, and maintain automation rules in Jira and Confluence (triggers, conditions, branching, smart values, scheduled and webhook-based rules, and cross-product automations) to eliminate manual work, enforce process, and keep data consistent in each tenant.

• Track feature, app, and automation differences between commercial and FedRAMP environments, and plan around them so teams get comparable capabilities in either tenant.

• Manage user lifecycle and access, including onboarding and offboarding, group and role management, SSO and automated provisioning with our identity provider, and periodic access reviews, with access to the FedRAMP tenant limited to eligible users.

• Support security and compliance requirements (such as CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and DFARS): apply least-privilege access, maintain audit logging and retention settings, and provide evidence for internal assessments and external audits.

• Evaluate, install, configure, upgrade, and retire Atlassian Marketplace apps and integrations, confirming each is approved and available for use in the FedRAMP tenant before deployment.

• Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into project templates, workflows, JQL filters, dashboards, and reports; drive standardization across programs.

• Govern Confluence content: space structure, page templates, ownership, marking, archiving, and retention, so documentation stays current, properly handled, and easy to find.

• Follow the change control process for platform changes; plan and execute upgrades, migrations, content moves between tenants, and instance cleanups, and communicate changes and release notes to users.

• Serve as the escalation point for Atlassian support requests, perform root-cause analysis, and work with Atlassian support when needed.

• Create and maintain administrator documentation, runbooks, and user training materials.

• Travel: minimal, up to roughly 10% (occasional trips to company offices).

• Physical demands: primarily sedentary work at a computer; occasional movement around the office.

Minimum Requirements:

• Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or another related field or equivalent work experience

• Hands-on experience administering Jira and Confluence Cloud for a multi-team organization, including permission schemes, workflows, custom fields, and project and space configuration.

• Experience administering Atlassian products in a FedRAMP-authorized or other government cloud environment, or comparable experience managing separate commercial and regulated tenants.

• Proven track record building and maintaining automation rules in Jira and Confluence, including conditions, branching, smart values, and scheduled or webhook-triggered rules.

• Experience configuring and administering Jira Service Management, including request types, queues, SLAs, approval workflows, and customer portals.

• Working knowledge of JQL, with the ability to build filters, dashboards, and reports for non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience managing users and groups, including SSO and automated provisioning (SAML/SCIM) with an identity provider such as Entra ID or Okta.

• Familiarity with handling CUI and working under frameworks such as NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, or DFARS 252.204-7012, including access control, audit logging, and data-handling requirements.

• Experience working with stakeholders to map processes and turn them into automated workflows, with clear written and verbal communication.

• Experience working within a change management process and documenting administrative procedures.

• U.S. person status, as required for access to CUI and export-controlled data (ITAR/EAR).

Preferred Requirements:

• Active U.S. government security clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

• Atlassian certification in Jira or Confluence administration; security certification such as Security+ or CISSP.

• Experience supporting CMMC, NIST 800-171, or FedRAMP assessments, including producing evidence and responding to auditor requests.

• Scripting or API experience (REST APIs, Python, PowerShell, or ScriptRunner) to extend automation beyond built-in rules.

• Experience with ITIL or ITSM practices, and with migrating or consolidating Atlassian instances or moving content between tenants.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $140,000 - $200,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

jobs.title: Associate General Counsel (Commercial)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Associate General Counsel on a lean Legal team, you will help shape the function while focusing principally on transactional needs across the business. You will provide legal advice on commercial contracts, including supplier agreements, and support the legal needs of a scaling organization in a risk-forward environment. You will partner with internal stakeholders to identify and mitigate legal risks across the business while supporting the development of new business lines.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with internal stakeholders to negotiate and close partnership deals, vendor agreements, and real estate and facility leases in support of a rapidly scaling manufacturing organization.

 - Lead the review and negotiation of commercial contracts, MSAs, NDAs, and other business agreements, ensuring terms are favorable and risks are well-managed.

 - Develop company-wide practices and standards that mitigate legal risk across cybersecurity, employment and labor law, and consumer protection.

 - Build scalable, business-centric legal frameworks that give the company the flexibility and speed to operate and grow without unnecessary friction.

 - Provide legal support across corporate transactions, including fundraising activities, tax equity, and project and asset financings.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of legal experience, with a strong background in transactional work; experience in energy, utilities, or technology sectors is preferred but not necessary; startup or high-growth company experience is also preferred.

 - Good judgment to operate independently within a surging business.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex legal concepts into clear, actionable advice.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset that thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and prioritizes impact.

 - Passion for our work and a commitment to fueling American innovation, security, and prosperity through a more reliable grid for all.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Base's legal team owns the legal, regulatory, and compliance foundation of the Company, partnering closely with commercial teams to allow the business to operate and scale. The work spans commercial contracting, supplier agreements, utility regulation, financing, corporate transactions, and compliance—covering significant ground for a small team. As Base develops new markets and new products, the legal function sits at the center of pivotal decisions, engaging directly with business components and leadership, without the layers typical of a larger legal organization.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Commercial West
jobs.description:
Hypori, Inc. is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com.

Hypori is looking for a hunter-minded Account Executive to join our growing commercial sales team. You will own net-new enterprise revenue across the West territory, selling to CISOs, CIOs, and compliance leaders at large commercial enterprises in the Defense Industrial Base, financial services, and healthcare, both directly and with partners. You will report to the VP of Commercial Sales.

Regulated enterprises have an endpoint problem that MDM does not solve, and CMMC 2.0 Level 2 is now a contract requirement across the Defense Industrial Base. Hypori removes the endpoint from scope, and it is proven at scale: more than 95,000 Department of War users are on the platform today, and we hold IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, CMMC 2.0 Level 2, SOC 2 Type II, and HIPAA, so the security review is a strength rather than a hurdle. The commercial enterprise motion is early, and the person in this seat helps define it.

Responsibilities

• Build and run a territory plan across named enterprise accounts

• Generate most of your own pipeline through outbound, events, partners, and your network, prospecting into CISO, CIO, and compliance leaders

• Multi-thread across security, IT, procurement, legal, and the business units that own contractor and BYOD access

• Understand the why first: why change, why now, why Hypori, and why not the status quo. No clear why, no deal

• Run rigorous MEDDPICC discovery on every opportunity

• Quantify value in the buyer’s terms: scope reduction, assessment exposure, device and VDI cost avoidance, data loss risk, and BYOD privacy

• Qualify out early, hold to stage exit criteria, and forecast accurately in Salesforce

• Lead proof-of-value engagements with solution engineers against agreed success criteria, and build mutual action plans with your champion

• Drive security reviews, procurement, and negotiation to signature on 6- and 7-figure multi-year deals

• Land and expand across business units, contractor populations, and supply chains

Qualifications

• 3–5 years of quota-carrying cybersecurity sales

• Consistent attainment against a $700K – $1M+ annual new business ARR quota

• Experience selling to CISOs, CIOs, or senior IT and security leaders

• MEDDPICC or MEDDIC experience. Be ready to walk through a deal you won and a deal you lost

• A track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with 6–12 month sales cycles

• Strong Salesforce and pipeline hygiene

Who You Are

jobs.title: Director of Manufacturing & Site Lead
jobs.description:
About Spectrum Vascular

Spectrum Vascular is an innovative medical device company focused on vascular access and medication management. Our mission is to improve the lives of patients worldwide by providing caregivers with high quality, innovative products with exceptional customer service. We are a company that was formed through the acquisition of a portfolio of trusted products that have been widely used by customers for decades. Innovation has been a core strategic pillar throughout our history and many of our products have been designed to deliver antimicrobial and antithrombogenic protection or to support certain patient populations such as those who are critically ill and pediatrics. This role represents a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team with established products and an entrepreneurial mindset.

The Director of Manufacturing & Site Lead is responsible for establishing, commissioning, and leading manufacturing operations at Spectrum Vascular’s Allentown, Pennsylvania facility. This
is a hands-on site leadership role with responsibility for taking the facility from construction and operational readiness through validation, licensing, product transfer, and commercial production.
During the initial phase of the role, the Director will lead the operational start-up of the approximately 74,000-square-foot facility, including two cleanrooms, a QC laboratory, warehouse operations, and supporting infrastructure. Key priorities include establishing kitting and packaging operations and transferring and validating Spectrum’s coating manufacturing process from Cook Medical while maintaining timing necessary to support continuity of product supply. The Director will build and lead the site organization, including approximately 40 hourly and supervisory employees anticipated by mid-2027, and will establish the operating systems, processes, culture, and performance standards necessary to support a highly regulated manufacturing environment. Following site start-up, the Director will have ongoing accountability for manufacturing operations, safety, cost, delivery, productivity, facilities, and overall site performance.

Initial Site Start-Up and Operational Readiness

Role Responsibilities

During approximately the first 12 months, the Director will have significant responsibility for:

• Leading manufacturing readiness activities during facility construction and build-out.
• Supporting equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, and validation.
• Establishing manufacturing operations for kitting and packaging product lines.
• Leading the transfer, installation, qualification, and validation of the Spectrum 1 coating line currently operated by Cook Medical.
• Driving the Spectrum 1 transfer and validation schedule to support production readiness before bridge inventory is exhausted.
• Partnering with Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Supply Chain, and external resources to achieve site validation and regulatory readiness.
• Supporting state drug manufacturing licensing and other applicable regulatory requirements.
• Establishing production workflows, staffing models, training programs, standard work, and manufacturing controls.
• Recruiting, onboarding, training, and developing the site's hourly and supervisory workforce.
• Establishing site KPIs and daily management systems across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
• Preparing the facility and manufacturing organization for regulatory and customer inspections.

Responsibilities & Duties

Site Leadership: Serve as the senior operational leader for the Allentown facility, with responsibility for employees, manufacturing operations, facilities, company property, business
continuity, and relationships with applicable local authorities.

Team Leadership: Recruit, train, lead, coach, and evaluate manufacturing employees and supervisors. Build an accountable, high-performance culture focused on safety, quality,
teamwork, continuous improvement, and employee development.

Manufacturing Operations: Establish and manage manufacturing processes to ensure products are produced safely, compliantly, efficiently, on time, and within budget. Develop and monitor
KPIs and operating metrics to drive performance.

Manufacturing Strategy: Develop and execute manufacturing strategies aligned with Spectrum's business objectives, with particular focus on safety, quality, delivery, cost,
productivity, capacity, and scalability.

Employee Safety and EHS: Provide site leadership for employee safety and environmental compliance. Establish appropriate controls and operating practices associated with chemical and
coating processes, including solvent handling, drug powders, hazardous materials, hazardous waste, air permitting, ergonomics, and injury prevention.

Quality and Regulatory Partnership: Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to maintain compliance with applicable FDA requirements, the FDA Quality Management System
Regulation (QMSR), ISO 13485, combination-product requirements including 21 CFR Part 4, and applicable cleanroom and environmental-monitoring requirements.
Quality retains responsibility for independent quality oversight, product release, and QC laboratory activities. The Site Lead is accountable for manufacturing execution, production
documentation, employee training, investigation and CAPA follow-through, manufacturing corrective actions, and maintaining a state of inspection readiness.

Inspection Readiness: Maintain manufacturing operations in a continuous state of readiness for inspections and audits by FDA, BSI, applicable state regulatory authorities, customers, and other
regulatory bodies.

Budget and Cost Management: Develop and manage the site's operating budget, monitor manufacturing costs, manage labor and operating expenses, and identify opportunities to
improve productivity and reduce cost without compromising safety, quality, or compliance.

Continuous Improvement: Establish a continuous-improvement culture in which employees and leaders identify and execute improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, workflow,
capacity, and manufacturing performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, R&D, and other functions to support site readiness, product
transfers, production planning, new-product introduction, and business objectives.

Technology and Manufacturing Systems: Lead implementation and optimization of manufacturing technologies, equipment, systems, and processes that improve operational
performance, scalability, traceability, and cost.

Facilities and Business Continuity: Ensure manufacturing equipment, utilities, facilities, and supporting infrastructure are appropriately maintained and capable of supporting validated
operations. Develop business continuity and contingency plans for critical equipment, utilities, processes, and supply risks.

Other Responsibilities: Perform other duties as required to support the successful establishment and operation of the Allentown manufacturing site.

Role Qualifications & Experience

• Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible manufacturing operations experience in an FDA-regulated medical device, pharmaceutical, combination-product, or similarly
regulated manufacturing environment.

• Minimum of 5 years of leadership responsibility for a manufacturing site, significant manufacturing operation, or multiple production lines.
• Demonstrated experience leading a new manufacturing site start-up, major facility expansion, or product/process transfer through commissioning, qualification, validation,
and commercial production.
• Experience operating within ISO-classified cleanroom environments, preferably ISO 7 and/or ISO 8.
• Experience with sterile or controlled-environment packaging operations.
• Experience with chemical, coating, pharmaceutical, or similar manufacturing processes involving controlled handling of solvents, chemicals, or drug materials.
• Demonstrated experience building, staffing, training, and developing an hourly manufacturing workforce.
• Strong working knowledge of FDA-regulated manufacturing requirements, QMSR, ISO 13485, cGMP principles, and applicable validation requirements.
• Demonstrated ability to establish manufacturing systems, standard work, performance metrics, and operating disciplines in a start-up or rapidly evolving environment.
• Proven record of implementing operational and process improvements.
• Strong understanding of production planning, capacity management, labor planning, and manufacturing economics.
• Experience managing operating budgets, production costs, and cost-reduction initiatives.
• Strong EHS orientation and experience managing manufacturing safety and environmental risks.
• Exceptional leadership, problem-solving, analytical, decision-making, and projectmanagement capabilities.
• Ability to operate strategically while remaining highly hands-on and execution focused.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment and lead effectively through ambiguity.
• Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills.

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline preferred.
• Substantial directly relevant manufacturing leadership experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
• Master's degree or MBA preferred but not required.

Preferred Qualifications
• Medical-device or combination-product manufacturing experience.
• Experience with drug-device combination products and 21 CFR Part 4.
• Experience transferring manufacturing processes between contract manufacturers and internal manufacturing facilities.
• Experience with coating or chemical processing operations.
• Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous-improvement certification or experience.
• Experience supporting FDA, notified body, state regulatory, or customer inspections

Work Environment:

On site in our Lehigh Valley manufacturing facility, with occasional office work. Some travel may be required to visit suppliers or customers, especially in the first 6-9 months.

Spectrum Vascular is an Equal Opportunity Employer and committed to creating a diverse and inclusive company culture. Spectrum Vascular does not discriminate against candidates and employees because of their disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion,
national origin, age, veteran status, or any other protected status under the law.

jobs.title: Vice President, FP&A and Program Finance
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

Your Mission

As Vice President, FP&A and Program Finance at True Anomaly, you will own both functions end to end and report directly to the CFO. You will lead budgeting, forecasting, reporting, resource allocation, and the operating rhythm the executive team uses to run the business, delivering both the numbers and the narrative behind them. You will do this for a rapidly scaling, dynamic business executing across multiple products and programs, where financial insights drive operational outcomes.

Success in this role means leadership makes decisions on a forecast it trusts, program economics are visible and predictable, resources flow to the company's highest priorities, and the finance organization is built to support True Anomaly's next stage of scale. This role is for a proven finance executive who leads leaders, earns credibility with engineers, program managers, and government customers alike, and is as comfortable in a program review as in an executive meeting. You will own and be accountable for the finance engine at a fast-growing company taking on some of the hardest problems in national security.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategic Partnership

• Partner with the CFO and executive team as the owner of the company's operational financial picture, bringing an independent view on budgets, resource allocation, and investment tradeoffs

• Lead resource allocation across headcount, opex, capex, and IRAD, and evaluate major operating decisions such as new programs, capacity investments, and make-vs-buy

• Run the company's monthly and quarterly business reviews with the leadership team, making sure performance issues lead to decisions and follow-through, and hold leaders across the organization accountable to their plans

• Partner with Strategic Finance & Corporate Development on the long-range plan by building the bottoms-up operational model behind it, tying long-range targets to program, capacity, and cost realities

• Build and lead a growing, multi-layered FP&A and Program Finance team, developing a team of Directors, Managers, and Analysts who deliver operational and financial outcomes

• Set the roadmap for the function's policies, processes, and systems (ERP, EPM, program management tools, AI and automation) so that we build ahead of the next phase of scale

Financial Planning & Analysis

• Own the annual operating plan and quarterly forecasts, and build a planning process accurate and transparent enough that leadership relies on it to make decisions

• Deliver timely, accurate monthly, quarterly, and board-level reporting with commentary that explains what happened and what to do about it

• Manage indirect rate structures, overhead budgets, and cost allocation in compliance with FAR/CAS, including forward pricing rate strategy, and keep rates competitive as the company grows

• Partner with Business Development on pricing strategy and proposal economics so bids reflect real costs, can win, and make money when executed

Program Finance & Controls

• Integrate Program Finance closely with Accounting, Supply Chain, PMO, and the rest of Finance so program cost, schedule, procurement, and revenue data stay consistent across the close, forecasts, and reporting

• Own the quarterly EAC process for all customer-funded programs, giving leadership a clear and predictable view of program economics and how they roll into the company forecast

• Be accountable for program compliance, audit readiness, and customer cost and schedule reporting, and represent True Anomaly in senior financial discussions with customers

• Own IRAD budgets and program cost analysis, and work with PMO on the risk and opportunity register so issues surface early and show up in the forecast

Qualifications

• 15+ years in finance, with significant aerospace or defense experience across both program controls and broader FP&A or business finance leadership

• Senior leadership experience running FP&A and/or Program Finance end to end in a complex, multi-program business, including leading Directors and managers

• Proven partner to CFOs and executive teams, with a track record of shaping budgets, resource allocation, and investment decisions

• Deep knowledge of program finance: EAC methodology, EVMS, ASC 606, FAR/DFARS, CAS, and government financial reporting (CPR, IPMR)

• Strong FP&A and pricing background, including financial modeling, annual operating plans, indirect rate development, and basis of estimates for government proposals

• Clear communicator who can explain the story behind the numbers and has credibility with program teams, executives, the board, and government customers

• Experience building processes and systems that scale, including practical use of AI and automation

• Works independently, owns outcomes, and makes progress when the path isn't fully defined

• Experience in a high-growth environment strongly preferred; experience at a major defense prime is also valued

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred

Compensation

• Base Salary: Denver: $300,000 - $345,000 - Long Beach: $300,000 - $360,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO, and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Additional Requirements

• Work Location: We observe an in-person work environment, and expect 4 days per week in office at the Company's Denver, CO headquarters or at our facility in Long Beach, California

• Security Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance; an active TS/SCI clearance is preferred

jobs.description:

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Audience Business Analyst

San Mateo, CA (Collab)

In this role you will be an analyst on SIE’s Growth, Media, and Omnichannel Marketing team; specifically, as a part of the Audience, Infrastructure, and Measurement (AIM) team. You will play a vital role in shaping and evolving the way we communicate with our consumers. AIM Analysts bring a diverse range of expertise, spanning SQL development and audience strategy to product leadership and process optimization. While AIM analysts have clear areas of expertise, every member of the team has the opportunity to learn and grow new skills outside of their specialty by contributing to all areas of AIM.

We are looking to fill a new Audience Business Analyst role on the AIM team, specializing in audience strategy, operations, and activation for our Live Service business. You will further enable our global marketing organization to use our first party data to put the customer first in all our marketing communications. Together as gamer and customer experience advocates, we can show how PlayStation is truly the Best Place to Play!

Primary Responsibilities

• Collaborate with marketing and agency partners across all marketing regions as the subject matter expert on our ecosystem of data to create custom segments and support campaign executions supporting player acquisition, ongoing engagement, and retention

• Advise partners on campaigns, using data-based insights from AIM, marketing analytics, data science models, and consumer research

• Work as part of our AIM SCRUM team to deliver value to audience activation, while also analyzing and employing operational optimizations that bring our operations to scale across all our owned and paid marketing channels

• Manage ad-hoc and automated customer lists to power PlayStation’s digital marketing channels globally

• Ensure the efficient and successful delivery of all customer segments to global marketing platforms

• Partner with Martech product teams to translate business needs into actionable requirements and feature enhancements for marketing platforms.

• Experience with working with a variety of marketing platforms and channels, including but not limited to email, paid media, and custom tools

• Executed analysis projects related to lifecycle marketing, targeting segmentation strategies, cohort analysis and tracking, churn prevention, A/B and multivariate tests, and reporting dashboard design and development

• Demonstrates understanding of analytical approaches—can set up clean testing frameworks for clear and meaningful measurement reporting downstream

• Experienced with BI visualization tools such as Domo and Tableau

jobs.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a Compliance Specialist to join our Human Resources Team! This individual will report into our Senior Manager of Total Rewards & Compliance and play an important role in managing and enhancing HR compliance programs, policies, reporting, and processes to ensure alignment with employment laws, workers’ compensation standards, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with leaders and partners across the organization, this role will provide compliance guidance, identify opportunities for process improvements, and support the development and implementation of practices that minimize risk and promote consistency across SupplyHouse. If you’re passionate about HR compliance, enjoy navigating complex regulations and finding practical solutions, and are excited to help build processes that support our team members and the continued growth of our organization, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: SMB Account Manager - US-Based
jobs.description:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Our Account Managers grow and retain Toptal’s small- and medium-sized business clients. You will own a book of high-value SMB accounts, become a trusted advisor to each client, and proactively expand each relationship across Toptal’s full portfolio, including specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.
This is a high-energy, consultative growth role. You will look beyond the transactional request to understand the business problem behind it, identify needs the client has not yet voiced, and build account plans that turn one successful engagement into a broader partnership. Excellence in this role means asking better questions than the clients expect, keeping every engagement healthy, and consistently turning insight into expansion revenue.
You will own the full client lifecycle. You will be the primary point of contact for your accounts, guide clients through active projects, resolve issues before they stall decisions or put the relationship at risk, and know when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise. You will work closely with Talent Operations, Delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s services experts to deliver an exceptional experience while driving growth.
Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be recognized for the growth you create, this is the team you want to be part of.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Own the Portfolio: You are the dedicated advisor and primary point of contact for a portfolio of SMB accounts, accountable for their retention, growth, and success. You exercise discretion and independent judgment in how you prioritize and grow each account.
Discovery and Diagnosis: You run insight-driven conversations with clients to understand the business objective behind each request, assess account health, and uncover challenges Toptal can solve. You earn the right to recommend before you recommend.
Account Planning: You build and execute proactive account plans that connect each client’s business goals to the right Toptal offering, with clear next steps, timing, and expansion targets.
Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You expand accounts across Toptal’s full portfolio, including specialized talent, HireGlobal for global hiring and payroll, and our AI-driven, platform-powered services offerings, positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction talent vendor.
Qualify, Manage, and Win Expansion: You own expansion from identification through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close across departments, projects, and offerings. You explain why the relevant offering fits and address concerns, bringing in teammates as subject-matter experts for specialized offerings and working with internal specialists and experts for solution expertise and scoping. You own the client relationship. You maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce (SFDC).
Uncover Value Early: You monitor demand signals and platform data to offer “uncovered value,” identifying needs before the client voices them, and you use outreach and engagement campaigns, including Salesloft cadences, to educate clients on Toptal’s full breadth of services.
Own the Client Experience: You own the client relationship and the client’s experience of every engagement, from kickoff onward. You stay close to active work, address concerns with a client-first mindset, and partner with Talent Operations and Delivery, who execute the work, to keep engagements on track so that retention is earned through results.
First Line of Defense: You are the first to respond when a client raises an issue, resolving smaller concerns yourself and escalating to Client Experience when an issue needs more than you can solve on your own. You partner with Talent Operations, Delivery, HireGlobal, and services experts to bring the right expertise into an account at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
Meet colleagues across Customer, Talent Operations, Delivery, and HireGlobal to begin your onboarding journey.
Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the Account Manager did well and what they missed.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales and vertical-specific training, demonstrating fluency in our full range of talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
Begin joining client calls, learning who the business partners are on both sides of each relationship and where Toptal can help them grow.
Review and prioritize your portfolio, and draft an initial account plan for each of your accounts.
In the first three months, expect to:
Complete all onboarding and portfolio transitions, and establish yourself as the primary point of contact for your accounts through introduction and discovery calls.
Establish a working cadence with key clients and with the team members supporting those accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. Run account health check-ins that surface at least one new business need beyond the client’s original request.
Build a qualified expansion pipeline across your portfolio based on priority account plans with consistently high-performing call-quality metrics and accurate forecasts maintained in SFDC.
In the first six months, expect to:
Execute your account plans and consistently meet or exceed your defined revenue and expansion metrics, with a clear pattern of organic growth across your portfolio.
Expand the scope of engagements to include new departments, projects, and offerings, including HireGlobal and services opportunities.
Identify where expansion opportunities lose momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
In the first year, expect to:
Demonstrate portfolio net revenue growth through sustained retention and expansion performance, with a consistent qualified pipeline of new opportunities across your accounts.
Be a trusted advisor to your clients, and a reference point for the team on maintaining forecast accuracy, account planning excellence, and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
Mentor new team members, sharing best practices on Toptal’s model and on moving from transactional to consultative account management.
Position yourself for senior-level partnership responsibilities.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree is required.
3+ years of B2B account management or sales experience, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue-based quotas.
1+ years of experience in a software consulting or tech sales role, with proficiency navigating the software project lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience growing and retaining existing client accounts, including proactively creating and closing expansion opportunities, reaching new decision makers, and connecting new business needs to additional solutions.
Experience managing a portfolio of accounts in parallel and maintaining momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
Ability to translate a client’s business objectives into recommendations and actionable project scopes that demonstrate Toptal’s value.
Experience maintaining accurate pipeline, forecast, and account data in a CRM.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a diverse array of clients and competing deadlines. Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.
Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to a named sales methodology, such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.
Core Competencies
These are what we assess for in interviews and coach against after you join.
Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You uncover the “why” behind a client’s request.
Proactive ownership. You do not wait for a client to name a new opportunity or voice dissatisfaction. You analyze their trajectory, spot gaps, needs, and roadblocks before they occur, and you own the outcome, successes and failures alike.
Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk, and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation, stay current on industry trends, and are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request is not the best path to their goal.
Portfolio thinking. You see beyond the single engagement and can position specialized talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings as parts of one growth plan.
Account discipline. You bring consistent, disciplined account management and process adherence, including rigorous SFDC hygiene, to execute account strategies and long-term growth.
Client-centricity. You are committed to the client’s success, across the talent we provide, the experience we offer, and the outcomes we deliver, and you are direct about fit when Toptal is not the right answer.
Will to win. You are naturally competitive, with yourself first, and optimistic and ambitious in the face of change. You want to exceed targets, not just meet them.
Learn-it-all mindset. You seek feedback, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
Collaborative and grounded. Nothing we do is done in isolation. You work as a team within Toptal and within client accounts, and you don’t take yourself too seriously. We are a high-performance team that values authenticity and wit.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
 
This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II, Machining
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

The Machine Shop team delivers high-precision, high-quality machined components that are critical to Terran R’s success. You’ll work with best-in-class, premium machinery and get to bring our expanded, state-of-the-art machine shop to life to support the scale and pace of the Terran R program. With clear training pathways, you’ll have opportunities to advance from operating machines to programming them, growing your career alongside the program.

Nice to haves but not required:

• Knowledge of metrology and dimensional inspection methods

jobs.title: Admissions Representative
jobs.description:
Training Tomorrow's Technicians to Become Skilled, Employable and Essential.

About Us - Big Changes, Better Benefits - Join Us Today!

About Centura College
Centura College is a premier provider of hands-on technical and career training, offering programs in Allied Health and Skilled Trades. We are passionate about preparing the next generation of skilled professionals by equipping students with the tools, knowledge, and confidence to succeed in rewarding careers.

With flexible day and evening classes, real-world experience, and a supportive learning environment, Centura College is committed to making a difference in the lives of our students. Ready to inspire and guide future professionals? Apply today!

Admissions Representative

Location: Centura College | 7020 N Military Hwy, Norfolk, VA 23518
Compensation: Up to $30/hour, based on experience and qualifications
Schedule:

• Monday–Thursday: Two days, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; two days, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM

• Friday: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

• Rotating Saturdays: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, with corresponding time off during the week

Build Your Career While Helping Students Build Theirs

Are you a motivated, goal-oriented professional who enjoys connecting with people and making a meaningful impact? Centura College is seeking an enthusiastic Admissions Representative to help prospective students explore educational opportunities and take the next step toward their career goals.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a background in sales, admissions, or customer service who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. You'll build relationships, guide prospective students through the enrollment process, and contribute directly to the success of our campus.

Key Responsibilities

• Engage with prospective students through high-volume inbound and outbound calls, emails, and in-person or virtual meetings.

• Conduct admissions interviews to understand students' career goals, interests, and educational needs.

• Guide prospective students through the admissions and enrollment process, including applications, required documentation, and next steps.

• Achieve established performance goals related to outreach activity, appointment setting, conversion rates, and student enrollment.

• Maintain consistent follow-up with prospective students to answer questions, address concerns, and support enrollment decisions.

• Accurately document student interactions, application progress, and enrollment activity in the CRM or student management system.

• Collaborate with campus leadership and other departments to provide a positive prospective student experience.

• Represent Centura College professionally at campus events, open houses, and community outreach activities.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a motivated professional who enjoys working with people, takes ownership of results, and brings enthusiasm and accountability to their work.

• Results-driven: Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales, admissions, or customer service performance goals.

• Strong communicator: Confident engaging with prospective students, building rapport, and conducting meaningful conversations by phone and in person.

• Self-motivated: Takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and maintains consistent productivity.

• Student-focused: Genuinely interested in helping individuals explore educational opportunities and make informed decisions.

• Organized and adaptable: Effectively manages competing priorities, maintains accurate records, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

• Team-oriented: Brings a positive attitude, collaborates effectively, and contributes to a supportive campus culture.

Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED required; associate degree or higher preferred.

• Previous experience in sales, admissions, customer service, or a related field with demonstrated success meeting performance goals.

• One or more years of admissions experience in a postsecondary educational environment preferred.

• Strong verbal and written communication, relationship-building, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage a high volume of outreach activity while maintaining attention to detail.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn CRM and student information systems.

• Ability to work the established schedule, including rotating Saturdays.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of our full-time employees, including:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance available on the first day of employment

• 401(k) with company match

• Life insurance options

• Paid parental leave

• Paid time off (PTO)

Join Our Team

At Centura College, our mission is to help students develop the skills and confidence to pursue rewarding careers. As an Admissions Representative, you'll play an important role in connecting students with educational opportunities that can make a lasting difference in their lives.

Apply today and help students take the first step toward their future.

jobs.title: Staff Data Systems Architect
jobs.description:
At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat. We provide tools, resources and support to enable users to reach their health goals.

We are looking for a Staff Data Systems Architect to join the MyFitnessPal Data Engineering team. Our users rely on MyFitnessPal to power their health and fitness journeys every day. As a member of our MyFitnessPal Engineering team, you’ll have the opportunity to positively impact those users with your expertise in the backend systems that drive the MyFitnessPal ecosystem. In addition to technical expertise, you’ll find that your teammates value collaboration, mentorship, and inclusive environments.

About the team:

MyFitnessPal encourages innovation and adoption of the latest technologies available to deliver an amazing experience for our members. Our diverse team of brilliant technologists builds and maintains native mobile applications, a web application, the world’s largest nutrition database, constantly evolving data science and AI/ML assets, the backend infrastructure and data platform required to support these applications and databases, as well as the business systems and data required to manage an awesome company. Technologies and languages we work with include: Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, Git Hub, PlanetScale, Elasticsearch, Scala, Python, SQL, Amplitude, Appsflyer, Kubernetes, Kafka, Docker, Okta and Claude Code. We care more about your general engineering skills and technical leadership than your knowledge of a specific language and or framework.

What you'll be doing:

• Own the end-to-end systems design of the MyFitnessPal product data stack

• Develop, drive, and maintain the systems architecture roadmap for the product data stack

• Serve as the primary point of contact in Data Platform for the consolidated data stack, coordinating contributions from Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Product Analytics, and backend engineering teams

• Define and enforce data movement and standardization discipline across the stack

• Lead architecture review of new tool decisions, vetting vendors against the existing stack, surfacing duplication, and collaborating on proof-of-value evaluations

• Contribute to the compliance architecture for user data, including PII tagging and a deletion/DSR policy by which every tool receiving user data is governed

• Administer access and licensing across the data stack, maintaining a single view of spend and access

• Document and evangelize architecture decisions, standards, and ownership models across the organization

Qualifications to be successful in this role:

• 8 - 12+ years in systems design, architecture, or engineering roles, including 3 - 5 years designing end-to-end data platform architecture at the architect / staff level

• Experience architecting the integrations of a modern customer data stack — product analytics, experimentation, attribution, and marketing activation tools (e.g. Amplitude, Eppo, Harness, AppsFlyer, Braze)

• Experience in Snowflake or similar cloud data platform, including performance tuning, cost optimization, and role-based access design

• Experience leading vendor evaluations, tool consolidations, or platform migrations

• Experience implementing data governance, security, and compliance frameworks, including PII handling and deletion/DSR workflows across multiple destinations

• Demonstrated experience defining architecture standards adopted across a team or organization, and enforcing them through automation rather than manual review

• Cost-conscious ownership of infrastructure and vendor spend, balancing performance and reliability against cost

• Proven ability to drive architecture decisions across teams and organizations

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience deploying semantic layer and metrics layer best practices via dbt or similar tooling

• Experience with data cataloging/governance tools (e.g. Secoda, Snowflake Horizon) and metadata stewardship programs

• Experience in high velocity experimentation organizations, including exposure/assignment pipelines and experiment metric governance

• Advanced SQL knowledge and experience

• Experience working in consumer-facing subscription app environments, with an understanding of acquisition, retention, and engagement metrics

• Experience making governed data safely available to AI assistants and agents — AI-ready data models, agent context, and guardrailed access patterns

Values you’ll model

• Be Kind and Care — build with empathy; assume positive intent; support teammates and members.

• Live Good Health — champion healthy habits and balance in how we work and what we ship.

• Be Data-Inspired — ground decisions in research and data; measure what matters.

• Champion Change — lean into ambiguity; iterate, learn, and improve continuously.

• Leave it Better than You Found It — raise quality, clarify systems, and document as you go.

• Make It Happen — bias to action; deliver impact with craft and accountability.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at MyFitnessPal ranges from $160,000 - $220,000. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, MyFitnessPal offers a wide range of comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, parental planning, mental health benefits, annual performance bonus, a 401(k) plan and match, responsible time off, monthly wellness and technology allowances, and others.

Exciting Full-Time Employee Benefits, Perks and Culture

Face-to-Face Connections: We value personal connections. Enjoy opportunities to meet and connect with your team members in person to help forge meaningful relationships that extend beyond the virtual realm. Teams meet as often as needed and all of MyFitnessPal gathers annually.

Enjoy our paid maternity and paternity leave, to provide time to balance family responsibilities with your career and take the time needed to strengthen family relationships.  We understand the complexities of starting or expanding a family, which is why we provide best-in-class comprehensive assistance for fertility-related matters.

Wellness Comes First: Live Good Health is one of our core values. Receive a monthly Wellness Allowance, empowering you to focus on your physical and mental well-being by choosing from a range of wellness initiatives, including dedicated mental health days.

Celebrate Greatness: Your hard work deserves recognition! Our reward and recognition platform empowers peers to acknowledge and reward each other for the exceptional contributions they make.

Elevate Your Health & Fitness: Get access to MyFitnessPal Premium, allowing you to take your fitness, health and wellness journey to new heights.

Unlock Your Potential: Access our virtual learning and development library, and participate in training opportunities  to continuously grow and enhance your skills.

Championing Inclusion: Our dedicated DEI Committee actively fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace by setting actionable goals and evaluating progress across the organization.

Healthcare Matters: Your well-being is our priority. Take advantage of our competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits that cater to your holistic healthcare needs. Feel secure and supported on your wellness journey.

Secure Your Future: Benefit from our retirement savings program, giving you peace of mind for your financial goals. Reach them sooner with MyFitnessPal’s competitive employer match.

At MyFitnessPal, our mission is to enable people to make healthy choices. And it wouldn't be possible without our team. We celebrate the unique POV that each person brings to the table and believe in a collaborative and inclusive environment. jobs.title: Logistics Specialist
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About the Role

We are seeking an organized, proactive and detail oriented shipping, receiving and inventory logistics specialists that will be a core operations employee serving an office that is dedicated to developing cutting edge hardware and software technologies.

Unlike traditional distribution centers, our facility handles high-mix, custom designed components, expensive test equipment, sensitive electronic components, and custom engineering prototypes. You will ensure fast intake, accurate cataloging, rapid internal delivery, and flawless logistics tracking to keep all stakeholders aware of goods movements.

Duties include preparing both outgoing and incoming shipments of parts, materials and supplies. The Logistics Specialist must make arrangements for all inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring that outbound goods are properly packaged, and must track all shipments on a regular basis so that internal stakeholders maintain accurate expectations for deliveries. Prepares all required shipping documents and optimizes cost/quality/delivery through utilization of the best carriers. The Logistics Specialist confirms physical shipments are matching shipping documents including bills of lading, commercial invoices, purchase orders and other documents.

About the Work

• Manages the outbound and inbound of all products, materials, and supplies, including inventory and expensed materials

• Inspect & Process Inbound Shipments: Receive, unpack, and inspect incoming daily freight and parcel shipments (FedEx, UPS, DHL, freight carriers) for damage and order accuracy.

• Fast-Track Delivery to Labs: Ensure components, raw materials, PCB assemblies, and custom parts are logged into our system and delivered directly to specific engineering labs or individual engineers in a timely manner.

• Capital Equipment Intake: Properly record and tag incoming high-value lab equipment, tooling, and test rigs for asset management.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Quality Engineer - Flight Test
jobs.description:
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.

Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.

About the Role:

We are seeking a high-ownership Sr. Product Quality Engineer - Flight Test to join our Quality Engineering team on-site at our Salinas flight test operations center. In this role, you will be a key quality engineering contributor on the flight line, executing quality controls and ensuring our developmental aircraft, integrated systems, and flight hardware meet safety, operational, and regulatory airworthiness standards.

You will work hands-on alongside flight test crews, assembly engineers, and technicians to develop digital inspection plans, process non-conformances (MRB), perform root-cause investigations, and support FAA conformity inspections. This role requires an agile, technical engineer who thrives in high-ambiguity, fast-paced prototype environments where hardware and flight test operations evolve rapidly.

What You’ll Do:

• Flight Line Quality Execution: Serve as an embedded quality contributor for flight test operations, inspecting and dispositioning airframe components, avionics, wire harnesses, and integrated systems in a hanger/flight line setting.

• FAA & Conformity Support: Assist with hardware, documentation, and tooling preparation for company and FAA conformity inspections, performing AS19102 First Article Inspections (FAIs) and regulatory verification checks.

• Non-Conformance & MRB Disposition: Conduct Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions and apply Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA/CAPA) techniques to resolve technical defects on flight hardware.

• Inspection Planning: Develop and maintain electronic inspection plans within MES to ensure consistent verification across flight line operations and maintenance activities.

• Dimensional Verification: Apply ASME Y14.5 GD&T principles to review 2D drawings and 3D Model-Based Definitions (MBD), using metrology tools (FARO arms, surface plates, optical trackers) to verify physical hardware.

• Cross-Functional Bridge: Partner closely with Design, Aircraft Integration, and Test Operations to feed flight line learnings back into manufacturing and engineering design loops.

What You Need:

• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent technical experience) with 5+ years of hands-on quality or manufacturing engineering experience in aerospace or flight test environments.

• Flight Line Operational Depth: Direct, hands-on experience supporting active flight lines, flight test centers, or aircraft hanger operations.

• GD&T & Metrology Fundamentals: Applied working knowledge of ASME Y14.5 Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and experience verifying complex physical assemblies against engineering models.

• Conformity & Quality Assurance: Proven experience with AS19102 First Article Inspections (FAI), MRB dispositioning, and FAA conformity inspection processes.

• Digital Ecosystems: Experience navigating PLM, MES, and ERP platforms (e.g., Teamcenter, SAP) to execute inspection plans and disposition non-conformances.

• Startup/Prototype Mindset: Demonstrated ability to work independently, solve complex technical problems with minimal guidance, and drive processes to completion in evolving, early-stage engineering programs.

Bonus Qualifications:

• FAA Certifications: Valid FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) license or exposure/credentials as an FAA Designee (DMAR, DAR, or DER).

• Domain Expertise: Experience with composite structural assembly, high-voltage battery systems, or complex aircraft wire harness integration.

• Advanced Quality Tools: Hands-on experience with APQP methodologies (AS9145), PFMEAs, Control Plans, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

• Industry Standards: Familiarity with AS9100, AS9102, AS9103, and AS6500 standards.

• Certifications: ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.

• Industry Background: Exposure to electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL), urban air mobility (UAM), or prototype aircraft development programs.

Please note that this job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and does not include an exhaustive list of responsibilities and qualifications.

At Archer we aim to attract, retain, and motivate talent that possess the skills and leadership necessary to grow our business. jobs.title: Security Advocate
jobs.description:
About Nightfall:

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem - former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others.

About the role:

A hands-on security research role with a public voice: the DevRel function for security operations and data security.

AI models and agents give software new ways to access and move company data. We want someone who will test what that makes possible, find where data actually leaks, and show security teams what they found.

You might be a detection engineer, incident responder or insider-risk engineer who enjoys explaining your work. Or a security advocate, researcher or SE who wants more time to build. At Nightfall, you'll own technical investigations end to end and become a trusted public voice for the company with SOC, IR and data security practitioners.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run "The Model Did What?" investigations. Test new models, agents and AI tools against realistic enterprise workflows. Find concrete data exposures, build working reproductions, and show where security controls hold or fail.

 - Explain it on camera and in writing. Open your laptop and walk through what happened. Turn findings into technical videos, blog posts and demos that SOC and data security teams want to watch and share, working with our content team.

 - Build open-source tools. Ship detections, scanners, labs and utilities that practitioners actually use. Document them, respond to issues, and maintain them after launch.

 - Speak and teach. Give talks at security and engineering conferences (BSides, Black Hat, DEF CON villages and similar). Run hands-on workshops where participants reproduce the problem and test a defense themselves.

 - Build the community. Host or join podcasts, livestreams and practitioner communities. Bring what you hear from security teams back to product and marketing.

 - Equip our sales engineers. Create realistic, resettable demo environments with synthetic data, plus the scenarios and documentation SEs need to run them on their own.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, incident response, insider risk/DLP, security research or sales engineering.

 - An established public voice in security: talks, a podcast, research write-ups, open-source projects or a following practitioners trust.

 - You can code, work with APIs and debug across unfamiliar systems.

 - You understand how enterprise data moves across SaaS, endpoints and AI tools, and how security controls like DLP, CASB, SIEM and EDR work.

 - You can explain a technical finding clearly and defend it under questioning.

 - You enjoy talking with security practitioners and engineers, on camera and in person.

 - You follow through on the software and content you publish.

Nice to have: experience as a security advocate, evangelist or DevRel at a security vendor; hands-on work with LLMs, AI agents or MCP; SOC or data security operations experience.

Public work can be a small tool, a strong write-up or a clear demo. We care about the quality of your thinking and what you built, not the title you held.




Environment

Nightfall AI takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.



Compensation

Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits & perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter.

jobs.title: General Manager, Reconditioning - Fairburn
jobs.description:

To make sure our car’s are in first-rate condition,  we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

About the team and position

The Inspection Center General Manager is responsible for the overall performance of the center. Providing leadership for up to 500 associates working multiple shifts in a lean manufacturing environment. Maintaining a culture of continuous improvement and high associate engagement while ensuring the facility meets quality, production, and cost objectives.

What you’ll be doing

Leadership 30%

• Leads strategic planning to ensure the facility will have the capability to meet future demands.

People Management 30%

Continuous Improvement 10%

• Proven track record of leading and developing associates

• Proven ability to obtain project deliverables and company metrics

• Ability to work a flexible work schedule

• Excellent communications skills, oral and written

What we’ll offer in return
