Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

What success looks like:

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

• Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.

• Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.

• Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.

• Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.

• Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.

• Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.

• Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.

• Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.

• Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.

• Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.

• See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

What you will bring:

• 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.

• Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.

• A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.

• You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.

• You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.

• You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.

• You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.

• Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.

• You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.

• You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.

• You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: HPC Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

The journey to space starts with the engines.

Ursa Major is bringing a new model to propulsion and defense technology: one where performance and access are no longer constrained by legacy systems. We design, build, and deploy advanced propulsion systems that power national security missions, hypersonic capabilities, and the future of space access.

Our mission requires an extraordinary team; one that will mold tomorrow’s critical technologies while deploying today’s best. We are an intrinsically motivated team with a passion for solving complex technical problems and empowering each other every day, knowing that there is always room for growth.

About The Role

As a critical member of our Digital Operations team reporting to the IT Manager, the HPC Systems Engineer holds a dual mandate: driving the continuous expansion of our High-Performance Computing (HPC) simulation clusters while serving as IT’s core Enterprise Linux Subject Matter Expert.

By taking ownership of our HPC infrastructure, you will directly liberate engineering bandwidth and accelerate propulsion design cycles enabling our solids, liquids, thermal, and structural analysis teams to run complex CFD/FEA workloads faster and at greater scale. Simultaneously, you will partner with IT, DevOps, and Zero-Trust Networking to architect, automate, and harden our enterprise Linux servers across our Colorado and Ohio facilities.

Responsibilities:

• Design, deploy, expand, and optimize Linux-based HPC clusters, storage systems, and compute nodes supporting mission-critical propulsion analysis.

• Administer job schedulers and resource managers (e.g., Slurm, PBS) to ensure fair-share scheduling, efficient queue utilization, and minimal job latency for engineering users.

• Partner directly with solids, liquids, thermal, and CFD analysis engineers to integrate, benchmark, and optimize commercial and open-source simulation suites (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus) and GPU-accelerated workloads (NVIDIA CUDA).

• Manage high-throughput storage solutions (e.g., BeeGFS, NVMe-oF, NFS) and high-speed network fabrics (InfiniBand / 100GbE) to eliminate data bottlenecks during large-scale parallel processing.

• Act as the primary systems engineer and Level 2/3 escalation point for enterprise Linux systems, hypervisors, and core IT infrastructure.

• Automate system provisioning, configuration management, patching, and user onboarding using Ansible, Python, Bash, Terraform, and automated kickstart routines.

• Integrate Linux servers and HPC head nodes with enterprise identity platforms (Entra ID, SSSD) for centralized authentication and role-based access control (RBAC).

• Implement and maintain system hardening, access controls, patching, and vulnerability management aligned with NIST SP 800-171, CMMC Level 2, and ITAR/CUI data protection requirements.

• Deploy metrics, alerting, and telemetry frameworks (e.g., PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana) to proactively monitor node health, cluster temperature, memory usage, and hardware failures.

• Maintain clean architectural diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and system security plans (SSPs) for all Linux and HPC environments.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 5+ years of dedicated experience in Linux systems engineering and infrastructure administration.

• Hands-on mastery of enterprise Linux distributions (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu Server) including kernel tuning, storage management (LVM, ZFS), and network configuration.

• Demonstrated experience building, managing, or scaling HPC clusters, job schedulers (Slurm, PBS), and distributed MPI/GPU environments.

• Strong proficiency in Python, Bash, and Ansible or Terraform for infrastructure automation.

• Practical understanding of system hardening, vulnerability patching, and security controls in CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, DoD, or similar regulated compliance frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity supporting engineering simulation platforms (ANSYS Fluent/Mechanical, Siemens STAR-CCM+, Abaqus, or MATLAB).

• Experience configuring InfiniBand/RoCE fabrics, high-performance parallel file systems, and NVIDIA GPU clusters.

• Experience with enterprise hypervisor clusters (e.g. VMware vSphere).

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance.

Compensation, Location & Classification

• Primary Location: Hybrid (Longmont, CO office)

• On-Site Presence: Periodic support at our Berthoud, CO facility and data center colocation in the Denver Tech Center (DTC).

• Remote Support: Ongoing support for Ohio facilities.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $108,000 - $135,000, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

• Unlimited PTO - Vacation, Sick, Personal, and Bereavement

• Paid Parental and Adoptive Leave

• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)

• Employer Paid Short and Long Term Disability, Basic Life, AD&D

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Engineering Manager for Data Engineering, you will lead and grow the team responsible for the data foundations that support Virta’s business, care delivery, and AI capabilities. You will take over an established team with deep technical and business knowledge and help shape its next stage of growth. The team is composed of both Data Engineers (platform) and Analytics Engineers (models). You will be accountable for reliable pipelines, platform tooling, and engineering standards, as well as reusable analytical models, semantic definitions, and the Looker experiences that help people make decisions. Both disciplines are core to the role, with distinct skills and career paths to develop.

Your initial priorities will be completing our data and analytics modernization, expanding self-service, and enabling agents and ML to use trusted data. Our stack includes BigQuery, dbt Cloud, and Looker/LookML. You will work directly with stakeholders to understand their needs, set priorities, and measure adoption. Strong engineers will be your partners in delivery; you should be comfortable getting into the technical details when decisions or problems require it.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Lead and grow both engineering disciplines. Coach data engineers and analytics engineers, set clear expectations, and support their technical and career growth. Assess the team’s needs and use additional planned hires to build the right mix of capabilities.

 - Complete the data and analytics migration. Lead the remaining BigQuery medallion architecture and Looker Core rollout, including validation, stakeholder onboarding, and retirement of legacy paths. Preserve confidence in business metrics throughout the transition.

 - Own discovery, priorities, and delivery. Build relationships with Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Commercial, and Clinical partners. Translate their needs into a focused roadmap, resolve competing priorities, and balance planned work with operational support.

 - Expand self-service. Build reusable ingestion and transformation patterns, tooling, documentation, and standards that help engineering and analytics teams produce and use trustworthy data with less central coordination.

 - Own analytics engineering quality. Guide the development of reusable dbt models, shared semantic definitions, and LookML. Partner with domain experts to establish consistent business meaning and create datasets that serve multiple use cases.

 - Advance data capabilities for agents and ML. Build and operate data agents, and provide governed datasets, semantic context, and tools for agents built by other teams. Partner with Applied AI and MLOps on the data access, quality, and interfaces needed for their ML workflows.

 - Improve reliability and governance. Establish clear ownership, testing, freshness expectations, actionable alerts, and incident practices. Partner with Security and Infrastructure on access controls, PHI/PII protection, lineage, and cost management.

 - Improve how the team works. Apply AI-assisted development and automation where they reduce toil and improve delivery, with validation that protects data correctness. Use adoption, migration progress, reliability, and stakeholder feedback to assess impact.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience, including direct leadership of both data engineering and analytics engineering work. Deep expertise in one discipline is sufficient if you have successfully led and developed engineers in the other.

 - Strong technical judgment across data pipelines, cloud warehouses, SQL and data modeling, transformation frameworks, orchestration, and BI or semantic layers. You can review designs and code, investigate difficult problems, and make sound tradeoffs with experienced engineers.

 - Experience leading a significant data platform or analytics migration, including data validation, stakeholder adoption, and operational continuity.

 - Experience owning stakeholder discovery and roadmap prioritization without relying on a dedicated product manager. You can understand a business problem, challenge assumptions, and turn competing requests into an achievable plan.

 - A track record of building reusable capabilities and helping other teams adopt them. You can balance shared standards with the needs of different business domains.

 - Experience hiring, coaching, and managing performance across different engineering skill sets, and building collaborative teams in a remote or asynchronous environment.

 - Clear communication with technical and business audiences, with experience connecting team priorities to company outcomes and using evidence to guide decisions.




BONUS POINTS FOR…

 - Experience with BigQuery, dbt Cloud, Looker/LookML, GCP, Python, Go, or infrastructure as code.

 - Experience building data agents, governed natural-language analytics, semantic layers for AI, or data capabilities that support production ML systems.

 - Experience introducing AI-assisted development workflows with effective testing and review practices.

 - Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, including sensitive-data governance and access controls.




90 DAY PLAN

An example of what your first 90 days at Virta could include is:

 - By Day 45: Build relationships with the team and its stakeholders, understand the migration and operational workload, and establish individual growth goals. Assess capability gaps across both disciplines and define profiles for additional hires.

 - By Day 60: Align stakeholders on the next migration milestones and the highest-value self-service and agent/ML opportunities. Establish success measures, clarify ownership with Applied AI and MLOps, and begin delivery on a prioritized improvement.

 - By Day 90: Deliver a meaningful migration milestone or self-service improvement with measurable user adoption. Align the next two quarters of work in the team’s Now/Next/Later roadmap, with a clear path for data agents and ML enablement, and advance hiring against the agreed team needs.




VALUES-DRIVEN CULTURE

Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if:

 - You put people first and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally

 - You have a strong sense of ownership and take initiative while empowering others to do the same

 - You prioritize positive impact over busy work

 - You have no ego and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience

 - You appreciate transparency and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information

 - You are evidence-based and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma

 - You take risks and rapidly iterate

jobs.title: Video Editor, Regulated Industry (Full-Time Contract, Remote)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Pearmill is a performance marketing agency. We plan, produce, and run paid ads for brands across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other channels, and our creative team produces the video and static assets that run in those accounts.

We are a fully remote team across the US and Europe, and we use AI tools throughout our production work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a video editor to work as a full-time contractor with one client in a regulated industry, across their paid ads and organic social. Every asset for this client carries required disclosure copy that must match the approved version exactly.

Most of the work is precision work: cutting and versioning footage that already exists, and making sure everything that appears on screen is approved. We are looking for someone analytical who can QA their own work and build QA systems and templates that keep every version accurate at volume.




PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Produce multiple variations of each concept, where volume can be high.

 - Resize every paid video into all required formats (currently five) and adjust framing for each one.

 - Build organic social videos (Reels and video Stories) from approved templates.

 - Add and update on-screen elements, including required disclosure copy, across every version.

 - Work from briefs and plan priorities each week with the creative lead.

 - Amend assets based on internal and client feedback until they are fully approved.

 - Maintain a consistently high level of quality on every delivery.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of professional video editing and motion experience, with a portfolio or reel.

 - Expert in After Effects, comfortable in Premiere Pro, and able to use AI tools in your workflow.

 - Exceptional attention to detail. You can visually QA every text element on screen, and this is the most important skill for this role.

 - The ability to keep track of many near-identical versions, which often differ by only a few lines of text, without mixing them up.

 - Clear, proactive communication with the team. There are many revision rounds, and raising questions or mistakes early is part of the job.

 - Project files built to our team standards (clear folder structure, descriptive names for files, compositions and layers, live text layers, no unused footage or third-party plugins), so other editors can open them and pick up when needed.

 - Fluent English, written and spoken, and comfortable on video calls.

 - Based in Europe, Latin America, or Canada with working hours that overlap US East Coast business hours.

 - Consistently meets deadlines, including during high-volume periods.


STRONGLY PREFERRED BUT NOT REQUIRED

 - Experience editing ads in a regulated industry, including how required disclosures are presented on screen.

 - Experience working through legal and regulatory review rounds.

 - Experience building reusable templates: social graphics, After Effects motion graphics templates, or Premiere Pro templates.


HOW WE WORK

 - Day to day you work with the producer on this account and with our creative lead. One of our motion designers onboards you and stays involved for reviews.

 - Batches usually have 2 to 3 days of turnaround, and some client changes come in on the same day.

 - Briefs, approved copy, and feedback come in through Notion and Slack. Files live in Dropbox with a set naming convention.

 - You join our weekly creative call, plus short check-ins when volume spikes.

 - Every delivery gets checked against the approved copy before it goes to the client. You own the first check.

 - We share workflows and AI experiments openly on the team, and we'd love it if you bring ideas that make this faster or safer.




HOW TO APPLY

 1. Share your portfolio or reel through the application form. Please include regulated or versioning-heavy work, even if it is not your most visually striking work.

 2. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test.


FLOURISHING AT PEARMILL

We get an unreasonable amount of satisfaction out of making the things around us better at their jobs. Clients who arrived wanting a channel fixed and left with a system. People who joined to run ad accounts and left able to build a team that runs global strategy. And most recently, our little AI agents running around our Notion docs and giving us super powers.

We're a fast growing, diverse group of goofy yet dedicated marketers, creatives, engineers, and analysts, running over $500M in ad spend across 15+ platforms. Join us!

jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Administrator (Azure Windows Admin)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS Industries is looking for a Senior IT Systems Administrator to design, build, secure, and operate the Windows and Azure cloud infrastructure our teams rely on every day. You will keep servers, identity services, and cloud workloads healthy, patched, and compliant in a defense environment where uptime and data protection are both non-negotiable. As a senior member of the IT organization, you will act as a technical lead for systems engineering: setting standards, owning the hardest problems, and mentoring teammates, while partnering with cybersecurity, service desk, engineering, and program teams.

• Team mandate: keep the core platforms running reliably, securely, and predictably, and automate the repetitive work so the team can spend its time on improvements. You will be the escalation point for complex systems issues and a trusted advisor on infrastructure decisions.

• Ownership: technical ownership of the Windows Server and Azure environments, including architecture, patching, monitoring, backup and recovery, and hardening, plus leadership of infrastructure projects such as server and cloud migrations, new site standups, and environment consolidations as the company grows.

Responsibilities:

• Architect, administer, and maintain Windows Server environments (physical and virtual), including provisioning, configuration, patching, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

• Design, deploy, and manage Azure cloud resources, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity, and monitoring, in commercial and government cloud environments, using templates and infrastructure as code.

• Administer and improve Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and certificate services, including identity lifecycle, privileged access, MFA, and conditional access policies.

• Serve as technical lead and final escalation point for complex incidents; perform root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.

• Mentor and coach junior systems administrators and service desk staff, and set technical standards, best practices, and peer review for the team.

• Lead infrastructure projects from planning through delivery, including site buildouts, server and cloud migrations, and the integration of newly acquired environments.

• Design and maintain automation with PowerShell and other scripting tools to streamline provisioning, patching, reporting, and routine administration.

• Own backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity design, including regular restore testing and recovery objectives.

• Apply and maintain security baselines (such as DISA STIG and CIS benchmarks), remediate vulnerabilities, and partner with cybersecurity to close findings.

• Support compliance requirements (such as CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and FedRAMP) by maintaining configuration documentation, logs, and access reviews, and providing evidence for audits.

• Review technical designs and changes, follow the change control process, and communicate maintenance windows and impacts to stakeholders.

• Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies, and contribute to the infrastructure roadmap, capacity planning, and budget inputs.

• Support Microsoft 365 and endpoint management services, including device compliance and configuration policies, in partnership with the service desk.

• Create and maintain system documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams.

• Participate in an on-call rotation and occasional after-hours maintenance windows for critical systems.

• Travel: minimal, up to roughly 10% (occasional trips to company offices and new sites).

• Physical demands: primarily sedentary work at a computer; occasional lifting of equipment up to 25 lbs and work in server or network rooms.

Minimum Requirements:

• Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or another related field or equivalent work experience

• 7+ years of progressive experience administering enterprise Windows Server and Microsoft Azure environments.

• Deep expertise with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP, and with Microsoft Entra ID identity and access management, including MFA and conditional access.

• Experience designing and implementing Azure solutions, including virtual machines, virtual networking, storage, role-based access control, and hybrid connectivity.

• Advanced PowerShell scripting to automate administration, patching, and reporting at scale.

• Experience owning patch management, monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery, including testing restores and meeting recovery objectives.

• Experience hardening systems and remediating vulnerabilities in a regulated environment (such as NIST SP 800-171 or CMMC).

• Track record of leading infrastructure projects and mentoring other engineers, with strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

• U.S. person status, as required for access to CUI and export-controlled data (ITAR/EAR).

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience with Azure Government or Microsoft GCC High environments, and with other cloud platforms such as AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM) in multi-cloud or hybrid environments.

• Experience with Okta for single sign-on, MFA, and identity lifecycle management, including integrating Okta with Entra ID and cloud applications.

• Cloud or Microsoft certification such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or AWS Solutions Architect; security certification such as Security+ or CISSP.

• Experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management (Bicep, Terraform, ARM templates, or Ansible) across cloud platforms.

• Experience supporting CMMC, NIST 800-171, or FedRAMP assessments, and an active U.S. government security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $140,000 - $200,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. Our products and technologies require an extraordinary team—one that will ensure the security of tomorrow’s technologies while deploying today’s best. We are an intrinsically motivated team with a passion for solving problems and empowering each other every day.

About the Role:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Level 3 w/ Clearance) within our Digital Operations team, you won’t just be monitoring alerts or checking compliance boxes. You will be a hands-on technical problem solver and trusted advisor who bridges the gap between commercial enterprise operations and cleared defense program execution—helping our hardware, software, and manufacturing engineers navigate complex security environments without slowing down the pace of innovation.

Reporting up through Digital Operations, you will sit at the intersection of DevOps, Digital Manufacturing, Software Engineering, Zero-Trust Networking, and IT. As Ursa Major scales from 380 to 500+ employees and doubles our cleared cybersecurity bench, you will play a central role in both evolving our CMMC Level 2 posture and maintaining hands-on security engineering across classified spaces, secure labs, and air-gapped networks

Responsibilities:

• Stakeholder Enablement & Creative Risk Mitigation Partner directly with non-cyber employees (program managers, propulsion engineers, test stand operators, cleared defense leads) to understand their workflows and help them safely manage CUI and classified data flows without unnecessary friction. Approach security challenges with nuance rather than black-and-white rules. Design controls around engineering workflows to eliminate latency and operational bottlenecks, ensuring compliance feels like an accelerator rather than a roadblock.

Execute Risk Management Framework (RMF) and JSIG lifecycle tasks—including system hardening using STIGs/SCAP, vulnerability scanning (ACAS/Tenable), eMASS package management, System Security Plan (SSP) authoring, and POA&M remediation. Manage and optimize technical security controls (EDR, SIEM log aggregation, firewalls, identity platforms) across both enterprise and classified network environments.

Partner with physical security, FSO, and ISSM staff to support secure facility operations, media sanitization, DCSA audit readiness, and classified authorization packages. Minimum Qualifications:

• 4+ years of dedicated cybersecurity engineering experience in DoD, cleared defense contractor, or high-rigor regulated environments.

• Current DoD 8570/8140 IAM/IAT Level II or III certification (e.g., Security+, CISSP, CISM, CASP+, or CySA+).

• Demonstrated experience executing STIG hardening, SCAP compliance scanning, vulnerability remediation, and EDR/SIEM administration across air-gapped or classified Windows/Linux environments.

• Proven track record of working constructively with engineering and business stakeholders—focusing on trust-building, communication, and enabling business outcomes rather than simple ticket-taking.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer (Senior) Job #560
jobs.description:
Systems Engineer (Senior)

Clearance Required:  TS/SCI

Springfield, VA

Minimum Years’ Experience:  12 years

Overall Assignment Description:

National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency is modernizing their GEOINT Reporting and Workflow Orchestration to a service architecture requiring support in guiding the architecture and development activities moving forward.  This position is in support of our Analysis Integrated Program Office (IPA) customer, where our team provides engineering services to assist the team in defining the to-be architecture, decomposing capabilities into solution/program epics, documenting and prioritizing the development baseline, integrating new customers and sources as required, and working with the development vendor to achieve the planned baseline.  While we primarily support the IPA leadership team, we also provide services to the various projects dealing with intelligence and geospatial analysis capabilities provided to the intelligence community.  Areas that our team is involved with include: Structured Observation Management Services, Analytic Modernization Services, Exploitation Services, Orchestration Services, Advanced Geospatial Services, as well as requirements, architecture, and integration with a number of sensor-related programs.

Primary Duties include:

• Guides the planning, analysis/traceability of user requirements, architectures traceability, procedures, and problems to automate or improve existing systems and review cloud service capabilities, workflow, and scheduling limitations.

• Assists the Government in the capture and translation of mission and customer requirements/needs into systems/capability requirements and solutions.

• Coordinates between Government Program Manager customer and DevOps teams utilizing Agile methodologies, Scrum and Agile Planning Tools.

• Supports the analyses and allocation of requirements to systems architecture components and executing programs.

• Assists the Government in performing systems integration activities, strategic technical planning, project management, performance engineering, risk management and interface design.

Secondary Duties include:

• Operates at the level of integrating multiple systems, services, processes, and interfaces within a Major Systems Acquisitions across organizational and agency boundaries.

• Guides Mid-level and Junior-level system engineers performing requirements engineering, solutions engineering, scheduling, reliability, resiliency, services development, integration, test and evaluation, maintainability and analysis across the National System of Geospatial-intelligence (NSG), Allied System of Geospatial-intelligence (ASG) and Federal Agencies.

• Conducts Analysis of Alternatives (AoAs), Course of Actions (CoAs), Trade Studies, and Engineering Assessments.

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Systems Engineering or in related technical or scientific fields such as engineering, physics, mathematics, operations research, engineering management, Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or related STEM degree program.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Clarity Innovations is a trusted national security partner, dedicated to safeguarding our nation’s interests and delivering innovative solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

Role

This role is for a  Data Scientist on a close-knit team supporting a U.S. Special Operations Command program at MacDill AFB. This team is at the center of helping the command empower and leverage its data for more effective analysis and decision making. As a subject matter expert, the Data Scientist will leverage their experience to gather and derive insights from complex data, assist the command with development initiatives, and facilitate digital transformation efforts. The work done in this role has a direct impact on mission readiness as the team's efforts go toward making a more resilient and data-driven organization.

Responsibilities

A data scientist will have skills sets of both data analysts and data engineers. Data scientists are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a data pipeline.  In addition, data scientists shall interpret and analyze complex sets of data, as well as plan, execute, and manage ML projects with cloud-native platforms and advanced ML solutions. They understand some of the most challenging processes, technologies, and can leverage a vast array of methodologies in the field, such as data mining, natural language programming, and machine learning.
Data scientists must have a combination of skills that includes programming, mathematical modeling, statistics, and domain knowledge. They must combine an advanced math and statistics background with programming, domain knowledge, and communication skills to analyze data, create applied mathematical models, and present results in a form useful to the organization.  They must also be able to understand and manipulate structured and unstructured large data sets, which requires proficiency in distributed SQL programming, relational and non-relational data queries, general programming languages (such as Python and R,) and machine learning techniques.

The Data Scientist shall perform the following tasks:
•    Interpret and analyze data using exploratory mathematic and statistical techniques based on the scientific method.
•    Coordinate research and analytic activities utilizing various data points (unstructured and structured) and employ programming to clean, massage, and organize the data
•    Experiment against data points, provide information based on experiment results and provide previously undiscovered solutions to command data challenges.
•    Coordinate with Data Engineers to build Data environments providing data identified by other data professionals
•    Apply and develop scientific methodology, statistics, and algorithms to discover and frame relevant problems, hypotheses, and opportunities.
•    Develop predictive and prescriptive modeling, natural language processing (NLP), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), text mining and processing, clustering, forecasting methods, and other advanced statistical techniques.
•    Design and automate processes to facilitate the manipulation and analysis of data. Manage and integrate data across dissimilar data sets. Analyze large-scale structured and unstructured data.
•    Use frameworks such as Spark and Hadoop to conduct large-scale data processing. Perform statistical modeling and create data visualizations using products like Tableau, Microsoft Power BI and R Shiny.
•    Research, design, and implement algorithms to solve complex problems. Program using R, Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) or similar analytical languages.
•    Perform data engineering, data processing and modeling techniques using cloud-based data management, data science, and ML platforms such as Databricks, IBM Cloud Pak, Cloudera, and Snowflake.
•    Communicate complex concepts and hypothesis to a non-technical audience through digital storytelling.

Requirements

• A minimum of 1 year of hands-on Data Science experience is required.

• Bachelor's Degree in a STEM field is required.

• Proficient with one or more programming languages (Java, C++, Python, R, etc.)

• Proficient in Agile Development and Git operations

• A Secret Clearance is required

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with DoD

• Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or related fields.

• Experience with Maven Smart System or Palantir Foundry

• Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility

• Logistics experience

Salary Range: $111,700 - $189,900

Pay Range

The posted pay range reflects the national salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the requirements of the position and a variety of job-related factors, which may include geographic location, applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and wage rates, relevant experience, skills and competencies, education, certifications, and the scope and responsibilities of the role.

Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range.

Total Rewards

In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions.

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Systems & Software
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

The journey to space starts with the engines.

Ursa Major is bringing a new model to propulsion and defense technology: one where performance and access are no longer constrained by legacy systems. We design, build, and deploy advanced propulsion systems that power national security missions, hypersonic capabilities, and the future of space access.

Our mission requires an extraordinary team—one that will mold tomorrow’s critical technologies while deploying today’s best. We are an intrinsically motivated team with a passion for solving complex technical problems and empowering each other every day, knowing that there is always room for growth.

About The Role

Reporting directly to the Head of Digital Operations, the Director of Enterprise Systems & Software (ESS) is a strategic executive technology leader responsible for establishing central ownership, governance, and architectural rigor across Ursa Major's entire internal enterprise digital landscape.

This role officially transitions core enterprise system ownership out of legacy, ad-hoc structures (previously managed under Digital Manufacturing) and establishes a dedicated department built on extreme system ownership. You will lead a high-performing team of dedicated Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across core enterprise platforms (PLM, ERP, MES, Data/BI) alongside our internal Software Engineering organization (which builds custom internal web applications, including our engine testing solution and enterprise integration middleware). Day 1 leadership scope includes inheriting an established team (1x Product Owner, 2x Senior Software Developers, and a Manager of Digital Manufacturing transitioning to lead Enterprise Systems Integrations) alongside hiring dedicated Systems Engineers/Architects across PLM (Windchill), ERP (Odoo), MES (Critical Manufacturing), Atlassian, and Data Science/Analytics.

As Ursa Major scales from 380 to 500+ employees and prepares for public-company operations, you will lead the evolution of our ERP (Odoo) into a public-company-ready platform. Over time, your organization will systematically absorb and professionalize adjacent business-critical systems—such as HighQA, Jama, Ignition, and Atlassian—building an integrated digital thread across ISA-95 levels and laying the technical foundation for a fully operational Digital Twin across our manufacturing facilities by EOY 2027.

Responsibilities:

• Establish centralized ownership and serve as the executive authority for all business-critical enterprise platforms, enforcing to internal stakeholders that ESS provides dedicated SME ownership, administration, and support.

• Lead the strategy to systematically absorb, integrate, and govern critical A&D enterprise tools, including HighQA (quality/inspection), Jama (requirements management), Ignition (SCADA/HMI), and Atlassian (collaboration) thereby creating single-point accountability for the software that runs the business.

• Define system boundaries and single-source-of-truth data authority across PLM (Windchill), ERP (Odoo), MES (Critical Manufacturing), and shop-floor SCADA (Ignition) to eliminate data friction, manual rework, and audit risks.

• Establish the strategic technical roadmap and execution plan to connect engineering design, materials planning, shop-floor execution, and engine test data into a fully integrated Digital Twin environment before EOY 2027.

• Assume complete ownership of our ERP ecosystem (Odoo), transitioning it out of legacy Digital Manufacturing management, and architect its core inventory, Work-in-Progress (WIP) tracking, Average Costing mechanics, and financial reporting structures to support public-company standards.

• Direct and mentor a multi-disciplinary department comprising Enterprise Systems Architects (PLM, ERP, MES, Atlassian), Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Owners, and Integration Leads.

• Guide the transition of our Digital Manufacturing Manager into leading a dedicated Enterprise Systems (ES) Integrations team, ensuring robust API middleware and secure data pipelines connect all internal systems.

• Oversee internal software development initiatives, including our custom web-based engine testing platform, internal web portals, and operational tools.

• Serve as the strategic digital partner across our geographic manufacturing footprint—aligning software and systems workflows across our Longmont headquarters, Berthoud (liquids manufacturing), Galeton (solids manufacturing), and Youngstown, OH (additive manufacturing) sites.

• Collaborate with executive leaders across Propulsion Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to unblock operational bottlenecks and align digital tooling with business velocity.

• Partner with Finance to structure enterprise system implementations and internal software projects to qualify for internal-use software capitalization, building balance sheet asset value.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 10+ years of progressive technical leadership experience in enterprise systems architecture, software engineering, or IT/Digital Operations, with at least 4+ years in director-level management roles.

• Deep domain experience within aerospace, defense, automotive, or high-complexity discrete manufacturing environments understanding shop-floor realities across hardware assembly, liquid/solid propulsion, or additive manufacturing.

• Demonstrated experience overseeing enterprise platforms across PLM (PTC Windchill), ERP (Odoo, SAP, NetSuite), MES (Critical Manufacturing, Apriso), and domain-specific tools (HighQA, Jama, Ignition).

• Proven track record taking ownership of fragmented or legacy ERP environments and building scalable financial, costing, and inventory structures capable of supporting public-company audits and reporting.

• Comprehensive understanding of ISA-95 framework levels, manufacturing data flows, and architecting connected enterprise environments (Digital Twin).

• Demonstrated experience leading teams building custom internal web applications, APIs, or middleware integrations.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

About the Role:

We’re a fast-growing health-tech company with more than 1,300 employees, and we’re scaling quickly. As the VP of Operations’ right hand, you’ll keep a high-velocity executive calendar, travel schedule, and set of competing priorities running smoothly. You’ll also serve as our Site Administrator, coordinating the logistics and experience for senior executives and clients who visit our office.

This role suits someone who anticipates needs before they’re voiced, exercises sound judgment with confidential information, and stays calm when priorities shift by the hour.

This role is based at our Robinson Township, PA office and would require being onsite 5 days per week. Some travel might be required.

Key Responsibilities:

Executive Support-

Calendar and priority management

• Manage a complex, high-volume calendar across internal teams, other executives, and external stakeholders

• Prepare the VP for meetings with agendas, briefing materials, and follow-up items

Expenses and budget administration

• Support departmental administrative tasks such as invoice routing, purchase requests, and vendor coordination

• Flag policy exceptions and keep clean records for audit purposes

Events and meetings

• Plan and run leadership offsites, town halls, team meetings, executive reviews, and organization-wide events

• Coordinate agendas, venues, catering, materials, and attendee communications

• Manage the operating rhythm for the VP’s organization, including recurring leadership meetings and planning cycles

Special projects

• Support cross-functional initiatives and organizational communications for a growing operations team

• Assist with onboarding and logistics as the organization scales

Site Administration-

Executive and client visit coordination

• Serve as the primary point of contact for all senior executive, board member, and client visits

• Work with Facilities team to coordinate visit schedules, conference rooms, catering, building access, and visitor registration

• Work with Facilities, Security, IT, and HR to make sure every visit goes smoothly

• Maintain a master calendar of upcoming visits and prepare internal stakeholders in advance

Office operations

• Partner with Facilities on workspace needs, equipment, supplies, and office readiness

• Serve as a go-to resource for on-site questions, escalations, and day-to-day administrative needs

• Contribute to a professional, welcoming office culture

Qualifications:

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, and within ambiguity.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills required.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Ability to navigate cross-functional relationships at all levels of the organization with internal and external partners alike.

What Success Looks Like:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER, SUPPLY CHAIN (LAUNCH SITE)

SpaceX demands a new type of supply chain. We require our suppliers to provide premium quality with rapidly evolving designs at increasingly ambitious volumes. We are actively looking for candidates who possess comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing and quality tools and have an unrelenting motivation to enable suppliers to succeed. This position will be the key focal point for Launch, supporting our Starship, Dragon, and Falcon programs, and requires a combination of proven leadership and technical capabilities.

This is a highly technical position that requires practical experience in process engineering and new product development through stabilized production for the machined components and assemblies used in rockets and rocket engines. The ideal candidate will have a broad understanding of the machining and assembly of metallic components and associated processes, with the desire and capability to take on new challenges in unfamiliar areas to help enable our mission to Mars.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Act as the technical point of contact for assigned parts or systems within flight, non-flight, and launch site and recovery infrastructure, solving emergent challenges at suppliers and mitigating risk to the manifest by addressing high-impact manufacturing and quality challenges

• Lead and coordinate containment activities to mitigate risk to build and launch schedules, and drive ongoing reliability improvements

• Intervene and drive resolution at the supplier for critical path components to ensure zero disruption to the build schedule

• Review issues on assigned parts and solve to the root cause, implementing changes at the supplier, at SpaceX, or both, as appropriate, drive further actions to closure, and re-source to new suppliers where appropriate

• Create and disposition issue tickets where needed, working with engineering counterparts to implement, but not limited to, required re-work, repair, or use as-is disposition

• Become thoroughly familiar with your assigned parts, systems, and the processes that make up the overall assembly, and become the primary point of contact for supply chain-related defects on your parts

• Work with procurement to find exceptional suppliers and vet them appropriately for quality and ability to meet our aggressive takt times

• Conduct design for manufacturing (DFM) reviews to ensure parts are manufacturable at early stages, preferably prior to sourcing

• Own the new product introduction (NPI) process at a supplier for new parts, drawing changes, or when re-sourcing existing parts to a new supplier

• Drive the production part approval process (PPAP) program to ensure stable supply, reduce inspection oversight, and improve overall delivery time

• Demonstrate innovation, technical excellence, attention to detail, self-direction, and courage to push the technical envelope, which is conventionally held in the industry

• Drive for results and customer satisfaction by collaborating with teams, leading projects, and continuously driving improvement in the supply base

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or STEM discipline

• 5+ years of experience with manufacturing and/or inspection of mechanical products in a production environment

PREFERRED SKILLS and EXPERIENCES:

• Master’s degree in engineering

• Experience with machining and ancillary operations such as milling, turning, fabrication, and vendor design-engineered systems such as pumps, valves, and actuators

• Experience with interpreting engineering drawings and models; GD&T

• Working knowledge of supplier quality processes (production part approval process, advanced product quality planning, first article inspection reports, etc.)

• Knowledge of statistical techniques and methods, e.g., design of experiments, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.

• Experience with quality systems (ISO 9000/TS/AS9100/NADCAP) and manufacturing operation systems (MRP/ERP)

• Working knowledge of problem-solving techniques such as 8D or A3

• Proficient in MS Office and Excel applications and report writing

• Proficient in SQL and Power BI

• Experience with sharing information and influencing others across organizational lines, internally and externally

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to travel - up to 60-85% work week travel may be required, including international travel

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones

• This position is based in Cape Canaveral, FL, and requires being on-site - remote work not considered

• Valid driver’s license

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: MRB Analysis Engineer, Fury
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Air Dominance and Strike Aerostructures Engineering Team is responsible for designing and analyzing advanced structural parts for Group 5 air vehicles and missile platforms. Air Dominance and Strike Structures Engineers own the full development lifecycle, from conceptual to detailed design and analysis of primary and secondary structures, ensuring high-performance, resilient, and scalable mechanical systems that meet the demands of complex, contested environments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Serve as the engineering authority dispositioning Material Review Board (MRB) non-conformances for metallic and composite primary and secondary structures on Group 5 air vehicles

• Perform structural substantiation analysis — static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, and buckling — using first-principle hand calculations and finite element methods to support use-as-is, repair, and scrap dispositions

• Write clear, defensible disposition packages that restore airworthiness and meet program certification requirements

• Develop and continuously improve MRB work methods, tools, and standard dispositions to scale the process as production rates increase

• Monitor trends in recurring non-conformances and drive root cause and corrective action (RCCA) efforts with Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and Materials & Processes (M&P)

• Coordinate directly with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Design, and M&P to resolve non-conformances quickly without compromising structural integrity

• Conduct trade studies to evaluate repair versus rework versus scrap decisions, balancing schedule, cost, and performance

• Provide on-the-floor engineering support during builds, including occasional travel to manufacturing and integration sites

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in aerospace structural analysis, with direct experience dispositioning non-conformances (MRB, liaison, or stress engineering)

• Strong understanding of static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, and load path analysis for metallic and composite structures

• Proficiency with finite element analysis tools (NASTRAN or equivalent) and classical hand-calculation methods

• Experience analyzing and substantiating repairs for both metallic and composite aircraft structures

• Excellent written communication skills — able to produce clear, technically rigorous disposition packages under schedule pressure

• Self-driven with strong autonomy and adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Ability to travel up to 50% to vendors, production, and test sites as needed to support hardware builds and troubleshoot issues directly

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior MRB signature/delegated authority on a production aerospace program

• Experience with high-rate or rapidly scaling production environments

• Familiarity with military airworthiness and structural substantiation standards (e.g., MIL-HDBK-5, MIL-STD-1530)

• Experience with composite laminate fastened and bonded structure repair

• CATIA or Siemens NX proficiency

• Hands-on experience in an aircraft manufacturing or depot repair environment

• Broad experience across a range of aircraft or missile programs

US Salary Range

$132,000—$175,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Administrator (Linux Admin)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS Industries is looking for a Senior IT Systems Administrator with deep Linux expertise to design, build, secure, and operate the Linux infrastructure our engineering and program teams depend on. You will keep servers, services, and cloud workloads reliable, patched, and compliant in a defense environment where uptime and data protection are both non-negotiable. As a senior member of the IT organization, you will act as a technical lead for Linux systems engineering: setting standards, owning the hardest problems, and mentoring teammates, while partnering with cybersecurity, service desk, engineering, and program teams.

• Team mandate: keep the Linux platforms running reliably, securely, and predictably, and automate everything repeatable so the team can spend its time on improvements. You will be the escalation point for complex systems issues and a trusted advisor on infrastructure decisions.

• Ownership: technical ownership of the Linux server environment, including architecture, configuration management, patching, monitoring, backup and recovery, and hardening, plus leadership of infrastructure projects such as platform migrations, new site standups, and environment consolidations as the company grows.

Responsibilities:

• Architect, administer, and maintain Linux server environments (physical, virtual, and cloud), including provisioning, configuration, patching, monitoring, and lifecycle management across Red Hat-family and Debian-family distributions.

• Design and maintain automation and configuration management using Ansible, shell, and Python to standardize builds, enforce configuration, and streamline patching, reporting, and routine administration.

• Build and maintain hardened, standardized server images and templates aligned to security baselines such as DISA STIG and CIS benchmarks, including SELinux, auditd, and FIPS-validated cryptography where required.

• Manage Linux storage and networking, including LVM, file systems, NFS, DNS, firewalls, and system tuning for performance and capacity.

• Integrate Linux systems with enterprise identity services (Active Directory, LDAP, Kerberos, SSSD) and enforce SSH key management, sudo policy, MFA, and privileged access controls.

• Deploy and manage Linux workloads in virtualized and cloud environments, including Azure and AWS virtual machines, and support containerized workloads where applicable.

• Serve as technical lead and final escalation point for complex incidents; perform root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.

• Mentor and coach junior systems administrators and service desk staff, and set technical standards, best practices, and peer review for the team.

• Lead infrastructure projects from planning through delivery, including platform migrations, site buildouts, and the integration of newly acquired environments.

• Own backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity design for Linux systems, including regular restore testing and recovery objectives.

• Monitor system health, logs, and performance with centralized monitoring and logging tools; remediate vulnerabilities in partnership with cybersecurity.

• Support compliance requirements (such as CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and FedRAMP) by maintaining configuration documentation, logs, and access reviews, and providing evidence for audits.

• Review technical designs and changes, follow the change control process, and communicate maintenance windows and impacts to stakeholders.

• Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies, and contribute to the infrastructure roadmap, capacity planning, and budget inputs.

• Create and maintain system documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams.

• Participate in an on-call rotation and occasional after-hours maintenance windows for critical systems.

• Travel: minimal, up to roughly 10% (occasional trips to company offices and new sites).

• Physical demands: primarily sedentary work at a computer; occasional lifting of equipment up to 25 lbs and work in server or network rooms.

Minimum Requirements:

• Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or another related field or equivalent work experience

• 7+ years of progressive experience administering enterprise Linux server environments (such as RHEL, Rocky, CentOS, Ubuntu, or Debian).

• Expert command-line and troubleshooting skills, with deep knowledge of systemd, networking, storage (LVM, file systems, NFS), and performance tuning.

• Strong scripting and automation skills in Bash and Python, and experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible.

• Experience hardening Linux systems and remediating vulnerabilities in a regulated environment, including SELinux, auditd, DISA STIG or CIS baselines, and NIST SP 800-171 or CMMC requirements.

• Experience integrating Linux with enterprise identity (Active Directory, LDAP, Kerberos, SSSD) and managing SSH, sudo, and privileged access.

• Experience owning patch management, monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery, including testing restores and meeting recovery objectives.

• Track record of leading infrastructure projects and mentoring other engineers, with strong documentation and communication skills.

• U.S. person status, as required for access to CUI and export-controlled data (ITAR/EAR).

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience running Linux in Azure, AWS, or Azure Government and Microsoft GCC High environments, including hybrid and multi-cloud designs.

• Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Podman, or Kubernetes) and with virtualization platforms such as KVM or VMware.

• Linux or cloud certification such as RHCSA, RHCE, LFCS, or Azure or AWS Associate-level; security certification such as Security+ or CISSP.

• Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Git-based workflows, or pipelines).

• Experience supporting CMMC, NIST 800-171, or FedRAMP assessments, and an active U.S. government security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $140,000 - $200,000

jobs.title: Cognitive Systems Lead
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.

We are scaling at an historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.

Arsenal-2 is purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation AUVs at scale.

We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California, where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.

In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea—and this is the moment to join us.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own the Cognitive subsystem for a maritime autonomous vehicle, owning navigation and control, the vehicle management system, communications, and protective systems. Reporting to the Vehicle Systems Lead, you will set architecture for how the vehicle navigates, communicates, manages itself, and protects itself across long-range autonomous operations.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

• Drive Vehicle Management System design including route planning and casualty monitoring

• Own communications architecture across BLOS, LOS, and acoustic domains

• Drive design-for-manufacturability in coordination with Production

• Represent the cognitive subsystem in technical and customer meetings

• Interface with Vehicle Systems Lead and Chief Engineer on technical decisions

• Travel up to 25% to test sites and customer locations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent

• 8+ years of experience in GN&C, vehicle autonomy, or embedded systems for marine, aerospace, or robotic platforms

• Experience taking navigation, control, or communications systems through full product development cycles

• Demonstrated experience with navigation systems, control systems, or communications architectures

• Experience transitioning designs from prototype to production

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with autonomous underwater or surface vehicles

• Working knowledge of inertial navigation, GPS-denied navigation, or acoustic communications

• Experience with vehicle management systems or flight management systems

• Familiarity with safety-critical software and system design

• Experience in defense or maritime robotics
