The Patient Flow Coordinator, RN (PFC, RN) reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.  The PFC, RN is a skilled professional nurse with competence in a specialized area of nursing.  Works cooperatively and communicates effectively within a framework to actively promote holistic care for patients.  Demonstrates self-direction and initiative in the role of nurse clinician, educator, and consultant.  Provides direct patient care and/or consultation using in-depth clinical knowledge and skills in area of expertise.  Promotes customer service and communication between the healthcare team and patient.  The Patient Flow Coordinator should work autonomously within the guidelines set by ICC medical leadership and efficiently in a fast-paced environment. The Patient Flow Coordinator role is performed from within designated Northwestern Medicine ICC locations and requires in-clinic orientation.  This position will work 12-hour shifts and include weekend and holiday requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Maintain a safe and clean work environment. Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations. Report deficiencies to supervisor immediately. Assist in rectifying deficiencies as requested. Assume responsibility for and supervision of the appropriate care of medical equipment.
• For each patient, perform a comprehensive assessment of the chief complaint and patient needs utilizing the nursing process. Based on findings, seek solutions and offer opinions to physicians and other health care providers. Document all nursing assessments in the patient's medical record. Ensure that all documentation is clear, complete and legible. Maintain patient confidentiality at all times. Understand and uphold the protocols and procedures for release of patient medical information.
• Demonstrate clinical competency and independently perform routine nursing duties including phlebotomy, medication administration, measurement of vital signs, preparation of lab specimens, etc.
• Interpret and define abnormalities detected in tests and procedures, then take appropriate remedial action. Document all interventions in the patient medical record as appropriate.
• Communicate and collaborate with other clinical and administrative departments in order to coordinate appropriate patient care, as needed.
• Communicate with outside agencies or facilities as appropriate.
• Triage and prioritize incoming telephone calls and results using clinical assessment skills and service standards. Communicate results/plan of care with patients by phone or MyChart per department procedure. Document all assessments in the patient medical record as appropriate.
• Manage urgent/emergent medical situations as appropriate and in accordance with the organization's protocols for medical emergencies and cardiac arrests. Obtain and/or operate emergency equipment according to relevant standards.
• Serve as a resource for staff and physicians for daily problem solving and decision-making. Maintain a consistent alertness to patient care needs and take a proactive approach to address/resolve issues. Delegate appropriate tasks according to Illinois law and organizational protocols.
• Comply with all existing policies and procedures related to patient care. Make recommendations to management regarding new policies and procedures that may improve the patient experience. Assure that new policies and procedures are implemented in a timely manner.
• Initiate and coordinate patient education. Ensure that patients understand educational materials and can exhibit return demonstration when pertinent.
• Serve as a resource and role model for team members by providing feedback and assisting with clinical education.
• Other duties as assigned

BEHAVIORAL EXPECTATIONS

• Ability to function independently and as part of the ICC team
• Excellent at multitasking in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent critical thinking and high tolerance for ambiguity
• Responds effectively to changes in ICC workflow due to volume, use of new technology, staffing, volume control, or closures.

Required:

• BSN
• Current Registered Nurse License issued by State of Illinois
• BLS certification
• Minimum two years of RN experience

Preferred:

• Minimum of three years of emergency department or urgent care setting
• National certification in specialty area such as CEN, TCRN, Ambulatory Care, or others
• Proficient with Epic electronic charting system

jobs.title: Data Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com.

How This Role Makes a Difference

Data Coordinators play an important role in clinical research by helping ensure study data is accurate, complete, and available when needed. As part of a centralized data coordination team, this role helps protect data integrity, and support Care Access’ mission to make clinical trials more accessible to participants everywhere.

Through source data quality control, accurate EDC/CRF transcription, visit-to-entry reconciliation, and proactive query follow-up, Data Coordinators help keep study records reliable and inspection-ready. By catching discrepancies early and helping move issues to resolution, this role contributes to smooth study operations across the Care Access site network.

How You'll Make An Impact

• Site-Level Quality Control: Review source data collected during clinic visits and work with clinical staff to clarify or resolve discrepancies before information is entered into Sponsor EDC/CRF systems. Responsibilities include: Reviewing source records for completeness, internal consistency, and required good documentation practices. Identifying missing data, incomplete fields, missing signatures, or other potential documentation issues. Reviewing source records for consistency with protocol requirements and study workflows. Documenting quality control activities in the approved Care Access system and tracking items through to resolution.

• Data Reconciliation: Reconcile study data against supporting documentation to make sure required source records are available, complete, and aligned with study expectations. Responsibilities include: Confirming availability of required source materials, including lab reports, ECGs, imaging reports, and other visit-related records. Reconciling visit documentation against required study data points and expected source records. Maintaining and reconciling adverse event information, informed consent logs, protocol deviation logs, and other study tracking tools. Identifying missing or inconsistent documentation and tracking items through to completion or resolution.

• EDC/CRF Data Entry: Enter study data into Sponsor EDC/CRF systems accurately and on time, using source documentation and study guidance to support reliable trial records. Responsibilities include: Entering clinical research data in accordance with study requirements, Sponsor expectations, and applicable completion guidelines. Completing data entry within required study timelines and operational expectations. Verifying entered data against applicable source documentation before submission or completion. Applying study-specific EDC/CRF instructions consistently across assigned studies and visits.

• Query Management: Manage EDC queries and monitor follow-up items by reviewing, routing, responding, and escalating items as needed to keep data issues moving toward closure. Responsibilities include: Reviewing EDC queries generated by Sponsors, CROs, monitors, and EDC systems. Resolving queries directly when responses are supported by existing source documentation. Routing queries that require source clarification, clinical interpretation, investigator assessment, or input from additional site team members. Entering approved query responses into the EDC and monitoring open or ageing queries through resolution. Following up with site personnel when additional input is required and escalating unresolved queries in a timely manner. Reviewing monitor follow-up letter items and coordinating with site staff, where required, to support timely resolution. Reporting monitor follow-up items as quality issues in the Care Access QMS, as applicable.

• Study and Site Coordination: Work with study teams and site personnel to keep data workflows organized, address open items, and maintain alignment with protocol and Sponsor expectations. Responsibilities include: Maintaining awareness of assigned study protocols, study-specific requirements, and data entry expectations. Prioritizing workload based on participant visits, Sponsor timelines, monitoring visits, and database milestones. Communicating with CRCs, PIs, and site network leadership regarding outstanding data requirements and documentation needs. Participating in study-specific meetings and trainings, as required, to support successful study execution.

• Other Responsibilities: Support additional data quality, reporting, documentation, and process improvement work as assigned. Maintain study trackers, data logs, dashboards, and other tools used to monitor progress, data completeness, and open action items. Collaborate with cross-functional partners during study start-up, maintenance, monitoring, closeout, and audit or inspection readiness activities, as applicable.

The Expertise Required

• Strong attention to detail and ability to review clinical research documentation for completeness, consistency, and data quality.

• Working knowledge of clinical trial data workflows, source documentation, EDC/CRF systems, and query management processes.

• Ability to interpret and follow study protocols, completion guidelines, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and study-specific requirements.

• Effective organizational and time management skills, including the ability to prioritize work across multiple studies, visits, deadlines, and competing data needs.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to follow up on open items and work effectively with site teams, study teams, monitors, Sponsors, and cross-functional partners.

• Ability to spot data discrepancies, documentation gaps, and recurring quality issues, and raise or help resolve them appropriately.

• Comfort working independently in a remote setting while staying accurate, productive, and responsive.

• Proficiency with common office and productivity tools, including spreadsheets, shared trackers, email, collaboration platforms, and study related systems.

• Commitment to confidentiality, appropriate handling of clinical research information, and adherence to applicable quality and compliance expectations.

Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience

• Minimum Education: Minimum high school diploma or GED required; associate degree or bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, clinical research, data management, or a related field preferred.

• Minimum Experience: 2+ years experience in clinical research, clinical trial support, healthcare operations, data coordination, data entry, quality control, or a related role preferred. Experience reviewing, entering, reconciling, or maintaining structured data using electronic systems, spreadsheets, trackers, or databases. Experience working with confidential or regulated information and an understanding of the importance of accuracy, documentation quality, and proper information handling. Familiarity with electronic data capture systems, case report forms, clinical source documentation, query resolution preferred. Experience working with internal teams, site staff, monitors, Sponsors, CROs, or other cross-functional partners to resolve documentation, data, or operational follow-up items preferred. GCP, clinical research, healthcare, or data management experience preferred, but not essential.

How We Work Together

• Location: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.

• Travel: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.

jobs.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER ANALYST III |  BACKOPS OPERAT MG
jobs.description:
Conheça o Inter
Pioneiros, mudamos o mercado ao lançar o primeiro banco digital do Brasil e seguimos criando tendências com tecnologia de ponta. Evoluímos para um Super App Financeiro Global, com soluções completas e inovação de primeira. Aqui, o trabalho tem propósito: construir oportunidades reais, transformar a vida das pessoas e o mercado financeiro. Esse é o nosso Jeito Inter de Fazer. Se você quer fazer parte dessa mudança e deixar um legado, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem ser Sangue Laranja.

Get to Know Inter
As pioneers, we transformed the market by launching Brazil’s first digital bank and continue to shape the future with cutting-edge technology.
We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.
This is the Inter way of making things happen. If you want to be part of this transformation and leave your mark, your place is here.

Become Sangue Laranja.

Sobre a vaga e missão do cargo

Você fará parte da equipe de Shopping Digital Media & Portal, dentro da diretoria de Product Engineering do Inter&Co. Nosso time é responsável pela construção e evolução do núcleo operacional e financeiro do Inter Shop, gerenciando microsserviços relacionados à gestão administrativa, cálculo e conciliação de comissões (take rate), repasses financeiros a sellers, motor de benefícios e cashback, bem como o pós-venda, que inclui estornos, cancelamentos e integração com CRM/adquirentes, além de alertas de campanhas e integrações contábeis (SAP/COSIF/SOX).

Sua missão será desenvolver soluções backend de alta performance, seguras e escaláveis utilizando Java/Micronaut. Você trabalhará em uma cultura de engenharia moderna e AI-First, onde implementamos agentes de IA e automações inteligentes para potencializar nossa produtividade durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento e criar produtos internos cada vez mais autônomos.

No seu dia a dia, você vai:

• Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar microsserviços em Java (21/25) com Micronaut, aplicando arquitetura limpa (Clean Flow), abordagem Contract-First (OpenAPI/Swagger) e processamento concorrente com Virtual Threads.

• Construir e manter fluxos financeiros e operacionais críticos do marketplace: cálculo de comissões (take rate), repasses e débitos de sellers, gestão de cashback/benefícios, estornos em lote, workflows de aprovação (maker-checker) e conciliação contábil (SAP/SOX).

• Modelar dados transacionais no AWS DynamoDB, construir consultas paginadas, filtros e agregações de alto desempenho no OpenSearch e utilizar Redis para cache e locks distribuídos.

• Desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento assíncrono em lote utilizando AWS SQS, SNS e S3 (incluindo geração e leitura de relatórios operacionais e financeiros).

• Trabalhar em um fluxo de Engenharia aumentada por IA (AI-Assisted Development), utilizando ferramentas como Cursor IDE, agentes de IA e integrações via MCP (Model Context Protocol) para acelerar diagnósticos, escrita de testes, refatorações e revisões de código, além de contribuir em funcionalidades que integram IA Generativa (LLMs) aos nossos serviços.

• Garantir a excelência técnica das entregas com testes automatizados (JUnit 5, Mockito), testes de mutação (PITest), validação arquitetural (ArchUnit), análise estática no SonarQube e Code Reviews ativos no GitLab.

• Acompanhar deploys via GitOps (Argo CD) em Kubernetes (EKS), configurar rotas no InterGateway e monitorar a saúde dos serviços em produção (Brasil e US Branch) usando Grafana (Loki, Mimir, Tempo) e OpenTelemetry.

O que buscamos

Obrigatórios:

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend com Java (Java 11, 17 ou 21+), dominando orientação a objetos, Streams, coleções, tratamento de exceções

• Vivência prática com frameworks modernos para microsserviços (Micronaut e/ou Spring Boot).

• Experiência na construção e documentação de APIs RESTful (OpenAPI/Swagger) e integrações entre microsserviços com autenticação OAuth2 / JWT.

• Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados NoSQL (especialmente AWS DynamoDB ou similares) e/ou motores de busca distribuídos (OpenSearch / Elasticsearch).

• Experiência com mensageria e processamento assíncrono (AWS SQS, SNS, Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e armazenamento em nuvem (AWS S3).

• Domínio de testes automatizados (JUnit 5, Mockito), Git, pipelines de CI/CD e padrões de qualidade de código (Clean Code, SOLID, SonarQube).

• Vivência ou interesse prático no uso de ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento de software (como Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude/LLMs), com senso crítico para validar arquitetura, segurança e qualidade do código gerado.

Desejáveis:

• Experiência prévia com Micronaut Framework, Java 21/25 (Virtual Threads), ArchUnit e PITest (Mutation Testing).

• Experiência avançada com queries e agregações no OpenSearch / Elasticsearch e modelagem no DynamoDB.

• Vivência em domínios de Marketplace / E-commerce, Meios de Pagamento, Split Financeiro, Cashback, Pós-venda (Estornos/Chargeback) ou sistemas sujeitos a controles SOX / Contábeis (SAP/COSIF).

• Experiência prática com observabilidade e investigação de incidentes em produção usando Grafana (LogQL/Loki, PromQL/Mimir, Tempo) e OpenTelemetry.

• Conhecimento em ecossistema Cloud Native: Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Istio (Service Mesh), API Gateways e GitOps (Argo CD).

• Experiência com engenharia de contexto para agentes de IA (Rules, Skills, MCPs) ou integração de APIs de IA Generativa (LLMs / AWS Bedrock) em aplicações backend.

• Inglês técnico para leitura/escrita de código, documentação e atuação em contexto multi-região (Brasil e US Branch).

Benefícios

• Vale-alimentação e Vale-refeição

• Plano de saúde e odontológico

• Seguro de vida

• DayOff de Aniversário

• Baby On Board e Sala de Amamentação

• Licença parental estendida

• Auxílio-creche/babá e/ou auxílio para filhos com deficiência

• Wellhub e Grupo de Corrida Inter

• Espaço CARE4U (Belo Horizonte): serviços de autocuidado com valores exclusivos, área de descompressão, jogos e minicampo de golfe

• Vantagens no nosso SuperApp, como Duo Gourmet

• Cartão Prime Inter

• Programas de treinamento e capacitação internos

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

• Triagem de currículos;

• Screening (abordagem inicial para alinhamento de expectativas sobre a vaga);

• Assessments;

• Entrevista com Time de Talent;

• Entrevista com a liderança;

jobs.title: Medical Assistant - Medical Oncology Full-time Days
jobs.description:
The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

• Assures efficient patient flow through the site: Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination. Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards. Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information. Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms. Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit. Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient. Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.
• Assists practitioner with medical and surgical procedures in accordance with established protocols such as: Electrocardiogram (ECG), venipuncture, immunizations, setting up procedure trays, specimen collection and/or Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) waived testing as directed by Provider.
• Provides high quality care by: Prepares and stocks all exam rooms in treatment area by following established protocols for disinfecting and sterilizing equipment and instruments. Participates in environmental safety rounds. Maintains vaccine/medication inventory. Monitors and maintains equipment and instruments according to clinic guidelines. Assists in ordering supplies and correctly disposes of all expired items. Adheres to office opening and closing procedures.
• Functions as an integral part of the patient care team and promotes patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner: Accepts and performs delegated responsibilities in a positive manner. Offers assistance to others. Attends and participates in staff meetings. Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone)
• Performs delegated procedures common to the specialty area in a safe, effective, and efficient manner (see specialty practice addendum)
• Performs all other duties as assigned by the Supervisor or Manager

Required:

• High school diploma or GED.
• Current certification in one of the below or must have written proof of meeting candidate eligibility requirements for writing one of the five eligible certification exams (AAMA, AMT, NCCT, NHA, NRCMA)Accepted documentation:New MA Graduates within six (6) months from date of graduation from an MA Program must submit: a letter from the school or a letter from the certifying bodyNon-Certified MAs or new graduates past six (6) months from date of graduation from an MA program must submit: a letter from the certifying bodyWithin first six months of employment, will complete one of the following certifications after up to two test attempts:Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through American Medical Technologists (AMT) orNational Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) through the National Healthcareer Association (NHA)Nationally Registered Certified Medical Assistant (NRCMA) through the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP)Signed acknowledgement during onboarding that certification must be attained within six (6) months, as a condition of employment
• American Heart Association accredited Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) certification.
• Zero (0) to two (2) years’ experience in a relevant role.
• Strong computer skills.

Preferred:

• Completion of accredited Medical Assistant training program.
• One to two years of ambulatory care experience.
• Experience with electronic medical record.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

Build your sales career with a path toward agency ownership.

At the Nicholas Myers Agency - Farmers Insurance, you’ll earn a base salary plus commissions while developing your skills alongside an experienced Farmers Insurance agency owner. We’re looking for someone who wants to succeed in sales today and work toward building a business of their own.

Whether you have insurance experience or are bringing strong skills from another industry, you’ll receive coaching, licensing support, and hands-on experience helping clients protect what matters most.
